# What is Embossing?

Embossing raises your logo off the surface. Here is how the dies work and how to pair it with foil or Spot UV.

By Sarah AshleyAugust 25, 2026

![What is Embossing?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/what-is-embossing.webp)

Embossing raises selected parts of your artwork above the surface, giving them a three-dimensional texture you can see and feel. You have likely run your fingers over it on business cards, book covers and premium boxes. Here is how embossing works, why brands use it and how it differs from debossing.

## How Embossing Works

Embossing uses two tools: a die and a press. The die is a pair of metal plates, a front plate and a back plate (the counter-die), that sandwich the paper or board to form the shape. The process runs like this:

1. Prepare the die. A male and a female die are made from your logo, text or artwork.
2. Position the material. The stock sits between the two dies. For embossing, the female die is on top and the male die works as the counter-die underneath.
3. Apply heat and pressure. The press pushes the material into the die.
4. Create the raised design. The selected area now stands above the surrounding surface.
5. Choose blind or combination embossing. With no ink or foil, it is called blind embossing and relies on texture alone. Combined with ink or metallic foil, it is called registered or combination embossing.
6. Inspect the result. Check depth, alignment and sharpness so the design looks clean and consistent.

## Embossing vs Debossing

Embossing and [debossing](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/blog/what-is-debossing/) are two sides of the same coin: one raises the design, the other presses it in.

| Feature | Embossing | Debossing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Effect | Raised above the surface | Pressed into the surface |
| Appearance | Makes logos, text or patterns stand out | Gives an engraved look |
| Die position | Male die pushes the material up into the female die | Male die presses the material down into the female die |
| Texture | Noticeably raised | Deep and indented |
| Best for | Logos, brand names, patterns, premium packaging | Minimal logos, typography, subtle designs |
| Ink or foil | Can be combined with ink or foil | Can be combined with ink or foil |
| Overall look | Bold, prominent, premium | Subtle, elegant, refined |

## Benefits of Embossing

- Better brand visibility: raised logos and graphics catch the eye and make packaging memorable.
- A premium feel: the tactile finish makes boxes feel more refined and valuable.
- Focus on key elements: draw attention to a logo, product name or pattern without relying on extra ink.

## Conclusion

Embossing adds texture, depth and interest to printed materials and packaging. Used alone or with ink and foil, it helps your logo and artwork stand out and gives your boxes a premium finish customers can feel.

Want embossing on your boxes? It is available on all our [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/). [Get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/).

# What is Foil Stamping?

How hot and cold foil stamping work, which foils are available, and when a metallic finish is worth adding to your boxes.

By Sarah AshleyOctober 26, 2026

![What is Foil Stamping?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/foil-stamping-blog.webp)

Foil stamping adds a shiny, metallic finish to packaging, making logos, product names and artwork look premium. From luxury rigid boxes to everyday folding cartons, it can lift even a simple design. Here is how it works, the main types, its benefits and what to consider before you choose it.

## What Is Foil Stamping?

Foil stamping uses heat, pressure and a metal die to apply a thin layer of foil to a surface. It has been used since the late 19th century and is still a favorite for premium packaging. Like embossing, debossing and Spot UV, it adds visual appeal and raises perceived value. It works on many paper stocks, but smooth surfaces give the best results.

## How Foil Stamping Works

Unlike regular printing, foil stamping uses no liquid ink:

1. Prepare the design. A metal die is made from your artwork.
2. Choose the foil. Pick a color and finish to suit the design.
3. Apply heat and pressure. The heated die presses the foil onto the surface.
4. Transfer the foil. Heat activates the foil’s adhesive layer so it bonds to the material.
5. Reveal the result. The carrier film is peeled away, leaving a clean, shiny design.

It is ideal for logos, brand names, patterns and decorative details.

## Types of Foil Stamping

### Hot foil stamping

The most common method, using a heated metal die on paperboard, cardboard and other surfaces. Popular for custom boxes, cosmetic packaging and gift boxes.

### Cold foil stamping

Uses adhesive and pressure instead of a heated die; the foil sticks wherever adhesive is applied. Common for labels, folding cartons and high-volume runs.

### Digital foil stamping

Applies foil digitally without a metal die, which suits short runs, personalized packaging and designs that change often.

## Benefits for Custom Packaging

- It stands out: foil catches the light and draws the eye to key details.
- It looks premium: gold and silver foils especially add a luxury feel.
- It highlights what matters: your logo, product name or a message, without covering the whole box.
- It is flexible: many colors and finishes, and it pairs well with embossing or debossing.
- It works in every industry: from cosmetics to jewelry.

## Which Materials Work With Foil?

| Material | Suitability |
| --- | --- |
| Smooth paperboard | Excellent for detailed foil designs |
| Rigid box wrapping paper | Ideal for premium packaging |
| Coated cardstock | Clean foil finish |
| Kraft paper | Works well with the right foil and settings |
| Corrugated board | Best on smooth liners or wrapped surfaces |
| Textured paper | Needs testing for consistent results |

Smooth, even surfaces give the best results. Rough materials may need special dies, foils or heat and pressure adjustments.

## Foil Stamping vs Embossing vs Spot UV

| Technique | Main effect |
| --- | --- |
| Foil stamping | Adds metallic or colored foil |
| Embossing | Creates a raised design |
| Debossing | Creates a pressed-in design |
| Spot UV | Adds gloss to selected areas |

These can be combined. Embossed foil, for example, creates a raised metallic logo customers can see and feel.

## What to Consider Before Choosing Foil

- Design size: small text and fine details need care to transfer cleanly.
- Material: smoother surfaces give better results.
- Foil color: choose one that contrasts with the background.
- Quantity: hot foil needs a die, which adds setup cost to small orders.
- Placement: keep foil details away from folds, creases and cut edges.

Ask for a sample or proof to check color, placement and overall look before a bulk run.

## Final Thoughts

Gold, silver or holographic, foil stamping adds shine and a premium touch to custom packaging. The best results depend on your material, artwork and method. [Get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/) to add foil to your boxes.

## FAQs

### Is foil stamping expensive?

It can cost more than standard printing because it may need a custom die and extra production steps. The price depends on the design, foil type and quantity.

### Can foil be applied to cardboard boxes?

Yes, especially smooth paperboard and coated surfaces. Rough corrugated board may need special preparation.

### What is the difference between gold foil and gold ink?

Gold foil gives a reflective metallic finish. Gold ink is a printed color; metallic inks reflect some light but look different from foil.

### Is foil stamping suitable for small orders?

Yes. Digital foil stamping needs no metal die, which suits small runs. Availability and cost vary by manufacturer.

### Can foil stamping be combined with embossing?

Yes. Together they create raised metallic designs, often used for luxury logos.

# What Is Kraft Paper? The Complete Guide to Eco-Friendly Packaging

How kraft paper is made, the brown, white and black options, and why it is a favorite for eco-friendly brands.

By Sarah AshleyAugust 4, 2025

![What Is Kraft Paper? The Complete Guide to Eco-Friendly Packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/what-is-kraft-paper.webp)

Packaging has become a strategic brand tool, and eco-conscious buyers want packaging that is sustainable, versatile and attractive. Kraft paper delivers all three: strength, recyclability and a rustic look that appeals to modern shoppers. Whether you run a bakery, a luxury candle brand or an industrial business, here is what you need to know about kraft paper.

## What Is Kraft Paper Made Of?

“Kraft” is German for strength. Kraft paper gets its durability from the kraft pulping process, which chemically treats wood pulp while keeping long fibers for excellent tear resistance.

- Raw materials: virgin pulp from softwoods such as pine and spruce, and recycled pulp.
- Process: chlorine-free bleaching where bleached, and blends of virgin and recycled fiber.
- Types: natural brown (unbleached), bleached white and coated kraft (poly-coated, wax-coated or laminated).

## Kraft Paper vs Regular Paper

The difference comes down to pulping and fiber strength. Kraft keeps more lignin and longer fibers, so it is stronger and tougher. Regular paper is heavily bleached and refined, making it smoother and better for writing and printing, but weaker.

| Feature | Kraft paper | Regular paper |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Production | Kraft pulping (sodium hydroxide and sodium sulfide) keeps lignin and long fibers | Heavily bleached and refined, with shorter fibers |
| Strength | High tensile and tear strength; handles heavy loads | Weaker; tears and crumples easily |
| Appearance | Natural brown, textured; can be bleached or coated | Smooth white or off-white |
| Sustainability | Biodegradable, compostable, highly recyclable | More chemicals and energy from bleaching |

## Sustainability and Certifications

Kraft paper is naturally biodegradable, can be recycled several times and is compostable. Look for these certifications and standards:

- FSC (Forest Stewardship Council)
- PEFC (Programme for the Endorsement of Forest Certification)
- EN 13432 (EU compostability)
- ASTM D6400 (US compostability)

Demand for kraft continues to grow worldwide, driven by e-commerce and sustainability rules.

## What Is Kraft Paper Used For?

- Food packaging: food-contact kraft for bakery bags, sandwich wraps and takeaway bags, and kraft board for [bakery](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/), [burger](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/burger-boxes/) and [fry](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/french-fry-boxes/) boxes. Greasy foods need food-safe grease-resistant coatings.
- Retail: grocery and boutique bags, gift wrap and kraft board for [candle](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/candle-boxes/), retail and display boxes, popular for minimalist brands. See [custom paper bags](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-paper-bags/).
- E-commerce: paper mailers, protective wrap, void fill and liners for corrugated [mailer boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/).
- Industrial: multiwall sack kraft bags for cement, fertilizer, feed, seeds and powders.
- Protective wrapping: wrapping fragile items, separating products and cushioning gaps in cartons.

## Printing and Finishing on Kraft

- Digital printing: easy design changes and personalization such as names, QR codes and seasonal graphics.
- Flexographic printing: works well on rough kraft surfaces and long runs, popular for bags.
- Offset printing: precise color and high-quality results for premium kraft packaging.
- Inks: soy-based and water-based inks for sustainability.
- Finishes: Spot UV, aqueous coating or varnish for protection; embossing and debossing for texture; foil stamping for luxury.

- Strength: high tensile strength resists tears and punctures, in grades from light wraps to heavy sacks, with coatings for moisture and oil resistance.
- Eco branding: certified, recyclable material that builds trust with eco-aware customers.
- Customization: easily made into printed [kraft boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/kraft-boxes/) that carry your brand story.

- Practical advantages: available in rolls, sheets and bulk boxes, with custom designs and premium finishes.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Rigid stock (1.5–3 mm) | Premium gifts, luxury | Excellent | Varies |
| Corrugated (E/B flute) | Shipping protection | Basic to digital | Recyclable |
| SBS paperboard | Mid to premium retail | Sharp, high detail | Recyclable |

Kraft paper stands for sustainability, strength and branding flexibility. From industrial sacks to luxury boxes, it adapts to almost every need and keeps eco-conscious customers engaged. [Get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/) for kraft packaging.

### What is kraft paper made of?

Wood pulp, virgin softwood and/or recycled, processed with the kraft pulping method, which keeps long fibers for strength.

### What types of kraft paper are there?

Natural brown, bleached white and coated kraft (poly, wax or laminated).

### How is kraft different from regular paper?

Kraft keeps more lignin and longer fibers, making it stronger. Regular paper is bleached and smoother for printing but tears more easily.

### Is kraft paper biodegradable?

Yes. Uncoated kraft is biodegradable and compostable, and can meet EN 13432 and ASTM D6400 standards.

How kraft paper is made, the brown, white and black options, and why it is a favorite for eco-friendly brands.

By Sarah AshleyAugust 4, 2025

![What Is Kraft Paper? The Complete Guide to Eco-Friendly Packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/what-is-kraft-paper.webp)

Packaging has become a strategic brand tool, and eco-conscious buyers want packaging that is sustainable, versatile and attractive. Kraft paper delivers all three: strength, recyclability and a rustic look that appeals to modern shoppers. Whether you run a bakery, a luxury candle brand or an industrial business, here is what you need to know about kraft paper.

sections.title: What Is Kraft Paper Made Of?
sections.content:
“Kraft” is German for strength. Kraft paper gets its durability from the kraft pulping process, which chemically treats wood pulp while keeping long fibers for excellent tear resistance.

- Raw materials: virgin pulp from softwoods such as pine and spruce, and recycled pulp.
- Process: chlorine-free bleaching where bleached, and blends of virgin and recycled fiber.
- Types: natural brown (unbleached), bleached white and coated kraft (poly-coated, wax-coated or laminated).

sections.title: Kraft Paper vs Regular Paper
sections.content:
The difference comes down to pulping and fiber strength. Kraft keeps more lignin and longer fibers, so it is stronger and tougher. Regular paper is heavily bleached and refined, making it smoother and better for writing and printing, but weaker.

| Feature | Kraft paper | Regular paper |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Production | Kraft pulping (sodium hydroxide and sodium sulfide) keeps lignin and long fibers | Heavily bleached and refined, with shorter fibers |
| Strength | High tensile and tear strength; handles heavy loads | Weaker; tears and crumples easily |
| Appearance | Natural brown, textured; can be bleached or coated | Smooth white or off-white |
| Sustainability | Biodegradable, compostable, highly recyclable | More chemicals and energy from bleaching |

sections.title: Sustainability and Certifications
sections.content:
Kraft paper is naturally biodegradable, can be recycled several times and is compostable. Look for these certifications and standards:

- FSC (Forest Stewardship Council)
- PEFC (Programme for the Endorsement of Forest Certification)
- EN 13432 (EU compostability)
- ASTM D6400 (US compostability)

# What Is Packaging Design?

What packaging design is, its key elements and types, how it shapes your brand, and the mistakes to avoid.

By Sarah AshleyNovember 11, 2026

![What Is Packaging Design?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/the-ultimate-packaging-design.webp)

Every product needs packaging, but not every package is designed to win attention, build trust and leave a lasting impression. Packaging design is what turns a plain box, bottle or container into a marketing tool that shapes how customers see a product and whether they choose it over the alternatives.

For startups and global brands alike, good packaging design protects the product, communicates key information and builds a recognizable brand. Here is what it is, why it matters and how to get it right.

## What Is Packaging Design?

Packaging design is the process of creating both the look and the physical structure of a product’s packaging. It brings design, branding, marketing and function together, so the result looks appealing, protects the product and improves the customer experience.

## Why Packaging Design Matters

Packaging is often a customer’s first physical contact with your brand, and that first impression can shape a buying decision in seconds.

- It makes a strong first impression. Professional packaging builds confidence. Dated or generic packaging does the opposite.
- It helps products stand out. Color, graphics, structure and branding catch attention on crowded shelves and marketplaces. Distinctive [shelf-ready boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/shelf-ready-boxes/), for example, make products easier to notice and remember.
- It builds trust. Customers link quality packaging with quality products, especially when the box feels sturdy and the information is clear.
- It keeps marketing working. Packaging repeats your key benefits and brand message long after an ad has been seen.
- It improves the experience. The experience begins when the box is seen, opened and handled. Thoughtful packaging makes customers feel valued, which encourages loyalty and recommendations.

## The Key Elements of Packaging Design

### Color

Color is usually the first thing people notice, and it carries meaning. Black often suggests luxury, green suggests nature and sustainability, red brings energy, blue signals trust and white feels clean and simple. Pick colors that speak to your audience.

### Typography

Good typography is easy to read, matches your brand personality, balances the layout and guides the eye to key information. A premium brand might choose elegant type, while a tech brand might prefer clean, simple fonts.

### Graphics and imagery

Illustrations, photos, icons, patterns and custom artwork tell your product’s story. They should support the design, not overwhelm it.

### Structure

Shape, size and opening style all affect the experience. A creative structure can make a product easier to use and more noticeable on the shelf. Explore our [box styles](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/box-by-style/).

### Materials

Materials affect durability, appearance and sustainability. Choose paperboard, rigid stock, glass, metal or another option based on your product, budget and positioning. See our [materials guide](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/materials/).

### Product information

Name, benefits, ingredients, instructions, safety information and barcodes should be clear, organized and easy to find.

## What Makes Packaging Both Attractive and Functional?

Looks alone aren’t enough. The best packaging balances appearance with practicality. Focus on:

- Clear hierarchy: brand name, product name and key benefits should be obvious at a glance.
- Protection: the structure must prevent damage in shipping, storage and handling.
- Ease of use: easy-open closures, resealable features and comfortable shapes.
- Shelf presence: distinctive colors, shapes and branding.
- Quality materials that suit both the product and the brand.
- Readable information with clear type and good spacing.
- Consistent branding in colors, logo and visual style.
- Practicality: easy to store, transport, open and dispose of.
- Sustainability: eco-friendly materials and minimal structures that reduce waste.
- A memorable unboxing: custom inserts, branded tissue and careful presentation.

## Types of Packaging Design

Packaging that suits a luxury skincare line won’t suit frozen food or medicine. Choose a design approach based on how and where your product is sold, displayed, shipped and used.

| Type | Main purpose | Key features | Common industries |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Retail | Attract shoppers on the shelf | Bold graphics, strong branding, eye-catching color | Cosmetics, electronics, snacks, beverages |
| E-commerce | Protect products in shipping | Durable materials, inserts, branded mailers | Online retail, subscriptions, DTC brands |
| Luxury | Create a premium perception | Rigid boxes, foil, embossing, magnetic closures | Jewelry, cosmetics, fragrance, gifts |
| Food | Keep food fresh and safe | Barrier protection, nutrition labels, tamper evidence | Food and beverage |
| Pharmaceutical | Ensure safety and compliance | Clear instructions, secure closures, regulatory labels | Healthcare and medicine |
| Promotional | Support campaigns | Limited editions, seasonal themes, custom print | Retail, FMCG, seasonal products |
| Sustainable | Reduce environmental impact | Recyclable materials, minimal structures, eco inks | Organic, beauty, food, retail |

Whatever the type, the most effective packaging combines function, protection and visual appeal.

## How Packaging Design Connects to Branding

Many customers will never visit your website or speak to your team, but they will handle your packaging. That makes it one of your most visible brand tools.

- First impressions: colors, materials and graphics instantly signal what your brand stands for, whether luxury, sophistication or sustainability.
- Recognition: using the same colors, type, logo and style across your range helps customers spot your products and buy again. The world’s best-known brands are recognizable from their packaging alone.
- Values: sustainable brands lean on recyclable materials and natural colors, luxury brands on premium finishes, wellness brands on calm, clean layouts, and innovative brands on bold structures.
- Emotion: packaging that creates anticipation and delight builds stronger relationships.
- Long-term growth: packaging keeps working after the sale when it is shared, recommended and recognized next time. Treat [custom packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) as part of your marketing, not just a container.

## Common Packaging Design Mistakes

- Putting looks before function. If products break in transit, appearance doesn’t matter.
- Too much information. Too many graphics, fonts or messages hide what matters. Simpler usually works better.
- Ignoring your audience. What appeals to one audience may not appeal to another.
- Inconsistent branding. Frequently changing colors, logos or styles weakens recognition.
- The wrong materials. Poor material choices hurt durability, protection and perception.
- Poor readability. Use clear type and strong contrast for essential details.
- Overlooking sustainability. Excess packaging and waste can damage your brand image.

## The Takeaway

Packaging design is far more than decoration. It combines creativity, strategy, function and branding to protect your product, attract attention, support your marketing and create memorable experiences. Done well, it becomes one of the most powerful tools for building a brand.

Need help designing yours? Our design support is free. [Get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/) or read our [packaging design checklist](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/blog/packaging-design-checklist/).

## FAQs

### What is packaging design?

The process of creating the look, structure and function of a product’s packaging, combining branding, marketing and protection.

### Why is packaging design important?

It attracts attention, builds trust, communicates brand values and influences buying decisions, while improving satisfaction and recognition.

### What are the key elements of packaging design?

Color, typography, graphics, materials, structure, product information and branding.

### How does packaging design affect branding?

Packaging is a physical expression of your brand. Consistent colors, logos, materials and messaging help customers recognize it and connect with it.

# What Is Packaging? A Complete Guide for Beginners and Businesses

The basics of packaging: what it does, the main types and materials, and how to plan packaging for your products.

By Sarah AshleyMarch 5, 2026

![What Is Packaging? A Complete Guide for Beginners and Businesses](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/what-is-packaging.webp)

Packaging is a product’s first impression. It is protection, branding and experience in one, and today it also has to meet regulations, sustainability goals and customer expectations. Whether you are a student, a curious reader or a business planning a launch, this beginner’s guide explains what packaging is and answers the most common questions.

## What Is Packaging?

Packaging is the system of enclosing and presenting products using materials, design and structure, so they can be protected, stored, transported and marketed. It covers material choice, shape, labeling, branding and function.

Packaging vs packing: packaging is the materials, structure and design that hold and present a product. Packing is the process of preparing packaged goods for storage, shipping or distribution. Packaging is the strategic part that shapes branding and customer experience.

## The Key Roles of Packaging

- Protection: shields products from damage, contamination and tampering in transport, storage and handling. Specialized options include cold-chain packaging and [inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) for fragile electronics.
- Brand communication: carries product details, certifications and brand identity. Eco labels like FSC reassure buyers, and interactive features can tell your story.
- Convenience: resealable bags, handles and sturdy boxes make products easier to use and store, which drives repeat purchases.
- Sustainability: reducing waste through circular design, refills and recyclable materials.

## Types of Packaging

### Primary packaging

The product’s first skin: the container customers touch, open and use. It keeps the product safe, clean and usable and carries key information like ingredients, directions and expiry dates, so materials must be safe, durable and ideally sustainable. Examples: juice cartons, yogurt cups, toothpaste tubes and perfume bottles.

### Secondary packaging

The brand’s stage. It groups and protects primary packs and is often what shoppers see first on shelves or online. Examples: the carton around a toothpaste tube, branded sleeves and perfume boxes. These are the [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) you see in retail.

### Tertiary packaging

The workhorse of logistics, built for bulk handling, transport and warehousing rather than the shopper’s eye. Examples: shipping cartons, stretch-wrapped pallets and large corrugated boxes.

| Type | Purpose | Visibility to shoppers | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary | Holds the product; safety, freshness, usability | High | Juice cartons, yogurt cups, tubes, perfume bottles |
| Secondary | Groups and protects; adds branding | Medium | Folding cartons, custom boxes, sleeves |
| Tertiary | Bulk handling, transport, storage | Low | Shipping cartons, pallets, large corrugated boxes |

Together they form one system: primary protects the product, secondary builds the brand and tertiary powers logistics. Read more in [types of packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/blog/types-of-packaging/).

## Packaging Materials

| Material | Strengths | Common uses | Sustainability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Paper and paperboard | Light, affordable, printable, recyclable | Corrugated boxes, folding cartons, kraft bags, rigid boxes | High |
| Plastic (PET, HDPE, LDPE) | Flexible, durable, strong moisture and oxygen barrier | Food containers, bottles, pouches, wraps | Medium |
| Glass | Non-reactive, preserves purity, premium, recyclable | Beverages, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals | High |
| Metal | Strong, long shelf life, highly recyclable | Cans, tins, specialty products | High |
| Biodegradable and compostable | Reduces waste, supports green branding | Molded pulp trays, compostable films | High |

See our [materials guide](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/materials/) for the box materials we offer.

## Structural Types of Packaging

- Rigid: strong and premium, like [rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/) for luxury goods or glass bottles.
- Flexible: light and cost-effective, like pouches, films and sachets, which reduce shipping costs.
- Semi-rigid: a balance of strength and flexibility, like blister packs and meal trays.
- Custom structures: die-cut inserts, folding cartons and modular designs for irregular shapes and better unboxing.

## Regulatory Standards

Compliant packaging protects safety, credibility and market access, while non-compliance risks fines, recalls and reputational damage. Key standards include:

- ISO 9001: quality management
- ISO 14001: environmental management
- FDA regulations: food and pharmaceutical safety in the US
- EU packaging waste rules: recycling and waste reduction
- REACH: chemical safety in materials

## What Makes Good Packaging?

- Function: protects in transit and storage, with easy-open, resealable or stackable designs.
- Compliance: meets every applicable standard.
- Sustainability: renewable or biodegradable materials and a smaller footprint.
- Creativity: stands out on shelves, with options like smart labels for engagement. See [what is packaging design?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/blog/what-is-packaging-design/)
- Efficiency: optimized for shipping, stacking, storage and recycling.

## How Much Does Packaging Cost?

Material drives most of the cost. Paper bags and kraft boxes can cost just cents per unit; plastic pouches range from cents to under a dollar; glass runs roughly $0.50–2 and metal tins $0.30–1.50; luxury rigid boxes with magnets or foil can reach $3–10 per unit. Digital printing suits short runs, offset suits bulk, and finishes add cost but lift perception. Eco materials may add around 10–20% upfront, often recovered through loyalty and premium positioning. For a full breakdown, read [how much does packaging cost?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/blog/how-much-does-packaging-cost/)

Smart businesses don’t just ask “how much?” but “what value does this packaging create?”

## Packaging Needs by Industry

- Food and beverage: freshness, contamination prevention, cold chain and compostable options. See [food boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/).
- Pharmaceuticals: FDA and EU compliance, child-resistant and tamper-evident features.
- Cosmetics and luxury: premium finishes like magnetic closures, foil and embossing, plus FSC paper and refills. See [cosmetic boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/).
- Electronics: shock and static protection with foam inserts, pulp trays and anti-static films.
- E-commerce: boxes that survive shipping and create memorable unboxings, with inserts, sleeves and QR codes. See [mailer boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/).

## Emerging Packaging Technology

- Augmented reality for interactive experiences
- Blockchain for supply chain transparency and anti-counterfeiting
- RFID and NFC for smart logistics and engagement

## The Takeaway

Packaging is a strategic system that protects products, communicates your brand and enhances the customer experience. In every industry, good packaging protects, persuades and positions your product for success. [Get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/) for yours.

## FAQs

### What is packaging?

The system of enclosing and presenting products using materials, design and structure.

### What is its main purpose?

To protect products from damage and contamination while communicating brand identity and product information.

### What are the types of packaging?

Primary (holds the product), secondary (groups and brands) and tertiary (bulk handling and shipping).

### What materials are used?

Paper and paperboard, plastics (PET, HDPE, LDPE), glass, metal and biodegradable options like molded pulp and compostable films.

### What compliance standards apply?

Common ones include ISO 9001, ISO 14001, FDA regulations and EU packaging waste rules.

# What is Rigid Stock & Its Importance in Luxury Packaging?

Rigid stock is the thick chipboard behind luxury boxes. Learn the grades, thicknesses and why premium brands choose it.

By Sarah AshleySeptember 3, 2026

![What is Rigid Stock & Its Importance in Luxury Packaging?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-stock-in-luxury-packaging.webp)

What makes luxury packaging stand out? A famous name helps, but much of the effect comes from the material: rigid stock. Its strength and premium look are what give high-end boxes their presence. Here is what rigid stock is and why it matters for luxury packaging.

## What Is Rigid Stock?

Rigid stock is a premium packaging material made by combining two layers with different jobs: thick cardstock or chipboard, which gives the box a sturdy base, and a paper wrap, which carries the printing. Together they create a durable board for luxury boxes.

It is the right choice for brands that want to make a lasting impression and show a commitment to quality and an unforgettable unboxing.

## How Rigid Stock Is Made

Layers of board are compressed into a rigid structure of at least 300 GSM. For a heavy-duty, premium feel we recommend 800 to 2000 GSM, depending on product weight.

The board forms the structure only. A paper stock of your choice is printed, finished and then wrapped around the rigid box to create the final luxury look.

## Key Features of Rigid Stock

- Durability and strength: a thick, dense core resists bending, pressure and impact in handling, storage and shipping.
- High-quality printing: the smooth paper wrap carries logos, detailed artwork, patterns and product information with clear, vivid color.
- Stability: it holds its shape under pressure, in transit, in storage and on the shelf.
- Premium appearance: the thick structure and smooth surface look luxurious, especially with premium finishes.
- Versatility: suitable for chocolates, cosmetics, jewelry, electronics and luxury gifts.
- Availability: widely available in many thicknesses, wraps, colors, styles and finishes.

## Types of Rigid Stock

### Grey chipboard

Made from recycled paper fibers, with a grey finish. Its thick, dense structure protects products and holds the box shape, and it is usually wrapped in printed specialty paper for gifts, jewelry and cosmetics.

### Thick cardboard

A broad term for dense paperboard used in sturdy packaging. Solid board resists bending and is wrapped in printed paper for gifts, electronics and luxury products.

### Duplex chipboard

Usually white on one side and grey on the back. The coated side prints logos and artwork clearly. Choose the right thickness or a laminated build for enough strength.

### Kraft chipboard

A natural brown board with a simple, earthy look and a firm structure, ideal for minimal designs with a logo, paper wrap or finish.

## Benefits of Rigid Stock

- Protects products from bending, crushing and damage.
- Keeps the box shape for a neat, sturdy presentation.
- Supports custom printing, paper wraps and decorative finishes.
- Creates a memorable unboxing experience.
- Encourages customers to reuse the box for storage.

## Conclusion

Rigid stock combines strength with premium presentation, which makes it ideal for luxury packaging. Its sturdy core protects products, and printed wraps carry your brand identity. Consider your product’s weight and needs when choosing board thickness, box style and finishes.

Explore our [rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/) or read [What is a rigid box?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/blog/what-is-a-rigid-box/) Then [get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/).

# What is Shelf Ready Packaging?

Shelf ready packaging goes from the truck to the shelf in one step. Here is how it works and why retailers ask for it.

By Sarah AshleyOctober 19, 2026

![What is Shelf Ready Packaging?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/shelf-ready-packaging.webp)

Retail shelves are where products compete for attention, and packaging now has to deliver presentation, speed and impact as well as protection. That is where shelf ready packaging (SRP) comes in: a system that moves products from warehouse to shelf in one step, saving time and money and helping sales. Here is how it works.

## What Is Shelf Ready Packaging?

Shelf ready packaging, also called retail ready packaging (RRP), goes straight onto the shelf without unpacking. It combines the strength of a shipping case with display appeal, and is perforated or designed to open easily to reveal the products inside.

SRP grew out of supermarkets’ need to restock faster and is now standard practice for many large retailers. Early versions were simple tear-away cases; today’s designs use CAD, pallet optimization and digital printing. In short, SRP is a retail strategy as much as a box. See our [shelf-ready boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/shelf-ready-boxes/).

## The “Five Easies” of SRP

Retailers judge SRP on five criteria:

- Easy to identify: clear labels, barcodes and graphics for fast placement.
- Easy to open: clean perforations or tear strips, no box cutters needed.
- Easy to shelve: fits standard shelf bays for fast stocking.
- Easy to shop: products are visible and easy to reach.
- Easy to dispose of: breaks down quickly for recycling.

These are design principles as well as retailer rules. A pack that is easy to shop is easier to sell.

## SRP Materials

| Material | Key properties | Ideal products | Sustainability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Corrugated board | Strong, light, cost-effective, many flute grades | Food, beverages, bulk goods | Highly recyclable |
| Paperboard | Smooth surface for premium print | Cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, retail items | Recyclable |
| Kraft | Natural brown, durable, rustic | Organic and eco brands | Recyclable, biodegradable |
| Rigid stock | Thick, durable, premium | Electronics, high-end cosmetics, gift sets | Reusable |

## Why Retailers Want SRP

- Faster restocking: a whole case goes on the shelf in one move.
- Lower labor costs: less time spent unpacking and arranging.
- Better presentation: neat, consistent displays and stronger visibility.
- Less damage and loss: products stay protected during stocking.

## Benefits for Brands

- Stronger branding at the point of sale, with full-color graphics and logos and no extra display spend.
- Consistent presentation in every store, building trust and recognition.
- More impulse buys, because products are easy to see and grab.
- Retailer preference: meeting SRP requirements makes you easier to stock.
- Sustainability reputation through recyclable materials.
- Shopper insight: QR codes on the case can drive engagement and loyalty campaigns.

## Common SRP Types

| Type | Description | Ideal products |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tray style | Lower tray with removable top | Snacks, biscuits, canned goods |
| Display boxes | Tear-away fronts reveal the products | Chocolates, cereals, beverages |
| Perforated tear-away | Quick-open perforated designs | Frozen food, multipacks, promo kits |
| Tuck-top boxes | Secure closure with a premium look | Cosmetics, premium tea, small electronics |
| Shrink-wrap formats | Clear film holds units together | Bottled water, soft drinks, multipacks |

Choose based on product and shopper behavior: tuck-tops suit premium cosmetics, while snacks thrive in grab-and-go trays. See [perforated boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/perforated-boxes/) and [PDQ boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/pdq-boxes/).

## CAD and Planogram Compliance

### CAD design

Engineers model SRP digitally before production, defining tray and tear-away dimensions, board strength (flute grade), fold and perforation performance and pallet efficiency. Simulation cuts trial and error and helps meet retailer standards before a box is printed.

### Planograms

A planogram is the retailer’s shelf blueprint. It sets shelf width, depth and height limits, the number of facings, barcode placement and product arrangement. Packaging that doesn’t comply can be rejected, so even small dimensional errors matter.

## Industries Using SRP

- Food and beverage: snacks, cereals, chocolate and canned goods.
- Cosmetics and beauty: skincare kits and makeup sets with strong shelf presence.
- Pharmaceuticals: clear labeling and easy disposal for over-the-counter products.
- Stationery: neatly organized small items for impulse purchases.
- CBD and wellness: compliant labeling and easy access. See [CBD display boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cbd-display-boxes/).
- Quick commerce: compact packs that work as both transport and display.

## Sustainability, Cost and Innovation

SRP can use recyclable, biodegradable and FSC-certified materials, and reduces waste and backroom handling. It saves labor, wholesale pricing makes it affordable at scale, and printing on the case can replace separate in-store displays. Newer designs add QR codes, NFC or RFID, and digital printing allows personalization.

## How to Implement SRP in 5 Steps

1. Audit your packaging to find which SKUs need SRP.
2. Check each retailer’s guidelines, since every chain has its own.
3. Work with packaging professionals to align CAD designs with pallet and shelf sizes.
4. Test prototypes in store for tear-away performance and shopper appeal.
5. Scale up sustainably with eco materials and digital print.

## The Takeaway

Shelf ready packaging is retail strategy. For retailers it means faster restocking, lower labor costs and consistent shelves; for brands it means stronger in-store branding, more impulse sales and progress on sustainability. [Get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/) for your SRP.

## FAQs

### What is shelf ready packaging?

Packaging that goes straight onto retail shelves without unpacking, combining transport strength with display appeal.

### Why do retailers require SRP?

It speeds up restocking, reduces labor and keeps shelves consistent.

### What are the Five Easies?

Easy to identify, open, shelve, shop and dispose of.

### How does SRP help brands?

Better in-store visibility, consistent presentation, more impulse sales and support for sustainability goals.

# What Is Spot UV & Why Do Brands Use It?

Spot UV adds a glossy, raised coat to selected areas. See why it works so well on matte and soft-touch boxes.

By Sarah AshleyAugust 20, 2026

![What Is Spot UV & Why Do Brands Use It?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/what-is-spot-uv-why-do-brands-use-it.webp)

Ever noticed glossy details on premium packaging that seem to jump out from the rest of the design? That is usually Spot UV, also called spot gloss or spot varnish. It adds a thick, clear coat to chosen parts of the artwork so they pop against the surrounding surface. Beauty, wellness and many other brands use it for a distinctive, high-end look.

## What Is Spot UV?

Spot UV is a specialty finish that applies a clear, glossy varnish to targeted areas of a printed design rather than the whole surface. Like lamination it improves how your print looks, but it highlights specific details instead of covering everything. On boxes it is most often used on:

- Logos
- Slogans
- Artwork details
- Images

## How Does Spot UV Work?

A clear coating is applied to selected areas of plain or printed stock, then cured instantly with ultraviolet light. The result is a glossy finish that deepens color, adds sheen and protects the surface from moisture and everyday wear. It can also create a contrast in texture, adding depth and visual interest, especially on matte or soft-touch boxes.

## Why Brands Use Spot UV

- It draws the eye. Gloss on key elements helps products stand out on the shelf.
- It looks premium. Highlighting a logo or pattern gives packaging a polished, professional finish.
- It protects. The cured coat guards printed areas against moisture, scratches and scuffs.
- It feels different. A smooth, sometimes raised texture makes packaging more engaging to hold.

## More Benefits of Spot UV

- Striking contrast that looks more refined than standard coated print.
- A cleaner process: UV coatings are solvent-free and release minimal VOCs (volatile organic compounds) during curing.
- Speed: the coating cures almost instantly, so production moves quickly with precise results.

## Where Spot UV Works Best

Spot UV is popular on business cards, brochures, flyers, postcards, invitations, cardstock and [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/). It can range from a subtle gloss to high gloss, or a satin look. It suits both thick and lighter stocks, but isn’t recommended for very thin or delicate paper, which may not handle the coating well.

## How to Prepare Artwork for Spot UV

1. Mark exactly where you want Spot UV in your artwork, with clear instructions.
2. Supply a separate mask file in pure black and white, with no gradients, blur or shadows, and sharp edges.
3. Keep it to a few focal points, such as your logo or a key message. Too much Spot UV loses the contrast and can look messy.

The clear coat is then applied only to the areas in your mask. See our [artwork guidelines](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/artwork/) for more file tips.

## Conclusion

Spot UV is a simple but effective way to give packaging a premium look. It highlights important elements with glossy contrast, adds depth and protects against wear. Used well, it helps your packaging stand out and strengthens your visual identity.

Add Spot UV to your next order: [get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/).

# Why Do You Need Retail Boxes For Your Business?

Retail boxes protect products, inform shoppers and sell on the shelf. Here is what a good retail box does for your brand.

By Sarah AshleyAugust 31, 2026

![Why Do You Need Retail Boxes For Your Business?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/need-retail-boxes-for-your-business.webp)

Plenty of new products fail every year, even from well-known brands. Sometimes the product falls short; more often the brand never found a way to stand apart from its competitors.

Standing out matters most in retail. If your product looks like everything else on the shelf, shoppers will walk past it, because they decide quickly and rarely compare every option in detail. The right retail packaging grabs attention, improves your presentation and makes your brand easier to notice. Here are five reasons your business needs [custom retail boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/).

## 1. They Keep Products Safe

Retail boxes are made from durable materials such as cardstock and corrugated board, which protect products on the shelf and in transit. With the right construction they can also carry heavier or delicate items, such as electronics, perfumes and glass bottles.

## 2. They Are Built Around Your Product

You choose the size, shape, material, printing, coating and design. Add window cutouts, hang tabs, perforations or inserts to make the box more useful and more eye-catching.

## 3. They Help Customers Remember You

Your logo, brand colors and artwork turn every box into an advert on a crowded shelf. Printing the inside as well makes unboxing more memorable and gives customers another reason to remember your brand.

## 4. They Share Important Information

Retail boxes give you space for instructions, ingredients, features, benefits, warnings, contact details or your brand story, so shoppers understand your product before they buy.

## 5. They Work for Online Orders Too

Strong construction protects products in shipping, and custom sizing stops them moving around inside the box. Add inserts or extra protective packaging if your product needs more support in delivery.

## Conclusion

By Sarah AshleyAugust 31, 2026

![Why Do You Need Retail Boxes For Your Business?](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/need-retail-boxes-for-your-business.webp)

Plenty of new products fail every year, even from well-known brands. Sometimes the product falls short; more often the brand never found a way to stand apart from its competitors.

Standing out matters most in retail. If your product looks like everything else on the shelf, shoppers will walk past it, because they decide quickly and rarely compare every option in detail. The right retail packaging grabs attention, improves your presentation and makes your brand easier to notice. Here are five reasons your business needs [custom retail boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/).

sections.title: 2. They Are Built Around Your Product
sections.content: You choose the size, shape, material, printing, coating and design. Add window cutouts, hang tabs, perforations or inserts to make the box more useful and more eye-catching.

sections.title: 3. They Help Customers Remember You
sections.content: Your logo, brand colors and artwork turn every box into an advert on a crowded shelf. Printing the inside as well makes unboxing more memorable and gives customers another reason to remember your brand.

sections.title: 4. They Share Important Information
sections.content: Retail boxes give you space for instructions, ingredients, features, benefits, warnings, contact details or your brand story, so shoppers understand your product before they buy.

sections.title: 5. They Work for Online Orders Too

sections.title: Conclusion

Retail boxes do much more than hold products. They protect items, improve presentation, support your branding and inform customers. Whether you sell in stores or online, the right design and materials make your products look more professional and help your brand grow.

## Custom Branded Candle Boxes For Maximum Impact

Your candle box is the first thing a shopper sees. Branded packaging in the right style and size shows off your candles and makes them easy to recognize, whether they are jar, taper or votive candles.

### Key Features of Custom Candle Boxes

- Durable materials: Sturdy and sustainable options for every type of candle.
- Flexible printing: Print on one side, both sides, or leave the box plain.
- Water-based inks: Printing without chemical solvents.
- Premium finishes: Lamination, foil, embossing and Spot UV for a polished look.

### Enhance Your Candle Presentation

Printed candle boxes make every candle look gift-ready. Custom inserts hold the candle in place, preventing movement and damage on the way to your customer.

### Kraft Candle Boxes For a Natural Look

Kraft candle boxes are recyclable and biodegradable, a good fit for eco-minded brands. Kraft stock is available from 14pt to 24pt.

### A Luxurious Look For Premium Candles

For luxury scented candles, thick rigid chipboard gives a solid, premium feel. Pair it with custom inserts to keep heavier jars secure.

### Ship Your Candles Safely

Corrugated candle shipping boxes and mailers add crush resistance, so candles sold online arrive in one piece.

### A Candle Box Style For Every Candle

- Two piece boxes: A separate lid and base for a classic, premium reveal.
- Magnetic closure boxes: A hidden magnetic flap for luxury gift sets.
- Reverse tuck end boxes: A lightweight, budget-friendly retail style.
- Window boxes: A die-cut window that shows the candle inside.

### Printing & Finishing Options for Candle Boxes

We use offset printing for bulk runs and digital printing for smaller orders, in CMYK and Pantone colors for accurate branding.

- Lamination: Gloss or matte finishing.
- Embossing and debossing: Raised or pressed-in detail you can feel.
- Foil stamping: Gold, silver or rose gold accents.
- Window patching and Spot UV: Show the product or highlight your logo.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering candle boxes.

### What are candle boxes?

Boxes made to protect, ship and present candles of every type, reducing damage along the way.

### Can my candle boxes include FPLA labeling?

Yes. We can design your boxes with ingredient and brand labeling in line with FPLA requirements.

### Can I customize the size of my candle boxes?

Yes. Send us the length, width and height and we make the box to fit.

### Can I order candle boxes in bulk?

Yes. Bulk orders lower the price per box and help with stock planning.

### Which material is best for luxury scented candles?

Rigid stock gives the most premium look and feel.

### Can you help if I don't have a design?

Yes. Our design support is free.

### How soon can I receive my candle boxes?

Standard turnaround is 8–12 business days.

- Durable materials: Sturdy and sustainable options for every type of candle.
- Flexible printing: Print on one side, both sides, or leave the box plain.
- Water-based inks: Printing without chemical solvents.
- Premium finishes: Lamination, foil, embossing and Spot UV for a polished look.

sections.title: Enhance Your Candle Presentation
sections.content: Printed candle boxes make every candle look gift-ready. Custom inserts hold the candle in place, preventing movement and damage on the way to your customer.

sections.title: Kraft Candle Boxes For a Natural Look
sections.content: Kraft candle boxes are recyclable and biodegradable, a good fit for eco-minded brands. Kraft stock is available from 14pt to 24pt.

sections.title: A Luxurious Look For Premium Candles
sections.content: For luxury scented candles, thick rigid chipboard gives a solid, premium feel. Pair it with custom inserts to keep heavier jars secure.

sections.title: Ship Your Candles Safely
sections.content: Corrugated candle shipping boxes and mailers add crush resistance, so candles sold online arrive in one piece.

sections.title: A Candle Box Style For Every Candle
sections.content:
- Two piece boxes: A separate lid and base for a classic, premium reveal.
- Magnetic closure boxes: A hidden magnetic flap for luxury gift sets.
- Reverse tuck end boxes: A lightweight, budget-friendly retail style.
- Window boxes: A die-cut window that shows the candle inside.

sections.title: Printing & Finishing Options for Candle Boxes
sections.content:
We use offset printing for bulk runs and digital printing for smaller orders, in CMYK and Pantone colors for accurate branding.

- Lamination: Gloss or matte finishing.
- Embossing and debossing: Raised or pressed-in detail you can feel.
- Foil stamping: Gold, silver or rose gold accents.
- Window patching and Spot UV: Show the product or highlight your logo.

## CBD Packaging That Protects, Promotes, and Performs

CBD packaging is made to store, protect and transport cannabidiol products such as oils, edibles, topicals and capsules, while keeping them safe and presentable.

### Make Your Brand Stand Out With Custom CBD Boxes

The CBD market is busy, so your packaging needs to set you apart. Custom boxes protect against damage, contamination and tampering, and premium design and finishes help your products stand out on crowded shelves.

### Material Options

- Paperboard: Sturdy yet lightweight, from 14pt to 24pt, with high-quality color printing for retail shelves.
- Kraft: Durable kraft in brown, black or white with a natural texture. Recyclable and biodegradable.
- Corrugated: A fluted core that absorbs shock in shipping, ideal for e-commerce.
- Rigid: Thick chipboard with a solid structure for a premium unboxing.

### Standard & Custom Sizes

Popular sizes are 3 × 1 × 4 inches for small CBD items and 8 × 4.7 × 3.9 inches for larger ones. Need something else? Request a custom size and we will make it.

### Box Styles and Printing

Popular styles include two piece, reverse tuck end, mailer, magnetic and drawer boxes. Print your logo, brand elements, usage directions, batch and best-before dates and ingredients in CMYK or Pantone using offset, digital, flexographic or screen printing.

### Child-Resistant CBD Packaging

CBD products can be harmful if children get to them. Add child-resistant locks, tamper-evident seals and clear labeling to protect families and build customer confidence. Check the labeling and packaging rules that apply to your products and market.

### Premium Finishes & Add-ons

Finish your boxes with matte, gloss or soft-touch lamination, Spot UV, embossing or foil stamping, and add PVC windows, custom inserts, ribbons or tags for a memorable unboxing.

### Which products can be packed in CBD boxes?

Gummies, capsules, topicals, vapes, edibles, skincare and pet supplements, among others.

### Are CBD boxes moisture-resistant?

Yes. Protective coatings, lamination and specialty inks help block humidity and moisture to keep oils and edibles fresh.

### Can I print on both sides of my CBD boxes?

Yes. Use both sides for branding, ingredients, required information and QR codes.

### Can I order a sample?

Yes. Order a sample before your bulk order to check the material, printing and finishing.

### Which materials are best for CBD packaging?

Paperboard, rigid board, kraft, corrugated and recycled options all work well, balancing durability, print quality, sustainability and protection.

### What is the production time?

8–12 business days. Rush orders are available for faster turnaround.

sections.title: CBD Packaging That Protects, Promotes, and Performs
sections.content: CBD packaging is made to store, protect and transport cannabidiol products such as oils, edibles, topicals and capsules, while keeping them safe and presentable.

sections.title: Make Your Brand Stand Out With Custom CBD Boxes
sections.content: The CBD market is busy, so your packaging needs to set you apart. Custom boxes protect against damage, contamination and tampering, and premium design and finishes help your products stand out on crowded shelves.

sections.title: Material Options
sections.content:
- Paperboard: Sturdy yet lightweight, from 14pt to 24pt, with high-quality color printing for retail shelves.
- Kraft: Durable kraft in brown, black or white with a natural texture. Recyclable and biodegradable.
- Corrugated: A fluted core that absorbs shock in shipping, ideal for e-commerce.
- Rigid: Thick chipboard with a solid structure for a premium unboxing.

sections.title: Standard & Custom Sizes
sections.content: Popular sizes are 3 × 1 × 4 inches for small CBD items and 8 × 4.7 × 3.9 inches for larger ones. Need something else? Request a custom size and we will make it.

sections.title: Box Styles and Printing
sections.content: Popular styles include two piece, reverse tuck end, mailer, magnetic and drawer boxes. Print your logo, brand elements, usage directions, batch and best-before dates and ingredients in CMYK or Pantone using offset, digital, flexographic or screen printing.

sections.title: Child-Resistant CBD Packaging
sections.content: CBD products can be harmful if children get to them. Add child-resistant locks, tamper-evident seals and clear labeling to protect families and build customer confidence. Check the labeling and packaging rules that apply to your products and market.

sections.title: Premium Finishes & Add-ons
sections.content: Finish your boxes with matte, gloss or soft-touch lamination, Spot UV, embossing or foil stamping, and add PVC windows, custom inserts, ribbons or tags for a memorable unboxing.

## Say It All About Your Brand With Custom Corrugated Boxes

Custom corrugated boxes carry your logo, artwork and colors to every customer. They let you ship with confidence and show your brand’s values from the moment the box arrives.

### Durable Corrugated Box Packaging Materials

Corrugated board is known for its durability, sustainability and shipping strength. Choose from:

- Corrugated: A sturdy fluted layer between two linerboards.
- Bleached White Board: A bright white kraft liner that makes colors look more vibrant.
- Kemi White Board: A semi-gloss, brilliant white liner on one side for high-quality printing.
- Oyster White: A clay-coated, textured off-white surface for high-resolution printing.
- Flute and wall options: B-flute (1/8″), E-flute (1/16″), single wall, double wall or triple wall.

### Select Your Box Type

Our team guides you through every step. Popular corrugated styles include mailer boxes, 1-2-3 bottom slotted containers, pizza boxes, tab lock roll end boxes, tuck top boxes, full slotted containers and roll end tuck top boxes. Need a style that isn’t listed? Just ask.

### Custom Dimensions

Send us the length, width and height of your product and our experts handle the rest.

### Printing & Finishing Options

Show your logo, artwork, product details and colors with offset or digital printing.

- Laminations: Matte, gloss or soft touch.
- Spot UV: Selective shine on logos and details.
- Foil stamping and embossing: Metallic accents and raised detail.

### Extra Security With Engineered Inserts

Custom inserts follow the shape of your product to reduce damage and return costs.

- Cardboard box dividers: Keep multiple items apart in transit.
- Cardboard inserts: Cut to hold your product in place.
- Foam inserts: Cushioning for fragile or high-value items.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering corrugated boxes.

### What is the difference between corrugated and cardboard?

Corrugated has several layers, including a fluted middle layer, for more strength and cushioning. Cardboard is usually a single flat paperboard for lightweight packaging.

### What is the difference between corrugated and mailer boxes?

Corrugated is the fluted material that protects well in shipping. A mailer box is a style with self-locking flaps, usually made from corrugated or sturdy paperboard.

### Do you have a minimum order quantity?

No. Order as few as one box or as many as you need.

### Which flute thickness is best for heavy products?

B-flute suits heavier products, with good stacking strength and durability. Thicker double or triple wall builds are available depending on weight.

### Are corrugated boxes recyclable?

Yes. They are made from paper fiber. Remove excess tape, plastic or non-paper materials before recycling.

### Can I order a sample before a bulk order?

Yes. A sample lets you check the size, construction, material, printing and look before your full order.

sections.title: Durable Corrugated Box Packaging Materials
sections.content:
Corrugated board is known for its durability, sustainability and shipping strength. Choose from:

- Corrugated: A sturdy fluted layer between two linerboards.
- Bleached White Board: A bright white kraft liner that makes colors look more vibrant.
- Kemi White Board: A semi-gloss, brilliant white liner on one side for high-quality printing.
- Oyster White: A clay-coated, textured off-white surface for high-resolution printing.
- Flute and wall options: B-flute (1/8″), E-flute (1/16″), single wall, double wall or triple wall.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.content: We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering corrugated boxes.

sections.title: What is the difference between corrugated and cardboard?
sections.content: Corrugated has several layers, including a fluted middle layer, for more strength and cushioning. Cardboard is usually a single flat paperboard for lightweight packaging.

sections.title: What is the difference between corrugated and mailer boxes?
sections.content: Corrugated is the fluted material that protects well in shipping. A mailer box is a style with self-locking flaps, usually made from corrugated or sturdy paperboard.

sections.title: Do you have a minimum order quantity?
sections.content: No. Order as few as one box or as many as you need.

sections.title: Which flute thickness is best for heavy products?
sections.content: B-flute suits heavier products, with good stacking strength and durability. Thicker double or triple wall builds are available depending on weight.

sections.title: Are corrugated boxes recyclable?
sections.content: Yes. They are made from paper fiber. Remove excess tape, plastic or non-paper materials before recycling.

sections.title: Can I order a sample before a bulk order?
sections.content: Yes. A sample lets you check the size, construction, material, printing and look before your full order.

## Cosmetic Box Materials That Protect and Perform

Cosmetics are delicate. Our boxes are built from paperboard, cardboard, kraft, corrugated and rigid stock, with fitted inserts and dividers that protect against breaking, cracking and melting.

### Custom Sizes for a Perfect Cosmetic Box

No product is too big or too small. Popular standard sizes (L × W × H) include:

- Lipstick and lip gloss: 0.875 × 0.875 × 3.2 in
- Foundation: 1.5 × 1.5 × 5.0 in
- Makeup: 4.5 × 3.75 × 0.75 in
- Eyelashes: 4.5 × 2.5 × 0.75 in

### Stylish Cosmetic Box Styles

- Straight tuck end: Clean closures for sleek foundations.
- Reverse tuck end: Quick to assemble, ideal for lightweight lip glosses.
- Auto-lock bottom: A sturdy pre-glued base for heavy glass skincare jars.
- Magnetic closure: Rigid boxes with hidden magnets for luxury cosmetic sets.
- Two piece: A separate lid and base for luxury perfumes.
- Drawer boxes: A sliding reveal for concealers and eyelashes.
- Window and display boxes: Show off shades and drive impulse buys at the counter.
- Mailer boxes: Self-locking, durable boxes for e-commerce orders.

### Printed Cosmetic Boxes for Every Shelf and Unboxing

Digital and offset printing in CMYK and Pantone, on the outside, inside or both. Finish with matte or gloss lamination, Spot UV, foil stamping, or embossing and debossing to raise your brand’s visibility on the shelf and at unboxing.

### Wholesale Cosmetic Boxes with Quality Guaranteed

Our cosmetic boxes are affordable, with lower per-unit prices on bulk orders, and small batches are welcome with no minimum order. Order today for fast, free shipping.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering cosmetic boxes.

### Do cosmetic boxes come with inserts?

Custom-fitted inserts and dividers are optional add-ons that help prevent breaking, cracking or melting in transit.

### Can my box be printed on the inside and outside?

Yes. You can print on the inside, the outside, or both.

### Can I order a sample before a bulk order?

Yes. Contact a customer representative to order a sample.

### Can you help with structural design so my product fits?

Yes. Our design support team helps with structure and sizing.

### Do you ship outside the United States?

Yes, including the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada.

### How many boxes must I order?

There is no minimum order quantity.

### When will I receive my order?

Typically 8–12 business days. Rush orders can be discussed.

### Will I get a proof?

Yes. You get a 3D mockup or 2D proof, and production starts only after you approve it.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.content: We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering cosmetic boxes.

sections.title: Do cosmetic boxes come with inserts?
sections.content: Custom-fitted inserts and dividers are optional add-ons that help prevent breaking, cracking or melting in transit.

sections.title: Can my box be printed on the inside and outside?
sections.content: Yes. You can print on the inside, the outside, or both.

sections.title: Can I order a sample before a bulk order?
sections.content: Yes. Contact a customer representative to order a sample.

sections.title: Can you help with structural design so my product fits?
sections.content: Yes. Our design support team helps with structure and sizing.

sections.title: Do you ship outside the United States?
sections.content: Yes, including the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada.

sections.title: How many boxes must I order?
sections.content: There is no minimum order quantity.

sections.title: When will I receive my order?
sections.content: Typically 8–12 business days. Rush orders can be discussed.

sections.title: Will I get a proof?
sections.content: Yes. You get a 3D mockup or 2D proof, and production starts only after you approve it.

Create an unboxing experience your customers remember. Custom boxes help brands present their products professionally while keeping them safe and secure. From small businesses to growing enterprises, our custom printed boxes suit all types of products.

Are you looking for a way to boost your product sales? Custom boxes can help. Today, having a great product is not enough. Your packaging also needs to look professional, branded, and appealing to customers.

Not only that, but branded custom boxes also help your products get the attention they deserve on retail shelves and during unboxing.

### Design Tips for The Perfect Custom Box

Designing the perfect custom boxes requires attention to detail. When designing your boxes, there are several steps that you must follow to achieve the best result possible:

- Understand Your Product: Start by considering the product’s size, weight, shape, and protection needs before designing the box.
- Choose the Right Material: Select a packaging material that provides enough protection and suits your product.
- Add Your Brand Elements: Use your logo, brand colors, artwork, and other details to make the packaging easy to recognize.
- Consider Sustainability: Choose recyclable, reusable, or responsibly sourced packaging options when they fit your product and business needs.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering custom boxes.

### What are custom boxes?

Custom boxes are specialized containers that help to advertise, protect, and ship your products effectively. You can print them with your branded artwork and custom logo to strengthen your brand identity.

### How do I know which box size I need for my custom box?

To determine your box size, measure your product from the widest side for the width, the longest side for the length, and the tallest side for the height. Once you have these measurements, add a little extra (e.g., 0.25 inches) to allow room for fit and any packaging fillers. You can also read our full guide on measuring your box dimensions for a better understanding.

### What are the most popular types of custom boxes?

The popular and common types of custom boxes are as follows: folding cartons for retail products, mailer boxes for shipping ecommerce products, and rigid boxes for showcasing and protecting luxury or premium items.

### Which custom box is perfect for shipping ecommerce items?

For shipping ecommerce items, custom boxes made from corrugated materials are the best choice. The most popular choice for shipping ecommerce products is a mailer box, as it is made from corrugated materials and can protect your product while leaving a lasting impression with each delivery.

### Can I order a sample of my custom box?

Absolutely. You can order a sample of your custom box to check the material quality, printing, finishing, and size. If you are satisfied with the result, we will start manufacturing the rest of your order.

### How does ordering custom boxes benefit my small business?

Ordering custom boxes from Pack Legacy can benefit your small business. We offer no minimum order, no setup fees, and no die plate charges, making it cost effective and easy for small businesses to order from us.

### Which sides are printable on my box?

Printing sides of your box is fully customizable. You can choose where you want your artwork printed, such as the inside, outside, or both sides. If you need a plain custom box, we can provide that too.

### Do you also offer custom box inserts?

Yes. We do offer custom box inserts, such as EVA foam inserts, cardboard inserts, corrugated box dividers, and packaging card inserts. You can customize your box insert size as per your product size requirements.

faqs.question: What are custom boxes?
faqs.answer: Custom boxes are specialized containers that help to advertise, protect, and ship your products effectively. You can print them with your branded artwork and custom logo to strengthen your brand identity.

faqs.question: How do I know which box size I need for my custom box?
faqs.answer: To determine your box size, measure your product from the widest side for the width, the longest side for the length, and the tallest side for the height. Once you have these measurements, add a little extra (e.g., 0.25 inches) to allow room for fit and any packaging fillers. You can also read our full guide on measuring your box dimensions for a better understanding.

faqs.question: What are the most popular types of custom boxes?
faqs.answer: The popular and common types of custom boxes are as follows: folding cartons for retail products, mailer boxes for shipping ecommerce products, and rigid boxes for showcasing and protecting luxury or premium items.

faqs.question: Which custom box is perfect for shipping ecommerce items?
faqs.answer: For shipping ecommerce items, custom boxes made from corrugated materials are the best choice. The most popular choice for shipping ecommerce products is a mailer box, as it is made from corrugated materials and can protect your product while leaving a lasting impression with each delivery.

faqs.question: Can I order a sample of my custom box?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can order a sample of your custom box to check the material quality, printing, finishing, and size. If you are satisfied with the result, we will start manufacturing the rest of your order.

faqs.question: How does ordering custom boxes benefit my small business?
faqs.answer: Ordering custom boxes from Pack Legacy can benefit your small business. We offer no minimum order, no setup fees, and no die plate charges, making it cost effective and easy for small businesses to order from us.

faqs.question: Which sides are printable on my box?
faqs.answer: Printing sides of your box is fully customizable. You can choose where you want your artwork printed, such as the inside, outside, or both sides. If you need a plain custom box, we can provide that too.

faqs.question: Do you also offer custom box inserts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We do offer custom box inserts, such as EVA foam inserts, cardboard inserts, corrugated box dividers, and packaging card inserts. You can customize your box insert size as per your product size requirements.

## High-Quality Mylar Bags That Preserve Freshness

Our mylar bags are made from high-performance polyester film (BoPET), which combines durability, barrier protection and flexibility. Each bag is engineered to block oxygen, moisture, light and odor.

### Why Mylar Film Works

- High tensile strength: Up to 3–5 times stronger than unstretched PET.
- Barrier protection: Excellent resistance to oxygen, moisture and odors.
- Chemical resistance: Stable against oils, solvents and acids.
- Thermal stability: Performs from -70°C to 150°C.
- Dimensional stability: Keeps its shape and size under stress and heat.

### More Mylar Bag Options

Beyond the bags above, we also make frozen meat packaging, mylar bags with windows, pet food packaging, spout pouches, vacuum seal bags, smell-proof bags, cannabis bags, ziplock bags, stand-up pouches, CBD bags and holographic mylar bags. Ask for any of them in your quote.

### Bag Styles for Every Product

All styles come in a wide range of standard sizes, or fully custom sizes and shapes.

- Flat pouch (three-side seal): Light and cost-effective, for samples, spices and single-serve snacks.
- Stand-up pouch: Shelf presence and resealability for coffee, tea, pet food and cosmetics.
- Side gusset bag: A premium choice for bulk coffee, powdered mixes and specialty grains.
- Flat or block bottom bag: Stable and premium-looking, for rice, confectionery and luxury goods.
- Spout pouch: For liquids like juices, sauces and oils.
- Child-resistant bag: Compliant packaging for cannabis, CBD and pharmaceuticals.

### Closure Options

- Heat seal: Simple and tamper-evident, best for single use.
- Ziplock: Resealable and easy to open, great for snacks and coffee.
- Child-resistant: Safe for cannabis and pharmaceuticals.
- Tear notches: Easy to open while keeping the barrier intact.
- Hang holes: For retail peg displays.
- Degassing valves: Release gas from coffee while keeping aroma in.
- Spouts: Easy pouring and resealing for liquids.

### Printing, Compliance and Sustainability

Choose digital printing for small runs or rotogravure for high-volume, photo-quality graphics, with matte, gloss, metallic, Spot UV, soft-touch or foil finishes. Add your logo, QR codes, compliance labels or promotional graphics.

Our films are FDA food-grade for direct food contact, child-resistant options meet ASTM standards for cannabis and CBD, and kraft laminates and recyclable films are available for eco-conscious brands.

### Applications Across Industries

- Food and beverage: Coffee, tea, cookies, snacks, spices and baked goods.
- Cosmetics and beauty: Creams, powders, masks and beauty essentials.
- Pharmaceuticals and supplements: Pills, powders, capsules and medical products.
- Cannabis and CBD: Flower, concentrates, gummies and edibles.
- Pet food and specialty goods: Nutritional mixes, treats and premium supplies.

### Flexible Pricing and Wholesale Options

Order in bulk for a lower per-unit price and discounts, or start with a small batch thanks to our low minimums. Whatever your order size, you get premium mylar bags at competitive rates, with fast, free shipping.

A high-performance polyester film that combines durability, barrier protection and flexibility.

Yes. Our materials are FDA-approved for direct food contact, and child-resistant options meet cannabis packaging standards.

### Can mylar bags preserve food?

Yes. They are an excellent barrier against oxygen, moisture and odors, keeping food fresh, safe and market-ready.

### Can I order mylar bags in custom sizes?

Yes. Choose standard dimensions or fully custom sizes and shapes.

### How long does mylar bag production take?

Standard production is 8–12 business days, with rush options for urgent orders.

### What does shipping cost for printed mylar bags?

Nothing. Shipping is free on every order.
