sections.title: What are custom mylar bags made of?
sections.content: A high-performance polyester film that combines durability, barrier protection and flexibility.

sections.title: Are mylar bags food-safe and compliant?
sections.content: Yes. Our materials are FDA-approved for direct food contact, and child-resistant options meet cannabis packaging standards.

sections.title: Can mylar bags preserve food?
sections.content: Yes. They are an excellent barrier against oxygen, moisture and odors, keeping food fresh, safe and market-ready.

sections.title: Can I order mylar bags in custom sizes?
sections.content: Yes. Choose standard dimensions or fully custom sizes and shapes.

sections.title: How long does mylar bag production take?
sections.content: Standard production is 8–12 business days, with rush options for urgent orders.

sections.title: What does shipping cost for printed mylar bags?
sections.content: Nothing. Shipping is free on every order.

# Custom Paper Bags

Put your brand in every step your customers take with custom paper bags printed with your logo. Made with or without handles, they give products that need outer packaging a polished, memorable finish.

Design your bags in any size, shape and style, in eco-friendly, durable kraft, cardboard or paperboard.

Fill out the quote form to order custom paper bags that combine convenience and branding.

## Key Takeaways

Paper bags are designed to carry, package, and present retail products, gifts, food items, and shopping purchases. These bags are made from materials such as brown Kraft paper, white Kraft paper, and specialty paper, and come in various styles with twisted paper, rope, or die-cut handles. At Pack Legacy, we offer custom paper bags with no minimums, plus free shipping and design support.

## Paper Bags That Carry Your Brand

Every time a customer carries your bag down the street, on public transport or into the office, it works as a walking billboard. Custom paper bags also show your brand values and give products and giveaways a professional finish.

### Our Paper Bag Range

- Bakery bags: Keep baked goods neatly packed and branded.
- Food bags: A professional, logo-printed presentation for food products.
- Luxury paper bags: An elegant finish that carries your brand identity.
- D-cut bags: Integrated die-cut handles for everyday purchases.
- Kraft paper bags: Natural appeal with practical style.
- Self-opening sack bags: Flat bottoms for easy filling and storage.
- Gift bags: Stylish designs and personal details for gifting.
- Gable bags: A distinctive top with a convenient carry handle.

### Materials Made for Everyday Use

Our bags suit retail stores, boutiques, markets, trade shows, takeout and bakeries, with handles for easy carrying. Need something tougher? See our custom mylar bags.

- Kraft stock: 100% recyclable with a natural, organic look that shows your commitment to sustainability.
- Cardboard: Durable, with a luxury look. Thickness depends on what the bag will carry.
- Paperboard: Light yet durable with vibrant print quality, for light to medium-weight products.

### Standard and Custom Sizes

Need a different size? Send us your dimensions and we will make it. Artwork is printed digitally or offset, in CMYK and Pantone, for crisp, accurate color.

- Small, 7.48″ x 3.15″ x 8.86″: For cosmetics or jewelry.
- Medium, 8.66″ x 3.94″ x 11.81″: For apparel, books and perfumes.
- Large, 10.24″ x 5.51″ x 13.39″: For shoe boxes and bulk takeout orders.

### Bag Styles and Premium Finishes

Choose from paper bags with handles, gusseted bags, gable bags, self-opening sack bags and D-cut bags, or tell us your own idea. Finish them with foil stamping for metallic logos, embossing for raised detail, matte lamination for a smooth, elegant feel, or Spot UV for glossy accents.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering paper bags.

### What are custom paper bags?

Paper bags personalized with your logo, colors, artwork and dimensions, giving customers a convenient, consistent and recognizable way to carry your products.

### Are kraft paper bags recyclable?

Uncoated kraft bags are generally recyclable when clean and dry. Remove non-paper handles or decorations, and check local guidelines for coated or laminated bags.

### Is there a minimum order for custom paper bags?

Yes. The minimum order is 100 bags, so you can get branded bags without a large first purchase.

### Can I print my logo on custom paper bags?

Yes. Add your logo, brand colors and artwork for a professional look that customers recognize.

### What finishes are available?

Foil stamping, embossing, matte lamination and Spot UV.

### Can paper bags hold heavy products?

Yes, when made with the right paper thickness, reinforced bottoms and sturdy handles.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.content: We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering paper bags.

sections.title: What are custom paper bags?
sections.content: Paper bags personalized with your logo, colors, artwork and dimensions, giving customers a convenient, consistent and recognizable way to carry your products.

sections.title: Are kraft paper bags recyclable?
sections.content: Uncoated kraft bags are generally recyclable when clean and dry. Remove non-paper handles or decorations, and check local guidelines for coated or laminated bags.

sections.title: Is there a minimum order for custom paper bags?
sections.content: Yes. The minimum order is 100 bags, so you can get branded bags without a large first purchase.

sections.title: Can I print my logo on custom paper bags?
sections.content: Yes. Add your logo, brand colors and artwork for a professional look that customers recognize.

sections.title: What finishes are available?
sections.content: Foil stamping, embossing, matte lamination and Spot UV.

sections.title: Can paper bags hold heavy products?
sections.content: Yes, when made with the right paper thickness, reinforced bottoms and sturdy handles.

## Drive Up Sales & Attract Customers with Custom Display Boxes

Eye-catching display boxes draw attention to featured items, encourage impulse buys and keep products within easy reach, near the checkout or on the shelf.

### High-Quality Display Box Materials

The material you choose affects durability, sustainability and presentation. We offer:

- Cardboard/Paperboard: Sturdy and lightweight, the most popular choice in retail for its flexibility.
- Kraft paper: Durable kraft in brown, black or white with a natural texture, for eco-conscious brands.
- Corrugated: A fluted layer between two liners, popular for display mailers and shelf-ready boxes.
- Rigid board: Thick chipboard with a solid base and a premium feel.

### Match Your Display Box Size to Your Product

Popular standard sizes include 5″ × 3″ × 8″, 7″ × 3″ × 7″, 8″ × 5″ × 10″ and 12″ × 10″ × 6″. Custom sizes are available too: send us the length, width and height.

### Enhance Your Brand With Custom Printed Display Boxes

Show your logo and artwork with offset, digital, flexography or screen printing, using CMYK and Pantone (PMS) colors for accurate branding.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering display boxes.

### What are custom display boxes?

Packaging made to present products attractively, increase visibility and encourage purchases in stores, at checkout and in promotions.

### Which display packaging is best for counters?

Countertop display boxes, since they keep items visible and within easy reach.

### Can I add a header tab to my display boxes?

Yes. A header tab adds space for branding, promotions, product details or graphics.

### What products can I put in a display box?

Cosmetics, snacks, candy, supplements, electronics, accessories, personal care and promotional items, among others.

### Can I add custom inserts to cardboard display boxes?

Yes. Inserts hold products securely, keep them organized and give a cleaner look.

### What is the minimum order for display boxes?

There is no minimum. Order as few or as many boxes as you need.

sections.content: Eye-catching display boxes draw attention to featured items, encourage impulse buys and keep products within easy reach, near the checkout or on the shelf.

sections.title: High-Quality Display Box Materials
sections.content:
The material you choose affects durability, sustainability and presentation. We offer:

- Cardboard/Paperboard: Sturdy and lightweight, the most popular choice in retail for its flexibility.
- Kraft paper: Durable kraft in brown, black or white with a natural texture, for eco-conscious brands.
- Corrugated: A fluted layer between two liners, popular for display mailers and shelf-ready boxes.
- Rigid board: Thick chipboard with a solid base and a premium feel.

sections.title: Match Your Display Box Size to Your Product
sections.content: Popular standard sizes include 5″ × 3″ × 8″, 7″ × 3″ × 7″, 8″ × 5″ × 10″ and 12″ × 10″ × 6″. Custom sizes are available too: send us the length, width and height.

pages.content_markdown:
Help center

# Frequently asked questions.

Quick answers to the questions customers ask most before ordering custom boxes.

01

### How much does a custom box cost, and what affects the price?

The price depends on the material, box size, quantity and the printing and finishing options you choose. We keep our pricing affordable and competitive, and every quote is built for your exact box.

02

### What is the minimum number of boxes I can order?

There is no minimum order quantity. Order as few or as many boxes as you need.

03

### Which file format should I send my artwork in?

Please send artwork as AI, PSD or PDF. For print-ready results, use CMYK color at 300 DPI or higher.

04

### Can my box be printed on the inside and outside?

Yes. We can print the outside, the inside, or both sides of your box.

05

### How do I choose the right packaging material for my product?

Think about your product’s size, shape, weight, fragility and shelf life. Cardboard is often a flexible choice because it is strong, affordable and recyclable. Browse our [materials library](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/materials/) or ask our team for a recommendation.

06

### Can I order a sample before placing a bulk order?

Yes. Contact a customer representative or request one from our [sample kits](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/sample-kits/) page.

07

### Will you help me get the right size for my box?

Yes. Our packaging team can work out the right box size from your product’s measurements.

08

### Do you ship to countries other than the United States?

Yes. We also ship to countries including the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada.

09

### Are there any hidden fees? What about die and plate costs?

No hidden fees, and no die or plate charges. Your quote shows what you pay.

10

### When will I receive my custom box order?

Most orders are completed in 8 to 12 business days. If you need your boxes sooner, ask us about rush production. See our [shipping policy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/shipping-policy/) for details.

11

### Do you offer eco-friendly packaging?

Yes. We offer eco-friendly options in kraft, paperboard and cardboard.

12

### Do I have to pay for shipping?

No. Standard shipping is fast and free on qualifying orders.

## Still have a question?

Our packaging specialists reply quickly and are happy to help with sizing, materials and artwork.

- sales@packlegacy.com
- +1 (424) 321-6460
- [How to order](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/how-to-order/)
- [Track your order](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/track-your-order/)

[Get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/)

## Ready to design your custom boxes?

Tell us your size, quantity and style. A packaging specialist will send you a free quote, with design help if you need it.

[Get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/)[Talk to our team](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/contact-us/)

## Folding Cartons: The Retail Packaging Favorite

Light, foldable and easy to print, folding cartons are the go-to retail box across food and beverage, cosmetics and personal care, pharmaceuticals and wellness, household items and consumer goods.

### The Benefits of Folding Cartons

- Structural integrity: Lightweight but protective against crushing, light and dust, in transit and on shelves or pegs.
- Space-saving logistics: Made and shipped flat, which cuts shipping and warehousing costs.
- Quick assembly: Pre-creased, pre-glued designs fold into shape fast, saving labor.
- Marketing canvas: Every panel is a smooth, printable surface for graphics, type and storytelling.
- Cost-effective: An affordable, lightweight option that lowers storage and shipping costs.
- Eco-friendly: Paperboard cartons are 100% recyclable and biodegradable.

### Material Options

- SBS paperboard: Premium bright-white board with excellent printability, for cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and high-end retail.
- Unbleached kraft: Strong, tear-resistant and natural, ideal for heavier items like beverages.
- Folding box board: A layered board with a mechanical-pulp core that stays stiff and strong while remaining light.

### Folding Carton Styles

Every style is customizable, and precise die-cutting sizes each carton exactly to your product, from small cosmetics to large beverages.

- Straight tuck end (STE): Top and bottom flaps fold the same way, leaving a clean, seamless front panel.
- Reverse tuck end (RTE): Flaps tuck in opposite directions for a more cost-effective box.
- Auto-lock bottom: Pre-glued panels pop into shape and lock in place.
- 1-2-3 bottom: Interlocking bottom flaps snap together without glue.
- Sleeves: A printed paperboard wrap that slides over a tray or another box.

### Folding Cartons With Your Logo

Stand out on crowded shelves with your artwork, product details and logo printed with digital or offset printing in CMYK and Pantone colors, on the outside, inside or both. Finish with matte or gloss lamination, Spot UV, foil stamping, or embossing and debossing.

### Wholesale Prices, No Minimums

There is no minimum order and no setup cost, and bulk orders bring a lower per-unit price and special discounts. You also get free design support from our packaging team, an 8–12 business day turnaround and reliable free shipping.

sections.title: Folding Cartons: The Retail Packaging Favorite
sections.content: Light, foldable and easy to print, folding cartons are the go-to retail box across food and beverage, cosmetics and personal care, pharmaceuticals and wellness, household items and consumer goods.

sections.title: The Benefits of Folding Cartons
sections.content:
- Structural integrity: Lightweight but protective against crushing, light and dust, in transit and on shelves or pegs.
- Space-saving logistics: Made and shipped flat, which cuts shipping and warehousing costs.
- Quick assembly: Pre-creased, pre-glued designs fold into shape fast, saving labor.
- Marketing canvas: Every panel is a smooth, printable surface for graphics, type and storytelling.
- Cost-effective: An affordable, lightweight option that lowers storage and shipping costs.
- Eco-friendly: Paperboard cartons are 100% recyclable and biodegradable.

sections.title: Material Options
sections.content:
- SBS paperboard: Premium bright-white board with excellent printability, for cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and high-end retail.
- Unbleached kraft: Strong, tear-resistant and natural, ideal for heavier items like beverages.
- Folding box board: A layered board with a mechanical-pulp core that stays stiff and strong while remaining light.

sections.title: Folding Carton Styles
sections.content:
Every style is customizable, and precise die-cutting sizes each carton exactly to your product, from small cosmetics to large beverages.

- Straight tuck end (STE): Top and bottom flaps fold the same way, leaving a clean, seamless front panel.
- Reverse tuck end (RTE): Flaps tuck in opposite directions for a more cost-effective box.
- Auto-lock bottom: Pre-glued panels pop into shape and lock in place.
- 1-2-3 bottom: Interlocking bottom flaps snap together without glue.
- Sleeves: A printed paperboard wrap that slides over a tray or another box.

sections.title: Folding Cartons With Your Logo
sections.content: Stand out on crowded shelves with your artwork, product details and logo printed with digital or offset printing in CMYK and Pantone colors, on the outside, inside or both. Finish with matte or gloss lamination, Spot UV, foil stamping, or embossing and debossing.

sections.title: Wholesale Prices, No Minimums
sections.content: There is no minimum order and no setup cost, and bulk orders bring a lower per-unit price and special discounts. You also get free design support from our packaging team, an 8–12 business day turnaround and reliable free shipping.

Keep meals fresh, protected and appetizing with custom food boxes, whether they are on display in store, packed for takeout or out for delivery. Our boxes use moisture-resistant, grease-resistant, food-safe materials that help preserve taste and aroma.

Packaging that balances durability, branding and function, from your kitchen to your customer’s hands.

## Food Packaging For Every Kind Of Food Business

Restaurants, bakeries, cafés, food trucks, caterers and retail food brands all need packaging that protects the food and promotes the brand. Here is how to choose it.

### Packaging for Hot, Cold, Frozen, Greasy & Dry Foods

Different foods need different protection. Tell us what you are packing and we will match the structure and coating to it.

- Hot foods: Burgers, pizza, fries and noodles need ventilation to prevent sogginess, grease-resistant linings and heat-retaining designs.
- Cold and chilled: Desserts and chilled meals need moisture-resistant coatings that stand up to condensation.
- Greasy foods: Fried chicken, burgers and fries need oil-resistant barriers and leak-proof closures.
- Dry foods: Tea, cereal, candy and cookies need secure closures and moisture control to extend shelf life.
- Frozen foods: Frozen meals and desserts need boards that stay strong at low temperatures.

### Which Material Works Best for Food Boxes?

- Paperboard: Lightweight and highly printable. Best for cereal, tea, bakery items and candy.
- Kraft: A rustic, eco-friendly look for takeout, bakery and natural brands.
- Corrugated: Crush protection and durability for pizza, delivery and heavier food.
- Rigid stock: Premium presentation for chocolates and gourmet gifts.

### Popular Food Box Styles & When to Use Them

- Tuck-end boxes: Folding cartons for tea, cereal, candy and dry foods where shelf presentation matters.
- Auto-bottom boxes: A pre-glued base that locks into place, for heavier items like jars, sauces and bulk snacks.
- Gable boxes: A built-in carry handle for bakery items and takeaway meals.
- Takeout boxes: Sturdy fold-over closures for delivery meals and heavier food.
- Tray and sleeve: A sliding sleeve over a tray for prepared meals and premium retail food.

### Grease, Moisture & Food-Contact Protection

Functional coatings keep food at its best: grease-resistant barriers for burgers and fries, moisture-resistant coatings for refrigerated and frozen food, ventilation for hot meals, liners for direct food contact, and window films that show the food while keeping it covered.

### Wholesale Food Boxes: No MOQ, Free Shipping

Order exactly what you need, from a small run for a pop-up to a full rollout. There are no hidden fees, die costs or plate charges, shipping is free, and standard production takes 8–12 business days. Rush orders are available on request.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering food boxes.

### What is the minimum order quantity for custom food boxes?

There is no minimum order quantity. Order as few or as many boxes as you need.

### What file format should I send my artwork in?

Send AI, PSD or PDF files in CMYK at 300 DPI. Free dieline templates are available, and our design team can help for free.

### Are your food boxes food-safe?

Yes. We use food-grade materials, with grease-resistant and moisture-resistant coatings and liners for direct food contact where needed.

### Can I get a sample before a bulk order?

Yes. Contact us or visit our sample kits page to order a sample before your full run.

### How long does delivery take?

Standard production takes 8–12 business days after artwork approval, with free shipping. Rush orders are available, so tell us your deadline.

### Can food boxes be printed inside and outside?

Yes. You can print on the inside, the outside, or both.

### Do you charge for shipping, dies or plates?

No. Shipping is free, and there are no die or plate charges.

### Do you offer eco-friendly food packaging?

Yes. Kraft, cardboard and paperboard options are recyclable and a good fit for eco-conscious brands.

sections.title: Food Packaging For Every Kind Of Food Business
sections.content: Restaurants, bakeries, cafés, food trucks, caterers and retail food brands all need packaging that protects the food and promotes the brand. Here is how to choose it.

sections.title: Packaging for Hot, Cold, Frozen, Greasy & Dry Foods
sections.content:
Different foods need different protection. Tell us what you are packing and we will match the structure and coating to it.

- Hot foods: Burgers, pizza, fries and noodles need ventilation to prevent sogginess, grease-resistant linings and heat-retaining designs.
- Cold and chilled: Desserts and chilled meals need moisture-resistant coatings that stand up to condensation.
- Greasy foods: Fried chicken, burgers and fries need oil-resistant barriers and leak-proof closures.
- Dry foods: Tea, cereal, candy and cookies need secure closures and moisture control to extend shelf life.
- Frozen foods: Frozen meals and desserts need boards that stay strong at low temperatures.

sections.title: Which Material Works Best for Food Boxes?
sections.content:
- Paperboard: Lightweight and highly printable. Best for cereal, tea, bakery items and candy.
- Kraft: A rustic, eco-friendly look for takeout, bakery and natural brands.
- Corrugated: Crush protection and durability for pizza, delivery and heavier food.
- Rigid stock: Premium presentation for chocolates and gourmet gifts.

sections.title: Popular Food Box Styles & When to Use Them
sections.content:
- Tuck-end boxes: Folding cartons for tea, cereal, candy and dry foods where shelf presentation matters.
- Auto-bottom boxes: A pre-glued base that locks into place, for heavier items like jars, sauces and bulk snacks.
- Gable boxes: A built-in carry handle for bakery items and takeaway meals.
- Takeout boxes: Sturdy fold-over closures for delivery meals and heavier food.
- Tray and sleeve: A sliding sleeve over a tray for prepared meals and premium retail food.

sections.title: Grease, Moisture & Food-Contact Protection
sections.content: Functional coatings keep food at its best: grease-resistant barriers for burgers and fries, moisture-resistant coatings for refrigerated and frozen food, ventilation for hot meals, liners for direct food contact, and window films that show the food while keeping it covered.

sections.title: Wholesale Food Boxes: No MOQ, Free Shipping
sections.content: Order exactly what you need, from a small run for a pop-up to a full rollout. There are no hidden fees, die costs or plate charges, shipping is free, and standard production takes 8–12 business days. Rush orders are available on request.

Free, No-Obligation Quote

# Get a quote for your custom boxes.

Share your product’s requirements and our packaging experts will put together a custom quote for you.

- No minimum order
- Free design support
- No die or plate charges
- Free shipping

## What happens next

1. 01

### Share your specs.

Tell us the box size, quantity, material and any finishes. Add your artwork or ask for design help.
2. 02

### Get your custom quote.

A packaging specialist reviews your request and sends pricing for your exact box. There is no obligation to order.
3. 03

### Approve and produce.

Check your digital proof. Once approved, production takes 8–12 business days, with free shipping.

Here To Help

## We’re with you through your packaging journey.

Every product is different, so its packaging should be too. Our team designs each box around your product’s specifications, including custom sizes and dimensions. Request your quote to get started.

Prefer to talk it through? Email sales@packlegacy.com or call +1 (424) 321-6460.

[How to order](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/how-to-order/)[Artwork guidelines](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/artwork/)[Free dieline templates](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/free-dieline-templates/)

## Frequently asked questions

Quick answers to the questions customers ask most before ordering custom boxes.

### How much does a custom box cost?

The price depends on the material, box size, quantity and the printing and finishing you choose. Our pricing is affordable and competitive, and every quote is built for your exact box.

### What is the minimum number of boxes I can order?

There is no minimum order quantity. Order as many or as few boxes as you need.

### Which file format should I send my artwork in?

Send your artwork as an AI, PSD or PDF file.

### Can my box be printed on the inside and outside?

Yes. We can print the inside, the outside, or both.

### Can I order a sample before a bulk order?

Yes. Contact our customer team to order a sample of your box first.

### Are there hidden fees, or die and plate costs?

No. There are no hidden fees, and you never pay for dies or printing plates.

### When will I receive my order?

Most orders are completed in 8 to 12 business days. Need them sooner? Ask us about a rush order.

### Do I pay for shipping, and do you ship outside the US?

Shipping is fast and free. Besides the United States, we also ship to countries including the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada.

## Stylish Gift Boxes That Look High-End

Premium packaging turns simple items into memorable moments. Our gift boxes combine luxury with durability, with precise edges, sturdy structure and flawless finishing.

### Gift Box Styles

- Magnetic closure boxes: Hidden magnets that click shut, for luxury items, electronics and influencer kits.
- Two-piece boxes: A lid and base for clothing, classic games and jewelry.
- Gable boxes: A built-in handle for gourmet food, bakery treats and party favors.
- Shoulder neck boxes: A base, lid and inner neck for cosmetics, perfume and watches.
- Pillow boxes: A soft curved shape for jewelry, gift cards and boutique cosmetics.
- Tray and sleeve boxes: An inner tray and outer sleeve for chocolates and soaps.
- Window boxes: Window cutouts for candles and confectionery displays.

### Custom Gift Boxes for Every Special Moment

Match your packaging to the moment. Custom printed gift boxes in any size, shape and print tell your brand story for corporate gifting, weddings, holiday campaigns and product launches.

### Gift Packaging: Excellence Meets Sustainability

Our gift boxes use eco-friendly paperboard, cardboard, kraft, corrugated and rigid stock without losing strength.

- Protective laminations: Guard against scratches, moisture and fingerprints.
- Packaging sleeves: Extra structure and easy sliding access.
- Custom inserts: Foam, cardboard or velvet inserts cradle delicate items.

### Gift Boxes with Logo That Elevate Your Brand

Every gift box is printed in high resolution with digital or offset printing in CMYK and Pantone, inside, outside or both. Finish with matte or gloss lamination, Spot UV, foil stamping, or embossing and debossing.

sections.title: Stylish Gift Boxes That Look High-End
sections.content: Premium packaging turns simple items into memorable moments. Our gift boxes combine luxury with durability, with precise edges, sturdy structure and flawless finishing.

sections.title: Gift Box Styles
sections.content:
- Magnetic closure boxes: Hidden magnets that click shut, for luxury items, electronics and influencer kits.
- Two-piece boxes: A lid and base for clothing, classic games and jewelry.
- Gable boxes: A built-in handle for gourmet food, bakery treats and party favors.
- Shoulder neck boxes: A base, lid and inner neck for cosmetics, perfume and watches.
- Pillow boxes: A soft curved shape for jewelry, gift cards and boutique cosmetics.
- Tray and sleeve boxes: An inner tray and outer sleeve for chocolates and soaps.
- Window boxes: Window cutouts for candles and confectionery displays.

sections.title: Custom Gift Boxes for Every Special Moment
sections.content: Match your packaging to the moment. Custom printed gift boxes in any size, shape and print tell your brand story for corporate gifting, weddings, holiday campaigns and product launches.

sections.title: Gift Packaging: Excellence Meets Sustainability
sections.content:
Our gift boxes use eco-friendly paperboard, cardboard, kraft, corrugated and rigid stock without losing strength.

- Protective laminations: Guard against scratches, moisture and fingerprints.
- Packaging sleeves: Extra structure and easy sliding access.
- Custom inserts: Foam, cardboard or velvet inserts cradle delicate items.

sections.title: Gift Boxes with Logo That Elevate Your Brand
sections.content: Every gift box is printed in high resolution with digital or offset printing in CMYK and Pantone, inside, outside or both. Finish with matte or gloss lamination, Spot UV, foil stamping, or embossing and debossing.

Ordering guide

# Custom boxes, ordered in 5 steps.

Fill out one short form with your box size and quantity. We send a free quote, a digital proof, and then your finished boxes, shipped free.

[Start my free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/)[See the steps](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/how-to-order/#step-1)

- 2 minto request a quote
- No MOQorder any quantity
- Freedesign help and proofs
- 10–12 daysfrom proof to your door

Step by step

## From first click to free quote.

![](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/1.-select-the-desired-product.webp)

![](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/2.-measure-your-box-dimension.webp)

![](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/3.-provide-your-details.webp)

![](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/4.-provide-additional-information.webp)

![](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/5.-upload-your-artwork.webp)

Step 1 of 5

1. 01

![Select the desired product](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/1.-select-the-desired-product.webp)

Step 1

### Select the desired product

Click Get a Quote on any page, or open the product you want first. Either way, a quote form for that product opens. Fill it in as accurately as you can so we can price it right.

- Any box style
- Quote from any page

[Browse custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/)
2. 02

![Measure your box dimensions](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/2.-measure-your-box-dimension.webp)

Step 2

### Measure your box dimensions

Enter the length, width and depth (height) of the box you need, and choose your unit. Not sure how to measure? Our team can work out the right size from your product.

- Length × Width × Depth
- Inches, cm or mm

Tip: Measure the inside of the box, and add a little room for inserts or tissue.

[Read the box measuring guide](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/blog/measure-your-box-dimensions/)
3. 03

![Provide your details](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/3.-provide-your-details.webp)

Step 3

### Provide your details

Add your name, email, phone number and how many boxes you need. There is no minimum order, so order exactly what you need. A packaging specialist then contacts you with your custom quote.

- No minimum order
- Quick reply
4. 04

![Provide additional information](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/4.-provide-additional-information.webp)

Step 4

### Provide additional information

Use the message box for questions or extra details, like the box style, material, coating or finishes you have in mind. The more we know, the closer your price estimate.

- Material
- Coating
- Finishes
- Inserts

[Explore materials and finishes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/materials/)
5. 05

![Upload your artwork](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/5.-upload-your-artwork.webp)

Step 5

### Upload your artwork

## Have these ready.

Only your name, email and phone number are required. Size and quantity help us price faster, and we can help with everything else.

### Custom quote

3. 38–10 business days

### Production

Printing starts once your proof is approved and paid.
4. 42–3 business days

### Free shipping

Delivered with tracking via UPS, FedEx or DHL.

Need it sooner? Rush production takes 6 to 8 business days. See our [shipping policy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/shipping-policy/).

A packaging specialist reviews your details and sends your custom quote by email. Questions? Call +1 (424) 321-6460 or email sales@packlegacy.com.

### Can I order without artwork?

Yes. Request your quote first and send artwork later, or let our design team create it with you for free.

03

### Will I see my box before it is printed?

Yes. You always get a digital proof to approve. Production starts only after you approve it.

04

### Can I get a sample first?

Yes. See our [sample kits](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/sample-kits/) for plain, random and pre-production samples.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering custom boxes.

### What industries do you provide custom boxes for?

Almost every industry, including retail, gifting, food, electronics, apparel, CBD, bakery, cosmetics and healthcare.

### Do you have a minimum order quantity?

No. Order a single box, a small batch or a large bulk order.

### Can I order two different box styles in the same order?

Yes. Share your requirements with our packaging experts and we will put the order together for you.

### Are your boxes eco-friendly?

Yes. We use cardboard, kraft stock and corrugated board, designed to be recyclable and sustainable.

### Can I customize the size, shape and design of my boxes?

Yes. Size, shape, material, printing and finishing can all be customized.

### Do you offer free design support?

Yes. Our design team helps you create, adjust or optimize your artwork so it is print-ready.

Present every piece in style with custom jewelry boxes that show your brand from the very first look. Whether you sell rings, necklaces, earrings or full collections, our packaging protects delicate pieces, lifts your brand image and creates an unboxing moment customers remember.

## Jewelry Packaging Engineered For Every Piece

Every piece of jewelry needs packaging shaped around its size, weight and presentation. We design each box and insert to stop movement, prevent tangling and scratches, and keep the piece perfectly placed from display to delivery.

### Boxes for Every Type of Jewelry

- Ring boxes: Custom-cut foam, velvet pads or molded inserts hold engagement rings, wedding bands and stackable sets securely, while keeping them easy to lift out.
- Necklace boxes: Hooks, tabs, fold-over cards and fitted trays keep chains untangled and pendants in place.
- Earring boxes: Pierced cards, foam slots or recessed inserts keep studs, hoops, drops and statement pieces paired, separated and scratch-free.
- Bracelet boxes: Pads, fitted trays and elastic loops hold bangles, cuffs, tennis and charm bracelets without straining clasps.
- Watches and sets: Tailored compartments for watches, brooches, cufflinks, pendants, gift sets and matching jewelry sets.

### Premium Packaging That Adds Value

Customers judge a jewelry purchase before the box is even open. The weight of the box, the fit of the lid, the feel of the surface and the placement of the logo all shape how valuable the piece feels. Rigid board, soft-touch paper, velvet inserts, foiled logos, ribbon pulls and magnetic closures all show care and attention to detail.

Customers also keep jewelry boxes for storage, gifting and travel, which keeps your brand in front of them long after the sale.

### Materials for Protection and Presentation

Choose rigid stock for a sturdy, high-end box that suits luxury collections, or kraft, corrugated or cardboard for a natural look and practical everyday packaging. Every box is made to your product’s dimensions for a secure fit in storage, on display and in transit, and we help you pick the right material for your brand, budget and sales channel.

### Box Styles and When to Use Them

- Magnetic closure boxes: Hidden magnets give a smooth open and a secure close. Ideal for bridal jewelry, luxury gifts and high-value pieces.
- Drawer boxes: A ribbon pull or thumb notch and a fitted tray create a slow, special reveal for anniversary gifts and bridal sets.
- Two-piece boxes: A separate lid and base that are simple, durable and easy to stack. Cardboard keeps costs low; rigid board adds luxury.
- Mailer boxes: Extra protection in shipping, with plenty of room for print. Pair a magnetic or drawer box with a branded mailer for e-commerce.

### Custom Printing, Logos and Inserts

Put your logo, colors, typography and patterns on the outside, inside, insert, sleeve or card, with full-color or single-color printing, foil stamping, embossing, debossing or Spot UV. Very fine lines and small text may need adjusting for foil or embossing, and we match colors to Pantone specifications rather than screen colors. Printed samples or production proofs let you check quality before production starts.

Inserts are engineered for your piece, in EVA foam, velvet or fabric-covered foam, paperboard, molded pulp or removable trays.

### How to Order Custom Jewelry Boxes

- 1. Send your requirements: Jewelry dimensions, box style, quantity, finish and delivery timeline.
- 2. Get recommendations: We suggest the right material, insert, structure and printing for your budget.
- 3. Receive your quote: Clear pricing based on your specifications, quantity and shipping needs.
- 4. Review and approve: Confirm the design, details and sample before full production.
- 5. Production: Once approved, we produce your order and arrange delivery.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering jewelry boxes.

### Can I order custom jewelry boxes in small quantities?

Yes. There is no minimum order, which suits startups, product launches, seasonal collections and testing.

### What is the best material for jewelry packaging?

It depends on your product, price point and sales channel. Rigid board suits fine jewelry, cardboard suits retail ranges, and kraft gives a natural look.

### Can you add my logo to jewelry boxes?

Yes. We can print, foil stamp, emboss or deboss your logo on the box, lid, sleeve, insert or card.

### Do you make jewelry boxes with inserts?

Yes. Choose EVA foam, velvet-covered foam, paperboard inserts, removable trays, slotted cards or custom-cut compartments.

### How long does production take?

Usually 8–12 business days, depending on quantity, material, printing, finishes, inserts, sampling and shipping.

### Can you make boxes for different jewelry products?

Yes. We make boxes for rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets, watches and multi-piece sets.

sections.title: Jewelry Packaging Engineered For Every Piece
sections.content: Every piece of jewelry needs packaging shaped around its size, weight and presentation. We design each box and insert to stop movement, prevent tangling and scratches, and keep the piece perfectly placed from display to delivery.

sections.title: Boxes for Every Type of Jewelry
sections.content:
- Ring boxes: Custom-cut foam, velvet pads or molded inserts hold engagement rings, wedding bands and stackable sets securely, while keeping them easy to lift out.
- Necklace boxes: Hooks, tabs, fold-over cards and fitted trays keep chains untangled and pendants in place.
- Earring boxes: Pierced cards, foam slots or recessed inserts keep studs, hoops, drops and statement pieces paired, separated and scratch-free.
- Bracelet boxes: Pads, fitted trays and elastic loops hold bangles, cuffs, tennis and charm bracelets without straining clasps.
- Watches and sets: Tailored compartments for watches, brooches, cufflinks, pendants, gift sets and matching jewelry sets.

sections.title: Premium Packaging That Adds Value
sections.content:
Customers judge a jewelry purchase before the box is even open. The weight of the box, the fit of the lid, the feel of the surface and the placement of the logo all shape how valuable the piece feels. Rigid board, soft-touch paper, velvet inserts, foiled logos, ribbon pulls and magnetic closures all show care and attention to detail.

Customers also keep jewelry boxes for storage, gifting and travel, which keeps your brand in front of them long after the sale.

sections.title: Materials for Protection and Presentation
sections.content: Choose rigid stock for a sturdy, high-end box that suits luxury collections, or kraft, corrugated or cardboard for a natural look and practical everyday packaging. Every box is made to your product’s dimensions for a secure fit in storage, on display and in transit, and we help you pick the right material for your brand, budget and sales channel.

sections.title: Box Styles and When to Use Them
sections.content:
- Magnetic closure boxes: Hidden magnets give a smooth open and a secure close. Ideal for bridal jewelry, luxury gifts and high-value pieces.
- Drawer boxes: A ribbon pull or thumb notch and a fitted tray create a slow, special reveal for anniversary gifts and bridal sets.
- Two-piece boxes: A separate lid and base that are simple, durable and easy to stack. Cardboard keeps costs low; rigid board adds luxury.
- Mailer boxes: Extra protection in shipping, with plenty of room for print. Pair a magnetic or drawer box with a branded mailer for e-commerce.

sections.title: Custom Printing, Logos and Inserts
sections.content:
Put your logo, colors, typography and patterns on the outside, inside, insert, sleeve or card, with full-color or single-color printing, foil stamping, embossing, debossing or Spot UV. Very fine lines and small text may need adjusting for foil or embossing, and we match colors to Pantone specifications rather than screen colors. Printed samples or production proofs let you check quality before production starts.

Inserts are engineered for your piece, in EVA foam, velvet or fabric-covered foam, paperboard, molded pulp or removable trays.

sections.title: How to Order Custom Jewelry Boxes
sections.content:
- 1. Send your requirements: Jewelry dimensions, box style, quantity, finish and delivery timeline.
- 2. Get recommendations: We suggest the right material, insert, structure and printing for your budget.
- 3. Receive your quote: Clear pricing based on your specifications, quantity and shipping needs.
- 4. Review and approve: Confirm the design, details and sample before full production.
- 5. Production: Once approved, we produce your order and arrange delivery.

# Pack Legacy

> Custom printed packaging boxes, rigid boxes, folding cartons, mailer boxes and mylar bags with no minimum order, free design support and free shipping.

Pack Legacy is a US custom packaging manufacturer. Key facts:

- No minimum order quantity on custom boxes (custom paper bags start at 100 units).
- Free design support, digital proofs, and no die or plate charges.
- Standard production 8–12 business days after artwork approval; rush orders available.
- Free shipping; ships to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia.
- Materials: paperboard/cardboard, kraft, corrugated, rigid stock (chipboard) and BoPET (mylar).
- Printing: CMYK and Pantone, digital and offset, inside and outside. Finishes include foil stamping, embossing, debossing, Spot UV, soft-touch, matte and gloss.
- Contact: sales@packlegacy.com, +1-424-321-6460, 520 Vetterlein Ave, Hamilton Township, NJ 08619, USA.

## Unboxing Joy with Custom Mailer Boxes

Custom mailer boxes boost retail and eCommerce sales. They are durable, easy to assemble and fully customizable inside and out. They are ideal for eCommerce orders, subscription boxes, retail displays, corporate gifts and promotional kits.

### Custom Mailer Boxes Built For Protection

Mailer boxes protect your products from shipping and handling damage while still looking great. Choose from:

- Corrugated cardboard: Strong and reliable for shipping, storage and delivery.
- Kraft corrugated: Eco-friendly, recyclable kraft with a natural look.
- Flute thickness: E-flute (1/16″) or B-flute (1/8″) to absorb shock and support weight.

### Custom-Sized To Fit Every Product

A box sized to your product needs less void fill and weighs less to ship. Typical ranges are 3″–25″ long, 2″–25″ wide and 1″–15″ deep.

### Printing Options

Print inside, outside or both, in full color or a single solid color, with offset, digital, flexography or screen printing in CMYK and Pantone (PMS).

### Premium Finishes

Add matte, soft-touch or gloss lamination, Spot UV, embossing or foil stamping to highlight your artwork.

### Deliver Products Securely With Inserts

- Packaging card inserts: A personal message, discount card or brand info.
- EVA foam inserts: Cushioning for fragile or high-value items.
- Cardboard dividers: Separate multiple products in transit.
- Custom cardboard inserts: Cut to fit your product exactly.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering mailer boxes.

### What are custom mailer boxes used for?

Shipping eCommerce orders, subscriptions, retail items, corporate gifts and promotional kits, while protecting products and improving the unboxing experience.

### Do you offer inside printing for mailer boxes?

Yes. Interiors can carry branding, patterns, thank-you messages, offers or product information.

### Can I print my logo on mailer boxes?

Yes. Logos, brand colors, artwork and messages can be printed with offset, digital, flexography or screen printing in CMYK and Pantone.

### Are custom mailer boxes suitable for shipping?

Yes. Corrugated construction absorbs shock and stands up to handling.

### Can I add inserts inside mailer boxes?

Yes. Choose cardboard inserts, dividers, thank-you cards or EVA foam inserts.

### How long does it take to make mailer boxes?

Typically 8–12 business days, depending on size, quantity, printing, finishing and inserts.

sections.title: Unboxing Joy with Custom Mailer Boxes
sections.content: Custom mailer boxes boost retail and eCommerce sales. They are durable, easy to assemble and fully customizable inside and out. They are ideal for eCommerce orders, subscription boxes, retail displays, corporate gifts and promotional kits.

sections.title: Custom Mailer Boxes Built For Protection
sections.content:
Mailer boxes protect your products from shipping and handling damage while still looking great. Choose from:

- Corrugated cardboard: Strong and reliable for shipping, storage and delivery.
- Kraft corrugated: Eco-friendly, recyclable kraft with a natural look.
- Flute thickness: E-flute (1/16″) or B-flute (1/8″) to absorb shock and support weight.

sections.title: Custom-Sized To Fit Every Product
sections.content: A box sized to your product needs less void fill and weighs less to ship. Typical ranges are 3″–25″ long, 2″–25″ wide and 1″–15″ deep.

sections.title: Printing Options
sections.content: Print inside, outside or both, in full color or a single solid color, with offset, digital, flexography or screen printing in CMYK and Pantone (PMS).

sections.title: Premium Finishes
sections.content: Add matte, soft-touch or gloss lamination, Spot UV, embossing or foil stamping to highlight your artwork.

sections.title: Deliver Products Securely With Inserts
sections.content:
- Packaging card inserts: A personal message, discount card or brand info.
- EVA foam inserts: Cushioning for fragile or high-value items.
- Cardboard dividers: Separate multiple products in transit.
- Custom cardboard inserts: Cut to fit your product exactly.

faqs.question: What are custom mailer boxes used for?
faqs.answer: Shipping eCommerce orders, subscriptions, retail items, corporate gifts and promotional kits, while protecting products and improving the unboxing experience.

faqs.question: Do you offer inside printing for mailer boxes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Interiors can carry branding, patterns, thank-you messages, offers or product information.

faqs.question: Can I print my logo on mailer boxes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Logos, brand colors, artwork and messages can be printed with offset, digital, flexography or screen printing in CMYK and Pantone.

faqs.question: Are custom mailer boxes suitable for shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes. Corrugated construction absorbs shock and stands up to handling.

faqs.question: Can I add inserts inside mailer boxes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose cardboard inserts, dividers, thank-you cards or EVA foam inserts.

faqs.question: How long does it take to make mailer boxes?
faqs.answer: Typically 8–12 business days, depending on size, quantity, printing, finishing and inserts.

Materials & options library

# Every material, coating and finish in one place.

Years of packaging experience in one gallery. Each material and option has a short explanation, so you can compare and choose what suits your product. Our team is always here to help.

[Get instant quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/)[Order a sample kit](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/sample-kits/)

65 materials and options13 categories

![Paper and board collections](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/paper-collections.webp)

13 options

## Paperboard Materials

Lightweight, printable boards for folding cartons, retail boxes and product packaging.

- ![SBS C1S](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/sbs-c1s.webp)

### SBS C1S

Bleached white board with a smooth, glossy coating on one side. Excellent for crisp printing.

Coated 1 side
- ![SBS C2S](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/sbs-c2s.webp)

### SBS C2S

Strong, durable solid bleached board coated on both sides, for print inside and out.

Coated 2 sides
- ![CCNB](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/ccnb.webp)

### CCNB

Recyclable board with a white clay-coated top layer that takes high-resolution printing well.

Recyclable
- ![Fully Recycled CCNB](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/fully-recycled-ccnb.webp)

### Fully Recycled CCNB

Made entirely from recycled fibers, with a white clay coating for smooth printing.

100% recycled
- ![Natural Brown Kraft](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/natural-brown-kraft.webp)

### Natural Brown Kraft

Recyclable kraft made from a mix of virgin pulp and recycled paper, coated on both sides.

Eco-friendly
- ![White Kraft](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/white-kraft.webp)

### White Kraft

Eco-friendly kraft with a clean white surface, known for its strength and flexibility.

Eco-friendly
- ![Black Kraft](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/black-kraft.webp)

### Black Kraft

Black kraft made from virgin pulp and recycled paper, with an optional coating on both sides.
- ![Uncoated Unbleached Kraft](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/uncoated-unbleached-kraft.webp)

### Uncoated Unbleached Kraft

Light, natural kraft that is durable and tear-resistant, with no coating.

Uncoated
- ![CCK (Clay Coated Kraft Back)](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cck-clay-coated-kraft-back.webp)

### CCK (Clay Coated Kraft Back)

Recyclable kraft with a white clay-coated front for printing and a natural brown back.
- ![CNK (Clay Natural Kraft)](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cnk-clay-natural-kraft.webp)

### CNK (Clay Natural Kraft)

Sustainable board with at least 80% virgin unbleached wood pulp, for one-side printing.
- ![Metallic](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/metallic-paper.webp)

### Metallic

Premium board with a glossy or matte metallic laminate. Resists water and wear.

Premium
- ![Holographic](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/holographic.webp)

### Holographic

Glossy or matte holographic laminate that gives your box an eye-catching 3D effect.

Premium
- ![Textured](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/textured.webp)

### Textured

Premium paper stock with a raised surface that adds touch and visual appeal.

Premium

4 options

## Corrugated Materials

Liner boards for mailer and shipping boxes that need extra strength.

- ![Bleached White Board](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bleached-white-board.webp)

### Bleached White Board

Bleached kraft linerboard with a bright white finish that makes colors look more vivid.
- ![Kemi White Board](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/kemi-white-board.webp)

### Kemi White Board

Semi-gloss, bright white C1S linerboard made for high-quality printing.
- ![Natural Kraft Board](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/natural-kraft-board.webp)

### Natural Kraft Board

Brown, uncoated, unbleached linerboard. Durable, recyclable and great for shipping.

Recyclable
- ![Oyster White](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/oyster-white.webp)

### Oyster White

Durable clay-coated linerboard with a bleached, textured off-white surface for sharp printing.

9 options

## Flute Grades

Flutes are the wavy layers inside corrugated board. Thicker flutes cushion more; thinner flutes print better.

- ![A-Flute](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/a-flute.webp)

### A-Flute

About 1/4 inch thick. Best for stacking strength and cushioning fragile products.

1/4"
- ![B-Flute](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bflute.webp)

### B-Flute

About 1/8 inch thick. A flat surface for better printing and die cutting.

1/8"
- ![C-Flute](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/c-flute.webp)

### C-Flute

About 3/16 inch thick. Suited to shipping boxes, die cutting and quality printing.

3/16"
- ![E-Flute](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/e-flute.webp)

### E-Flute

About 1/16 inch thick. A strong, slim option for mailers and folding cartons.

1/16"
- ![F-Flute](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/f-flutes.webp)

### F-Flute

About 1/32 inch thick. For specialty packaging and point-of-purchase displays.

1/32"
- ![Single Face](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/single-face.webp)

### Single Face

One layer of fluting glued to one flat liner sheet. Often used as protective wrap.
- ![Single Wall](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/single-wall.webp)

### Single Wall

Fluting between two liners, forming one sturdy board. The most common shipping board.
- ![Double Wall](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/double.webp)

### Double Wall

Two flute layers with a liner board between them, for heavier products.
- ![Triple Wall](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/triple.webp)

### Triple Wall

Three fluted layers between four liners, for very heavy or industrial loads.

2 options

## Rigid Materials

Thick chipboard for luxury rigid, magnetic and drawer boxes.

- ![Duplex Chipboard](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/duplex-chipboard-materials.webp)

### Duplex Chipboard

Two layers of bleached chemical pulp. Strong and cost-effective.
- ![Grey Chipboard](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/grey-chipboard-materials.webp)

### Grey Chipboard

Thick board made from recycled material, the standard base for rigid boxes.

Recycled

5 options

## Special Qualifications

Extras that make your packaging feel finished and exclusive.

- ![Accessory Collections](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/accessory-collections.webp)

### Accessory Collections

Custom accessories, including handles, for exclusive packaging.
- ![Custom Insert](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-insert.webp)

### Custom Insert

Inserts designed around your product to hold it in place and protect it.
- ![Custom Ribbons](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-ribbons.webp)

### Custom Ribbons

Ribbons in any color, width or finish to tie your look together.
- ![Custom Structures](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-structures.webp)

### Custom Structures

Custom rigid structures built for your exact packaging needs.
- ![Paper Collections](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/paper-collections.webp)

### Paper Collections

A wide range of colored and textured papers for wraps and linings.

2 options

## Insert Materials

Keep products secure and beautifully presented inside the box.

- ![Cardboard Inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cardboard-inserts-materials.webp)

### Cardboard Inserts

Custom-cut card placed inside a box to separate and protect items.

Recyclable
- ![EVA Foam](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/eva-foam-materials.webp)

### EVA Foam

Flexible, lightweight foam with excellent shock absorption.

7 options

## Bag Materials

Paper stocks for custom printed shopping and gift bags.

- ![CCNB](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/ccnb-1.webp)

### CCNB

Recyclable board with a white clay-coated layer for high-resolution printing.
- ![Holographic](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/holographic-1.webp)

### Holographic

Holographic laminate in gloss or matte for a striking 3D effect.
- ![Metallic Paper](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/metallic-paper-1.webp)

### Metallic Paper

Glossy or matte metallic laminate that resists water and wear.
- ![Natural Brown Kraft](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/natural-brown-kraft-1.webp)

### Natural Brown Kraft

Recyclable kraft from virgin pulp and recycled paper, coated on both sides.
- ![SBS C1S](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/sbs-c1s-1.webp)

### SBS C1S

Bleached white board with a smooth, glossy coating on one side.
- ![Textured](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/textured-1.webp)

### Textured

Premium stock with a raised surface that adds visual appeal.
- ![White Kraft](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/white-kraft-1.webp)

### White Kraft

Eco-friendly white kraft, coated on both sides, strong and flexible.

2 options

## Mylar Bag Materials

Films for food, coffee and CBD pouches that need a strong barrier.

- ![Metalized Film](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/metalized-filmz.webp)

### Metalized Film

Metallized polyester film. Very light and resistant to punctures and tears.
- ![White Film](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/white-film.webp)

### White Film

Durable Mylar polyester film known for its strength and protection.

7 options

## Coatings & Laminations

Protect your print and change how your box looks and feels.

- ![Varnish](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/varnish-materials.webp)

### Varnish

Clear ink applied during CMYK printing to boost color, in gloss or matte.
- ![Aqueous Coating](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/aqueous-coating.webp)

### Aqueous Coating

Water-based, eco-friendly coating that dries quickly on printed material.

Eco-friendly
- ![Soft Touch Coating](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/soft-touch-coating.webp)

### Soft Touch Coating

Fast-drying coating with a smooth, velvety texture.
- ![Soft Touch Lamination](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/soft-touch-lamination.webp)

### Soft Touch Lamination

Protective matte laminate with a luxurious velvet feel.
- ![Spot UV](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/spot-uv-materials.webp)

### Spot UV

UV-cured gloss coating applied only to chosen areas, like your logo.
- ![UV Coating](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/uv-coating.webp)

### UV Coating

UV-cured gloss or matte coating that protects the whole surface.
- ![Lamination](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/lamination.webp)

### Lamination

A thin plastic layer over the print that adds shine or matte and protects it.

5 options

## Premium Finishes

Add-ons that make your logo shine, rise or reveal what is inside.

- ![Cold Foil Stamping](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cold-foil-stamping.webp)

### Cold Foil Stamping

A UV-curable adhesive and foil printed onto the board for a high-end metallic look.
- ![Hot Foil Stamping](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/hot-foiling.webp)

### Hot Foil Stamping

Heat, a die plate and metallic foil create a shiny, sharp design.
- ![Emboss](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/embosszz.webp)

### Emboss

Raises your design above the surface for texture and depth.
- ![Deboss](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/deboos.webp)

### Deboss

Presses your design into the surface for a subtle, luxurious feel.
- ![Window Patching](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/window-patching.webp)

### Window Patching

Clear film over a die-cut window so customers can see your product.

2 options

## Printing Options

Choose the method that fits your quantity and color needs.

- ![Offset Printing](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/offset-printing.webp)

### Offset Printing

Plates and rubber blankets transfer the design. Best value for large orders.

Large runs
- ![Digital Printing](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/digital-printing.webp)

### Digital Printing

Prints straight from your file with no plates. Ideal for short runs.

Short runs

3 options

## Material Terms

Three words you will see on every quote.

- ![PT](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/pt-1024x681.webp)

### PT

Points: the thickness of a paper stock. 1 pt equals 1/1000 of an inch.
- ![Flute](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/flute-1024x681.webp)

### Flute

The wave-like arches bonded between linerboards in corrugated board.
- ![GSM](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/gsm-1024x681.webp)

### GSM

Grams per square meter: the density, or weight, of a paper stock.

4 options

## Sustainability

Options for brands that want packaging that is kinder to the planet.

- ![Plastic Free](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/plastic-free-1024x681.webp)

### Plastic Free

Contains no petroleum-based plastics.
- ![Compostable](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/compostable-1024x681.webp)

### Compostable

Breaks down into soil under composting conditions.
- ![Biodegradable](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/biodegradable-1024x681.webp)

### Biodegradable

Breaks down naturally with exposure to air, light and moisture.
- ![Recyclable](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/recyclable-1024x681.webp)

### Recyclable

Made with a high share of recycled material and can be recycled again.

## Need more guidance?

We are always ready to help you pick the right material, thickness and finish for your product.

[Contact us](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/contact-us/)[Get a quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/)

pages.content_markdown:
Policies

# Privacy policy.

Your privacy matters to us. This page explains what information we collect, why we collect it and how we keep it safe.

## Introduction

This policy explains how Pack Legacy (“we”, “our” or “us”) collects, uses, discloses and protects your information when you visit our website and use our custom packaging services.

## Information we collect

- Contact data: your name, email address, phone number and shipping address.
- Business data: your company name, product details, box specifications and artwork.
- Transaction data: order details and payment records. Card payments are handled by secure third-party payment processors.
- Technical data: IP address, browser type and how you use our site, collected through cookies.

## How we use your information

- To process, produce and ship your orders.
- To talk to you about quotes, proofs, orders and support.
- To send promotional emails, which you can opt out of at any time.
- To improve our website and services.

## How we share information

We do not sell your personal data.

We share information only with service providers who help us run our business, such as shipping carriers and payment gateways, and where the law requires it.

## Data security

We use SSL/TLS encryption and restrict access to your proprietary designs and artwork to the team members who need it.

No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## Cookies and tracking technologies

- Essential cookies keep the site working, for example remembering your quote form.
- Performance cookies help us understand how visitors use the site.
- Functional cookies remember your preferences.

## Legal disclaimer

Information on this website is for general purposes only and is not manufacturing, structural engineering or legal advice. We make no warranty about the accuracy of the site’s content. We are not responsible for the content of third-party websites we link to.

## Your rights and choices

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data. To make a request, email sales@packlegacy.com.

You can turn off cookies in your browser settings, but some features of the site may stop working.

## Updates to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

## Contact us

If you have a question about this policy, our team is happy to help.

- Email: sales@packlegacy.com
- Phone: +1 (424) 321-6460
- Address: 520 Vetterlein Ave, Hamilton Township, NJ 08619, USA

## What are 123 Bottom Boxes?

123 Bottom boxes, also known as snap lock bottom boxes, are a type of [folding carton](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/folding-cartons/) designed to keep your products safe through their interlocking mechanism. This type of folding carton is popular among various products, including candles, snacks, baked items, and more, due to the protection it provides. The mechanism of this box style is famous for [gable boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/) and [tuck-end boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/), which provide secure protection to your products without worrying about them falling out from the bottom.

## Safe, Durable & Cost-Effective 123 Bottom Boxes

123 bottom boxes are built to handle products that require extra support during storage, shipping, and retail display. Their reinforced bottom construction provides greater strength than standard tuck bottom boxes, making them a reliable choice for packaging heavier or more delicate items.

These boxes are manufactured from durable paperboard and can be customized with different material thicknesses to match your product’s weight and packaging requirements. Despite their sturdy construction, they remain cost-effective to produce, offering an excellent balance between durability, functionality, and affordability. Whether used for food, cosmetics, candles, electronics, or other retail products, 123 bottom boxes provide dependable performance without increasing your packaging costs.

## What Material Options Are Available For 123 Bottom Boxes?

We offer a range of material options for 123 bottom boxes. You can select the one that best suits your packaging needs. All of our material options are FSC-certified, which means they are recyclable after use.

Here are the material options available for custom 123 bottom boxes:

- Cardboard: A versatile and lightweight packaging material that offers excellent print quality, making it ideal for retail products and everyday packaging applications.
- Paperboard: A smooth and durable material that delivers a premium appearance while providing reliable protection for lightweight to medium-weight products.
- Kraft Stock: Made from recyclable paper fibers, kraft stock offers natural durability and an eco-friendly appearance for sustainable packaging solutions.
- Corrugated Cardboard: Consisting of two linerboards with a wavy flute in between, corrugated cardboard provides superior cushioning and protection for heavier or fragile products during shipping.

## Enhance The Appeal of Snap Lock Bottom Boxes With Premium Features

Create custom snap lock bottom boxes that reflect your brand with high-quality printing and premium finishing options. Whether you need bold graphics, vibrant colors, or a clean minimalist design, we deliver sharp, consistent print results on every order.

Here are the printing options we offer:

- Offset Printing: Produces sharp details and consistent colors, making it ideal for large production runs.
- Digital Printing: A great choice for short runs, custom designs, and high-resolution artwork with fast turnaround.
- Screen Printing: Delivers rich, vibrant colors with excellent durability, especially for bold designs and specialty applications.

Enhance the appearance and durability of your custom printed 123 bottom boxes with premium finishing options. We offer the following finishing options:

- Gloss: Adds a smooth, reflective finish that makes colors appear brighter and more vibrant.
- Matte: Creates a clean, non-reflective finish for a modern and sophisticated look.
- Soft-Touch: Offers a velvety texture for a premium feel.
- Spot UV: Highlights specific design elements with a glossy coating while adding extra resistance to scratches and moisture.
- Embossing: Raises selected design elements above the surface to create a textured, premium look that enhances your branding.
- Foil Stamping: Applies metallic or colored foil to specific areas, adding a luxurious finish that makes your packaging stand out.

## Choose Pack Legacy For Wholesale 123 Bottom Boxes

Pack Legacy is a trusted custom box manufacturer offering high-quality custom 123 bottom boxes at competitive wholesale prices. Whether you need packaging for retail products, food items, cosmetics, candles, or other products, we manufacture [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) to your exact specifications. With low minimum order quantities, fast turnaround times, free design support, and free shipping, we make ordering custom 123 bottom boxes simple and cost-effective.

- Secure packaging that keeps your products stable during transit
- A polished, retail-ready look that improves unboxing moments
- Sizing tailored to your product for a snug, reliable fit
- Printing that brings crisp, clean visuals to your packaging
- A smoother customer experience that supports repeat buying

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What products are 123 bottom boxes suitable for?

123 bottom boxes are suitable for candles, cosmetics, baked goods, snacks, supplements, electronics, pharmaceuticals, and many other retail products that require durable packaging with a secure bottom closure.

### Are your 123 bottom boxes eco-friendly?

Yes. Our 123 bottom boxes are manufactured using FSC-certified recyclable materials, helping businesses reduce environmental impact while maintaining the quality, durability, and appearance of their packaging.

### Can I customize the size of my 123 bottom boxes?

Yes. We manufacture custom 123 bottom boxes in any size, shape, and dimension to ensure your products fit perfectly while enhancing protection, presentation, and overall customer experience.

### Are 123 bottom boxes suitable for heavy products?

Yes. Their reinforced bottom construction provides extra support, making them suitable for products that require stronger packaging than standard tuck bottom boxes without compromising stability or performance.

### Can I print my logo and branding on the boxes?

Yes. We provide high-quality printing that allows you to customize your boxes with logos, product information, brand colors, graphics, and artwork for a professional and memorable presentation.

sections.title: What are 123 Bottom Boxes?
sections.content: 123 Bottom boxes, also known as snap lock bottom boxes, are a type of [folding carton](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/folding-cartons/) designed to keep your products safe through their interlocking mechanism. This type of folding carton is popular among various products, including candles, snacks, baked items, and more, due to the protection it provides. The mechanism of this box style is famous for [gable boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/) and [tuck-end boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/), which provide secure protection to your products without worrying about them falling out from the bottom.

sections.title: Safe, Durable & Cost-Effective 123 Bottom Boxes
sections.content:
123 bottom boxes are built to handle products that require extra support during storage, shipping, and retail display. Their reinforced bottom construction provides greater strength than standard tuck bottom boxes, making them a reliable choice for packaging heavier or more delicate items.

These boxes are manufactured from durable paperboard and can be customized with different material thicknesses to match your product’s weight and packaging requirements. Despite their sturdy construction, they remain cost-effective to produce, offering an excellent balance between durability, functionality, and affordability. Whether used for food, cosmetics, candles, electronics, or other retail products, 123 bottom boxes provide dependable performance without increasing your packaging costs.

sections.title: What Material Options Are Available For 123 Bottom Boxes?
sections.content:
We offer a range of material options for 123 bottom boxes. You can select the one that best suits your packaging needs. All of our material options are FSC-certified, which means they are recyclable after use.

Here are the material options available for custom 123 bottom boxes:

- Cardboard: A versatile and lightweight packaging material that offers excellent print quality, making it ideal for retail products and everyday packaging applications.
- Paperboard: A smooth and durable material that delivers a premium appearance while providing reliable protection for lightweight to medium-weight products.
- Kraft Stock: Made from recyclable paper fibers, kraft stock offers natural durability and an eco-friendly appearance for sustainable packaging solutions.
- Corrugated Cardboard: Consisting of two linerboards with a wavy flute in between, corrugated cardboard provides superior cushioning and protection for heavier or fragile products during shipping.

sections.title: Enhance The Appeal of Snap Lock Bottom Boxes With Premium Features
sections.content:
Create custom snap lock bottom boxes that reflect your brand with high-quality printing and premium finishing options. Whether you need bold graphics, vibrant colors, or a clean minimalist design, we deliver sharp, consistent print results on every order.

Here are the printing options we offer:

- Offset Printing: Produces sharp details and consistent colors, making it ideal for large production runs.
- Digital Printing: A great choice for short runs, custom designs, and high-resolution artwork with fast turnaround.
- Screen Printing: Delivers rich, vibrant colors with excellent durability, especially for bold designs and specialty applications.

Enhance the appearance and durability of your custom printed 123 bottom boxes with premium finishing options. We offer the following finishing options:

- Gloss: Adds a smooth, reflective finish that makes colors appear brighter and more vibrant.
- Matte: Creates a clean, non-reflective finish for a modern and sophisticated look.
- Soft-Touch: Offers a velvety texture for a premium feel.
- Spot UV: Highlights specific design elements with a glossy coating while adding extra resistance to scratches and moisture.
- Embossing: Raises selected design elements above the surface to create a textured, premium look that enhances your branding.
- Foil Stamping: Applies metallic or colored foil to specific areas, adding a luxurious finish that makes your packaging stand out.

sections.title: Choose Pack Legacy For Wholesale 123 Bottom Boxes
sections.content: Pack Legacy is a trusted custom box manufacturer offering high-quality custom 123 bottom boxes at competitive wholesale prices. Whether you need packaging for retail products, food items, cosmetics, candles, or other products, we manufacture [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) to your exact specifications. With low minimum order quantities, fast turnaround times, free design support, and free shipping, we make ordering custom 123 bottom boxes simple and cost-effective.
