## What are Auto Lock Bottom Boxes?

Auto lock bottom boxes, also known as crash lock bottom boxes or auto bottom cartons, are a type of [folding carton](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/folding-cartons/) featuring a pre-glued base that automatically locks into place when the box is opened. Unlike traditional tuck-end boxes, they require no manual bottom folding, glue, or tape during assembly, making packaging faster and more convenient. Their reinforced bottom structure provides dependable support for products such as candles, glass jars, cosmetics, food items, and retail goods. These boxes ship flat for easy storage and can be customized with branded printing, different sizes, and premium finishes to meet specific packaging needs.

## Auto Lock Bottom: Fast & Reliable Packaging Solutions

Auto lock bottom boxes are an ideal choice for retail brands, offering both affordability and convenience. These boxes are also referred to as auto-lock bottom cartons that feature an automatic locking bottom. You can easily assemble them by gently squeezing them into a box with a closed bottom.

From packaging and fragile items to storage and display, these boxes are a perfect option that provides branding benefits. You can have them personalized in any size, shape, and color with a custom design to enhance your brand presence.

## Design Your Auto Bottom Boxes With Pack Legacy

When it comes to auto bottom boxes, we design them with care and affection. Not only that, but we also allow our clients to work closely with our experts to customize their packaging to their unique requirements.

Here’s how you can design your auto bottom boxes with us:

### Custom Sizes

Whether you need compact packaging for lightweight items or larger boxes for bulkier products, we let you customize your box size to your unique requirements, ensuring a secure fit, a professional presentation, and efficient storage. Custom sizing helps reduce excess space, protects products during transit, and enhances the overall customer experience.

### Material Selection

Choose from a variety of premium packaging materials to create durable and reliable auto bottom boxes. Our experts help you select the right stock based on your product’s weight, shipping requirements, and branding goals.

We offer the following material options:

- Kraft Stock
- Cardboard
- Corrugated Cardboard

### Printing Options

Transform your auto bottom boxes into powerful marketing tools with custom printing solutions. Add your brand logo, product details, graphics, and promotional messages using high-quality printing techniques, such as digital printing and offset printing.

Whether you prefer vibrant colors, minimalist designs, or detailed artwork, our printing options use CMYK and Pantone (PMS) color systems to help create eye-catching packaging that strengthens brand recognition and leaves a lasting impression.

### Finishing Options

Give your custom printed auto bottom boxes a premium touch with a variety of finishing options that enhance their overall appearance and customer appeal.

- Glossy finish for a vibrant and polished look
- Matte coating for a smooth, elegant appearance
- Soft-touch finish for a luxurious feel
- Embossing and debossing for added texture
- Foil stamping to highlight key design elements

These finishing enhancements help strengthen brand recognition while making your packaging more attractive and memorable to customers.

## Get Affordable Auto Bottom Packaging With Us

Pack Legacy is a trusted packaging manufacturer that deals in [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) and packaging solutions at wholesale rates. At Pack Legacy, we design these boxes with affordability in mind. We offer wholesale rates for bulk orders of auto bottom boxes. Bagels are best enjoyed when they’re soft, chewy, and full of flavor. And the right [bakery packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) keep them that way.

Our custom bagel boxes are engineered to protect against common issues: crushing, moisture loss, and oil stains.

- Thick, food‑safe materials that provide durable structure.
- Grease-resistant linings to keep the box looking clean even with seeded or cheesy bagels inside.
- Optional ventilation holes to prevent condensation, ensuring your bagels don’t turn soggy during storage or delivery.
- Reinforced corners and secure closures make these boxes reliable for retail shelves and catering transport.

Whether it’s a single bagel or a dozen, every bagel packaging keeps your baked good intact, appetizing, and ready to impress.

sections.title: Customized Bagel Boxes for Every Order
sections.content:
Every bagel order deserves the right fit. From single-serve boxes to catering trays, our bagel box styles match portion sizes, protect freshness, and elevate product presentation.

Choose from a wide variety of designs to match your bakery’s needs:

- Single Bagel Boxes: Compact and easy for grab‑and‑go sales.
- [Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Let customers see toppings and freshness at a glance.
- [Gable Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/): Durable and convenient for half‑dozen packs and takeaway bundles.
- [Two Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Feature a separate lid and base to create a polished presentation; ideal for pairing bagels with cream cheese jars, spreads, or toppings.

From single bagel packs to catering trays, our unique styles cover every need. And if your bakery also offers sweet treats, pair these with our [cupcake boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cupcake-boxes/) or [macaron boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/macaron-boxes/) for a cohesive packaging lineup. Your customers will love consistency across product ranges.

sections.title: Bagel Packaging Boxes Built for Freshness & Protection
sections.content:
Bagels are best enjoyed when they’re soft, chewy, and full of flavor. And the right [bakery packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) keep them that way.

Our custom bagel boxes are engineered to protect against common issues: crushing, moisture loss, and oil stains.

- Thick, food‑safe materials that provide durable structure.
- Grease-resistant linings to keep the box looking clean even with seeded or cheesy bagels inside.
- Optional ventilation holes to prevent condensation, ensuring your bagels don’t turn soggy during storage or delivery.
- Reinforced corners and secure closures make these boxes reliable for retail shelves and catering transport.

Whether it’s a single bagel or a dozen, every bagel packaging keeps your baked good intact, appetizing, and ready to impress.

sections.title: Make Sustainable Choices with Eco-Friendly Bakery Boxes
sections.content:
We use high-quality, durable, and eco-friendly materials for every bagel box.

You can choose from cardboard, paperboard, kraft, corrugated, and rigid stock; each comes in different thickness ranges from 12-24pt. These choices reduce waste and appeal to environmentally conscious buyers.

sections.title: Bagel Boxes with Logo: Branding That Stands Out
sections.content:
Your bagel box isn’t just a container—it’s a canvas for your bakery brand. Our custom printing options ensure every box stands out.

You are free to choose from:

- Digital & Offset Printing
- CMYK & Pantone Colors
- Outside, Inside, and Both-Sided Printing
- Specialty finishes like matte/gloss laminations, foil stamping, embossing, or spot UV

We help you print your bagel boxes with:

- A vibrant logo, bold typography, or even mouth‑watering product images
- Seasonal designs and limited‑edition patterns
- QR codes that link directly to menus, loyalty programs, or social media campaigns

In short, our custom bagel packaging doesn’t just carry bagels—it carries your brand’s story.

## Custom Bath Bomb Boxes Designed for E-Commerce and Retail

Your bath bombs are formulated to deliver the ultimate self-care experience. However, their delicate, fizzy compositions require specialized packaging to prevent crumbling during transit. Whether you sell bath bombs online or on crowded retail shelves, choosing the right box layout is essential.

To ensure every bath bomb box meets your specific needs, we offer a range of functional styles.

- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): Featuring a sliding tray wrapped inside a sturdy protective outer sleeve, they are perfect for high-end single items or premium multi-pack bath bomb collections.
- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): With top and bottom closing flaps that fold directly toward the same side, these boxes are best suited for lightweight round bath fizzies.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Their flaps close in the opposite direction to optimize space and assembly speed; highly recommended for high-volume retail display lines.
- [Auto Bottom Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/auto-lock-bottom-boxes/): Come with pre-glued bottom panels that snap and lock into place instantly when unfolded; ideal for rapid packing of heavy or jumbo-sized individual fizzies.
- [Two Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Consist of a distinct base tray covered by a fully detachable lid; the ultimate choice for luxurious, heavy bath bomb sets or assortment packs.
- [Mailer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/): Heavy-duty, crush-proof interlocking structures designed to withstand direct courier handling; they are best for shipping e-commerce bath-bomb orders.
- [Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Include a transparent or precisely die-cut window patch on the top or front panel to showcase highly textured, colorful, or botanically infused bath bombs.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): Open-top box designs to hold and present multiple bath bombs on checkout counters.

## High-Quality Packaging Materials to Fit Your Bath Bomb Requirements

Choosing the perfect bath bomb box material ensures your products arrive intact while aligning seamlessly with your brand identity.

We manufacture durable [retail boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/) using high-grade materials to fit your bath bomb requirements.

Each material ensures your delicate bath bombs stay secure and look wonderful during shipping, display, and storage. Most importantly, all materials we use are environmentally friendly. Your bath bombs will look impressive every time, without sacrificing the planet.

## Level Up Your Branding Game with Printed Bath Bomb Boxes

Bath bombs are one of the best-selling cosmetic items. Thus, they deserve to be presented in beautiful [cosmetic boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/). Unbranded packaging hides your business potential, but custom printed graphics instantly elevate your market value. We use advanced CMYK digital printing for complex, multi-colored artwork and high-volume offset printing to ensure flawless Pantone color matching.

Every corner of your bath bomb boxes can be printed with your artwork, logo, ingredient lists, and even thank-you notes on the inside of the lid.

When it comes to leveling up your branding game, our bath bomb boxes with logo perform well.

sections.title: Custom Bath Bomb Boxes Designed for E-Commerce and Retail
sections.content:
Your bath bombs are formulated to deliver the ultimate self-care experience. However, their delicate, fizzy compositions require specialized packaging to prevent crumbling during transit. Whether you sell bath bombs online or on crowded retail shelves, choosing the right box layout is essential.

To ensure every bath bomb box meets your specific needs, we offer a range of functional styles.

- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): Featuring a sliding tray wrapped inside a sturdy protective outer sleeve, they are perfect for high-end single items or premium multi-pack bath bomb collections.
- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): With top and bottom closing flaps that fold directly toward the same side, these boxes are best suited for lightweight round bath fizzies.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Their flaps close in the opposite direction to optimize space and assembly speed; highly recommended for high-volume retail display lines.
- [Auto Bottom Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/auto-lock-bottom-boxes/): Come with pre-glued bottom panels that snap and lock into place instantly when unfolded; ideal for rapid packing of heavy or jumbo-sized individual fizzies.
- [Two Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Consist of a distinct base tray covered by a fully detachable lid; the ultimate choice for luxurious, heavy bath bomb sets or assortment packs.
- [Mailer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/): Heavy-duty, crush-proof interlocking structures designed to withstand direct courier handling; they are best for shipping e-commerce bath-bomb orders.
- [Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Include a transparent or precisely die-cut window patch on the top or front panel to showcase highly textured, colorful, or botanically infused bath bombs.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): Open-top box designs to hold and present multiple bath bombs on checkout counters.

## Custom Book Boxes Designed for Effective Display & Brand Recognition

Custom book boxes offer an excellent way to present books while reinforcing your brand identity. Widely used by publishers, bookstores, and libraries, these boxes help showcase books in an organized and visually appealing manner. Designed for both presentation and protection, they keep books secure from damage during storage, shipping, and display.

Beyond books, these versatile packaging solutions can also be used for a variety of retail products, making them a practical choice for businesses looking to enhance product presentation and create a memorable brand experience.

## Why Choose Custom Book Boxes?

Book boxes are an excellent choice for publishers, bookstores, authors, collectors, and book lovers who want to protect and showcase their books in style. Whether used for retail displays, subscription book sets, special editions, or gifts for avid readers, these boxes enhance every book presentation.

- Enhance shelf appeal and product visibility.
- Strengthen brand recognition and customer recall.
- Keep books organized during storage and display.
- Perfect for book subscriptions, collector’s editions, and gifts.
- Create a memorable unboxing experience for bookworms.
- Help present books professionally and attractively.

With their versatility and visual appeal, custom book boxes offer a practical packaging solution for businesses and reading enthusiasts alike.

## How To Create Premium Book Boxes?

A premium book box enhances product appeal, attracts readers, strengthens brand perception, and encourages customers to make a purchase. This is why we offer a wide range of customization options, so you can create your own premium book boxes to meet your product requirements.

Here’s how you can create your premium book box packaging with us:

### Custom-Sized Book Box

We allow you to customize your book box size to meet your product requirements. All you have to do is provide us with your box dimensions for both interior and exterior so your books and titles can fit perfectly in them.

To provide the inner dimensions, measure your book or title’s length, width, and height, and add a few extra inches to the edges to prevent damage.

Don’t know how to measure a box? No worries, you can read our detailed guide on [how to measure your box dimensions](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/blog/measure-your-box-dimensions/) for a better understanding.

### Top Quality Packaging Materials

We offer a wide range of materials for custom book boxes. You can select the one that best suits your needs. These materials help increase the appeal of your book box, and different thicknesses are available to cater to all your packaging needs.

We offer the following material options:

- SBS Cardboard: SBS cardboard offers a smooth, clean surface for premium printing, making book packaging visually appealing, durable, and professional.

- Kraft Stock: Kraft stock provides a natural appearance, excellent durability, and eco-friendly appeal, making it ideal for sustainable book packaging.

- Rigid Stock: Rigid stock creates luxurious [rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/) for books, offering superior protection, premium presentation, and an enhanced unboxing experience.

- Corrugated Cardboard: Corrugated cardboard delivers exceptional strength and cushioning, protecting books from impacts, moisture, and damage during shipping.

### Custom Box Style for A Unique Appearance

Choose a custom box style for custom book packaging boxes. We understand that one box style is not enough, which is why we provide you with a range of book box styles to choose from.

Here are box styles from which you can choose one for your product:

## Custom Inserts for Added Protection

Keep books secure and perfectly positioned with custom inserts. Designed to hold books securely in place, these inserts prevent shifting, corner damage, and wear during transit. Available in foam, cardboard, and paperboard, [custom packaging inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) create a clean, organized interior that elevates the overall unboxing experience and adds a premium touch to your packaging.

## Make Your Book Boxes More Premium With Printing & Finishing Options

Transform ordinary book boxes into eye-catching packaging with custom printing and finishing options. High-quality printing allows you to showcase vibrant colors, logos, brand messages, and unique artwork that reflect your brand identity. Whether for retail, gifting, or promotional purposes, premium printing enhances the visual appeal of your custom printed book boxes.

Further elevate your [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) for books with luxury finishing options, such as:

- Spot UV to highlight logos, text, or design elements

- Embossing and debossing for a sophisticated textured effect
- Soft-touch coating for a premium tactile experience

These enhancements create a memorable unboxing experience while increasing the perceived value of your books.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ordering custom book boxes.

### What are book boxes?

Book boxes are specialized packaging solutions designed to store, protect, and present books. They help prevent damage during shipping, handling, and storage while enhancing product presentation.

### Can book boxes be customized with branding?

Yes, book boxes can be customized with logos, artwork, colors, and brand messaging using premium printing and finishing options to create a professional appearance.

### How safe are the closures on custom book boxes?

Custom book boxes feature secure closure options such as magnetic closures, tuck flaps, ribbons, and lids. These closures keep books protected and ensure the packaging remains firmly closed.

### What materials are used to make book boxes?

Book boxes are commonly manufactured from SBS cardboard, kraft stock, corrugated cardboard, and rigid stock, providing varying levels of durability, protection, and visual appeal.

### Which type of books can book boxes hold?

Book boxes can accommodate novels, textbooks, journals, magazines, children's books, photo books, religious books, and collector editions through fully customizable dimensions and designs.

### Are custom book boxes suitable for shipping?

Yes, custom book boxes are designed to protect books during transportation. Durable materials and optional inserts help minimize movement, impacts, and damage throughout shipping.

## Custom Burger Boxes for Takeaway and Delivery

Burger packaging should protect the food without unnecessarily compressing the bun, trapping too much steam, or allowing grease to weaken the box.

Our custom burger packaging boxes can be manufactured according to your burger size, weight, serving style, and delivery requirements.

They can help:

- Reduce grease transfer
- Manage steam and condensation
- Protect buns and toppings from crushing
- Keep sauces better contained
- Reduce movement during delivery
- Improve food presentation
- Display your branding clearly

Whether you need boxes for a single burger, sliders, double burgers, loaded burgers, or burger meals, we can manufacture the structure around your requirements.

## Choose the Right Burger Box Size

A burger box should fit the finished burger, not just the patty.

Measure:

- Burger width at its widest point
- Total height including bun, patties, cheese, sauces, and toppings
- Additional space needed for tall or loaded burgers
- Space required for wrappers, inserts, fries, or sides

A box that is too tight can compress the burger, while an oversized box can allow unnecessary movement during delivery.

We manufacture custom-size burger boxes, so you are not limited to standard dimensions.

Send us your finished burger dimensions if you need help determining a suitable internal box size.

## Burger Box Materials

Choose the material according to the burger weight, box style, printing requirements, and required strength.

Kraft Board: Provides a natural brown appearance and works well for simple branded burger packaging.

Paperboard: Offers a smooth printing surface and is suitable for individual burgers and detailed full-color artwork.

Cardstock: A practical option for lightweight to medium-weight burger boxes requiring good print quality.

Cardboard: Offers flexibility in thickness and structure for different takeaway burger packaging styles.

Corrugated Cardboard: Provides additional strength for heavier burgers, combo meals, and larger food packaging.

Need a particular GSM, PT thickness, or corrugated flute? Include the requirement with your quote request.

## Which Material Should You Choose?

The final material should be selected according to the actual box dimensions, burger weight, structure, and delivery requirements.

## Custom Burger Box Styles

We offer different burger box styles according to how the food will be served and transported.

Clamshell Burger Boxes: A practical hinged structure for individual burgers and takeaway orders.

Vented Burger Boxes: Include ventilation holes to help release excess steam during takeaway and delivery.

[Roll-End Tuck Top Boxes:](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/roll-end-tuck-top-boxes/) Provide additional space and strength for larger burgers and burger meals.

Tuck Top Boxes: Offer a secure closure and can be manufactured in different depths for burgers and combo meals.

[Gable Boxes:](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/) Include a built-in handle and work well for takeaway meals and multiple food items.

[Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Add product visibility for grab-and-go displays and prepared food counters.

Mini Burger Boxes: Sized specifically for sliders, kids’ meals, mini burgers, and appetizer portions.

Need another structure? Send us your burger dimensions and packaging requirements for a custom box style.

## How Ventilation Helps Burger Packaging

Hot burgers release steam after packing. If too much steam remains trapped, condensation can form inside the box and soften the bun.

Vent holes help excess moisture vapor escape.

However, more ventilation is not always better. Too many openings can allow heat to escape faster.

The right ventilation depends on:

- Burger size
- Food temperature
- Bun type
- Sauce and grease level
- Box dimensions
- Delivery time

This is why ventilation should be designed around the burger instead of adding random holes to the packaging.

## Grease, Moisture, and Structural Protection

Different packaging features solve different problems.

A grease-resistant coating does not replace ventilation, and ventilation does not replace structural strength. The box should be configured according to the food being packed.

## Custom Printed Burger Boxes with Logo

Turn your takeaway packaging into branded packaging with custom printed burger boxes.

Add:

- Logo
- Brand colors
- Patterns
- Illustrations
- Slogans
- QR codes
- Social media handles
- Promotional artwork

We offer printing options according to the material, artwork, quantity, and box structure.

Digital Printing: Suitable for detailed artwork and flexible production requirements.

Offset Printing: Provides sharp print quality for detailed graphics and larger production runs.

CMYK Printing: Best suited to multi-color artwork, photographs, illustrations, and gradients.

Pantone/PMS Printing: Useful when specific spot colors or closer brand-color consistency are required.

## Burger Box Finishing Options

Enhance printed burger packaging with finishes according to your branding requirements.

Matte Lamination: Creates a smooth, low-shine appearance.

Gloss Lamination: Adds shine and enhances printed colors.

Spot UV: Highlights selected logos, text, or design elements.

Embossing: Creates raised design details on selected areas.

Foil Stamping: Adds metallic detailing to logos or artwork.

Decorative finishing and functional grease/moisture barriers serve different purposes and should be selected separately.

## Add Dividers, Inserts, and Food Wraps

Burger meals often contain foods that should not sit directly against each other during delivery.

We can add:

- Custom dividers
- Inserts
- Separate compartments
- Burger wraps
- Food liners
- Sauce sections

Dividers can help keep burgers, fries, nuggets, and other sides separated inside the same package.

We also offer [custom french fry boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/french-fry-boxes/) for businesses that prefer to package fries separately while maintaining consistent branding.

## Burger Boxes for Food Businesses

Our personalized burger boxes are suitable for:

- Burger restaurants
- Fast-food restaurants
- Food trucks
- Cloud kitchens
- Takeaway counters
- Delivery restaurants
- Cafes
- Catering businesses
- Street-food vendors
- Restaurant chains

The size, structure, material, and artwork can be customized according to your menu and operation.

## Easy-to-Store Burger Packaging

For busy kitchens, packaging should also be practical before the food goes inside.

Many folding burger box structures can be supplied flat, helping reduce storage space before assembly.

When selecting a structure, consider:

- Storage space
- Assembly time
- Closure type
- Daily order volume
- Number of box sizes used in the kitchen

If fast assembly is important, mention your expected order volume so we can recommend a practical structure.

## Sustainable Burger Packaging Options

Sustainability depends on the complete packaging construction, not simply whether the box looks natural.

Ask us about available:

- Kraft materials
- Recycled-content options
- Recyclable paper-based stocks
- Alternative coating options

The recyclability of finished food packaging can vary depending on material, coatings, grease contamination, laminations, and local recycling facilities.

Already have artwork? Send your print-ready design with your packaging requirements.

Useful files may include:

- Logo

If you do not have a finished dieline, our free design support can help prepare the artwork for your selected burger box structure.

This gives you an opportunity to review the structure and artwork before full production begins.

sections.title: Custom Burger Boxes for Takeaway and Delivery
sections.content:
Burger packaging should protect the food without unnecessarily compressing the bun, trapping too much steam, or allowing grease to weaken the box.

Our custom burger packaging boxes can be manufactured according to your burger size, weight, serving style, and delivery requirements.

They can help:

- Reduce grease transfer
- Manage steam and condensation
- Protect buns and toppings from crushing
- Keep sauces better contained
- Reduce movement during delivery
- Improve food presentation
- Display your branding clearly

Whether you need boxes for a single burger, sliders, double burgers, loaded burgers, or burger meals, we can manufacture the structure around your requirements.

sections.title: Choose the Right Burger Box Size
sections.content:
A burger box should fit the finished burger, not just the patty.

Measure:

- Burger width at its widest point
- Total height including bun, patties, cheese, sauces, and toppings
- Additional space needed for tall or loaded burgers
- Space required for wrappers, inserts, fries, or sides

A box that is too tight can compress the burger, while an oversized box can allow unnecessary movement during delivery.

We manufacture custom-size burger boxes, so you are not limited to standard dimensions.

Send us your finished burger dimensions if you need help determining a suitable internal box size.

sections.title: Burger Box Materials
sections.content:
Choose the material according to the burger weight, box style, printing requirements, and required strength.

Kraft Board: Provides a natural brown appearance and works well for simple branded burger packaging.

Paperboard: Offers a smooth printing surface and is suitable for individual burgers and detailed full-color artwork.

Cardstock: A practical option for lightweight to medium-weight burger boxes requiring good print quality.

Cardboard: Offers flexibility in thickness and structure for different takeaway burger packaging styles.

Corrugated Cardboard: Provides additional strength for heavier burgers, combo meals, and larger food packaging.

Need a particular GSM, PT thickness, or corrugated flute? Include the requirement with your quote request.

sections.title: Which Material Should You Choose?
sections.content: The final material should be selected according to the actual box dimensions, burger weight, structure, and delivery requirements.

sections.title: Custom Burger Box Styles
sections.content:
We offer different burger box styles according to how the food will be served and transported.

Clamshell Burger Boxes: A practical hinged structure for individual burgers and takeaway orders.

Vented Burger Boxes: Include ventilation holes to help release excess steam during takeaway and delivery.

[Roll-End Tuck Top Boxes:](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/roll-end-tuck-top-boxes/) Provide additional space and strength for larger burgers and burger meals.

Tuck Top Boxes: Offer a secure closure and can be manufactured in different depths for burgers and combo meals.

[Gable Boxes:](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/) Include a built-in handle and work well for takeaway meals and multiple food items.

[Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Add product visibility for grab-and-go displays and prepared food counters.

Mini Burger Boxes: Sized specifically for sliders, kids’ meals, mini burgers, and appetizer portions.

Need another structure? Send us your burger dimensions and packaging requirements for a custom box style.

sections.title: How Ventilation Helps Burger Packaging
sections.content:
Hot burgers release steam after packing. If too much steam remains trapped, condensation can form inside the box and soften the bun.

Vent holes help excess moisture vapor escape.

However, more ventilation is not always better. Too many openings can allow heat to escape faster.

The right ventilation depends on:

- Burger size
- Food temperature
- Bun type
- Sauce and grease level
- Box dimensions
- Delivery time

This is why ventilation should be designed around the burger instead of adding random holes to the packaging.

sections.title: Grease, Moisture, and Structural Protection
sections.content:
Different packaging features solve different problems.

A grease-resistant coating does not replace ventilation, and ventilation does not replace structural strength. The box should be configured according to the food being packed.

sections.title: Custom Printed Burger Boxes with Logo
sections.content:
Turn your takeaway packaging into branded packaging with custom printed burger boxes.

Add:

- Logo
- Brand colors
- Patterns
- Illustrations
- Slogans
- QR codes
- Social media handles
- Promotional artwork

We offer printing options according to the material, artwork, quantity, and box structure.

Digital Printing: Suitable for detailed artwork and flexible production requirements.

Offset Printing: Provides sharp print quality for detailed graphics and larger production runs.

CMYK Printing: Best suited to multi-color artwork, photographs, illustrations, and gradients.

Pantone/PMS Printing: Useful when specific spot colors or closer brand-color consistency are required.

sections.title: Burger Box Finishing Options
sections.content:
Enhance printed burger packaging with finishes according to your branding requirements.

Matte Lamination: Creates a smooth, low-shine appearance.

Gloss Lamination: Adds shine and enhances printed colors.

Spot UV: Highlights selected logos, text, or design elements.

Embossing: Creates raised design details on selected areas.

Foil Stamping: Adds metallic detailing to logos or artwork.

Decorative finishing and functional grease/moisture barriers serve different purposes and should be selected separately.

sections.title: Add Dividers, Inserts, and Food Wraps
sections.content:
Burger meals often contain foods that should not sit directly against each other during delivery.

We can add:

- Custom dividers
- Inserts
- Separate compartments
- Burger wraps
- Food liners
- Sauce sections

Dividers can help keep burgers, fries, nuggets, and other sides separated inside the same package.

We also offer [custom french fry boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/french-fry-boxes/) for businesses that prefer to package fries separately while maintaining consistent branding.

sections.title: Burger Boxes for Food Businesses
sections.content:
Our personalized burger boxes are suitable for:

- Burger restaurants
- Fast-food restaurants
- Food trucks
- Cloud kitchens
- Takeaway counters
- Delivery restaurants
- Cafes
- Catering businesses
- Street-food vendors
- Restaurant chains

The size, structure, material, and artwork can be customized according to your menu and operation.

sections.title: Easy-to-Store Burger Packaging
sections.content:
For busy kitchens, packaging should also be practical before the food goes inside.

Many folding burger box structures can be supplied flat, helping reduce storage space before assembly.

When selecting a structure, consider:

- Storage space
- Assembly time
- Closure type
- Daily order volume
- Number of box sizes used in the kitchen

If fast assembly is important, mention your expected order volume so we can recommend a practical structure.

sections.title: Sustainable Burger Packaging Options
sections.content:
Sustainability depends on the complete packaging construction, not simply whether the box looks natural.

Ask us about available:

- Kraft materials
- Recycled-content options
- Recyclable paper-based stocks
- Alternative coating options

The recyclability of finished food packaging can vary depending on material, coatings, grease contamination, laminations, and local recycling facilities.

sections.title: Artwork and Design Support
sections.content:
Already have artwork? Send your print-ready design with your packaging requirements.

Useful files may include:

- Logo
- Brand colors
- Text
- Illustrations
- QR codes
- Product information

If you do not have a finished dieline, our free design support can help prepare the artwork for your selected burger box structure.

Before production, review:

- Dimensions
- Cut lines
- Fold lines
- Logo placement
- Text
- Colors
- Artwork direction
- QR codes or barcodes

sections.title: Proof Before Production
sections.content:
Before manufacturing the complete order, you will receive a digital proof for approval.

The process is simple:

Requirements → Dieline → Artwork → Digital Proof → Approval → Production → Shipping

This gives you an opportunity to review the structure and artwork before full production begins.

Customize the:

## Where Cake Boxes Work Best?

Custom cake boxes help bakeries, cafes, home bakers, and dessert brands to deliver cakes with better protection and professional presentation. From daily counter sales and custom cake orders to seasonal collections and special events, the right packaging keeps cakes secure while creating a memorable customer experience.

Our boxes are ideal for protecting the delicate frosting, toppers, cake boards, and decorations during handling and transport to make your birthdays, weddings, and anniversaries memorable.

If you are offering a complete bakery range, pair your cake packaging with our [bakery boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) for cupcakes, cookies, donuts, and other baked treats.

## Build Around Your Cake Size, Not a Stock Template

Every cake has different packaging requirements. A 6-inch tall cake with tall frosting, toppers, or layered designs need more space than a standard 6x6x4 box. That is why we carefully engineer cake boxes around your cake’s actual dimensions, including height, diameter, cake board, size, and decorative details, to make your customers celebrate their special moments with love and thoughtfulness.

Whether you sell single cakes, tall tiered designs, wedding cakes, or everyday bakery orders, we create packaging with the right fit, support, and opening style.

Tall and specialty cakes often need extra vertical clearance to prevent the top from touching or shifting inside the box. For products with a naturally taller profile, such as panettone, we can make [panettone boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/panettone-boxes/) to match the product’s height and diameter for a more secure fit.

We customize cake boxes based on:

- Cake size and height to prevent frosting, toppers, and decorations.
- Cake board dimensions provide a secure fit and easy handling.
- Cake style and design to accommodate layers and decorations.
- Transport needs for stability during pickup, delivery, and events.
- Brand presentation to make your brand stand out.

## Material Options For Cake Boxes

The material you choose for your cake boxes has a noteworthy impact on how your customers perceive it. For the lightweight cakes and[cupcake boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cupcake-boxes/), we recommend food-safe paperboard and cardboard due to the fact that they offer a clean, polished structure that works well for printed designs and retail display. These materials are practical for bakeries that need attractive packaging for daily orders without making the box feel weighted much.

For heavier cakes, layered cakes, and delivery orders, corrugated stock gives excellent strength and resistance against bending and twisting. Kraft paper is a good choice when your bakery wants a natural, simple, or eco-conscious look, especially for homemade, organic, or rustic cake lines,

## Box Styles for Every Cake Type

Different cakes require different packaging structures. We understand this and offer custom cake box styles designed around your cakes, whether you need better visibility for decorated cakes, stronger support for premium designs, or practical packaging for everyday orders.

[Roll End Tuck Top Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/roll-end-tuck-top-boxes/): It is a reliable choice for everyday bakery packaging, especially for small bakeries and home bakers who need cost-effective, easy-to-handle boxes for regular cake orders.

Flip Top Boxes: They are designed for quick opening and closing, which makes them a convenient option for bakeries that want efficient packaging and a neat customer experience.

[Handle Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/handle-boxes/): Provide easier carrying for takeaway orders, gifting, and local deliveries while maintaining a professional appearance.

[Boxes with Die-cut Windows](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/die-cut-boxes/): Ideal for showcasing decorated cakes while also keeping them protected. This allows customers to see the design without opening the packaging.

[Two-Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): It is a premium packaging style with a separate lid and base. They perform best for wedding cakes and special occasion orders where presentation is demanded.

[Gable Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/): Combine a gift-style look with practical handling. This makes them a great fit for seasonal collections, celebrations, and desert gifting.

Our creativity is not limited to these box styles. We are happy to design custom styles if you have any specific requirements.

## Printing Options That Turn Packaging Into Branding

Let customers remember your brand by presenting your cakes in our custom-printed cake boxes with logos. With custom printing, you can add your bakery logo, brand colors, Instagram handle, QR code, flavor name, care instructions, reheating notes, storage tips, or a short thank-you message.

We offer CMYK and Pantone printing, along with inside, outside, or both-side printing. You can keep the design clean with a logo or simple pattern, or create themed packaging for birthdays, weddings, Christmas, Valentine’s Day, baby showers, corporate events, and holiday promotions.

If you sell seasonal cakes, personalized cake boxes make your limited-time products feel more special without changing your cake recipe itself.

## Finishing and Coating Options for a More Premium Look

Premium cakes deserve packaging that reflects their value. For wedding cakes, luxury treats, celebration cakes, and gift-ready collections, the right finish transforms your cake box into part of the customer experience.

We offer matte or gloss lamination, spot UV, embossing, debossing, and foil stamping to achieve the look your brand deserves. Whether you prefer a soft-touch matte finish, a vibrant gloss coating, a metallic foil logo, or textured details that stand out, every finish is applied by keeping both visual appeal and production quality in mind.

To keep your cakes protected from fresh frosting, we offer moisture- and grease-resistant coating to prevent oil and grease spots on packaging that may ruin the whole moment.

## Why Choose Us for Custom Cake Boxes?

At [Pack Legacy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/), we understand how much work goes into a cake before it reaches the customer. One loose box, weak panel, or incorrect size can damage hours of baking, frosting, decorating, and planning. That is why we do not treat cake packaging as a simple carton. We help you choose boxes that fit your cakes, protect their design, and present your bakery the way it deserves.

As a trusted custom cake box supplier serving bakeries, home bakers, and cafes across the USA, we create packaging tailored to your products, branding, and business goals.

Order wholesale cake boxes for bulk needs or take advantage of our no minimum order quantity to order smaller quantities for your limited editions. Our team provides free design support, digital proofs, custom sizing, premium materials, high-quality printing, and finishing options to simplify the entire process.

Also, for busy bakeries and time-sensitive campaigns, we offer fast turnaround, rush production, and free shipping. Usually, our production time may take 8-12 business days.

Contact our customer support team for an instant quote for your custom cake boxes and get started with us today!

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ordering custom cake boxes.

### What are custom cake boxes?

Custom cake boxes are packaging boxes made according to your cake size, style, material, branding, and presentation needs. They help protect cakes during handling and transport while giving your bakery a more professional look.

### What materials are best for cake boxes?

For lightweight cakes and everyday bakery packaging, paperboard and cardboard are common options. For heavier cakes, sheet cakes, tall cakes, and delivery orders, corrugated stock provides better strength and support. Kraft paper is also available for natural and eco-conscious packaging styles.

### Can I order custom cake boxes with my logo?

Yes, you can order custom cake boxes with your logo, brand colors, patterns, product details, QR codes, social media handles, and other branding elements. We offer high-quality custom printing to help your packaging represent your bakery.

### Can you make boxes for tall cakes or tiered cakes?

Yes, we can create custom-size boxes for tall cakes, tiered cakes, wedding cakes, and cakes with toppers or decorative details. We design the box around your cake’s actual height, diameter, cake board size, and transport needs.

### Do you offer window cake boxes?

Yes, we offer cake boxes with die-cut windows and clear window patching. Window cake boxes are ideal for decorated cakes because they allow customers to see the cake without opening the box.

### Do you offer wholesale cake boxes?

Yes, we offer wholesale cake boxes for bakeries, cafés, restaurants, cake shops, and dessert brands. Bulk ordering is a great option if you need regular packaging for daily bakery sales or large event orders.

### Is there a minimum order quantity?

We offer flexible ordering options, including no minimum order quantity. This makes it easier for home bakers, small bakeries, and new businesses to order custom cake boxes without buying large quantities.

### Do you provide design support?

Yes, our team provides free design support to help you prepare your artwork, logo placement, colors, printing layout, and finishing options. We also provide digital proofs before production.

sections.title: Where Cake Boxes Work Best?
sections.content:
Custom cake boxes help bakeries, cafes, home bakers, and dessert brands to deliver cakes with better protection and professional presentation. From daily counter sales and custom cake orders to seasonal collections and special events, the right packaging keeps cakes secure while creating a memorable customer experience.

Our boxes are ideal for protecting the delicate frosting, toppers, cake boards, and decorations during handling and transport to make your birthdays, weddings, and anniversaries memorable.

If you are offering a complete bakery range, pair your cake packaging with our [bakery boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) for cupcakes, cookies, donuts, and other baked treats.

sections.title: Build Around Your Cake Size, Not a Stock Template
sections.content:
Every cake has different packaging requirements. A 6-inch tall cake with tall frosting, toppers, or layered designs need more space than a standard 6x6x4 box. That is why we carefully engineer cake boxes around your cake’s actual dimensions, including height, diameter, cake board, size, and decorative details, to make your customers celebrate their special moments with love and thoughtfulness.

Whether you sell single cakes, tall tiered designs, wedding cakes, or everyday bakery orders, we create packaging with the right fit, support, and opening style.

Tall and specialty cakes often need extra vertical clearance to prevent the top from touching or shifting inside the box. For products with a naturally taller profile, such as panettone, we can make [panettone boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/panettone-boxes/) to match the product’s height and diameter for a more secure fit.

We customize cake boxes based on:

- Cake size and height to prevent frosting, toppers, and decorations.
- Cake board dimensions provide a secure fit and easy handling.
- Cake style and design to accommodate layers and decorations.
- Transport needs for stability during pickup, delivery, and events.
- Brand presentation to make your brand stand out.

sections.title: Material Options For Cake Boxes
sections.content:
The material you choose for your cake boxes has a noteworthy impact on how your customers perceive it. For the lightweight cakes and[cupcake boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cupcake-boxes/), we recommend food-safe paperboard and cardboard due to the fact that they offer a clean, polished structure that works well for printed designs and retail display. These materials are practical for bakeries that need attractive packaging for daily orders without making the box feel weighted much.

For heavier cakes, layered cakes, and delivery orders, corrugated stock gives excellent strength and resistance against bending and twisting. Kraft paper is a good choice when your bakery wants a natural, simple, or eco-conscious look, especially for homemade, organic, or rustic cake lines,

sections.title: Box Styles for Every Cake Type
sections.content:
Different cakes require different packaging structures. We understand this and offer custom cake box styles designed around your cakes, whether you need better visibility for decorated cakes, stronger support for premium designs, or practical packaging for everyday orders.

[Roll End Tuck Top Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/roll-end-tuck-top-boxes/): It is a reliable choice for everyday bakery packaging, especially for small bakeries and home bakers who need cost-effective, easy-to-handle boxes for regular cake orders.

Flip Top Boxes: They are designed for quick opening and closing, which makes them a convenient option for bakeries that want efficient packaging and a neat customer experience.

[Handle Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/handle-boxes/): Provide easier carrying for takeaway orders, gifting, and local deliveries while maintaining a professional appearance.

[Boxes with Die-cut Windows](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/die-cut-boxes/): Ideal for showcasing decorated cakes while also keeping them protected. This allows customers to see the design without opening the packaging.

[Two-Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): It is a premium packaging style with a separate lid and base. They perform best for wedding cakes and special occasion orders where presentation is demanded.

[Gable Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/): Combine a gift-style look with practical handling. This makes them a great fit for seasonal collections, celebrations, and desert gifting.

Our creativity is not limited to these box styles. We are happy to design custom styles if you have any specific requirements.

sections.title: Printing Options That Turn Packaging Into Branding
sections.content:
Let customers remember your brand by presenting your cakes in our custom-printed cake boxes with logos. With custom printing, you can add your bakery logo, brand colors, Instagram handle, QR code, flavor name, care instructions, reheating notes, storage tips, or a short thank-you message.

We offer CMYK and Pantone printing, along with inside, outside, or both-side printing. You can keep the design clean with a logo or simple pattern, or create themed packaging for birthdays, weddings, Christmas, Valentine’s Day, baby showers, corporate events, and holiday promotions.

If you sell seasonal cakes, personalized cake boxes make your limited-time products feel more special without changing your cake recipe itself.

sections.title: Finishing and Coating Options for a More Premium Look
sections.content:
Premium cakes deserve packaging that reflects their value. For wedding cakes, luxury treats, celebration cakes, and gift-ready collections, the right finish transforms your cake box into part of the customer experience.

We offer matte or gloss lamination, spot UV, embossing, debossing, and foil stamping to achieve the look your brand deserves. Whether you prefer a soft-touch matte finish, a vibrant gloss coating, a metallic foil logo, or textured details that stand out, every finish is applied by keeping both visual appeal and production quality in mind.

To keep your cakes protected from fresh frosting, we offer moisture- and grease-resistant coating to prevent oil and grease spots on packaging that may ruin the whole moment.

sections.title: Why Choose Us for Custom Cake Boxes?
sections.content:
At [Pack Legacy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/), we understand how much work goes into a cake before it reaches the customer. One loose box, weak panel, or incorrect size can damage hours of baking, frosting, decorating, and planning. That is why we do not treat cake packaging as a simple carton. We help you choose boxes that fit your cakes, protect their design, and present your bakery the way it deserves.

As a trusted custom cake box supplier serving bakeries, home bakers, and cafes across the USA, we create packaging tailored to your products, branding, and business goals.

Order wholesale cake boxes for bulk needs or take advantage of our no minimum order quantity to order smaller quantities for your limited editions. Our team provides free design support, digital proofs, custom sizing, premium materials, high-quality printing, and finishing options to simplify the entire process.

Also, for busy bakeries and time-sensitive campaigns, we offer fast turnaround, rush production, and free shipping. Usually, our production time may take 8-12 business days.

Contact our customer support team for an instant quote for your custom cake boxes and get started with us today!

sections.title: What are custom cake boxes?
sections.content: Custom cake boxes are packaging boxes made according to your cake size, style, material, branding, and presentation needs. They help protect cakes during handling and transport while giving your bakery a more professional look.

sections.title: What materials are best for cake boxes?
sections.content: For lightweight cakes and everyday bakery packaging, paperboard and cardboard are common options. For heavier cakes, sheet cakes, tall cakes, and delivery orders, corrugated stock provides better strength and support. Kraft paper is also available for natural and eco-conscious packaging styles.

sections.title: Can I order custom cake boxes with my logo?
sections.content: Yes, you can order custom cake boxes with your logo, brand colors, patterns, product details, QR codes, social media handles, and other branding elements. We offer high-quality custom printing to help your packaging represent your bakery.

sections.title: Can you make boxes for tall cakes or tiered cakes?
sections.content: Yes, we can create custom-size boxes for tall cakes, tiered cakes, wedding cakes, and cakes with toppers or decorative details. We design the box around your cake’s actual height, diameter, cake board size, and transport needs.

sections.title: Do you offer window cake boxes?
sections.content: Yes, we offer cake boxes with die-cut windows and clear window patching. Window cake boxes are ideal for decorated cakes because they allow customers to see the cake without opening the box.

sections.title: Do you offer wholesale cake boxes?
sections.content: Yes, we offer wholesale cake boxes for bakeries, cafés, restaurants, cake shops, and dessert brands. Bulk ordering is a great option if you need regular packaging for daily bakery sales or large event orders.

sections.title: Is there a minimum order quantity?
sections.content: We offer flexible ordering options, including no minimum order quantity. This makes it easier for home bakers, small bakeries, and new businesses to order custom cake boxes without buying large quantities.

sections.title: Do you provide design support?
sections.content:
Yes, our team provides free design support to help you prepare your artwork, logo placement, colors, printing layout, and finishing options. We also provide digital proofs before production.

- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each material is highly durable and eco-friendly, helping you preserve your candies without harming the planet.

In addition to high-quality materials, we include specialized liners for inward protection. This way, your candies will be safe from sugar bloom and oxygen exposure, which can turn confections stale.

## Provide Excellent Protection To Your Products By Using Cardboard Box Dividers

Cardboard packaging dividers, also known as box partitions, are designed to provide excellent protection while organizing products in an appealing way. They help in organizing multiple products at once, whether you want to showcase them on retail shelves or ship them.

These dividers use intersecting cardboard sheets to create separate compartments inside a box. They keep products organized, protected, and safely separated during handling and shipping. [Custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) that use cardboard box dividers can hold multiple products without them colliding or shifting.

## Why Use Cardboard Box Dividers?

Cardboard box dividers are ideal for organization and product protection. They can be customized in various sizes and shapes to fit a range of products. They work especially well for small items like toys, RC cars, cosmetics, bottles, and accessories. A snug fit also reduces movement and helps prevent scratches, dents, and other damage.

Besides protection, custom dividers can also improve the unboxing experience. Each product stays neatly placed in its own compartment. This creates a clean and professional presentation that customers can appreciate.

From precise die-cutting to quality printing, manufacturing these [custom box inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) requires experience and accuracy. We have all the expertise to create custom dividers that fit your products perfectly and provide reliable protection.

## Customize Your Cardboard Box Dividers

Get cardboard box dividers in custom sizes to fit your products perfectly. Choose the length, width, height, and compartment size based on your packaging needs.

You can also select printing options to match your brand identity. Use CMYK or Pantone colors for sharp and vibrant results.

Add your logo, product details, patterns, or brand artwork for a professional look. Custom printing makes your dividers more attractive and brand-focused.

With the right size and printing, these dividers provide protection and a polished product presentation.

Looking for a premium insert option? Check out our [custom EVA foam inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/eva-foam-inserts/), designed to enhance the overall appeal of your product and packaging.

## Products That Best Suit Cardboard Packaging Dividers

Cardboard packaging dividers work well for products that need separation. They keep each item secure and prevent unwanted movement inside the box. Here are some products that suit custom cardboard dividers:

- Glass Bottles: Keep bottles separated and reduce the risk of breakage.
- Cosmetics: Organize jars, bottles, and cosmetic products neatly.
- Candles: Prevent candles from rubbing against each other during shipping.
- Toys: Keep small toys organized and securely placed inside the box.
- RC Cars: Create separate compartments for cars and their accessories.
- Electronics: Protect small electronic products from scratches and impacts.
- Food Products: Separate packaged food items and maintain proper presentation.
- Craft Products: Organize handmade items, tools, and small accessories.
- Gift Items: Keep multiple gifts separated for a cleaner presentation.

Custom cardboard dividers can be designed around almost any product. They provide a snug fit while keeping items organized, protected, and ready for a better unboxing experience.

faqs.question: What are cardboard packaging dividers?
faqs.answer: Cardboard packaging dividers are inserts that create separate compartments inside a box. They keep products organized, protected, and safely separated during storage and shipping.

faqs.question: Can cardboard dividers be made in custom sizes?
faqs.answer: Yes, cardboard dividers can be made in custom sizes and shapes. They can match your box dimensions and create compartments based on your product requirements.

faqs.question: What products can use cardboard box dividers?
faqs.answer: Cardboard box dividers work well for bottles, cosmetics, candles, toys, electronics, glass products, and other small items that need separation and protection.

faqs.question: Can I print my logo on cardboard dividers?
faqs.answer: Yes, custom cardboard dividers can include your logo, brand artwork, product information, and other designs. CMYK and Pantone printing options are available.

faqs.question: Do cardboard dividers protect products during shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes, cardboard dividers help reduce product movement inside the box. They create separate compartments and minimize contact, scratches, dents, and other shipping damage.

faqs.question: Are cardboard packaging dividers suitable for wholesale orders?
faqs.answer: Yes, cardboard packaging dividers are suitable for wholesale packaging needs. They can be produced in bulk with consistent sizes, designs, printing, and quality.

## Cardboard Counter Top Displays: Maximizing Visual Impact at Point of Sale

Strategic placement drives immediate action. Our cardboard counter top displays position your items in high-traffic checkout areas to capture last-minute attention and boost sales effortlessly.

Here is how these [display boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/) stand out.

- Drive Impulse Purchases: Transform waiting time in the queue into buying time and draw attention to your grab-and-go products while customers are waiting in line.
- Organized Product Presentation: Multi-level shelving and compartments for a more organized product presentation.
- Space-Efficient Merchandising: Make the best use of all available retail space, and don’t allow merchandise to extend too far down the cash wrap or surround the cash register.

## Counter Top Displays Built with Functional Layouts & Structural Designs

A well-designed structure maximizes visibility and keeps merchandise neatly organized.

When you choose custom cardboard counter top displays, you will get:

- Multi-Tiered Shelves: Items in the back are elevated so that customers can easily see them and grab them.
- Custom Die-Cut Dividers: Store bottles, tubes, and jars safely using our precision-made custom dividers, which hold them upright at perfect angles to prevent tipping over.
- Header Cards & Risers: Removable top banners that provide extra branding space for items such as sales, business logo, or even call-to-actions.
- Peg Hooks & Gravity Feeds: Peg hooks to display carded items such as t-shirts while gravity feeds to restock merchandise automatically.
- Tool-Free Assembly: Quick and intuitive setup allows store staff to restock and deploy displays in seconds.

## High-Definition Custom Branding & Printing

Your display is a miniature billboard for your brand; we make sure it counts.

Our innovative printing options help you increase your branding performance.

Choose from:

- Digital & Offset Techniques
- High-resolution CMYK and PMS Colors
- Vibrant Finishes: Matte lamination, high-gloss coating, Spot UV, foil stamping, and embossing/debossing

## Industries That Rely on Our Custom Cardboard Counter Displays

Our cardboard countertop displays drive retail success across diverse industries and retail channels.

Here are different industries that choose them:

- Cosmetics & Beauty: Ideal for lipsticks, serums, and skincare kits.
- CBD Products: Used for oils, edibles, and vape products.
- Electronics Accessories: Chargers, earphones, and cables.
- Retail Impulse Items: From toys and keychains to travel-size goods.

Overall, these displays are optimized to trigger last-minute purchases through strategic placement and eye-catching design.

## Order Cardboard Counter Top Displays with No MOQs

It’s time to upgrade your point-of-purchase strategy with custom cardboard counter displays designed to boost brand awareness and drive higher revenue per customer. And the best part? We have no minimum quantity requirement for all our [custom packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/).

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ordering cardboard counter top displays.

### What is a countertop display box?

A countertop display box is a compact POS display unit placed on retail counters to showcase products and encourage impulse purchases.

### Are they eco-friendly?

Yes, cardboard displays are recyclable, biodegradable, and can be sourced from sustainable materials.

### What material is best for countertop displays?

Corrugated cardboard (E-flute or B-flute) and SBS paperboard are the most effective due to their strength, printability, and cost-efficiency.

### Can I customize the design?

Absolutely. From size and structure to printing and inserts, every aspect can be tailored to your brand and product needs.

### How much weight can it hold?

Depending on the material: • E-flute: Lightweight products • B-flute: Medium-weight items (up to several kilograms with proper design)

## What Are Custom Cardboard Inserts?

Custom cardboard inserts are specially designed packaging components that hold products securely inside a box. They prevent items from moving during shipping, reduce the risk of damage, and keep everything neatly organized. Available in custom shapes and layouts, cardboard inserts also improve product presentation and create a better unboxing experience for customers.

## How Do We Customize Your Cardboard Inserts?

When it comes to manufacturing custom cardboard inserts, we take all the necessary steps to provide you with the perfect [custom box inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) for your product packaging solution needs.

Here’s how you can customize your cardboard inserts with us:

### Exact Sizes for a Perfect Product Fit

We manufacture custom cardboard inserts in the exact size required for your products. This ensures a secure fit, minimizes movement during shipping, and keeps every item neatly organized inside the box. Some standard insert sizes include:

- 4″ x 4″ x 2″
- 6″ x 6″ x 3″
- 8″ x 8″ x 4″

Need a custom size? Simply share your product dimensions, and we will create cardboard inserts tailored to your packaging requirements.

### Functional Layouts for Better Product Organization

We offer a wide range of insert layouts to hold your products securely, reduce movement, and keep them well organized inside the packaging. Whether you need a single cavity or multiple compartments, every insert is designed for maximum protection and a clean presentation.

### Unique Shapes for a Perfect Fit

Our custom cardboard inserts are available in different shapes to match your product and packaging design. Some popular options include:

- Square
- Rectangle
- Circular
- Die-Cut Shapes

If your product requires a unique shape, we can create a custom die-cut insert that fits it perfectly.

## Which Custom Boxes Use Cardboard Inserts?

Custom cardboard inserts can be used with various [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) to protect products, keep them organized, and improve their presentation. These inserts prevent items from shifting during shipping and create a clean, professional unboxing experience. Cardboard inserts are commonly used with the following box styles:

- Tuck End Boxes
- Two Piece Boxes
- Drawer Boxes
- Sleeve Boxes
- Flip Top Boxes
- Custom Style Boxes

We can also design custom cardboard inserts to fit almost any box style based on your packaging requirements.

## Make Your Packaging Stand Out with Premium Cardboard Inserts

We offer premium customization options for custom cardboard inserts to improve product presentation and create a memorable unboxing experience. Every insert is designed to match your branding and packaging requirements.

### High-Quality Printing for Better Brand Visibility

Custom printed cardboard inserts help showcase your brand while keeping products securely in place. We offer the following printing options:

- Digital Printing
- Offset Printing
- 1 to 4 Color Printing
- Inside and Outside Printing
- CMYK and PMS Color Matching

### Premium Finishes for a Professional Appearance

Add premium finishes to your cardboard inserts to give your packaging a polished and high-end look. Available finishing options include:

- Gloss Finish
- Matte Finish
- Spot UV
- AQ Coating
- Embossing and Debossing
- Gold and Silver Foiling

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ordering cardboard inserts.

### What are cardboard inserts used for?

Cardboard inserts are used to keep products securely in place inside packaging. They reduce movement during shipping, prevent damage, improve product organization, and create a clean, professional unboxing experience.

### Can cardboard inserts be customized?

Yes, cardboard inserts can be customized in any size, shape, layout, and design. They are manufactured to match your product dimensions and fit perfectly inside your selected packaging style.

### Are cardboard inserts eco-friendly?

Yes, cardboard inserts are an environmentally friendly packaging solution. They are made from recyclable paperboard materials, making them a sustainable alternative to plastic or foam packaging inserts.

### Which products work best with cardboard inserts?

Cardboard inserts are ideal for cosmetics, candles, electronics, glass bottles, food products, promotional kits, retail items, and many other products that require secure packaging and organized presentation.

### Can cardboard inserts be printed?

Yes, custom cardboard inserts can be printed with logos, product information, or branding elements. Digital and offset printing options help create a more professional and memorable packaging experience.

### Do you offer wholesale cardboard inserts?

Yes, we provide custom cardboard inserts at wholesale prices with low minimum order quantities. Bulk orders receive competitive pricing, free design support, and fast production to meet your packaging needs.

sections.title: What Are Custom Cardboard Inserts?
sections.content: Custom cardboard inserts are specially designed packaging components that hold products securely inside a box. They prevent items from moving during shipping, reduce the risk of damage, and keep everything neatly organized. Available in custom shapes and layouts, cardboard inserts also improve product presentation and create a better unboxing experience for customers.

sections.title: How Do We Customize Your Cardboard Inserts?
sections.content:
When it comes to manufacturing custom cardboard inserts, we take all the necessary steps to provide you with the perfect [custom box inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) for your product packaging solution needs.

Here’s how you can customize your cardboard inserts with us:

sections.title: Exact Sizes for a Perfect Product Fit
sections.content:
We manufacture custom cardboard inserts in the exact size required for your products. This ensures a secure fit, minimizes movement during shipping, and keeps every item neatly organized inside the box. Some standard insert sizes include:

- 4″ x 4″ x 2″
- 6″ x 6″ x 3″
- 8″ x 8″ x 4″

Need a custom size? Simply share your product dimensions, and we will create cardboard inserts tailored to your packaging requirements.

sections.title: Functional Layouts for Better Product Organization
sections.content: We offer a wide range of insert layouts to hold your products securely, reduce movement, and keep them well organized inside the packaging. Whether you need a single cavity or multiple compartments, every insert is designed for maximum protection and a clean presentation.

sections.title: Unique Shapes for a Perfect Fit
sections.content:
Our custom cardboard inserts are available in different shapes to match your product and packaging design. Some popular options include:

- Square
- Rectangle
- Circular
- Die-Cut Shapes

If your product requires a unique shape, we can create a custom die-cut insert that fits it perfectly.

sections.title: Which Custom Boxes Use Cardboard Inserts?
sections.content:
Custom cardboard inserts can be used with various [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) to protect products, keep them organized, and improve their presentation. These inserts prevent items from shifting during shipping and create a clean, professional unboxing experience. Cardboard inserts are commonly used with the following box styles:

- Tuck End Boxes
- Two Piece Boxes
- Drawer Boxes
- Sleeve Boxes
- Flip Top Boxes
- Custom Style Boxes

We can also design custom cardboard inserts to fit almost any box style based on your packaging requirements.

sections.title: Make Your Packaging Stand Out with Premium Cardboard Inserts
sections.content: We offer premium customization options for custom cardboard inserts to improve product presentation and create a memorable unboxing experience. Every insert is designed to match your branding and packaging requirements.

sections.title: High-Quality Printing for Better Brand Visibility
sections.content:
Custom printed cardboard inserts help showcase your brand while keeping products securely in place. We offer the following printing options:

- Digital Printing
- Offset Printing
- 1 to 4 Color Printing
- Inside and Outside Printing
- CMYK and PMS Color Matching

sections.title: Premium Finishes for a Professional Appearance
sections.content:
Add premium finishes to your cardboard inserts to give your packaging a polished and high-end look. Available finishing options include:

- Gloss Finish
- Matte Finish
- Spot UV
- AQ Coating
- Embossing and Debossing
- Gold and Silver Foiling

Enjoy free design support, fast turnaround, and reliable shipping for premium cardboard inserts that protect your products and elevate your packaging.

sections.title: CBD Cigarette Packaging Boxes: The Ultimate Shield for Product Freshness
sections.content:
Your product’s integrity is our top priority. Our [custom packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) feature precise fits to prevent pre-rolls from rattling or tearing. We also include specialized barrier coatings that lock out humidity and light.

Preserve the potent aroma, flavor, and freshness of your hemp blends. Give your customers the exact premium smoking experience they pay for, every single time.

sections.title: Custom CBD Cigarette Boxes from Top-Quality Materials
sections.content:
We only use top-grade, durable stocks for our [custom CBD boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cbd-boxes/). Keep your pre-rolls fresh from the factory to consumers’ hands with our selected materials below:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each material protects your CBD cigarettes from moisture and physical damage.

And the size? We provide CBD cigarette boxes in custom sizes, ensuring every cigarette stays fresh and potent through shipping, display, and storage.

Better yet, every cigarette box is designed to fully comply with industry regulations, including:

- Child-Resistant Features
- Tamper-Evident Seals
- Proper Labeling Space

Each box we create meets state and federal packaging guidelines for cannabis products. Plus, we use odor-proof options and high-quality materials that comply with privacy and transportation laws.

sections.title: Custom Prints & Luxury Finishes for CBD Cigarette Boxes with Logo
sections.content:
Turn heads with high-definition printing technology. We offer advanced CMYK and PMS color models.

Your logo, graphics, and brand colors will look sharp and flawless with our:

- Digital Printing
- Offset Printing
- PMS & CMYK Colors

For a more appealing visual, polish your CBD cigarette packaging boxes with our premium finishes below:

- Gloss/Matte Lamination
- Foil Stamping
- Spot UV
- Embossing/Debossing

sections.title: Tailored CBD Cigarette Box Styles for Every Brand
sections.content:
Every brand is different, so your packaging shape should be too. We offer fully customizable dimensions to fit your specific pre-roll counts.

Find the perfect style for your product line:

- [Classic Flip-Top Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/flip-top-boxes/): The timeless cigarette-pack style for easy, one-handed opening.
- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): A modern, luxury aesthetic that feels like an unboxing experience.
- [Straight Tuck-End](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/) or [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Budget-friendly, highly efficient, and incredibly easy to assemble.
- [CBD Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cbd-display-boxes/): Showcase multiple CBD cigarette boxes in a single durable box with dividers.

sections.title: Stay Legal with Certified Compliance
sections.content:
Complying with cannabis laws can be tricky. We make compliance easy for your business. Our custom CBD cigarette boxes leave dedicated space for all required legal elements.

With advanced printing, we help you provide:

- Necessary Warnings
- Ingredient Lists
- THC/CBD Content Metrics
- Batch Numbers
- Scannable QR Codes for Lab Results

With our CBD cigarette boxes, you can protect your business while building deep transparency and trust with your consumers.

sections.title: Order CBD Cigarette Boxes at Wholesale Prices
sections.content:
We are an experienced manufacturer of wholesale cannabis cigarette boxes. You can expect the lowest prices and a special discount when you order your boxes in bulk. On the other hand, you can confidently order a small batch, as we require no minimum order quantity.

The best part? We will deliver your CBD cigarette boxes to your doorstep with fast and hassle-free shipping!

Get in touch with us today!
