## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ordering custom cbd display boxes.

### What are custom CBD display boxes used for?

Custom CBD display boxes are designed to showcase products on retail shelves, improve visibility, and make it easier for shoppers to get attracted.

### Are CBD display boxes compliant with labeling requirements?

Yes. They can be designed to add required elements such as THC disclaimers, ingredient lists, barcodes, and safety warnings, helping brands meet retail and regulatory standards with confidence.

### Can CBD display boxes be customized for different products?

Yes. Display boxes can be tailored in size, structure, and design to fit oils, gummies, topicals, and other CBD products while maintaining consistent branding across your product line.

### How do custom display boxes help increase sales?

Well-designed displays improve product visibility, communicate value quickly, and create a more organized shelf presence, which can improve shopper engagement and faster purchase decisions.

### What materials are best for CBD display packaging?

Paperboard is ideal for lightweight products due to its print quality, while corrugated board provides extra strength for larger or multi-layer displays.

## Durable CBD Hemp Oil Boxes to Protect Fragile Oil Bottles

Glass hemp oil bottles require specialized packaging to prevent cracking and leaks during everyday transit. A sturdy foundation is required as a protective shield against unexpected bumps and drops.

We use premium materials to produce durable CBD hemp oil boxes, including:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

For extra protection that safeguards your valuable CBD oils during shipping and reduces costly product returns, we also include innovative features, such as:

- Airtight & Leak-Proof Design: Sealed structural corners and snug closures to prevent accidental product drips and messy exterior stains.
- Light & Temperature Protection: Opaque thick box walls that block harmful UV rays and ambient heat to preserve cannabinoid and terpene degradation.
- Precise Sizing: Customized dimensions to perfectly match 15ml, 30ml, or 60ml bottles, eliminating internal rattling.
- [Custom Inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) & Dividers: Die-cut inserts or dividers that lock glass droppers securely upright.
- Protective Outer Labels: Clear water-resistant lamination shields printed text from oily finger smudges and heavy moisture exposure.

## Functional, Trendy CBD Hemp Oil Box Styles

The structural shape of your packaging directly impacts how customers interact with your wellness brand. Modern layouts improve retail accessibility while providing a satisfying unboxing experience. Choosing the right CBD hemp oil box style helps you highlight your product’s market value.

Have a look at our popular options below.

## CBD Medicine Packaging Made for Your Product

CBD medicine products mostly come in small bottles, blister packs, jars, and containers. A standard box may leave too much empty space. It may also fail to hold the product in place.

We create packaging according to the exact size of your container. This gives the box a cleaner appearance. It also improves product stability during storage, display, and delivery. Our CBD medicine boxes can be made for:

- CBD pill bottles
- CBD capsule bottles
- CBD softgel bottles
- CBD tablet packaging
- CBD blister packs
- CBD supplement containers
- Multi-bottle medicine sets

Send us the dimensions of your bottle, blister pack, or container. Our packaging team will help you select a suitable box style and material. Your box will be made for your product. You do not have to adjust your product to fit a standard carton.

## Custom Box Styles for CBD Medicines

The box structure you choose has a significant effect on protection, presentation, and ease of use.

[Straight tuck end](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/) (STE) and [reverse tuck end](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/)(RTE) boxes are popular choices for CBD medicine bottles. They are clean, practical, and easy to assemble.

Snap lock and [auto-lock bottom](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/auto-lock-bottom-boxes/) boxes provide more support for heavier bottles. They are useful for glass containers and larger products.

[Tray sleeve boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/)create a more premium presentation. The inner tray slides into an outer sleeve. The inner tray holds a bottle, blister pack, dropper, leaflet, or accessory in place. Customers choose this structure to create an organized professional look.

Two-piece boxes with custom [packaging inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/)work well for premium CBD medicine sets, subscription packs, and limited-edition products.

Window boxes can display the bottle or blister pack through a clear cutout. [Pop-Up display boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/pop-up-display-boxes/) hold several units for pharmacy counters, wellness stores, and retail shelves.

Child-resistant structures are also available. The best structure depends on the product, container, and selling requirements.

Once you are clear with your product needs, our team will help you compare the suitable options before production.

## Compliance-Ready Artwork Support

CBD medicine packaging often needs more than a logo and product name. These CBD medicine boxes provide space for product details, ingredients, usage instructions, warnings, batch information, and testing records.

Our design team can prepare the artwork layout around the information provided by your business. We provide packaging and artwork support. We do not approve medical claims or guarantee that one layout will meet every federal, state, or local requirement.

Your business should review and approve all product statements, warnings, legal text, and test information before printing. This process gives you more control over final packaging. It also reduces the risk of printing incorrect or unsupported information.

## Custom Materials and Thicknesses

We offer a wide range of [materials](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/materials/) to match the weight of your product, the box style, and the desired presentation.

Cardboard is a popular choice for CBD pill, capsule, tablet, and softgel boxes. It provides a smooth surface for detailed printing and clear text. This material is available in thickness that ranges from approximately 14pt to 24pt.

Kraft paper gives the packaging a natural appearance. It works well for wellness brands that prefer a simple and earthy look. Corrugated stock provides more strength for heavier products, multi-bottles sets, and shipping kits.

Rigid boards create a high-end presentation. It is suitable for CBD medicine sets, multi-product kits, subscription packs, and promotional sample boxes. We recommend material and suitable thickness after reviewing your product weight and your selected box style.

## Professional Printing and Finishing Option

Clear printing is highly important for CBD medicine packaging. Small text, warnings, barcodes, and product details must remain easy to read. We use CMYK printing, Pantone for color matching, offset printing, and digital printing. You can print on the outside and inside and box. Inside printing can be used for instructions, brand messages, website details, or custom support information.

Available finishing options include matte, gloss, soft-touch, anti-coating, foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, raised UV, and holographic effects.

- Matte coating creates a clean surface.
- Gloss adds shine.
- Soft-touch coatings give the box a smooth feel.
- Foil highlights the logo or product name.
- Embossing gives a rising texture.

Finishes should support the design instead of making the box look crowded. Our team can help you select the right combination for your brand and budget.

## Why Choose Pack Legacy for CBD Medicine Boxes?

[Pack Legacy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/) creates CBD medicine boxes around your product, brand, and order requirements. We design packaging for CBD pill bottles, capsules, tablets, softgels, and blister packs.

There is no minimum order quantity. You can order a small batch for samples, market testing, limited releases, or a new product launch. Larger wholesale quantities are also available for growing brands and established manufacturers.

Our team provides free design support. We can help with dielines, artwork placement, panel layout, and print presentation. You will receive a digital proof before production so you can review the dimensions, text, colors, barcodes, QR codes, and other design details.

Standard production usually takes 8 to 12 business days after artwork approval. Rush production is also available for suitable orders at an additional cost.

We also cover shipping costs for orders to deliver at your doorsteps. Before you approve the order, please confirm your production schedule, dispatch details, and expected delivery window based on your ZIP code.

Order your CBD medicine boxes in the quantity you need. Get custom-fit packaging, clear proofing, and dependable support from design to delivery.

## How to Order CBD Medicine Boxes?

Start by sending us your product dimensions, required quantity, preferred material, box style, printing details, and delivery ZIP code. These details help us determine the right box specifications and prepare an accurate quote.

Upload your artwork or ask our team for design support. We can assist with the dieline, panel layout, artwork placement, and print preparation based on your packaging requirements.

Before production, you will receive a digital proof showing the dimensions, folds, cut lines, panel layout, colors, text, barcodes, and QR codes. Review the proof carefully to make sure your artwork and product information appear exactly as intended. Production begins after your final approval.

Physical samples are also available on request. The cost and timeline depend on the box structure, material, printing, and finishing requirements.

After approval, we move your CBD medicine boxes into production and confirm the expected shipping schedule.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ordering custom cbd medicine boxes.

### What are CBD medicine boxes?

CBD medicine boxes are custom cartons made for CBD pills, capsules, tablets, softgels, medicine bottles, and blister packs. The term describes the packaging format. It does not mean that every CBD product is an approved medicine.

### Is there a minimum order quantity?

No. Pack Legacy offers custom CBD medicine boxes with no minimum order quantity. You can order a small test run or a larger wholesale quantity.

### Can you make the box according to my bottle size?

Yes. We can produce the box according to the exact dimensions of your bottle, container, or blister pack.

### Can you add a protective insert?

Yes. Paperboard, corrugated, molded pulp, foam inserts are available. The insert can be designed for one product or a complete medicine set.

### Do you offer child-resistant boxes?

Child-resistant structure options are available. The suitable option will depend on the product, container, and required standard. Certification should only be claimed when the exact packaging system has passed the required tests.

### Can you add tamper-evident features?

Yes. Available options include tear strips, perforations, security labels, stickers, and locking structures.

### Can you print QR codes and barcodes?

Yes. We can print client-provided QR codes, barcodes, SKUs, and batch information. QR codes can link to a Certificate of Analysis, laboratory report, product page, or other approved destination.

sections.title: CBD Medicine Packaging Made for Your Product
sections.content:
CBD medicine products mostly come in small bottles, blister packs, jars, and containers. A standard box may leave too much empty space. It may also fail to hold the product in place.

We create packaging according to the exact size of your container. This gives the box a cleaner appearance. It also improves product stability during storage, display, and delivery. Our CBD medicine boxes can be made for:

- CBD pill bottles
- CBD capsule bottles
- CBD softgel bottles
- CBD tablet packaging
- CBD blister packs
- CBD supplement containers
- Multi-bottle medicine sets

Send us the dimensions of your bottle, blister pack, or container. Our packaging team will help you select a suitable box style and material. Your box will be made for your product. You do not have to adjust your product to fit a standard carton.

sections.title: Custom Box Styles for CBD Medicines
sections.content:
The box structure you choose has a significant effect on protection, presentation, and ease of use.

[Straight tuck end](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/) (STE) and [reverse tuck end](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/)(RTE) boxes are popular choices for CBD medicine bottles. They are clean, practical, and easy to assemble.

Snap lock and [auto-lock bottom](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/auto-lock-bottom-boxes/) boxes provide more support for heavier bottles. They are useful for glass containers and larger products.

[Tray sleeve boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/)create a more premium presentation. The inner tray slides into an outer sleeve. The inner tray holds a bottle, blister pack, dropper, leaflet, or accessory in place. Customers choose this structure to create an organized professional look.

Two-piece boxes with custom [packaging inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/)work well for premium CBD medicine sets, subscription packs, and limited-edition products.

Window boxes can display the bottle or blister pack through a clear cutout. [Pop-Up display boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/pop-up-display-boxes/) hold several units for pharmacy counters, wellness stores, and retail shelves.

Child-resistant structures are also available. The best structure depends on the product, container, and selling requirements.

Once you are clear with your product needs, our team will help you compare the suitable options before production.

sections.title: Compliance-Ready Artwork Support
sections.content:
CBD medicine packaging often needs more than a logo and product name. These CBD medicine boxes provide space for product details, ingredients, usage instructions, warnings, batch information, and testing records.

Our design team can prepare the artwork layout around the information provided by your business. We provide packaging and artwork support. We do not approve medical claims or guarantee that one layout will meet every federal, state, or local requirement.

Your business should review and approve all product statements, warnings, legal text, and test information before printing. This process gives you more control over final packaging. It also reduces the risk of printing incorrect or unsupported information.

sections.title: Custom Materials and Thicknesses
sections.content:
We offer a wide range of [materials](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/materials/) to match the weight of your product, the box style, and the desired presentation.

Cardboard is a popular choice for CBD pill, capsule, tablet, and softgel boxes. It provides a smooth surface for detailed printing and clear text. This material is available in thickness that ranges from approximately 14pt to 24pt.

Kraft paper gives the packaging a natural appearance. It works well for wellness brands that prefer a simple and earthy look. Corrugated stock provides more strength for heavier products, multi-bottles sets, and shipping kits.

Rigid boards create a high-end presentation. It is suitable for CBD medicine sets, multi-product kits, subscription packs, and promotional sample boxes. We recommend material and suitable thickness after reviewing your product weight and your selected box style.

sections.title: Professional Printing and Finishing Option
sections.content:
Clear printing is highly important for CBD medicine packaging. Small text, warnings, barcodes, and product details must remain easy to read. We use CMYK printing, Pantone for color matching, offset printing, and digital printing. You can print on the outside and inside and box. Inside printing can be used for instructions, brand messages, website details, or custom support information.

Available finishing options include matte, gloss, soft-touch, anti-coating, foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, raised UV, and holographic effects.

- Matte coating creates a clean surface.
- Gloss adds shine.
- Soft-touch coatings give the box a smooth feel.
- Foil highlights the logo or product name.
- Embossing gives a rising texture.

Finishes should support the design instead of making the box look crowded. Our team can help you select the right combination for your brand and budget.

sections.title: Why Choose Pack Legacy for CBD Medicine Boxes?
sections.content:
[Pack Legacy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/) creates CBD medicine boxes around your product, brand, and order requirements. We design packaging for CBD pill bottles, capsules, tablets, softgels, and blister packs.

There is no minimum order quantity. You can order a small batch for samples, market testing, limited releases, or a new product launch. Larger wholesale quantities are also available for growing brands and established manufacturers.

Our team provides free design support. We can help with dielines, artwork placement, panel layout, and print presentation. You will receive a digital proof before production so you can review the dimensions, text, colors, barcodes, QR codes, and other design details.

Standard production usually takes 8 to 12 business days after artwork approval. Rush production is also available for suitable orders at an additional cost.

We also cover shipping costs for orders to deliver at your doorsteps. Before you approve the order, please confirm your production schedule, dispatch details, and expected delivery window based on your ZIP code.

Order your CBD medicine boxes in the quantity you need. Get custom-fit packaging, clear proofing, and dependable support from design to delivery.

sections.title: How to Order CBD Medicine Boxes?
sections.content:
Start by sending us your product dimensions, required quantity, preferred material, box style, printing details, and delivery ZIP code. These details help us determine the right box specifications and prepare an accurate quote.

Upload your artwork or ask our team for design support. We can assist with the dieline, panel layout, artwork placement, and print preparation based on your packaging requirements.

Before production, you will receive a digital proof showing the dimensions, folds, cut lines, panel layout, colors, text, barcodes, and QR codes. Review the proof carefully to make sure your artwork and product information appear exactly as intended. Production begins after your final approval.

Physical samples are also available on request. The cost and timeline depend on the box structure, material, printing, and finishing requirements.

After approval, we move your CBD medicine boxes into production and confirm the expected shipping schedule.

sections.title: Custom CBD Oil Boxes with Full Regulatory Compliance
sections.content:
Stay worry-free with packaging built to meet strict cannabis and CBD laws. We prioritize safety and consumer trust in every fold.

Have a look at the features of our CBD oil boxes below.

- Tamper-Evident Seals: Visible security features that indicate your CBD oil has remained sealed and is as fresh as the day it was packaged.
- Child-Resistant Locks: A safety closure designed to be child-proof but adult-friendly.
- Custom Inserts: Protect fragile glass oil bottles with custom foam or paperboard inserts.

sections.title: Durable CBD Oil Boxes Designed for Maximum Protection
sections.content:
CBD oil is delicate. Light, air, and rough handling can spoil potency fast. We craft our boxes using heavy-duty materials built to defend your liquid CBD products, including:

- Kraft
- Cardboard
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Rest assured, each material makes your CBD oil packaging highly durable, providing maximum protection during shipping and keeping the fragile glass bottles perfect.

sections.title: Tailored Sizes for Every CBD Oil Bottle
sections.content:
Never settle for loose, generic boxes that look sloppy. Our die-cutting technique creates custom packaging fitted to your exact bottle dimensions.

Whether you need [CBD boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cbd-boxes/) for 10ml, 15ml, 30ml, 60ml, or 120ml bottles, we are ready to create them.

Even better, you can get every box designed with a custom size that fits unique droppers, sprays, or oil sets.

sections.title: CBD Oil Boxes with Logo That Sell and Promote
sections.content:
Turn heads on the retail shelf with custom finishing techniques that command attention.

We provide advanced printing techniques, including:

- Offset & Digital Printing
- Vibrant PMS and crisp CMYK colors
- Outside, Inside, and Both-Sided Printing

Don’t skip on our luxury finishes, such as

- Gloss/Matte Lamination
- Foil Stamping
- Spot UV
- Embossing/Debossing

Beyond the visual appeal, our printed CBD oil boxes provide ample space to help you provide compliant labels, including:

- Ingredient lists
- Third-party lab QR codes
- THC warnings
- Usage guides cleanly

Speaking of CBD oil boxes that sell and promote, we have got you covered!

sections.title: Custom CBD Oil Box Styles Tailored to Your Brand Image
sections.content:
Match your CBD oil packaging directly to your retail or online distribution strategy.

Choose from our popular styles below.

- [Reverse Tuck-End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/) & [Straight Tuck-End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Classic, cost-effective, and fast for high-volume automated packaging lines.
- [Auto-Lock Bottom Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/auto-lock-bottom-boxes/): Snaps together instantly and offers reinforced base support for heavy glass droppers.
- [Two Piece Rigid Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Premium lid-and-base design offering an unboxing experience customers love.
- [CBD Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cbd-display-boxes/): One single box with dividers to showcase multiple bottles at the checkout counter.

### Can the display include compliance details like warnings and barcodes?

### Are pre roll display boxes only for dispensaries?

### Do you offer eco-friendly CBD pre roll display packaging?

Corrugated board is typically best for strength and longer in-store use, while paperboard is ideal for lighter displays with premium print quality.

faqs.question: What size should a CBD pre roll display box be?
faqs.answer: The best size depends on your tube diameter, product height, and how many units you want to display. Custom sizing provides a secure fit and a clean, upright presentation.

faqs.question: Can the display include compliance details like warnings and barcodes?
faqs.answer: Displays can be designed with clear space for warnings, barcode placement, and key product information so the setup remains retail-ready.

faqs.question: Are pre roll display boxes only for dispensaries?
faqs.answer: No. They are used by CBD brands, smoke shops, wellness stores, pharmacies, and retailers that want a neat, branded way to present pre rolls.

faqs.question: Do you offer eco-friendly CBD pre roll display packaging?
faqs.answer: Yes. Recyclable and responsibly sourced materials are available, and we can recommend options that balance sustainability, appearance, and durability.

faqs.question: Can I add compartments for different strains or variants?
faqs.answer: Yes. Compartment layouts are one of the most popular custom features because they keep variants separated and make browsing easier.

faqs.question: How do pre roll display boxes help increase sales?
faqs.answer: They improve visibility, keep products organized, and make shopping easier, which leads to quicker decisions and stronger point-of-purchase performance.

faqs.question: What material is best for durable pre roll displays?
faqs.answer: Corrugated board is typically best for strength and longer in-store use, while paperboard is ideal for lighter displays with premium print quality.

## CBD Pre-roll Packaging: Compliance & Protective Solutions

We understand that [CBD packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cbd-boxes/) must meet strict industry standards. Our boxes are designed with compliance in mind, ensuring your CBD brand stays safe and credible.

Therefore, every box features:

- Child-resistant locks to prevent accidental opening by kids
- Proper labeling space for dosage, warnings, and product details.
- [Custom inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) or dividers to hold pre-rolls securely.
- Tamper-evident seals for added safety that builds customer trust
- Durable box construction to withstand harsh shipping and handling.

## Premium Materials That Deliver Quality

Strong packaging starts with strong materials. We craft CBD pre-roll boxes using durable, sustainable options that protect your product and highlight your eco-conscious values.

Our premium material options include:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Rigid stock
- Corrugated

Each material is highly durable to protect every pre-roll during shipping, display, and storage. Plus, we provide custom sizes to ensure every CBD pre-roll box fits your products.

## Stylish CBD Pre-roll Box Designs That Stand Out

Packaging isn’t just about protection — it’s about presentation. Our custom CBD pre-roll packaging boxes are designed to grab attention on shelves and create a memorable unboxing experience.

Have a look at the popular CBD pre-roll box style below and choose the one you like.

- [Straight tuck end](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/) and [reverse tuck-end boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Simple, secure, and cost-effective.
- [Sleeve and tray boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/): Sleek design with easy slide-out functionality.
- [Window boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Showcase your pre-rolls without opening the package.
- [CBD pre-roll display boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cbd-pre-roll-display-boxes/): Perfect for showcasing multiple pre-rolls in dispensaries and retail counters.
- [Rigid drawer boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): Luxury appeal with premium durability.

Each style can be customized with branding and inserts to match your product line. You can even get a custom style you need!

## Perform Better Branding with Printed CBD Pre-roll Packaging

Absolutely. Choose from tuck-end, sleeve, window, or drawer-style boxes tailored to your product’s dimensions. We can also create a completely custom packaging style for your CBD pre-rolls.

### Will the packaging protect pre-rolls during shipping?

Yes, moisture-resistant coatings, protective inserts, and durable construction help keep your pre-rolls fresh, secure, and protected throughout shipping.

### Do you provide wholesale pricing for custom CBD pre-roll packaging?

Yes, bulk orders of custom CBD pre-roll packaging qualify for competitive wholesale rates and special volume discounts.

There is no additional shipping fee. We provide fast, free delivery of custom CBD pre-roll packaging directly to your doorstep.

sections.title: Custom Cereal Boxes: Consumer Safety Meets Durability
sections.content:
We prioritize consumer safety and your product shelf life. Our selection of eco-friendly, food-grade materials keeps your cereal fresh, crispy, and delicious.

Choose from:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft Paper
- Corrugated

Keep your cereal safe from the factory to the breakfast bowl. Our cereal boxes are built to handle stacking, shipping, and daily handling.

Have a look at the protective features of our boxes.

- Lock-Bottom Designs: Heavy-duty bottom flaps snap together securely to support dense, heavy contents without buckling.
- Reinforced Side Panels: Dual-layer edges prevent crushing, bowing, and bending on crowded retail shelves.
- Seal-End Top: Glued top flaps that lock out air, humidity, and pests, preserving long-term product freshness.

sections.title: Present Breakfast Staple in Style with Unique Cereal Boxes
sections.content:
Dull packaging gets lost in the grocery aisle. By partnering with us, you’ll get [custom food boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/) that highlight your nutritious cereals.

Turn your cereal into a morning must-have with our unique, attention-grabbing cereal box styles below.

- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/):Clean, seamless front look in which the top and bottom flaps fold directly into the back.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Efficient, cost-effective design with flaps that fold in opposite directions for quick assembly.
- [Auto-Lock Bottom Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/auto-lock-bottom-boxes/): Pop-and-go construction that snaps into shape instantly, speeding up your filling lines.
- [Gable Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/): Eye-catching, pitched-roof shape with a built-in handle for specialty, gift, or premium holiday cereals.
- [Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Feature clear window cutouts that let customers preview your colorful cereal shapes inside.

sections.title: Cereal Packaging Boxes in Custom Sizes
sections.content:
One size surely does not fit all in the breakfast food industry. Therefore, we offer a flexible range of dimensions to match your specific product volume and portion style.

- Standard / Retail Size: 12″ × 7.5″ to 8″ × 2″ to 2.5″

The perfect size for standard 12- to 16-oz grocery store shelf placement.

- Family Size: 14″ to 16″ × 8″ to 10″ × 3″ to 3.5″

Extra-large volume dimensions designed to hold value-sized, high-quantity family cereal portions.

- Mini / Single-Serve Size: 5″ to 6.5″ × 4″ to 5″ × 1″ to 1.5″

Compact, portable boxes tailored for hotels, school lunches, and promotional sample giveaways.

- Custom Sizing

Tailored dimensional choices made to fit your precise weight, volume, and interior bag volumes.

sections.title: Promote More with Custom Printed Cereal Boxes
sections.content:
Turn every cereal box into a powerful, silent salesman using our custom printing and premium finishing processes.

We use:

- Digital and Offset Printing
- CMYK and PMS Colors
- One-Side and Two-Side Printing

Rest assured, your mascots, brand logo, and nutritional facts look sharp and professional.

To make our cereal boxes with logo look even more appealing, we provide excellent finishes, including:

- Matte / Gloss Laminations
- Spot UV
- Foil Stamping
- Embossing / Debossing

When it comes to promoting your brand, our [custom printed packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) are all you need!

sections.content:

Simply request a free quote today and get custom cereal boxes delivered to your doorstep, fast and free!

Fried rice and lo mein meals can make an oily mess. But worry not! The interior of each box is coated with a grease-resistant barrier. This prevents unsightly oil spots and keeps the exterior clean.

Soggy food ruins the delivery and dining experiences. Our Chinese takeout packaging naturally regulates moisture build-up inside. It vents just enough excess steam to keep your fried foods crispy while retaining essential moisture.

## Top-Quality Custom Chocolate Boxes That Preserve the Delightful Taste

We craft every [food box](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/) using certified food-grade materials to guarantee absolute purity.

You can choose from:

- Cardboard
- Paperboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each material perfectly preserves the delightful taste and texture of your chocolates.

For better protection, we include advanced features in every chocolate packaging, such as:

- Moisture & Grease Barriers: Special internal barriers that block external humidity and prevent cocoa butter from seeping through the paper.
- Insulated Liners: Specialized insulated liners that guard against sudden heat spikes, keeping your chocolates from melting during transport and storage.
- Inserts & Dividers: Custom-molded inserts or dividers to keep every delicate confection securely in place.

## Perfect Styles for Perfect Chocolates

The right box style tells a story and enhances the unboxing experience. Matching your chocolate type to the perfect structure maximizes visual impact.

For the perfect chocolate displays, we offer a wide variety of box styles, including:

- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Feature built-in magnets and are ideal for luxury bonbon collections.
- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): A slide-out tray mechanism for premium chocolate assortments.
- [Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Include a crystal-clear plastic cutout that lets customers view vibrant artisan truffles directly.
- [Sleeve & Tray Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/): Designed with an outer sleeve over an open tray, excellent for minimalist chocolate bars.
- [Two-Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Consist of a classic separate-lid-and-base design, great for traditional holiday assortments.
- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Fold both top and bottom flaps toward the same side, ideal for single-serving bars.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Fold flaps in opposite directions for extra structural efficiency, perfect for retail chocolate bars.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): Open-top countertop structures with a pop-up header, designed to boost impulse buys of single-wrapped treats.
- [Mailer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/): Extra-sturdy shippers with interlocking flaps to protect e-commerce chocolate orders.

## The Ideal Box Size for Every Type of Chocolate

Size matters when it comes to preserving delicate confections. We offer custom sizes to fit single-serving favors, standard 4-pack samplers, or massive 48-piece holiday collections. Whether you sell thin breakaway bars, heavy fudge squares, or tall molded figurines, we create every chocolate box to the exact interior dimensions you need, eliminating empty space and preventing shifting.

## Chocolate Boxes with Logo: Promoting Your Brand Widely

Your packaging is a silent salesman that works 24/7 to promote your business; make sure it counts. With our digital and offset techniques, your logo, artwork, and all branding details will look sharp on printed chocolate boxes.

By partnering with us, you’ll get endless, high-definition printing options, including:

- CMYK and Pantone Matching colors
- Outside, Inside, and Both-Sided Printing
- Matte/gloss laminations, spot UV coating, foil stamping, and embossing/debossing

## Capture The Holiday Spirit This Christmas with Custom Christmas Boxes

Give your gifts a makeover this holiday season by adding holiday spirit with custom Christmas boxes. These boxes enhance the gift-giving experience and add a fun, festive touch for your customers.

Attract more customers this holiday season with eye-catching Christmas gift boxes. Add a festive touch to your packaging with custom designs, brand colors, logos, and holiday-themed prints.

These boxes not only make gifts look more special but also promote your brand and increase recognition by featuring your logo and artwork.

## Sturdy Christmas Boxes To Protect Your Gifting Goods

We all know Christmas is about spreading love to the people we care about most by giving them gifts. This is why you need to use [gift boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/gift-boxes/) that are made with durable materials, offer a premium and sturdy look, and keep the goods intact.

We use the following packaging materials for Christmas boxes:

- Cardboard
- Corrugated Cardboard
- Rigid Stock
- Kraft Stock

You can choose packaging materials based on your product needs and customize them to match the Christmas theme.

## Endless Customization Options for Christmas Boxes

We understand how much Christmas means to brands and customers, so we offer endless customization options to help you create the Christmas box packaging your product deserves.

With us, you can customize your Christmas boxes to your unique needs, including custom sizes, shapes, colors, and more.

We also offer a wide range of Christmas box styles. Some of the most popular Christmas box styles are:

- [Two Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/)

Need something unique? Tell us what you need, and our experts will bring your vision to life.

## Premium Finishing & Printing Options for Luxury Christmas Boxes

Make your luxury Christmas boxes even more premium with the right printing and finishing options. We use advanced printing techniques for [luxury rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/), such as digital and offset printing, using CMYK and Pantone (PMS) color models to deliver crisp, color-accurate results.

You can also make your custom printed Christmas boxes more luxurious with finishing options. The right finishing option can enhance your box’s overall appeal. We offer the following finishing options:

- Spot UV
- Embossing
- Foil Stamping
- Matte Lamination
- Gloss Lamination
- Soft-touch Lamination

## Tips to Design Christmas Boxes

Want your Christmas gift boxes to stand out this holiday season? Keep your designs festive, attractive, and true to your brand. Follow these simple tips:

- Choose festive colors like red, green, gold, and white.
- Add your brand logo for better brand recognition.
- Use Christmas trees, snowflakes, and ribbons in your artwork.
- Choose sturdy materials to keep gifts safe.
- Add foil stamping, embossing, or spot UV for a premium look.

These small details make your packaging more appealing and memorable.

sections.title: Tips to Design Christmas Boxes
sections.content:
Want your Christmas gift boxes to stand out this holiday season? Keep your designs festive, attractive, and true to your brand. Follow these simple tips:

## Custom Coaster Boxes with Innovative Features

Our custom coaster boxes are engineered for real‑world challenges.

Here are the protective, innovative features every box has:

- Edge‑crush resistance: Prevents collapse during shipping.
- Moisture‑barrier coatings: Protect against humidity.
- Dust‑resistant finishes: Keep your boxes clean in storage.
- Shock‑absorbing inserts: Safeguard fragile coasters.

Whether in humid regions, during sea during freight, or in stacked warehouses, every coaster packaging option helps ensure your coasters look their best.

## High-Quality Materials That Protect

The material you choose defines your coaster boxes’ look and performance.

We offer high-quality materials, including:

- Rigid stock: Adds weight and prestige, perfect for premium coaster sets.
- Paperboard: Smooth surface for vibrant, high‑resolution printing.
- Kraft paper: Rustic, eco‑friendly appeal for sustainability‑minded buyers.
- Corrugated: Crush‑resistant, ideal for bulk shipping.
- Cardboard: Affordable yet durable, balancing cost and performance.

Thickness range matters too: our materials range from lightweight 12pt–18pt paperboard for [folding cartons](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/folding-cartons/) to 40pt–60pt rigid stock for [premium rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/), with corrugated and cardboard options available in E‑flute to double‑wall grades for heavy‑duty protection.

## Custom Coaster Box Styles That Tell Your Story

Every box style carries a purpose.

Choose from our unique box styles below.

- [Two‑piece rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Luxury presentation, often reused by customers.
- [Tuck‑top boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tuck-top-boxes/): Lightweight, cost‑effective, easy to assemble.
- [Tray sleeve boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/): Sleek sliding reveal, minimalist branding.
- [Magnetic closure boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Premium snap-shut, durable, and reusable.
- [Window boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Showcase your coaster designs instantly to drive impulse buys.

Every style is customizable. Need [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) designed around your ideas? We can create those too!

## Precise Sizes That Fit Perfectly

We offer custom sizing to match your coaster dimensions precisely.

- Slim fit (3.5″ × 3.5″ × 0.25″): Ideal for lightweight cork or paper coasters
- Deep fit (4″ × 4″ × 0.5″ or 4.25″ × 4.25″ × 0.75″): Designed for ceramic or marble coasters, with reinforced walls to guard against chips.
- Multi‑pack options: Boxes for sets of 4, 6, or 12, ranging from 4″ × 4″ × 2″ up to 4.5″ × 4.5″ × 3.5″, with dividers to prevent stacking damage.
- Custom sizes: Tailored dimensions for unique coasters.

We tailor dimensions to the millimeter, eliminating looseness or scuffing. This precision keeps your coasters snug and ready to impress while protecting fragile finishes during transit or retail display.

sections.title: Custom Coaster Boxes with Innovative Features
sections.content:
Our custom coaster boxes are engineered for real‑world challenges.

Here are the protective, innovative features every box has:

- Edge‑crush resistance: Prevents collapse during shipping.
- Moisture‑barrier coatings: Protect against humidity.
- Dust‑resistant finishes: Keep your boxes clean in storage.
- Shock‑absorbing inserts: Safeguard fragile coasters.

Whether in humid regions, during sea during freight, or in stacked warehouses, every coaster packaging option helps ensure your coasters look their best.

sections.title: High-Quality Materials That Protect
sections.content:
The material you choose defines your coaster boxes’ look and performance.

We offer high-quality materials, including:

- Rigid stock: Adds weight and prestige, perfect for premium coaster sets.
- Paperboard: Smooth surface for vibrant, high‑resolution printing.
- Kraft paper: Rustic, eco‑friendly appeal for sustainability‑minded buyers.
- Corrugated: Crush‑resistant, ideal for bulk shipping.
- Cardboard: Affordable yet durable, balancing cost and performance.

Thickness range matters too: our materials range from lightweight 12pt–18pt paperboard for [folding cartons](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/folding-cartons/) to 40pt–60pt rigid stock for [premium rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/), with corrugated and cardboard options available in E‑flute to double‑wall grades for heavy‑duty protection.

sections.title: Custom Coaster Box Styles That Tell Your Story
sections.content:
Every box style carries a purpose.

Choose from our unique box styles below.

- [Two‑piece rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Luxury presentation, often reused by customers.
- [Tuck‑top boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tuck-top-boxes/): Lightweight, cost‑effective, easy to assemble.
- [Tray sleeve boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/): Sleek sliding reveal, minimalist branding.
- [Magnetic closure boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Premium snap-shut, durable, and reusable.
- [Window boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Showcase your coaster designs instantly to drive impulse buys.

Every style is customizable. Need [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) designed around your ideas? We can create those too!

sections.title: Precise Sizes That Fit Perfectly
sections.content:
We offer custom sizing to match your coaster dimensions precisely.

- Slim fit (3.5″ × 3.5″ × 0.25″): Ideal for lightweight cork or paper coasters
- Deep fit (4″ × 4″ × 0.5″ or 4.25″ × 4.25″ × 0.75″): Designed for ceramic or marble coasters, with reinforced walls to guard against chips.
- Multi‑pack options: Boxes for sets of 4, 6, or 12, ranging from 4″ × 4″ × 2″ up to 4.5″ × 4.5″ × 3.5″, with dividers to prevent stacking damage.
- Custom sizes: Tailored dimensions for unique coasters.

We tailor dimensions to the millimeter, eliminating looseness or scuffing. This precision keeps your coasters snug and ready to impress while protecting fragile finishes during transit or retail display.

sections.title: Custom Coaster Boxes with Logo That Elevate Branding
sections.content:
Elevate your branding and promote better with custom printed coaster boxes.

Our custom printing offers:

- Digital & Offset Printing
- CMYK & Pantone Colors
- Outside, Inside, and Both-Sided Printing
- Finishes: Matte/Gloss, Foil Stamping, Spot UV, Embossing/Debossing

You can add surprise branding—hidden messages, QR codes, or storytelling elements to every corner of the box,

sections.title: Enhance the Unboxing Experience with Add-Ons
sections.content:
Small details make big impressions.

To help you enhance the unboxing experience, we provide wonderful add-ons, including:

- Custom inserts/dividers: Secure your coasters during transit.
- Ribbon pulls: Elegant opening for a memorable unboxing.
- Scratch‑resistant coatings: Extend shelf life.
- Recyclable PET windows: Showcase your coaster designs.

sections.title: Sustainability Built Into Every Box
sections.content:
Rest assured, our custom coaster boxes help your business showcase its environmental responsibility.

We provide:

- Recyclable materials (kraft, paperboard, cardboard) that reduce waste.
- Biodegradable inks to lower environmental impact.
- Minimalist designs to reduce material use without compromising strength.

Customers value packaging that aligns with their eco‑conscious lifestyle, and eco-friendly coaster boxes strengthen loyalty beyond the product itself.

sections.title: Order Wholesale Coaster Boxes with No Minimums
sections.content:
Your coasters deserve packaging that protects and impresses without draining your budget. At [Pack Legacy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/), we provide wholesale coaster boxes designed for businesses of every size. Whether you need a small batch for a boutique launch or bulk packaging for nationwide distribution, we make it simple—no minimum order quantities required. Enjoy wholesale pricing, fast turnaround, and free shipping, too.

faqs.question: What is a collapsible rigid box?
faqs.answer: A collapsible rigid box is a trendy packaging option that combines a durable structure with the convenience of folding flat to save on storage and shipping costs.

faqs.question: Can I get the collapsible box designed to be the exact size I need?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can get your collapsible box designed to be the exact size you need. With our die-cutting technique, we can precisely cut your box to the required dimensions and shape for your products.

faqs.question: What material do you use to produce these boxes?
faqs.answer: We use durable, rigid stock, such as chipboard for base material and paperboard for wrapping material, to produce collapsible rigid boxes with custom artwork.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum quantity order policy for collapsible rigid boxes?
faqs.answer: No, we do not require a minimum order quantity for collapsible rigid boxes. You can order as many boxes as you need or as few as one.

faqs.question: What product can I pack in this box?
faqs.answer: You can pack various products, such as gifts, electronics, cosmetics, perfumes, apparel, jewelry, and retail goods.

faqs.question: How long will you deliver these boxes to my address?
faqs.answer: Our production timing takes 8 to 12 business days, and we take 2-3 business days to deliver your boxes to your doorstep.

## Colored Mailer Boxes with Smart Layouts & Functional Features

Move beyond standard packaging; deliver your valuable products in our colored mailer boxes. These boxes blend style and practicality.

- Self‑locking design: Quick assembly without tape or glue, saving time during packing.
- Foldable structure: They ship flat for easy storage and bulk handling, reducing warehouse space.
- Secure closure flaps: Engineered edges to keep your products safe during transit while maintaining a sleek look.
- Tear‑resistant corrugated walls: Extra durability for shipping and handling.
- Custom Sizing: Perfectly measured boxes that fit your products snugly.
- Optional inserts: Keep your products stable and organized, enhancing the unboxing experience.
- Spacious interior: Easily accommodates apparel, cosmetics, electronics, and subscription kits.
- Smooth exterior panels: Perfect canvas for bold colors, your logo, and custom prints.

## Perfect Uses Across Industries

[Mailer boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/) are already famous as the protective shell during delivery. And colored mailer boxes perform beyond that.

Their structural integrity and heavy-duty corrugated material make them perfect across industries, such as:

- E‑commerce packaging: Deliver products in boxes that impress customers the moment they arrive.
- Subscription kits: Add excitement to monthly deliveries with bold, colorful packaging.
- [Retail packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/): Showcase apparel, cosmetics, or electronics in eye‑catching designs.
- [Gift boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/gift-boxes/): Seasonal promotions and giveaways look more premium in colored mailers.
- Brand campaigns: Reinforce your brand identity with custom colors that match your logo and theme.

## Durable, Custom Colored Mailer Boxes You Can Count On

Our colored mailer boxes are crafted from durable corrugated or kraft material. The strong structure keeps your products safe in transit, while the smooth exterior provides the perfect canvas for bold colors. Choose eco‑friendly kraft interiors or double‑sided printing for a premium finish.

Thickness options range from lightweight E‑flute for retail display to heavy‑duty B‑flute for shipping. This balance of strength and style makes them versatile for every industry.

## Vibrant Printing That Highlights Every Colored Mailer Box

Plain packaging is forgettable. Colored mailer boxes are bold, protective, and brand‑ready. With innovative digital and offset printing, we help you customize them inside and out. You can add your logo, patterns, or promotional messages. Even better, you can elevate your design with foil stamping, gloss/matte lamination, embossing, debossing, or spot UV for a luxury effect.

Rest assured that every colored mailer box with logo will highlight your product while promoting your brand without any hassle.

## Order Colored Mailer Boxes with No MOQs

We are a reliable choice if you are looking for [custom printed boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) at wholesale prices. Order custom colored mailer boxes in the quantity you need with our no-minimum policy. Need the boxes in bulk? Our special bulk-order discounts await!

Our colored mailer boxes are crafted from durable corrugated or kraft material. The strong structure keeps your products safe in transit, while the smooth exterior provides the perfect canvas for bold colors. Choose eco‑friendly kraft interiors or double‑sided printing for a premium finish.

Thickness options range from lightweight E‑flute for retail display to heavy‑duty B‑flute for shipping. This balance of strength and style makes them versatile for every industry.

sections.title: Vibrant Printing That Highlights Every Colored Mailer Box
sections.content:

You can add your logo, patterns, or promotional messages. Even better, you can elevate your design with foil stamping, gloss/matte lamination, embossing, debossing, or spot UV for a luxury effect.

Rest assured that every colored mailer box with logo will highlight your product while promoting your brand without any hassle.

## Increase Your Sales with Our Custom Cone Sleeves

Turn every dessert into a walking marketing tool for your business. Our customized cone sleeves display your logo boldly, boosting brand recognition across crowded streets and social media feeds. This premium presentation allows you to command higher price points and attracts new buyers.

Invest in our high-quality [custom packaging solutions](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/) to create a memorable experience that drives repeat visits and spikes your revenue.

## Durable Sleeve Materials for Food-Grade Cone Sleeves

We use high-quality, food-grade materials to maintain structural integrity and freshness for our [food boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/).

And to ensure your custom cone sleeves are safe for direct food contact, we use:

- Food-Grade Kraft Paper: Eco-friendly and biodegradable.
- SBS C1S (Solid Bleached Sulfate): A coated paperboard with a glossy surface for high-quality printing.
- Grease-Resistant/Waterproof Paper: Protects against oil and moisture.
- Foil-Lined Paper: Paper with an aluminum-polyethylene barrier

## Keep Your Cones Crisp and Hygienic with Innovative Features of Our Cone Sleeves

Everyone loves ice cream, but consumers also judge its appearance and quality when purchasing it.

To help you convince every consumer, we include innovative features in our cone sleeves, including:

- Mess & Drip Prevention: Catches melted drips cleanly, keeping your customers’ hands spotless.
- Grease & Moisture Resistance: Prevents soggy paper from breaking down, even on hot summer days.
- Thermal Insulation: Shields warm hands from melting the ice cream too quickly.
- Textured Grip Options: Provides a secure, non-slip hold for a comfortable eating experience.

## Custom Printing That Increases the Beauty of Your Printed Cone Sleeves

Transform basic packaging into a work of art with our advanced printing tech. We offer high-definition digital and offset printing to make your brand colors pop on cone sleeves with logo.

Choose from premium finishes like glossy coating, elegant matte, spot UV, or metallic foil stamping. These stunning visual details make your desserts instantly picture-perfect and impossible to ignore.

## Custom Sizes to Fit Every Cone

We offer different sizes for custom cone sleeves, ranging from:

- Mini cones: 4.5″ height × 2.5″ width
- Regular cones: 5.5″ height × 3″ width
- Large waffle cones: 6.5″ height × 3.5″ width

These dimensions fit standard sugar and waffle cones. Plus, you can get a custom size to accommodate everything from mini tasting cones to jumbo, multi-scoop waffle cones.

## Eco-Friendly Cone Sleeve Packaging

Our eco-friendly cone sleeves help you reduce packaging waste without compromising on strength or performance. By using recyclable and biodegradable materials, you can serve your ice cream responsibly while still maintaining the durability needed for busy service environments.

## Wholesale Cone Sleeves in High Quality? Get Them from Us!

Get top-tier packaging without breaking your budget. We provide wholesale cone sleeves crafted with strict quality control at highly competitive prices. Whether you run a single boutique shop or a national franchise, our no-minimum-order policy and fast turnaround times keep your shelves fully stocked.

Get in touch with us today to order your custom cone sleeves!

Common questions about ordering custom cone sleeves.

### What materials do you use to make cone sleeves?

We use high-quality, food-grade materials to produce custom cone sleeves, including kraft, SBS paperboard, waterproof paper, and foil-lined paper.

### Are your cone sleeves eco-friendly?

Yes, all the materials we use for custom cone sleeves are recyclable and eco-friendly.

### What sizes are available for custom cone sleeves?

We offer different sizes for custom cone sleeves: mini (4.5" height x 2.5" width), regular (5.5" height x 3" width), and large (6.5" height x 3.5" width). You can also get a custom size to fit your needs.

### What is the minimum order quantity for printed cone sleeves?

We have no minimum requirement; you can order printed cone sleeves in the exact quantity you need.

### Is your cone sleeve greaseproof?

Yes, we include grease- and moisture-resistant barriers to prevent soggy paper from breaking down, even on hot summer days.

sections.title: Increase Your Sales with Our Custom Cone Sleeves
sections.content:
Turn every dessert into a walking marketing tool for your business. Our customized cone sleeves display your logo boldly, boosting brand recognition across crowded streets and social media feeds. This premium presentation allows you to command higher price points and attracts new buyers.

Invest in our high-quality [custom packaging solutions](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/) to create a memorable experience that drives repeat visits and spikes your revenue.

sections.title: Durable Sleeve Materials for Food-Grade Cone Sleeves
sections.content:
We use high-quality, food-grade materials to maintain structural integrity and freshness for our [food boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/).

And to ensure your custom cone sleeves are safe for direct food contact, we use:

- Food-Grade Kraft Paper: Eco-friendly and biodegradable.
- SBS C1S (Solid Bleached Sulfate): A coated paperboard with a glossy surface for high-quality printing.
- Grease-Resistant/Waterproof Paper: Protects against oil and moisture.
- Foil-Lined Paper: Paper with an aluminum-polyethylene barrier

sections.title: Keep Your Cones Crisp and Hygienic with Innovative Features of Our Cone Sleeves
sections.content:
Everyone loves ice cream, but consumers also judge its appearance and quality when purchasing it.

To help you convince every consumer, we include innovative features in our cone sleeves, including:

- Mess & Drip Prevention: Catches melted drips cleanly, keeping your customers’ hands spotless.
- Grease & Moisture Resistance: Prevents soggy paper from breaking down, even on hot summer days.
- Thermal Insulation: Shields warm hands from melting the ice cream too quickly.
- Textured Grip Options: Provides a secure, non-slip hold for a comfortable eating experience.

sections.title: Custom Printing That Increases the Beauty of Your Printed Cone Sleeves
sections.content:
Transform basic packaging into a work of art with our advanced printing tech. We offer high-definition digital and offset printing to make your brand colors pop on cone sleeves with logo.

Choose from premium finishes like glossy coating, elegant matte, spot UV, or metallic foil stamping. These stunning visual details make your desserts instantly picture-perfect and impossible to ignore.

sections.title: Custom Sizes to Fit Every Cone
sections.content:

- Mini cones: 4.5″ height × 2.5″ width
- Regular cones: 5.5″ height × 3″ width
- Large waffle cones: 6.5″ height × 3.5″ width

These dimensions fit standard sugar and waffle cones. Plus, you can get a custom size to accommodate everything from mini tasting cones to jumbo, multi-scoop waffle cones.

sections.content: Our eco-friendly cone sleeves help you reduce packaging waste without compromising on strength or performance. By using recyclable and biodegradable materials, you can serve your ice cream responsibly while still maintaining the durability needed for busy service environments.

## Custom Cookie Boxes For Bakeries, Cafes, Home Bakers, and Food Brands

Every cookie business has different packaging needs. Our cookie boxes are designed by keeping your business requirements in mind whether it is a tempting presentation, boost sales, unboxing experience, or to make consistent branding.

For home bakers, custom cookie boxes create a polished brand image from the first sale. For bakeries and cafes, they keep daily orders presentable for counters, takeaway, and customer handoff. Whether you need packaging for cookies, cupcakes, or celebration cakes, our range includes [cupcake boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cupcake-boxes/), cake boxes to help you maintain a consistent branded look across your product line.

For food brands, they help maintain a consistent, retail-ready look across deliveries, gifting, and repeat orders. These purpose-built cookie boxes give your cookies a secure, finished and trustworthy appearance, helping customers see the quality of your cookies before they even open the box.

## Food-Safe Materials That Help Keep Cookie Fresh

Protect the crispiness and freshness of your cookies intact to impress your customers that soggy or broken cookies fail to do. To keep your cookies crunchy outside and soft inside we offer food-safe materials including paperboard, kraft, cardboard, and rigidstock. Choose the material according to your product, budget, and branding goals.

- Cardboard offers excellent strength, high-quality printing, and dependable protection during transportation.
- Paperboard provides a smooth surface that produces sharp vibrant printing while maintaining a lightweight structure.
- Kraft material is preferred by artisan bakeries and environmentally conscious brands.
- For luxury collections and corporate gifting, [rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/) offer the highest level of durability and presentation.

To improve product protection even further, we offer several functional packaging add-ons like wax liners or protective coatings that help prevent butter and oil from staining the packaging while preserving freshness.

For assorted cookies, delicate iced cookies, or mutli-flavor cookie sets, we design custom cookie boxes with dividers to keep each cookie in place. This helps in minimizing shifting during handling and improves the final presentation when customers open the box.

## Choose the Right Cookie Packaging Box Style

Selecting the right style starts with your cookie size, presentation goals, and shipping requirements. To give your customers a sneak peek of your cookies, opt for window cookie boxes. These boxes are ideal for bakery counters, cafes, and retail shelves.

Two-piece lid boxes, tray and sleeve boxes, and magnetic closure boxes feel more premium and work well for gifting, gourmet assortments, and seasonal collections. These premium styles are also popular for delicate treats like macarons and chocolates, where [chocolate boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/chocolate-boxes/)offer the same level of protection and presentation.

In further options, [gable boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/) come with a built-in handle, making them practical for takeouts, events, and party packs. For cheaper but simple and easy-to-assemble options you may go for straight tuck-end boxes and for strength for heavier cookie packs and faster packaging Auto-lock button boxes offer the perfect solution.

The right choice of cookie packaging box style depends on how your cookies are sold, displayed, and transported.

## Which Size Cookie Box Do You Need?

Choosing the right box size saves your cookies from shifting during transport while creating a clean presentation for customers. The right dimensions also reduce packaging waste and shipping cost. Below are some standard cookie box sizes, you can check.

## Modern Printing and Finishing Options

We offer custom cookie box printing services that allow you to personalize every part of your packaging with your logo, brand colors, product information, ingredients, QR codes, promotional messages, or seasonal artwork. Whether you want clean, minimalist branding or bold, colorful packaging that stands out on retail shelves, our printing efficiencies can bring your vision to life.

We provide digital and offset printing, CMYK and Pantone color matching, as well as inside and outside printing for a fully branded experience.

To give your custom printed cookie boxes with the logo a more premium look, you can ask for matte, gloss, soft-touch finishes along with specialty enhancements such as spot UV, gold foil, silver foil, embossing, and debossing. These finishing options help highlight your branding while giving customers a memorable unboxing experience.

Our design teams work closely with businesses to make sure every detail aligns with your brand identity while maintaining excellent print quality from the first box to the last.

## Cookie Boxes at Wholesale Rates With No MOQ

Whether you are preparing for a seasonal launch, opening a new bakery, or scaling an established cookie business, ordering custom packaging should not cost you a huge amount or unnecessary commitments.

That is why we offer wholesale custom cookie boxes with no minimum order quantity. Small businesses can order exactly what they need. On the other hand, larger brands benefit from competitive bulk pricing without compromising quality.

If you offer multiple baked products along with cookies, our [bakery boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) collection lets you source consistent packaging across your entire product line.

## Why Choose Pack Legacy For Custom Cookie Boxes?

At Pack Legacy, we work hand in hand with our customers to make their business stand out. We understand the delicate nature of cookies, that is why our every order is customized with perfection using food-safe materials, premium printing, free design assistance, and digital mockups before production begins.

Our team helps you choose the right box style, material, size, and finishing options based on your products, budget, and distribution method. From idea to delivery, we focus on creating packaging that protects your cookies, strengthens your brand, and leaves a lasting impression on every customer.

sections.title: Custom Cookie Boxes For Bakeries, Cafes, Home Bakers, and Food Brands
sections.content:
Every cookie business has different packaging needs. Our cookie boxes are designed by keeping your business requirements in mind whether it is a tempting presentation, boost sales, unboxing experience, or to make consistent branding.

For home bakers, custom cookie boxes create a polished brand image from the first sale. For bakeries and cafes, they keep daily orders presentable for counters, takeaway, and customer handoff. Whether you need packaging for cookies, cupcakes, or celebration cakes, our range includes [cupcake boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cupcake-boxes/), cake boxes to help you maintain a consistent branded look across your product line.

For food brands, they help maintain a consistent, retail-ready look across deliveries, gifting, and repeat orders. These purpose-built cookie boxes give your cookies a secure, finished and trustworthy appearance, helping customers see the quality of your cookies before they even open the box.

sections.title: Food-Safe Materials That Help Keep Cookie Fresh
sections.content:
Protect the crispiness and freshness of your cookies intact to impress your customers that soggy or broken cookies fail to do. To keep your cookies crunchy outside and soft inside we offer food-safe materials including paperboard, kraft, cardboard, and rigidstock. Choose the material according to your product, budget, and branding goals.

- Cardboard offers excellent strength, high-quality printing, and dependable protection during transportation.
- Paperboard provides a smooth surface that produces sharp vibrant printing while maintaining a lightweight structure.
- Kraft material is preferred by artisan bakeries and environmentally conscious brands.
- For luxury collections and corporate gifting, [rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/) offer the highest level of durability and presentation.

To improve product protection even further, we offer several functional packaging add-ons like wax liners or protective coatings that help prevent butter and oil from staining the packaging while preserving freshness.

For assorted cookies, delicate iced cookies, or mutli-flavor cookie sets, we design custom cookie boxes with dividers to keep each cookie in place. This helps in minimizing shifting during handling and improves the final presentation when customers open the box.

sections.title: Choose the Right Cookie Packaging Box Style
sections.content:
Selecting the right style starts with your cookie size, presentation goals, and shipping requirements. To give your customers a sneak peek of your cookies, opt for window cookie boxes. These boxes are ideal for bakery counters, cafes, and retail shelves.

Two-piece lid boxes, tray and sleeve boxes, and magnetic closure boxes feel more premium and work well for gifting, gourmet assortments, and seasonal collections. These premium styles are also popular for delicate treats like macarons and chocolates, where [chocolate boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/chocolate-boxes/)offer the same level of protection and presentation.

In further options, [gable boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/) come with a built-in handle, making them practical for takeouts, events, and party packs. For cheaper but simple and easy-to-assemble options you may go for straight tuck-end boxes and for strength for heavier cookie packs and faster packaging Auto-lock button boxes offer the perfect solution.

The right choice of cookie packaging box style depends on how your cookies are sold, displayed, and transported.

sections.title: Which Size Cookie Box Do You Need?
sections.content:
Choosing the right box size saves your cookies from shifting during transport while creating a clean presentation for customers. The right dimensions also reduce packaging waste and shipping cost. Below are some standard cookie box sizes, you can check.

Note that:If your cookies have unique dimensions, thick icing, unusual shapes, or special presentation requirements, we can manufacture completely custom-sized cookie boxes that provide a precise fit and better product presentation.

sections.title: Modern Printing and Finishing Options
sections.content:
We offer custom cookie box printing services that allow you to personalize every part of your packaging with your logo, brand colors, product information, ingredients, QR codes, promotional messages, or seasonal artwork. Whether you want clean, minimalist branding or bold, colorful packaging that stands out on retail shelves, our printing efficiencies can bring your vision to life.

We provide digital and offset printing, CMYK and Pantone color matching, as well as inside and outside printing for a fully branded experience.

To give your custom printed cookie boxes with the logo a more premium look, you can ask for matte, gloss, soft-touch finishes along with specialty enhancements such as spot UV, gold foil, silver foil, embossing, and debossing. These finishing options help highlight your branding while giving customers a memorable unboxing experience.

Our design teams work closely with businesses to make sure every detail aligns with your brand identity while maintaining excellent print quality from the first box to the last.

sections.title: Cookie Boxes at Wholesale Rates With No MOQ
sections.content:
Whether you are preparing for a seasonal launch, opening a new bakery, or scaling an established cookie business, ordering custom packaging should not cost you a huge amount or unnecessary commitments.

That is why we offer wholesale custom cookie boxes with no minimum order quantity. Small businesses can order exactly what they need. On the other hand, larger brands benefit from competitive bulk pricing without compromising quality.

If you offer multiple baked products along with cookies, our [bakery boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) collection lets you source consistent packaging across your entire product line.

sections.title: Why Choose Pack Legacy For Custom Cookie Boxes?
sections.content:
At Pack Legacy, we work hand in hand with our customers to make their business stand out. We understand the delicate nature of cookies, that is why our every order is customized with perfection using food-safe materials, premium printing, free design assistance, and digital mockups before production begins.

Our team helps you choose the right box style, material, size, and finishing options based on your products, budget, and distribution method. From idea to delivery, we focus on creating packaging that protects your cookies, strengthens your brand, and leaves a lasting impression on every customer.

Ready to create custom cookie boxes that look as good as your cookie taste? Request a free quote today and let our packaging specialists help you design packaging tailored to your product and business goals.

## Material Thickness & Flute Types

Different products require different durability. That’s why we offer a wide range of thicknesses and flute types to ensure every box withstands the harsh delivery journey.

Choose from:

- E‑Flute (1.5 mm): Thin profile, smooth surface for high‑quality printing, ideal for cosmetics, apparel, and subscription boxes.
- B‑Flute (3 mm): Balanced strength and cushioning, perfect for e‑commerce packaging, food boxes, and mid‑weight products.
- C‑Flute (4 mm): Strong crush resistance, great for bulk deliveries and fragile goods.
- Double‑Wall (6 mm+): Maximum durability for heavy or oversized shipments, used in industrial and export packaging.

## Choose Premium Materials for Your Custom Cream Boxes

Different skincare creams require specific, reliable packaging solutions.

To ensure your sensitive items get the ultimate protection, we use premium materials, including:

- Paperboard
- Cardstock
- Corrugated
- Kraft
- Rigid Stock

Every box will be designed according to your product’s size and dimensions to ensure safe shipping and an appealing display.

Plus, we include innovative features in each cream packaging for added protection, such as:

- Specialized laminations that block harmful UV light to keep active ingredients stable.
- Sturdy walls to prevent accidental dents, leaks, and glass jar breakage.
- Strong moisture barriers to shield your creams from humid warehouse environments.

Keep your skincare creams flawless and appealing with [custom cosmetic boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/) built to protect and preserve.

## Stylish Custom Cream Packaging That Sells

The right box structure captivates customers and improves usability. We provide a wide range of cream packaging styles to match your product’s specific dimensions.

Choose from:

- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Both top and bottom flaps fold into the same side for a seamless, clean look on the front panel.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Flaps close in opposite directions for maximum strength and efficiency.
- [Auto-Lock Bottom Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/auto-lock-bottom-boxes/): The bottom pieces pre-glue and snap together instantly to support heavier glass cream jars without breaking or slipping.
- [Tray and Sleeve Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/): A smooth drawer slides out of a protective outer shell to create a high-end unboxing ritual for luxury lines.
- [Shoulder Neck Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/shoulder-neck-rigid-boxes/): Featuring a unique inner neck that creates a visual break, they add an upscale look to high-ticket skincare items.
- [Two Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): A separate, classic lid lifts off a sturdy base, providing an elegant presentation for exclusive cream bundles.
- [Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Designed with die-cut windows to reveal your actual cream container or product texture.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): An open-top layout to showcase multiple cream jars, driving impulse purchases on checkout counters.

Elevate your chosen style with our optional add-ons. Include [custom inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) to lock your jars safely in place, matching satin ribbons, or magnetic closures.

Want to create custom cream boxes in a specific style? Share your ideas with us, and let us bring them to life.

Boost your brand recognition with high-definition custom printing and finishes. We use innovative digital and offset techniques with advanced CMYK and PMS colors. Your brand logo, ingredient lists, and usage instructions will look legible, sharp, and professional on every cream box.

To add a visual appeal, we offer luxury finishes for cream boxes with logo, including:

- Matte/Gloss Lamination
