sections.title: Protective Features
sections.content:
To better protect your delicate makeup items, every makeup box is designed with innovative features, such as:

- Physical Shock Absorber: Heavy-duty corrugated fluting cushions fragile glass items against bumps during shipping.
- Tear Strips & Pull-Tabs: Tamper-evident seals offer easy opening while securing your products inside.
- Locking Tabs & Tuck Ends: Snug friction fit prevents boxes from opening accidentally on shelves.
- Scratch-Resistant Lamination: Protective exterior film prevents scuffs, oil stains, and fingerprint marks.
- Acetate Window Panes: Clear plastic panels that let customers preview shades safely without opening the seals.
- [Custom Inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) and Dividers: Precision-cut foam or paperboard inserts to lock individual makeup items tightly in place.

sections.title: Excellent Printing Choices for Custom Makeup Boxes with Logo
sections.content:
Bring your artwork to life with our high-definition custom printing services. We use excellent machinery to ensure your brand logo and custom graphics remain crisp, vibrant, and perfectly aligned.

- Offset & Digital Printing
- PMS and CMYK Colors
- One-Side or Both-Sided Printing

Premium Finishes for Printed Makeup Packaging

Turn your makeup packaging into a tactile masterpiece with our luxury finishing options. We provide specialized coatings that add texture, depth, and a high-end feel that drives impulse purchases, such as:

- Matte/Gloss Lamination

When it comes to [custom printed boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) that showcase your makeup items beautifully, we are the best partner to choose.

## Custom Mascara Boxes That Make Your Beauty Products Look Better

The beauty world moves fast, and looks matter. A great box easily catches a buyer’s eye. Our [cosmetic boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/) use bright colors, sharp details, and clean designs to give your mascara a high-end look. They turn a simple beauty tool into a must-have luxury item.

Whether you are selling waterproof mascara, clear lash gels, colored mascara, or volume and lengthening formulas, we can create the ideal box you need.

Choose a style that matches your brand’s look and feel:

- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Clean, classic boxes in which both flaps fold to the same side.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Functional boxes with flaps that close on opposite sides.
- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): Modern, slide-out boxes that give customers a premium unboxing experience.
- [Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Feature a clear window cutout so buyers can view your mascara tube.
- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Heavy, high-end boxes that snap shut with a hidden magnet.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): Large countertop boxes built to hold and showcase multiple mascaras at checkout counters.

Didn’t find the style you need? Or you have a specific style in mind? Share your ideas with us, and let our packaging experts create the best box for your lovely mascara.

## Materials That Ensure Product Safety

Mascara tubes can crack or scratch if they get bumped during shipping. Therefore, we create custom mascara boxes from strong, high-quality materials to protect your beauty product from harm.

Choose from:

- Cardstock
- Paperboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each material ensures your delicate mascara is well protected, even in a harsh shipping journey. Beyond shipping, all the materials we use will shield your delicate product and make it look more appealing in every retail display.

## High-Definition Printing for Mascara Boxes with Logo

A blurry logo ruins a great product. But our high-definition digital and offset techniques ensure your artwork looks sharp, crisp, and clean. Your logo will look bright and professional from every angle.

To make your custom mascara boxes with logo look more stunning, we provide endless custom printing, such as:

- CMYK and PMS colors
- Outside, inside, and both-sided printing

For premium finishes, choose from:

- Matte/Gloss Lamination
- Spot UV
- Foil Stamping
- Embossing/Debossing

Elegant or fun, luxury or trendy—you decide, we print.

## Engineering Your Perfect Fit—Custom Sizes, Inserts, and Windows

No two mascara wands are exactly the same size. And we build every mascara box from scratch to match your exact tube dimensions. This perfect fit prevents your product from rattling around inside the package.

Moreover, we can add [custom inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) to lock the tube safely in place. If you want to show off your beautiful artwork, get a custom window cutout into the front flap. You can choose either a completely open window or a clear, protective PVC shield.

## Save Your Cash with Custom Mascara Boxes at Wholesale Prices

Growing a beauty business means managing your packaging budget carefully. Our [custom boxes wholesale](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) options help you save on high-quality mascara packaging without compromising on quality. Ordering in bulk lowers your per-unit costs, while our no-minimum-order policy gives you the flexibility to purchase smaller quantities when needed.

sections.title: Custom Mascara Boxes That Make Your Beauty Products Look Better
sections.content:
The beauty world moves fast, and looks matter. A great box easily catches a buyer’s eye. Our [cosmetic boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/) use bright colors, sharp details, and clean designs to give your mascara a high-end look. They turn a simple beauty tool into a must-have luxury item.

Whether you are selling waterproof mascara, clear lash gels, colored mascara, or volume and lengthening formulas, we can create the ideal box you need.

Choose a style that matches your brand’s look and feel:

- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Clean, classic boxes in which both flaps fold to the same side.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Functional boxes with flaps that close on opposite sides.
- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): Modern, slide-out boxes that give customers a premium unboxing experience.
- [Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): Feature a clear window cutout so buyers can view your mascara tube.
- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Heavy, high-end boxes that snap shut with a hidden magnet.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): Large countertop boxes built to hold and showcase multiple mascaras at checkout counters.

Didn’t find the style you need? Or you have a specific style in mind? Share your ideas with us, and let our packaging experts create the best box for your lovely mascara.

sections.title: Materials That Ensure Product Safety
sections.content:
Mascara tubes can crack or scratch if they get bumped during shipping. Therefore, we create custom mascara boxes from strong, high-quality materials to protect your beauty product from harm.

Choose from:

- Cardstock
- Paperboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each material ensures your delicate mascara is well protected, even in a harsh shipping journey. Beyond shipping, all the materials we use will shield your delicate product and make it look more appealing in every retail display.

sections.title: High-Definition Printing for Mascara Boxes with Logo
sections.content:
A blurry logo ruins a great product. But our high-definition digital and offset techniques ensure your artwork looks sharp, crisp, and clean. Your logo will look bright and professional from every angle.

To make your custom mascara boxes with logo look more stunning, we provide endless custom printing, such as:

- CMYK and PMS colors
- Outside, inside, and both-sided printing

For premium finishes, choose from:

- Matte/Gloss Lamination
- Spot UV
- Foil Stamping
- Embossing/Debossing

Elegant or fun, luxury or trendy—you decide, we print.

sections.title: Engineering Your Perfect Fit—Custom Sizes, Inserts, and Windows
sections.content:
No two mascara wands are exactly the same size. And we build every mascara box from scratch to match your exact tube dimensions. This perfect fit prevents your product from rattling around inside the package.

Moreover, we can add [custom inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) to lock the tube safely in place. If you want to show off your beautiful artwork, get a custom window cutout into the front flap. You can choose either a completely open window or a clear, protective PVC shield.

sections.title: Save Your Cash with Custom Mascara Boxes at Wholesale Prices
sections.content:
Growing a beauty business means managing your packaging budget carefully. Our [custom boxes wholesale](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) options help you save on high-quality mascara packaging without compromising on quality. Ordering in bulk lowers your per-unit costs, while our no-minimum-order policy gives you the flexibility to purchase smaller quantities when needed.

Request a free quote for custom mascara boxes today and enjoy fast, free shipping!

## What Are Match Slide Rigid Boxes?

Match slide rigid boxes are premium packaging boxes that feature a tray-and-sleeve structure that slides open like a matchbox. They offer excellent protection and an upscale presentation. These boxes are commonly used for luxury products, gifts, cosmetics, jewelry, and specialty items.

## Key Features of Match Slide Boxes

The match slide boxes are designed to impress customers with a unique unboxing experience that leaves a lasting impression. Their unique, elegant, and sophisticated appearance makes them popular amongst premium and luxurious products.

When it comes to the match slide rigid boxes, they come with various features. Some of the key features are mentioned below:

- Durable Structure: Made from thick, rigid board to provide excellent strength and product protection.
- Convenience: Features a smooth slide-out tray for easy opening and closing.
- Cost-Effectiveness: Offers a premium presentation with long-lasting value for your packaging investment.
- Enhanced Unboxing Experience: Creates a memorable, luxurious opening for customers.
- Functionality: Suitable for a wide range of products and can include custom box inserts for better organization.

## Types of Match Slide Rigid Packaging

Match slide rigid packaging refers to boxes that include a two-component tray and a sleeve. Custom match boxes come in two different types. Select the one that best suits your needs:

- [Drawer Rigid Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): It includes a sleeve and a tray. The sleeve comes with a single-direction slide-out opening with ribbons or a thumb notch.
- Tray & Sleeve Boxes: It comes with a tray and a sleeve. The sleeve features a two-sided opening, allowing customers to open the box from either side.

## How To Design Unique Match Slide Boxes?

We understand that one box cannot meet every brand’s requirements, which is why we offer a wide range of customization options for these rigid boxes. Our match slide rigid boxes can be customized in the following ways:

- Custom Sizes & Shapes: We can manufacture match slide rigid boxes in any size and style to fit your products perfectly and meet your branding requirements.
- Material Options: Choose from grey chipboard, duplex chipboard, thick cardboard, and a variety of wrapping papers to achieve the desired strength and appearance.
- Printing & Finishing Options: Personalize your custom printed match slide boxes with full-color printing and premium finishes like matte, gloss, foil stamping, embossing, or spot UV.
- Add-Ons: Enhance functionality and presentation of these boxes with custom ribbons, thumb notches, and protective EVA foam inserts for a premium unboxing experience.

By using these customization options, you can design your own match slide rigid boxes that are as unique as your product and brand.

Are you looking for something else? Explore our range of [custom rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/) and select the one that best suits your needs.

Match slide rigid boxes offer more than just product protection. Their premium design helps brands create a better customer experience while giving products a luxurious appearance. These boxes are widely used for cosmetics, jewelry, candles, electronics, and gift items because they combine style with functionality.

- Premium Presentation: The slide-out design gives products a sophisticated and high-end look.

- Custom Branding: Supports custom printing, finishes, and inserts for a branded appearance.

## Custom Medicine Boxes Built for Distribution, Retail, and E-Commerce

Modern supply chains require flexible and resilient custom medicine box designs.

Well, our [high-quality custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) scale effortlessly across every major distribution channel. We help your pharmaceutical brand balance complex logistics with eye-catching retail presentation.

Our medicine packaging boxes are ideal for:

- Store shelves
- Direct-to-consumer shipping
- Sample kits
- Seasonal promotions
- Merchandising displays

## Medicine Packaging Features That Match Different Medicine Types

Different medical treatments require targeted containment configurations to ensure chemical stability. Therefore, we provide precise, custom sizing to deliver dimensionally accurate shapes that fit your exact product lines.

Rest easy knowing your delicate physical inventory fits securely inside our structural frames.

For better product protection, every medicine packaging includes advanced features, such as:

- Tamper-Evident Seals: Built-in perforations and security tear strips that leave visible evidence of any unauthorized opening attempt.
- Child-Resistant Closures: Integrated smart locking mechanisms to prevent accidental ingestion by children.
- Environmental & Moisture Barriers: Advanced protective coatings that effectively block external humidity, dust, and contaminants, securing your chemical formulations.
- Light Protection (UV Blocking): Specialized laminations to block the UV light from degrading the potency of your pharmaceutical items.
- [Custom Inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) & Dividers: Dividers separate delicate components, while inserts prevent glass-on-glass collisions during logistics handling.

## Medicine Packaging Types We Offer

Whatever pharmaceutical products you are offering, we can create the ideal medicine packaging you need, including:

- Custom Pill Boxes
- Blister Packaging
- Custom Vial Boxes
- Custom Syrup Boxes

## Material Selection That Protects Product Integrity

Pharmaceutical products are sensitive. Therefore, we use premium materials to guarantee they stay safe and potent, such as:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

## Regulatory Compliance Medicine Boxes Made for Your Brand

Complying with strict pharmaceutical packaging mandates requires experienced structural engineering. Our box design processes adhere closely to FDA and international compliance baselines.

Choose from our functional box styles to match your brand’s operational workflows:

- Tuck-End Boxes ([Straight](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/) & [Reverse](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/))
- [Auto Lock Bottom Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/auto-lock-bottom-boxes/)
- [Sleeve & Tray Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/)
- [Pillow Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/pillow-boxes/)
- [Two Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/)

## Printed Medicine Boxes That Communicate Clearly

Clear communication saves lives and builds long-term consumer authority.

Our custom printed medicine boxes provide clean, dedicated spaces for mandatory facts, including:

- Active ingredients
- Precise dosage instructions
- Weight metrics
- Batch numbers
- Expiration dates
- Barcodes

With advanced digital and offset printing techniques, we ensure every detail is displayed sharply and without smudging.

And to make sure your medicine boxes won’t look dull, you can polish them with excellent finishes like:

- Matte/Gloss Laminations
- Spot UV
- Foil Stamping
- Embossing/Debossing

## Wholesale Medicine Boxes with Quality Guaranteed

Scale up your pharmaceutical distribution safely while keeping operational costs low. [Pack Legacy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/) offers wholesale medicine boxes at competitive bulk pricing to maximize your brand’s market margins. sections.title: Custom Ornament Boxes for Maximum Brand Impact
sections.content: Ornaments bring joy to every celebration — from Christmas trees to Halloween décor, weddings, and more. Thus, they deserve packaging that’s just as special. And our customized ornament boxes are designed to protect, showcase, and elevate your products while strengthening your brand identity.

sections.title: Premium Materials That Elevate Your Ornament Packaging
sections.content:
Your ornaments deserve durable boxes that keep them secure. Therefore, we ensure every box feels just as special as the ornament inside.

Choose from our premium materials below:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid stock

Each material is highly durable and sustainable, making your ornament packaging a protective shell for your products. Plus, our custom sizing options ensure every box fits your ornaments perfectly.

sections.title: Ornament Box Styles That Inspire Buyers
sections.content:
Ornament packaging is about presentation, storytelling, and creating a festive experience. Our box styles are designed to captivate buyers, enhance retail displays, and deliver your ornaments with elegance.

Have a look at the popular styles below and choose the one that best suits your ornament products.

- [Rigid Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/): Premium and durable, these boxes provide maximum protection and a luxury feel; perfect for collectible ornaments or high‑end retail displays.
- [Window Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/window-boxes/): A clear window cut‑out lets customers preview your ornament without opening the box.
- [Two Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Feature a separate lid and base; these boxes are perfect for premium ornaments.
- [Sleeve & Tray Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/): Sleek and modern, they slide open to reveal ornaments in style.
- [Tuck Top Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tuck-top-boxes/): Lightweight yet effective, [straight tuck](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/) and [reverse tuck‑end boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/) are easy to assemble and cost‑efficient for bulk ornament orders.
- [Mailer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/): Sturdy boxes that ensure your ornaments arrive safely during shipping.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): Designed for premium retail presentations, these boxes securely and attractively showcase multiple ornaments.

sections.title: Let’s Design Festive‑Themed Ornament Packaging Boxes That Sell!
sections.content:
Ornaments are all about celebration — and their packaging should capture that same spirit. Therefore, we help you design ornament packaging that reflects the holiday mood.

Make your packaging part of the celebration with our high‑quality printing options:

- Digital and Offset Printing
- CMYK printing for full‑color, detailed artwork
- Pantone color system for precise brand shades
- Specialty finishes including spot UV, matte/gloss lamination, embossing, debossing, and foil stamping

From Christmas tree ornaments to holiday décor, our custom printing helps your products reflect the joy and sparkle of every occasion.

sections.title: Why Choose Our Ornament Boxes?
sections.content:
Our custom ornament boxes offer everything you need to present, promote, and sell more.

- Festive Appeal – Perfect for Christmas tree ornaments, holiday décor, and seasonal gifting
- Retail‑Ready Design – Eye‑catching packaging that enhances shelf presence
- Luxury Finishes – Foil stamping, embossing, velvet linings, and window cut‑outs
- Wholesale Options – Bulk orders tailored for retailers, distributors, and subscription brands

We offer:

sections.content: Common questions about ordering custom ornament boxes.

sections.title: What are custom ornament boxes?
sections.content: Ornament boxes are containers that contain your delicate ornaments safely during handling on retail shelves and deliveries. They can be customized into any shape and size to meet your brand’s specific needs.

sections.title: Can my box be printed on the inside and outside?
sections.content: Yes, we can print your box on the inside, outside, and both (inside & outside).

sections.title: Is there any minimum order quantity (MOQ) policy?
sections.content: No. You place an order for your ornament box packaging as few as one or as many as you need.

sections.title: Can I order a sample before placing a bulk order for my custom box?
sections.content: Yes, you can contact our customer representative to order a box sample.

sections.title: What if I don't have an artwork?
sections.content: No worries! You can ask our design support to help you design a custom artwork just for your brand.

sections.title: Do you ship to countries other than the United States?
sections.content: Yes, we ship to countries other than the US, including the United Kingdom, Australia, and Canada.

sections.title: Do you offer wholesale rates on bulk orders?
sections.content: Yes. We also deal in wholesale ornament boxes if you order in bulk. Plus, we also offer free shipping.

sections.title: When will I receive my custom box order?
sections.content:
We typically complete orders within 8 to 12 business days. If you need a rush order, you can discuss it with us.

FROM THE PEOPLE WE PACKAGE FOR

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ordering custom box inserts & packaging inlays.

### What are custom box inserts?

Custom box inserts are specially designed packaging components that keep your products secure inside the box. They are made according to your product dimensions to prevent movement, reduce damage during shipping, and create a better unboxing experience.

### What materials are used for custom packaging inserts?

Custom packaging inserts can be made from cardboard, corrugated cardboard, kraft paper, EVA foam, molded pulp, and paperboard. The right material depends on your product weight, protection needs, and the type of packaging you choose.

### What products can use custom box inserts?

Custom box inserts are suitable for almost every industry. They can securely hold candles, cosmetics, electronics, bottles, jars, supplements, food products, gifts, jewelry, apparel, and many other retail or shipping products.

### Can box inserts be customized to different product sizes?

Yes, every box insert is made according to your product dimensions. Whether you have one product or multiple items in a single box, inserts can be designed for a precise and secure fit.

### Are custom packaging inserts eco-friendly?

Yes, paper-based inserts made from cardboard, kraft, paperboard, or corrugated cardboard are recyclable and environmentally friendly. They provide excellent product protection while supporting sustainable packaging goals.

### Can custom inserts hold multiple products?

Absolutely. Custom inserts can include multiple compartments to keep several products separated inside one box. This prevents products from touching each other and keeps the presentation clean and organized.

### Do box inserts help protect products during shipping?

Yes, box inserts minimize product movement inside the packaging. They absorb impact during handling and shipping, reducing the chances of scratches, breakage, and other transit damage.

### Can custom inserts improve the unboxing experience?

Yes, well-designed inserts keep products neatly arranged and create a premium presentation. A clean and organized layout makes the packaging look more professional and leaves a lasting impression on customers.

mainEntity.name: What materials are used for custom packaging inserts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom packaging inserts can be made from cardboard, corrugated cardboard, kraft paper, EVA foam, molded pulp, and paperboard. The right material depends on your product weight, protection needs, and the type of packaging you choose.

mainEntity.name: Can custom inserts hold multiple products?

## What are Packaging Sleeves?

Packaging sleeves, also known as packaging belly bands, are a minimalist way to brand your products. They are specialized packaging sleeves that provide your customers with key information while ensuring your packaging has a lower carbon footprint than other options.

With these packaging sleeves, you can send a message to customers with sustainable solutions and wraps around your product, offering a high degree of changeability,

## Key Features of Packaging Sleeves

Packaging sleeves act like a hybrid between a label and a full box, offering businesses a cost-effective, sustainable, and highly customizable way to elevate brand presentation without the expense of fully [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/).

Here are some of the key features of packaging sleeves:

- Brand Visibility: Showcase your logo, product details, and promotional messages.
- Versatile: Suitable for food, cosmetics, apparel, gifts, and more.
- Easy to Apply: Slides over boxes quickly for fast packaging.
- Premium Appeal: Creates a professional and eye-catching presentation.
- Lightweight: Reduces packaging weight and helps lower shipping costs.

## Make Your Brand Stand Out With Packaging Sleeves

Custom packaging sleeves help your brand stand out with a polished, professional look. They are an affordable way to elevate plain packaging, improve shelf appeal, and showcase your logo or message. Easy to apply and highly versatile, sleeves also add a stylish finishing touch to invitations, cards, books, and other printed products, creating a memorable, lasting impression everywhere.

## How To Create Your Own Customized Packaging Sleeves?

Packaging sleeves can turn a simple, plain box into eye-catching, appealing packaging that encourages customers to choose your products over others. You can easily customize your packaging sleeve with us to meet your branding needs.

Here’s how:

### Select the Correct Dimension for Your Packaging Sleeves

The first step is to determine the dimensions of your packaging sleeves so you can easily slide your box into them. You can find your desired size from the following standard sizes:

- 8″ x 2″
- 12″ x 4″
- 18″ x 6″

Did not find yours? Nothing to worry about; we also deal in custom sizes. Just let us know your required dimensions, and we will manufacture it accordingly.

### Select Durable & Sustainable Materials

Once you have finalized your packaging sleeve size, the next step is to select the right material for your sleeves. We offer a wide range of material options for your packaging sleeves that are not only durable but also sustainable.

Here are the material options available for packaging sleeves:

- Cardboard: A sturdy and reliable material that provides excellent protection. It is perfect for retail packaging sleeves that require durability and premium print quality.
- Paperboard: A lightweight yet durable option with a smooth surface for vibrant printing. Ideal for food, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, and retail packaging sleeves.
- Kraft Paper Stock: It is made from recyclable materials that offer a natural look with impressive strength. It is an excellent choice for brands seeking sustainable, eco-conscious packaging.

Please note: All of the above materials are available in various thicknesses, ranging from 14pt to 24pt.

### Select Printing Options

Enhance your packaging sleeves with premium-quality printing that makes your branding stand out. We use advanced digital and offset printing techniques, combined with the CMYK and Pantone (PMS) color systems, to deliver sharp detail, accurate color matching, and vibrant graphics. Whether you need small or bulk orders, every sleeve is printed with precision and consistency.

We offer both inside and outside printing options to give your sleeves a complete branded look:

- Outside Printing: Showcase your branding with vibrant, high-resolution graphics.
- Inside Printing: Add promotional messages, brand stories, or custom designs for a memorable unboxing experience.

Are you looking for something extraordinary? Check out our [custom tray and sleeve boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/), designed to create an ultimate unboxing experience with both customized sleeves and boxes.

## Top-Notch Finishing Options for Premium Packaging Sleeves

Give your packaging sleeves a premium look with our wide range of finishing options. Whether you want a sleek, luxurious, or eye-catching appearance, our finishing techniques enhance both the visual appeal and durability of your packaging.

Choose from multiple finishes to create sleeves that leave a lasting impression on your customers:

- Gloss & Matte Lamination
- Soft-Touch Lamination

Our packaging sleeves are designed for quick and effortless assembly. Each sleeve comes with a half-inch-wide double-sided adhesive tape, allowing you to wrap and secure it around your boxes in seconds. This simple application process saves time and ensures a clean, professional finish. Whether you’re packing small batches by hand or fulfilling large wholesale packaging sleeve orders, our easy-to-assemble sleeves streamline your packaging process for maximum convenience.

- Versatile: Suitable for food, cosmetics, apparel, gifts, and more.
- Easy to Apply: Slides over boxes quickly for fast packaging.
- Premium Appeal: Creates a professional and eye-catching presentation.
- Lightweight: Reduces packaging weight and helps lower shipping costs.

sections.title: Make Your Brand Stand Out With Packaging Sleeves
sections.content: Custom packaging sleeves help your brand stand out with a polished, professional look. They are an affordable way to elevate plain packaging, improve shelf appeal, and showcase your logo or message. Easy to apply and highly versatile, sleeves also add a stylish finishing touch to invitations, cards, books, and other printed products, creating a memorable, lasting impression everywhere.

sections.title: How To Create Your Own Customized Packaging Sleeves?
sections.content:
Packaging sleeves can turn a simple, plain box into eye-catching, appealing packaging that encourages customers to choose your products over others. You can easily customize your packaging sleeve with us to meet your branding needs.

Here’s how:

sections.title: Select the Correct Dimension for Your Packaging Sleeves
sections.content:
The first step is to determine the dimensions of your packaging sleeves so you can easily slide your box into them. You can find your desired size from the following standard sizes:

- 8″ x 2″
- 12″ x 4″
- 18″ x 6″

Did not find yours? Nothing to worry about; we also deal in custom sizes. Just let us know your required dimensions, and we will manufacture it accordingly.

sections.title: Select Durable & Sustainable Materials
sections.content:
Once you have finalized your packaging sleeve size, the next step is to select the right material for your sleeves. We offer a wide range of material options for your packaging sleeves that are not only durable but also sustainable.

Here are the material options available for packaging sleeves:

- Cardboard: A sturdy and reliable material that provides excellent protection. It is perfect for retail packaging sleeves that require durability and premium print quality.
- Paperboard: A lightweight yet durable option with a smooth surface for vibrant printing. Ideal for food, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, and retail packaging sleeves.
- Kraft Paper Stock: It is made from recyclable materials that offer a natural look with impressive strength. It is an excellent choice for brands seeking sustainable, eco-conscious packaging.

Please note: All of the above materials are available in various thicknesses, ranging from 14pt to 24pt.

sections.title: Select Printing Options
sections.content:
Enhance your packaging sleeves with premium-quality printing that makes your branding stand out. We use advanced digital and offset printing techniques, combined with the CMYK and Pantone (PMS) color systems, to deliver sharp detail, accurate color matching, and vibrant graphics. Whether you need small or bulk orders, every sleeve is printed with precision and consistency.

We offer both inside and outside printing options to give your sleeves a complete branded look:

- Outside Printing: Showcase your branding with vibrant, high-resolution graphics.
- Inside Printing: Add promotional messages, brand stories, or custom designs for a memorable unboxing experience.

Are you looking for something extraordinary? Check out our [custom tray and sleeve boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/), designed to create an ultimate unboxing experience with both customized sleeves and boxes.

sections.title: Top-Notch Finishing Options for Premium Packaging Sleeves
sections.content:
Give your packaging sleeves a premium look with our wide range of finishing options. Whether you want a sleek, luxurious, or eye-catching appearance, our finishing techniques enhance both the visual appeal and durability of your packaging.

Choose from multiple finishes to create sleeves that leave a lasting impression on your customers:

- Gloss & Matte Lamination
- Soft-Touch Lamination
- Spot UV Coating
- Gold & Silver Foil Stamping
- Embossing & Debossing
- Aqueous Coating
- Holographic Foiling

sections.title: Hassle-Free & Easy-Assembling Packaging Sleeves
sections.content: Our packaging sleeves are designed for quick and effortless assembly. Each sleeve comes with a half-inch-wide double-sided adhesive tape, allowing you to wrap and secure it around your boxes in seconds. This simple application process saves time and ensures a clean, professional finish. Whether you’re packing small batches by hand or fulfilling large wholesale packaging sleeve orders, our easy-to-assemble sleeves streamline your packaging process for maximum convenience.

Every box is shaped to match the tall, rounded dome of a traditional panettone, preventing squishing or damage during storage or transport. You can even print your panettone packaging with logo, text, or any other desired graphics that look crisp and appealing.

Lightweight yet strong, these boxes are easy to carry, stack, and store, making them ideal for both commercial and retail use.

Biodegradable materials from kraft and corrugated cardboard are used to construct our sturdy panettone boxes. Its reinforced walls prevent bending, crushing, or tearing, even for heavier loaves.

### Secure closures

Whatever type or style of box for panettone you choose, we make sure that its tabs and locking mechanisms keep the loaf snug inside.

### Shipping ready

Designed to withstand courier handling without compromising freshness or shape, these boxes are easily stackable or, in some cases, flat-shipped. This not only reduces shipping costs but also lets you enjoy your bulk orders of panettone boxes at wholesale prices.

sections.content:

sections.title: Perfect height and dome fit
sections.content: Every box is shaped to match the tall, rounded dome of a traditional panettone, preventing squishing or damage during storage or transport. You can even print your panettone packaging with logo, text, or any other desired graphics that look crisp and appealing.

sections.title: Multiple sizes availability

sections.title: Ease of handling
sections.content: Lightweight yet strong, these boxes are easy to carry, stack, and store, making them ideal for both commercial and retail use.

sections.title: Strong construction
sections.content: Biodegradable materials from kraft and corrugated cardboard are used to construct our sturdy panettone boxes. Its reinforced walls prevent bending, crushing, or tearing, even for heavier loaves.

sections.title: Secure closures
sections.content: Whatever type or style of box for panettone you choose, we make sure that its tabs and locking mechanisms keep the loaf snug inside.

sections.title: Shipping ready

## Pastry Boxes Designed with Protective Features

Freshness is everything in the bakery industry.

Therefore, we design pastry packaging boxes with protective features that ensure your baked goods remain fresh longer, including:

- FDA‑approved, food‑safe materials that prevent contamination and preserve flavor.
- Grease‑resistant coatings to keep the packaging clean from oil and butter.
- Secure closures that protect against spills, crushing, and moisture.

Whether it’s buttery croissants or cream‑filled eclairs, every box keeps your pastries safe and appetizing.

## Functional Pastry Box Styles That Showcase Better

Every pastry has its perfect box. Here’s our collection of pastry box styles that cover everything from single slices to premium assortments:

- Slice Pastry Boxes: Compact single‑serve design. Perfect for cake slices, cheesecake portions, or pie wedges.
- [Straight Tuck End](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/) & [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Simple, economical, and quick to assemble; best for flat pastry packaging and other packaging like [cookie boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cookie-boxes/).
- Fold‑Over (One‑Piece) Boxes: Stronger lid integration; ideal for pies, sheet cakes, and pastries needing clearance.
- [Gable Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/): Feature a “roof” design and a built‑in handle for grab‑and‑go convenience; great for takeaway assortments.
- [Handle Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/handle-boxes/): Reinforced handles for carry support; suitable for loaves and heavier pastries.
- Window Boxes: Transparent film cut‑outs for product visibility; excellent for various pastries and decorated treats.
- [Two‑Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Premium presentation with separate lid and tray; ideal for luxury pastries and gifting.
- [Rigid Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/): Sturdy, premium boxes for signature pastry assortments.

Need another box style? Our packaging experts will create the ideal pastry boxes to meet all your requirements!

## Custom Sizes to Suit Every Pastry Portion

Not all pastries are created equal — and neither should their boxes be. That’s why we offer custom sizing options tailored to your product line.

Choose from:

- Single‑Serve Portions: Compact boxes (4″ × 4″ × 2″ or 6″ × 6″ × 3″) for cafés and grab‑and‑go counters.
- Cupcake & Muffin Pack: [Boxes for cupcakes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cupcake-boxes/) sized for 1, 4, 6, or 12 treats.
- Slice Boxes: Slim designs (approx. 3″ × 5″ × 2″) for portion control and takeaway.
- Small Pastry Assortments: Mid‑range boxes (8″ × 8″ × 4″ or 10″ × 6″ × 3″) for croissants, donuts, or mixed pastries.

With custom sizes, you can match every pastry portion to its ideal box—from a single cupcake to a tiered celebration cake.

## Custom Pastry Boxes with Logo That Make Your Brand Visible

With our digital and offset printing in PMS & CMYK colors, your logo, tagline, and designs shine.

You can also add premium finishes like:

- Foil Stamping
- Spot UV
- Matte/Gloss Lamination
- Embossing/Debossing

Rest assured that every printed pastry box becomes a silent ambassador for your bakery, encouraging repeat purchases and social shares.

## Get Eco-Friendly Pastry Boxes Your Bakery Brand Deserves

Sustainability is no longer optional, and the bakery industry is not an exception.

Our custom pastry boxes are crafted from recyclable materials, such as:

- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Paperboard
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each material comes in thicknesses ranging from about 12pt to 24 pt. With eco-friendly pastry boxes, you protect your pastries—and the planet.

## Why Choose Our Pastry Boxes?

We turn your [custom bakery boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) into business tools.

Here are the benefits of choosing our pastry packaging boxes.

- Freshness Guaranteed: Food‑safe coatings and secure closures keep pastries crisp, moist, and flavorful.
- Brand Recognition: Every printed logo, tagline, or design turns your box into a silent advertisement.

sections.title: Pastry Boxes Designed with Protective Features
sections.content:
Freshness is everything in the bakery industry.

Therefore, we design pastry packaging boxes with protective features that ensure your baked goods remain fresh longer, including:

- FDA‑approved, food‑safe materials that prevent contamination and preserve flavor.
- Grease‑resistant coatings to keep the packaging clean from oil and butter.
- Secure closures that protect against spills, crushing, and moisture.

Whether it’s buttery croissants or cream‑filled eclairs, every box keeps your pastries safe and appetizing.

sections.title: Functional Pastry Box Styles That Showcase Better
sections.content:
Every pastry has its perfect box. Here’s our collection of pastry box styles that cover everything from single slices to premium assortments:

- Slice Pastry Boxes: Compact single‑serve design. Perfect for cake slices, cheesecake portions, or pie wedges.
- [Straight Tuck End](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/) & [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Simple, economical, and quick to assemble; best for flat pastry packaging and other packaging like [cookie boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cookie-boxes/).
- Fold‑Over (One‑Piece) Boxes: Stronger lid integration; ideal for pies, sheet cakes, and pastries needing clearance.
- [Gable Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/): Feature a “roof” design and a built‑in handle for grab‑and‑go convenience; great for takeaway assortments.
- [Handle Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/handle-boxes/): Reinforced handles for carry support; suitable for loaves and heavier pastries.
- Window Boxes: Transparent film cut‑outs for product visibility; excellent for various pastries and decorated treats.
- [Two‑Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Premium presentation with separate lid and tray; ideal for luxury pastries and gifting.
- [Rigid Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/): Sturdy, premium boxes for signature pastry assortments.

Need another box style? Our packaging experts will create the ideal pastry boxes to meet all your requirements!

sections.title: Custom Sizes to Suit Every Pastry Portion
sections.content:
Not all pastries are created equal — and neither should their boxes be. That’s why we offer custom sizing options tailored to your product line.

Choose from:

- Single‑Serve Portions: Compact boxes (4″ × 4″ × 2″ or 6″ × 6″ × 3″) for cafés and grab‑and‑go counters.
- Cupcake & Muffin Pack: [Boxes for cupcakes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cupcake-boxes/) sized for 1, 4, 6, or 12 treats.
- Slice Boxes: Slim designs (approx. 3″ × 5″ × 2″) for portion control and takeaway.
- Small Pastry Assortments: Mid‑range boxes (8″ × 8″ × 4″ or 10″ × 6″ × 3″) for croissants, donuts, or mixed pastries.

With custom sizes, you can match every pastry portion to its ideal box—from a single cupcake to a tiered celebration cake.

sections.title: Custom Pastry Boxes with Logo That Make Your Brand Visible
sections.content:
With our digital and offset printing in PMS & CMYK colors, your logo, tagline, and designs shine.

You can also add premium finishes like:

- Foil Stamping
- Spot UV
- Matte/Gloss Lamination
- Embossing/Debossing

Rest assured that every printed pastry box becomes a silent ambassador for your bakery, encouraging repeat purchases and social shares.

sections.title: Get Eco-Friendly Pastry Boxes Your Bakery Brand Deserves
sections.content:
Sustainability is no longer optional, and the bakery industry is not an exception.

Our custom pastry boxes are crafted from recyclable materials, such as:

- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Paperboard
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each material comes in thicknesses ranging from about 12pt to 24 pt. With eco-friendly pastry boxes, you protect your pastries—and the planet.

sections.title: Why Choose Our Pastry Boxes?
sections.content:
We turn your [custom bakery boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) into business tools.

Here are the benefits of choosing our pastry packaging boxes.

- Freshness Guaranteed: Food‑safe coatings and secure closures keep pastries crisp, moist, and flavorful.
- Brand Recognition: Every printed logo, tagline, or design turns your box into a silent advertisement.
- Customer Confidence: FDA‑approved materials reassure buyers that your bakery values safety and compliance.
- Eco‑Friendly Appeal: Recyclable materials show your commitment to sustainability.
- Convenience & Functionality: Easy‑to‑assemble designs save staff time.
- Shelf & Display Impact: Showcase your bakery creations to boost impulse buys.
- Flexibility Across Occasions: From single‑serve slice boxes to luxury bakery packaging, you have solutions for everyday sales, catering, and premium events.

sections.title: Order Wholesale Pastry Boxes with No Minimums
sections.content:
Don’t let your pastries go unnoticed. Choose our high-quality [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) for safety, style, and sustainability in one solution.

We support bakery businesses of all sizes with low-priced wholesale pastry boxes. Plus, we have no minimum order quantity, so you can order as many boxes as you need.

Give us a call today to enjoy fast, free shipping for custom pastry boxes!

Common questions about ordering custom pdq display boxes.

### Is there any difference between PDQ Boxes & Shelf Ready Boxes?

Many people confuse PDQ boxes with shelf-ready packaging, but they serve different purposes. SRP boxes are made for shipping and retail display, often with tear-away panels for easy restocking. PDQ boxes are designed for quick display, usually pre-filled and ready to place on shelves.

### Are there any hidden charges?

No. We do not have any hidden charges. Also, we do not charge for die-plates.

### Can I add custom inserts in these trays?

Absolutely. You can add custom inserts in PDQ trays & boxes. Just let us know the size of custom inserts you require for your product, and we will manufacture them for you. We have both cardboard and foam inserts.

### Do you review the artwork before printing it?

Yes. Once you send your artwork file, our design team carefully reviews it before printing to ensure everything looks accurate and print-ready. If any adjustments are needed, we will inform you before moving forward.

### Do you offer custom samples?

Yes. You can place an order for your custom sample before ordering in bulk. It will allow you to review your packaging, material, and printing quality. Once you’re satisfied, we can continue with producing the rest of the order.

### Which product can be stored in PDQ trays?

PDQ trays can be used to store and display various products. You can display electronic items, candies, snacks, edibles, jewels, and much more using PDQ trays.

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. You can add custom inserts in PDQ trays & boxes. Just let us know the size of custom inserts you require for your product, and we will manufacture them for you. We have both cardboard and foam inserts.

mainEntity.name: Do you review the artwork before printing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Once you send your artwork file, our design team carefully reviews it before printing to ensure everything looks accurate and print-ready. If any adjustments are needed, we will inform you before moving forward.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer custom samples?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can place an order for your custom sample before ordering in bulk. It will allow you to review your packaging, material, and printing quality. Once you’re satisfied, we can continue with producing the rest of the order.

mainEntity.name: Which product can be stored in PDQ trays?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDQ trays can be used to store and display various products. You can display electronic items, candies, snacks, edibles, jewels, and much more using PDQ trays.

## What Are Perforated Boxes?

Perforated boxes are designed with tear-away sections that allow retailers to quickly convert packaging into a display unit, similar to [retail display boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/) used for shelf presentation.

Unlike traditional shipping boxes, perforated packaging provides both protection during transportation and a ready-to-use retail presentation solution.

## How Do Perforated Boxes Work?

For products that require easy access and controlled dispensing, businesses may also consider [dispenser boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/dispenser-boxes/), which provide a convenient way to organize and distribute products.

This makes them ideal for businesses that need fast shelf placement, easy product access, and attractive product visibility.

## Benefits of Custom Perforated Boxes

### Shelf-Ready Packaging Solution

Perforated boxes help retailers quickly move products from shipping cartons to store shelves. The packaging works as both a protective container and a display unit.

### Faster Product Display Setup

Retail employees can open and arrange products faster because the display section is already integrated into the box design.

### Improved Product Visibility

Custom printed perforated boxes allow brands to showcase logos, colors, product information, and marketing messages directly on the packaging.

### Cost-Effective Packaging

By combining shipping and display functions into one package, businesses can reduce additional display packaging costs.

### Easy Customer Access

The tear-away design allows customers to access products easily while keeping the remaining packaging organized.

## Applications of Perforated Boxes

Custom perforated boxes are widely used across different industries, including:

### Food and Beverage Packaging

Food brands use perforated packaging for snacks, beverages, bakery items, and promotional products because retailers can place products directly on shelves.

### Cosmetics and Beauty Products

Cosmetic brands use display-ready boxes to improve shelf presentation and create a premium shopping experience.

### Electronics Accessories

Chargers, cables, small gadgets, and accessories can be organized and displayed effectively using perforated boxes.

### Retail and Promotional Products

Businesses use perforated boxes for seasonal campaigns, product launches, and promotional displays.

### Subscription and E-commerce Packaging

Brands can combine shipping protection with a better unboxing and presentation experience.

## Customization Options for Perforated Boxes

At Pack Legacy, we can customize perforated boxes to your product requirements.

Available options include:

- Custom sizes and shapes
- Brand logo printing
- Full-color artwork
- Kraft and corrugated materials
- Die-cut designs
- Window cutouts

- Protective inserts
- Matte or gloss finishing options

Our packaging specialists can help create a design that matches your product, brand identity, and retail requirements.

## Perforated Boxes vs Regular Shipping Boxes

Perforated boxes are a better choice for businesses that need packaging that protects products during shipping while also supporting retail presentation.

sections.title: What are perforated boxes used for?
sections.content: Perforated boxes are used for products that need both shipping protection and quick retail display conversion. They are commonly used for food, cosmetics, electronics accessories, and promotional products.

sections.title: Are perforated boxes customizable?
sections.content: Yes, perforated boxes can be customized with different sizes, materials, printing designs, finishes, and perforation styles.

sections.title: Can perforated boxes be used for shipping?
sections.content: Yes, perforated boxes provide protection during transportation and can be converted into displays after delivery.

sections.title: What materials are used for perforated packaging boxes?
sections.content: Common materials include corrugated cardboard, kraft paperboard, and other durable packaging boards depending on product requirements.

sections.title: Why are perforated boxes better for retail products?
sections.content:
They save display setup time, improve product visibility, and allow retailers to quickly organize products on shelves.

## Custom Printed Perfume Boxes That Stop Shoppers

Turn heads on crowded retail shelves with eye-catching designs. We offer full-color CMYK and Pantone digital printing to highlight your branded artwork.

Whatever fragrance you offer, we provide full-custom printing to give it the spotlight it deserves.

### Custom Designs

- Minimalist Elegance: Clean lines, neutral color palettes (matte white, beige), and subtle, high-end details.
- Creative Structural Shapes: Moving beyond traditional rectangles into cylindrical, hexagonal, or [book-style boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/book-boxes/).
- Interactive Elements: Integrating QR codes or smart packaging to link physical boxes to digital brand stories or augmented reality (AR) experiences.

### Marketing & Sensory Touches

This is where your packaging creates an emotional connection with the buyer before they open the box.

With digital and offset techniques, we help you provide essential details, including:

- Brand Name & Logo: Your brand name and logo will be highly visible on the front and top of the box.
- Fragrance Profile: Sensory descriptors outlining the scent family (e.g., Floral, Woody, Citrus, or Musky).
- Olfactory Notes (The Pyramids): A brief breakdown of the top, heart (middle), and base notes of the scent profile.
- Brand Story & Tagline: A concise, evocative sentence or phrase that communicates the mood or values of your fragrance.

### Luxury Finishes

Elevate your custom perfume boxes with our top-tier luxury finishes:

- Metallic Foil Stamping: Adds a striking, reflective metallic sheen. Gold, silver, rose gold, and copper foils are perfect for your brand logo and delicate patterns, reflecting high-end value.
- Soft-Touch Matte Lamination: The industry standard for a velvety, suede-like texture that feels incredibly smooth and premium to the touch.
- Embossing & Debossing: Create tactile 3D depth by pressing the design into the paper (debossing) or raising it above the surface (embossing).
- Spot UV Coating: Applies a high-gloss, sleek sheen to specific areas of the box (like the brand name), creating a beautiful visual contrast against a matte background.
- Holographic Finishes: Incorporate reflective, rainbow-like patterns or metallic paper for an eye-catching, modern edge.

Outside, inside, or both-sided printing—rest assured that you’ll get stunning [cosmetic boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/) for your exclusive fragrances.

## Beautify Your Fragrances’ Look with Stylish Perfume Boxes

The shape of your perfume box speaks volumes before the customer even smells the fragrance. Choosing the right style elevates customers’ unboxing experience from ordinary to unforgettable.

Explore our most popular box styles to find the perfect fit for your brand.

- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): These boxes feature hidden magnets for a satisfying, secure snap closure. They offer the ultimate high-end feel for premium perfume sets and luxury lines.
- [Two-Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Classic and timeless, these [rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/) feature a separate lid and base. They provide a traditional, elegant unboxing experience that customers love to reuse.
- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): Let customers slide your product out smoothly with a convenient, modern ribbon pull-tab. This sleek style is perfect for modern, minimalist fragrance brands.
- [Shoulder Neck Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/shoulder-neck-rigid-boxes/): These excellent boxes reveal a hidden inner neck when opened, creating an exceptional layered scented look. They add an instant air of mystery and high value.
- Tuck End Boxes ([STE](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/) & [RTE](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/)): Simple, clean, and highly cost-effective, these are perfect for everyday retail displays. They assemble quickly and store flat to save warehouse space.
- [123 Bottom Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/123-bottom-boxes/): Designed with a heavy-duty interlocking bottom, these boxes securely hold heavier glass perfume bottles.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): Showcase multiple perfume bottles on checkout counters and drive impulse purchases without any hassle.
- Window Boxes: Show off your beautiful glass bottle directly through a clear, durable plastic pane. This style lets the natural color of your perfume do the talking.

Do you have a unique shape or structural concept in mind? Our expert team can create custom geometric shapes, hexagonal boxes, or die-cut patterns. We ensure you’ll get [custom packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) tailored exactly to your perfume’s image.

## Protect Your Scents with Durable Perfume Packaging Boxes

Fragile glass perfume bottles require maximum structural protection.

Here’s how our durable perfume boxes protect your scents.

### High-Quality Materials

We use top-grade eco-friendly materials, including:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

### Custom Sizes and Dimensions

Every fragrance packaging is crafted to your bottle’s exact custom dimensions for a snug, movement-free fit.

### Leak Containment & Moisture Barriers

We provide excellent coatings, such as aqueous coatings or anti-scratch matte laminations, that make the box exterior resistant to moisture and minor accidental spills.

### Secure Closures

Our magnetic closures, ribbons, or tight friction-fit lids ensure the box does not pop open unexpectedly, keeping your fragrance bottle safely nestled inside.

Protective Inserts

- [Custom Die-Cut Inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/die-cut-inserts/): Precisely molded to the shape of the perfume bottle, so they stay locked in place.
- Material Options: Our inserts are crafted from high-density EVA foam, molded pulp, or velvet-lined cardboard.

## Choose Quality, Choose Our Custom Perfume Boxes

Don’t you think that your fragrance deserves well-designed packaging? Well, our custom perfume packaging boxes don’t cost a lot. We offer them at wholesale prices without sacrificing quality. By ordering them in bulk, you can enjoy a lower per-unit price and a special discount we offer. However, you can always order as many boxes as you need, as we have no minimum requirement.

sections.title: Custom Printed Perfume Boxes That Stop Shoppers
sections.content:
Turn heads on crowded retail shelves with eye-catching designs. We offer full-color CMYK and Pantone digital printing to highlight your branded artwork.

Whatever fragrance you offer, we provide full-custom printing to give it the spotlight it deserves.

sections.title: Custom Designs
sections.content:
- Minimalist Elegance: Clean lines, neutral color palettes (matte white, beige), and subtle, high-end details.
- Creative Structural Shapes: Moving beyond traditional rectangles into cylindrical, hexagonal, or [book-style boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/book-boxes/).
- Interactive Elements: Integrating QR codes or smart packaging to link physical boxes to digital brand stories or augmented reality (AR) experiences.

sections.title: Marketing & Sensory Touches
sections.content:
This is where your packaging creates an emotional connection with the buyer before they open the box.

With digital and offset techniques, we help you provide essential details, including:

- Brand Name & Logo: Your brand name and logo will be highly visible on the front and top of the box.
- Fragrance Profile: Sensory descriptors outlining the scent family (e.g., Floral, Woody, Citrus, or Musky).
- Olfactory Notes (The Pyramids): A brief breakdown of the top, heart (middle), and base notes of the scent profile.
- Brand Story & Tagline: A concise, evocative sentence or phrase that communicates the mood or values of your fragrance.

sections.title: Luxury Finishes
sections.content:
Elevate your custom perfume boxes with our top-tier luxury finishes:

- Metallic Foil Stamping: Adds a striking, reflective metallic sheen. Gold, silver, rose gold, and copper foils are perfect for your brand logo and delicate patterns, reflecting high-end value.
- Soft-Touch Matte Lamination: The industry standard for a velvety, suede-like texture that feels incredibly smooth and premium to the touch.
- Embossing & Debossing: Create tactile 3D depth by pressing the design into the paper (debossing) or raising it above the surface (embossing).
- Spot UV Coating: Applies a high-gloss, sleek sheen to specific areas of the box (like the brand name), creating a beautiful visual contrast against a matte background.
- Holographic Finishes: Incorporate reflective, rainbow-like patterns or metallic paper for an eye-catching, modern edge.

Outside, inside, or both-sided printing—rest assured that you’ll get stunning [cosmetic boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/) for your exclusive fragrances.

sections.title: Beautify Your Fragrances’ Look with Stylish Perfume Boxes
sections.content:
The shape of your perfume box speaks volumes before the customer even smells the fragrance. Choosing the right style elevates customers’ unboxing experience from ordinary to unforgettable.

Explore our most popular box styles to find the perfect fit for your brand.

- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): These boxes feature hidden magnets for a satisfying, secure snap closure. They offer the ultimate high-end feel for premium perfume sets and luxury lines.
- [Two-Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Classic and timeless, these [rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/) feature a separate lid and base. They provide a traditional, elegant unboxing experience that customers love to reuse.
- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): Let customers slide your product out smoothly with a convenient, modern ribbon pull-tab. This sleek style is perfect for modern, minimalist fragrance brands.
- [Shoulder Neck Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/shoulder-neck-rigid-boxes/): These excellent boxes reveal a hidden inner neck when opened, creating an exceptional layered scented look. They add an instant air of mystery and high value.
- Tuck End Boxes ([STE](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/) & [RTE](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/)): Simple, clean, and highly cost-effective, these are perfect for everyday retail displays. They assemble quickly and store flat to save warehouse space.
- [123 Bottom Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/123-bottom-boxes/): Designed with a heavy-duty interlocking bottom, these boxes securely hold heavier glass perfume bottles.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): Showcase multiple perfume bottles on checkout counters and drive impulse purchases without any hassle.
- Window Boxes: Show off your beautiful glass bottle directly through a clear, durable plastic pane. This style lets the natural color of your perfume do the talking.

Do you have a unique shape or structural concept in mind? Our expert team can create custom geometric shapes, hexagonal boxes, or die-cut patterns. We ensure you’ll get [custom packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) tailored exactly to your perfume’s image.

## Custom Pie Packaging Built For Freshness, Display, and Brand Trust

Pies are delicate bakery items. Their crust, filling, shape, and presentation can be affected by poor packaging during handling, stacking, takeout, or delivery. That is why our custom pie packaging boxes are designed with the right balance of structure, food-safe material, and branding space.

We help you choose packaging that supports your product’s real needs, whether you sell fruit pies, savory pies, deep-dish pies, mini pies, or individual slices from sturdy board stocks to optional insert and window cut-outs. Every detail can be customized to improve protection, shelf appeal, and customer confidence.

Our pie packaging can be tailored for:

- Bakeries and dessert shops
- Cafes and restaurants
- Home-based banking businesses
- Farmers markets and pop-up shops
- Holiday pie sales and gifting
- Takeout, delivery, and retail display

If your bakery also sells cakes, cookies, cupcakes, donuts, or macarons, you can build a consistent packaging family with our [custom-printed bakery boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/), [cake boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cake-boxes/), [cookie boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cookie-boxes/), [cupcake boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cupcake-boxes/), [donut boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/donut-boxes/), and [macaron boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/macaron-boxes/).

## Choose The Right Pie Box Size: Mini, Slice, 9×9, 10×10, and Full-Pie Boxes.

A well-fitted box does more than hold your pie. It reduces movement, improves presentation, and helps customers receive the product in the condition you intended. We manufacture custom size pie boxes according to your required length, width, height, depth, and product shape.

Popular size and style options include:

Our team can also help you decide whether your product needs extra depth, stronger stock, a grease-resistant coating, or inserts for safer handling.

## Food-Safe Materials for Reliable Pie Packaging

The right material is one of the most important in bakery packaging as it helps protect your pies while maintaining a professional presentation. At Pack Legacy, we offer several food-safe options to match different bakery needs.

Cardboard is a popular choice for custom-printed pie boxes because it is lightweight, sturdy, and easy to print on. Kraft stock provides a natural, recyclable look that works well for artisan and eco-conscious bakeries.

Corrugated cardboard offers extra strength for larger pies, delivery orders, and wholesale packaging. For a more upscale presentation, rigid stock is ideal for a premium dessert collection.

We recommend the right stock thickness, coating, and box structure based on your pie size, weight, and handling requirements.

## Grease-Resistant and Moisture-Resistant Coating Options

Pies release moisture, oil, butter, or filling residue, depending on the recipe and storage conditions. A standard box may look fine at first, but without the right coating, stains, or softness, it can affect presentation. That is why we offer coating and finishing options that improve box durability and cleanliness.

You can request options such as:

- Aqueous coating
- Matte coating
- Gloss coating
- Food-safe inner coating options
- Grease-resistant barriers
- Moisture-resistant protection
- Lamination for added durability

These features are especially helpful for fruit pies, cream pies, buttery crust, and delivery-focused bakery packaging.

Pies are delicate bakery items. Their crust, filling, shape, and presentation can be affected by poor packaging during handling, stacking, takeout, or delivery. That is why our custom pie packaging boxes are designed with the right balance of structure, food-safe material, and branding space.

We help you choose packaging that supports your product’s real needs, whether you sell fruit pies, savory pies, deep-dish pies, mini pies, or individual slices from sturdy board stocks to optional insert and window cut-outs. sections.title: Food-Safe Materials for Reliable Pie Packaging
sections.content:
The right material is one of the most important in bakery packaging as it helps protect your pies while maintaining a professional presentation. At Pack Legacy, we offer several food-safe options to match different bakery needs.

Cardboard is a popular choice for custom-printed pie boxes because it is lightweight, sturdy, and easy to print on. Kraft stock provides a natural, recyclable look that works well for artisan and eco-conscious bakeries.

Corrugated cardboard offers extra strength for larger pies, delivery orders, and wholesale packaging. For a more upscale presentation, rigid stock is ideal for a premium dessert collection.

We recommend the right stock thickness, coating, and box structure based on your pie size, weight, and handling requirements.

sections.title: Grease-Resistant and Moisture-Resistant Coating Options
sections.content:
Pies release moisture, oil, butter, or filling residue, depending on the recipe and storage conditions. A standard box may look fine at first, but without the right coating, stains, or softness, it can affect presentation. That is why we offer coating and finishing options that improve box durability and cleanliness.

You can request options such as:

- Aqueous coating
- Matte coating
- Gloss coating
- Food-safe inner coating options
- Grease-resistant barriers
- Moisture-resistant protection
- Lamination for added durability

## What are Pillow Boxes and Why are They Popular?

Pillow boxes get their name from their unique, pillow-like shape. They feature a smart, flat-pack design with curved, interlocking flaps on both ends. You simply pop them open and fold the tabs to secure your products. No tape or glue is required for assembly. Their popularity comes from this perfect blend of form and function.

Our pillow packaging boxes ship completely flat, saving you massive storage space and reducing shipping costs. Once assembled, their unique layout provides excellent structural strength to protect your products. Customers love them for their highly memorable, premium unboxing experience.

## Custom Pillow Boxes: Lightweight, Trendy Packaging for Various Products

Trendy pillow packaging boxes are the perfect fit for a wide variety of items.

They are highly popular for packaging:

- Jewelry
- Cosmetics
- Soaps
- Gifts
- Apparel accessories
- Party favors

With built-in elegance, every pillow box eliminates the need for extra gift wrapping.

## Limitless Customization Options for Pillow Packaging Boxes

Your brand is unique, and your packaging should reflect that. We offer endless design flexibility to match your exact brand vision. With us, you can customize every single corner of pillow boxes from the inside out.

### High-Quality Materials

We source only premium, durable materials for your custom pillow boxes.

Choose from:

- Cardstock
- Kraft paper
- Cardboard

The thickness of our materials ranges from 12pt to 18pt, ensuring you’ll get sturdy pillow packaging boxes that protect your products.

### Precise, Custom Sizing Options

Say goodbye to standard boxes. We provide precise, custom sizing options for pillow packaging boxes.

- Small Pillow Boxes: 3.5″ x 2″ x 1″ to 4″ x 3″ x 1″ (ideal for jewelry, samples, and [candy packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/candy-boxes/)).
- Medium Pillow Boxes: 5″ x 3″ x 1.5″ to 6″ x 4″ x 2″ (perfect for soaps, cosmetics, and [retail packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/)).
- Large Pillow Boxes: 7″ x 4″ x 2″ to 9″ x 6″ x 3″ (great for apparel accessories, boutique products, and multi-item [gift boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/gift-boxes/)).
- Jumbo Pillow Boxes: 10″ x 7″ x 3″ to 12″ x 8″ x 4″ (best for premium corporate gift sets and subscription packaging).

Whether you need the pillow structure for small [apparel boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/apparel-boxes/) or medium [soap boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/soap-boxes/), we create the perfect fit for you.

### Vibrant Printing

Make your graphics pop with our state-of-the-art printing technology.

We use:

- Offset and digital printing methods
- CMYK and PMS (Pantone) color systems

Your logo, artwork, and brand text will look crisp, sharp, and highly professional on custom pillow boxes with logo.

### Excellent Finishes

Give your pillow packaging a flawless final touch with our premium finishes:

- Gloss/Matte Lamination
- Spot UV

- Embossing/Debossing

## Simplicity, Eco-Friendliness, and Cost-Effectiveness in One Box

Smart packaging shouldn’t cost a fortune or harm the planet. Our custom pillow boxes are made from 100% recyclable and biodegradable materials. They allow you to showcase your commitment to sustainability without sacrificing style.

Because they use minimal materials and fold flat, they keep production costs incredibly low. Your team can assemble hundreds of boxes in minutes, saving valuable labor time. It is the ultimate budget-friendly solution that delivers high-end luxury appeal.

## Deliver Freshness Every Time with Custom Pizza Boxes

Your tasty pizza deserves to arrive exactly as you intended. Cold, soggy crusts ruin the dining experience and hurt customer loyalty. Our high-quality [custom food boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/) combine premium engineering with smart design to maintain optimal quality from your oven to customers’ hands.

Every pizza box we produce includes protective features, such as:

- Grease-Resistant Linings: Our specialized barrier stops grease from seeping through the cardboard fibers. This protects your customers’ hands and keeps the external box design crisp.
- Heat Retention: Thick insulated walls keep your pizza hot during long delivery routes. Our food boxes trap heat, ensuring your pizza tastes fresh out of the oven every single time.
- Venting & Moisture Control: Built-in steam-ventilation tabs allow trapped humidity to escape smoothly, preventing moisture from making your pizza soggy.
- Structural Integrity: Reinforced front-lock tabs and sturdy side walls provide ultimate durability, supporting stacking of multiple orders during busy dinner rushes.

## Premium Material Options for Durable Pizza Packaging Solutions

We build our boxes using only the finest, premium raw materials, including:

- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated

Every option is 100% food-grade, odor-free, and safe for direct food contact.

## Sizes, Shapes, and Structures

Pizza comes in all shapes and dimensions, and your packaging should too.

We offer standard industry sizes ranging from

- Personal / Kids (8-inch pizza): 8” × 8” × 2” to 10” × 10” × 2”
- Slice Boxes: Typically 9” × 10” × 3” or 9” × 9” × 3” to fit single slices
- Medium (10 to 12-inch pizza): 12” × 12” × 2” to 13” × 13” × 2”
- Large (14 to 16-inch pizza): 14” × 14” × 2” or 16” × 16” × 2”
- Extra-Large / Party (18 to 24-inch pizza): 18” × 18” × 3” up to 24” × 24” × 4″
- Custom size options are also available to fit your unique culinary creations perfectly.

Beyond standard square pizza boxes, you can explore creative shapes to stand out from local competitors. Choose sleek hexagonal boxes, unique octagonal shapes, or compact triangular single-slice boxes.

## Pizza Boxes with Logo: Turn Every Delivery Into a Branding Opportunity

It’s time to transform every delivery route into a highly effective mobile billboard for your pizzeria. Our custom printing puts your logo, social media handles, and brand colors on display. Passersby on the street will instantly recognize your signature delicious pizzas. Choose high-contrast digital printing or rich offset printing for massive wholesale runs.

Plus, you can apply premium finishes to add a l high-end feel to your custom printed pizza boxes, including:

- Gloss / Matte Lamination
- Foil Stamping
- Spot UV
- Embossing/Debossing

## Why Choose Our Pizza Packaging Boxes?

We understand the daily demands of running a busy pizzeria or restaurant. Our [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) combine elite food science with beautiful graphic design to give you a competitive edge.

Here is why top-tier pizzerias rely on our custom pizza boxes.

- Better Presentation: Clean lines and vivid printing provide a high-end unboxing experience.
- Ultimate Protection: Rugged construction keeps your food safe from bumps and drops.
- Enhanced Marketing: Your logo stays visible on tables and at parties.

## Sell More, Spend Less with Wholesale Pizza Boxes

Scaling your pizza business should not mean draining your hard-earned marketing budget. We offer fantastic bulk-order discounts and wholesale pricing to keep your margins high. And our no-minimum-order policy makes it easy for small businesses to start branding immediately. Enjoy free design support, fast turnaround times, and reliable, free shipping on every order.
