Common questions about ordering custom pizza boxes.

### Are your custom pizza boxes safe for food?

Yes, we use FDA-compliant, food-grade materials, such as cardboard, kraft, and corrugated, that keep your pizza safe, hygienic, and delivery-ready.

### What printing options do you provide?

We provide advanced digital and offset printing options with CMYK and PMS color models.

### Can I get the boxes in custom sizes and shapes?

Yes, in addition to our size options, we offer fully customizable sizes, shapes, depths, and die-cuts for pizza boxes.

### How many pizza boxes should I order?

You can feel free to place your order, as we have no minimum quantity limits.

### Will the boxes keep my pizza crispy?

Yes, our pizza packaging boxes feature die-cut ventilation holes that release steam and maintain the crispiness of pizza.

We take 8 to 12 business days to complete an order. Your custom boxes will be delivered with fast, free shipping.

sections.title: Deliver Freshness Every Time with Custom Pizza Boxes
sections.content:
Your tasty pizza deserves to arrive exactly as you intended. Cold, soggy crusts ruin the dining experience and hurt customer loyalty. Our high-quality [custom food boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/) combine premium engineering with smart design to maintain optimal quality from your oven to customers’ hands.

Every pizza box we produce includes protective features, such as:

- Grease-Resistant Linings: Our specialized barrier stops grease from seeping through the cardboard fibers. This protects your customers’ hands and keeps the external box design crisp.
- Heat Retention: Thick insulated walls keep your pizza hot during long delivery routes. Our food boxes trap heat, ensuring your pizza tastes fresh out of the oven every single time.
- Venting & Moisture Control: Built-in steam-ventilation tabs allow trapped humidity to escape smoothly, preventing moisture from making your pizza soggy.
- Structural Integrity: Reinforced front-lock tabs and sturdy side walls provide ultimate durability, supporting stacking of multiple orders during busy dinner rushes.

sections.title: Premium Material Options for Durable Pizza Packaging Solutions
sections.content:
We build our boxes using only the finest, premium raw materials, including:

- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated

Every option is 100% food-grade, odor-free, and safe for direct food contact.

sections.title: Sizes, Shapes, and Structures
sections.content:
Pizza comes in all shapes and dimensions, and your packaging should too.

We offer standard industry sizes ranging from

- Personal / Kids (8-inch pizza): 8” × 8” × 2” to 10” × 10” × 2”
- Slice Boxes: Typically 9” × 10” × 3” or 9” × 9” × 3” to fit single slices
- Medium (10 to 12-inch pizza): 12” × 12” × 2” to 13” × 13” × 2”
- Large (14 to 16-inch pizza): 14” × 14” × 2” or 16” × 16” × 2”
- Extra-Large / Party (18 to 24-inch pizza): 18” × 18” × 3” up to 24” × 24” × 4″
- Custom size options are also available to fit your unique culinary creations perfectly.

Beyond standard square pizza boxes, you can explore creative shapes to stand out from local competitors. Choose sleek hexagonal boxes, unique octagonal shapes, or compact triangular single-slice boxes.

sections.title: Pizza Boxes with Logo: Turn Every Delivery Into a Branding Opportunity
sections.content:
It’s time to transform every delivery route into a highly effective mobile billboard for your pizzeria. Our custom printing puts your logo, social media handles, and brand colors on display. Passersby on the street will instantly recognize your signature delicious pizzas. Choose high-contrast digital printing or rich offset printing for massive wholesale runs.

Plus, you can apply premium finishes to add a l high-end feel to your custom printed pizza boxes, including:

- Gloss / Matte Lamination
- Foil Stamping
- Spot UV
- Embossing/Debossing

## Custom Playing Card Boxes That Protect, Elevate, and Showcase

Your cards deserve packaging that works as hard as you do. Our [custom printed boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) do not just sit on a shelf. They catch the eye, spark curiosity, and build instant anticipation.

Every playing card box is engineered to deliver a memorable unboxing experience. They feature secure closures, smooth textures, and vibrant graphics. Your artwork will pop with incredible clarity, ensuring your brand stands out on shelves and display screens.

## How Custom Printed Playing Card Boxes Define Your Brand

Great games need iconic packaging to build true brand recognition. We use advanced digital and offset printing to bring your unique vision to life. Your unique logo, artwork, and brand colors will look sharp and highly professional in CMYK & Pantone matching colors.

And to bring your playing card boxes with logo into the spotlight, we offer excellent finishes, such as:

- Gloss/Matte Laminations
- Foil Stamping
- Spot UV
- Embossing/Debossing

## Custom Sizes for Every Deck

No two card games are exactly alike. That is why we do not believe in one-size-fits-all packaging. We design fully personalized playing card boxes built to your exact specifications.

Have a look at our precise sizing options below:

- Standard Poker Decks: Tailored for traditional 2.5″ x 3.5″ cards.
- Bridge & TCG Decks: Perfect snug fit for gaming and trading cards.
- Multi-Deck Box Sets: Custom internal compartments to hold 2 or more decks at once.
- Tarot & Oversized Cards: Deep, secure layouts for large novelty or divination decks.

Need your boxes in a custom size? Brief us on your specifications; we’ll ensure every box fits your cards perfectly.

## High-Quality Materials That Keep Every Card Crisp

Our premium card boxes protect your decks from moisture, dust, and crushing.

We source sturdy, eco-friendly materials that withstand years of gameplay, including:

- Cardboard
- Paperboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each high-grade material prevents your cards from bending or fraying over time.

And to ensure your game cards stay in pristine condition during shipping and storage, we include advanced features, such as:

- Protective coatings to resist moisture and scratches.
- Structural integrity that protects luxury or collector decks.
- [Custom inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) to securely hold multiple decks.

## Brand Your Game Cards with Stylish Playing Card Boxes

The right box style sets the tone for your entire game. We offer a variety of structures to fit your budget and aesthetic goals.

Discover our most popular playing card box styles below to find your perfect match.

- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Both the top and bottom flaps fold into the same side for a clean, seamless front display.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): The top and bottom flaps fold in opposite directions for added structural stability. They are easy-to-assemble [retail boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/) for maximum efficiency.
- [Two-Piece Rigid Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Feature a separate base and lid structure; ideal for maximum crush protection and slow-release unboxing feel.

- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): The inner card tray slides smoothly out of an outer protective sleeve; highly popular for premium double-deck gift sets and expansion packs.

sections.title: Custom Playing Card Boxes That Protect, Elevate, and Showcase
sections.content:
Your cards deserve packaging that works as hard as you do. Our [custom printed boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) do not just sit on a shelf. They catch the eye, spark curiosity, and build instant anticipation.

Every playing card box is engineered to deliver a memorable unboxing experience. They feature secure closures, smooth textures, and vibrant graphics. Your artwork will pop with incredible clarity, ensuring your brand stands out on shelves and display screens.

sections.title: How Custom Printed Playing Card Boxes Define Your Brand
sections.content:
Great games need iconic packaging to build true brand recognition. We use advanced digital and offset printing to bring your unique vision to life. Your unique logo, artwork, and brand colors will look sharp and highly professional in CMYK & Pantone matching colors.

And to bring your playing card boxes with logo into the spotlight, we offer excellent finishes, such as:

- Gloss/Matte Laminations
- Foil Stamping
- Spot UV
- Embossing/Debossing

sections.title: Custom Sizes for Every Deck
sections.content:
No two card games are exactly alike. That is why we do not believe in one-size-fits-all packaging. We design fully personalized playing card boxes built to your exact specifications.

Have a look at our precise sizing options below:

- Standard Poker Decks: Tailored for traditional 2.5″ x 3.5″ cards.
- Bridge & TCG Decks: Perfect snug fit for gaming and trading cards.
- Multi-Deck Box Sets: Custom internal compartments to hold 2 or more decks at once.
- Tarot & Oversized Cards: Deep, secure layouts for large novelty or divination decks.

Need your boxes in a custom size? Brief us on your specifications; we’ll ensure every box fits your cards perfectly.

sections.title: High-Quality Materials That Keep Every Card Crisp
sections.content:
Our premium card boxes protect your decks from moisture, dust, and crushing.

We source sturdy, eco-friendly materials that withstand years of gameplay, including:

- Cardboard
- Paperboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each high-grade material prevents your cards from bending or fraying over time.

And to ensure your game cards stay in pristine condition during shipping and storage, we include advanced features, such as:

- Protective coatings to resist moisture and scratches.
- Structural integrity that protects luxury or collector decks.
- [Custom inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) to securely hold multiple decks.

sections.title: Brand Your Game Cards with Stylish Playing Card Boxes
sections.content:
The right box style sets the tone for your entire game. We offer a variety of structures to fit your budget and aesthetic goals.

Discover our most popular playing card box styles below to find your perfect match.

- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Both the top and bottom flaps fold into the same side for a clean, seamless front display.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): The top and bottom flaps fold in opposite directions for added structural stability. They are easy-to-assemble [retail boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/) for maximum efficiency.
- [Two-Piece Rigid Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Feature a separate base and lid structure; ideal for maximum crush protection and slow-release unboxing feel.
- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Hidden magnets are built right into the flip-top lid flap; they snap shut with a crisp click, keeping your cards completely secure.
- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): The inner card tray slides smoothly out of an outer protective sleeve; highly popular for premium double-deck gift sets and expansion packs.

## Custom Retail Displays Designed for Stronger Product Presentation

Our custom pop-up display boxes present multiple products in a compact, branded format for retail counters, checkout areas, and shelves. The raised header provides prominent space for your logo and promotional message, while the open structure keeps products visible, organized, and easy for customers to access.

Each display is manufactured according to your product dimensions, required capacity, packed weight, and available retail space. Custom printing, dividers, [packaging inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/), reinforced materials, and premium finishes can be added to create a display that supports both your merchandising requirements and brand identity.

## Customized Around Your Product, Not a Standard Template

Your product determines the display. We develop the dimensions, board strength, header height, opening style, and internal arrangement after considering the size of each item, the number of units required, the total packed weight, and the available counter or shelf space.

Lightweight products such as lip balms, tea sachets, candy, cosmetics, and small accessories can be presented in sleek paperboard displays with sharp printing and a polished finish. Heavier products such as cream jars, supplement bottles, balms, and packaged food items require reinforced paperboard or corrugated construction for improved stability.

The internal layout is also customized to match your products. Dividers, partitions, and fitted inserts keep your items organized and protected, while tiered layouts improve visibility across the display. The result is a stable, organized retail display that presents products professionally and makes efficient use of counter or shelf space.

## Choose the Display Structure That Fits Your Sales Strategy

Different products require different display structures. The right design depends on product size, weight, quantity, retail placement, and how customers interact with the display. We manufacture custom pop-up display boxes in a wide range to suit different product requirements.

### Pop-Up Header Counter Displays

Featuring a raised rear header above the product tray, these displays provide prominent space for branding while keeping product visible and easy to access. They are widely used for lightweight products.

### PDQ Boxes

[Product Display Quickly boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/pdq-boxes/)combine shipping and retail presentation in one unit. They allow products to be placed on shelves with minimal setup. They are commonly used for fast-moving consumer goods and promotional campaigns.

### Pop-Up Displays with Dividers

These displays include custom dividers or partitions that keep products upright, separated, and securely positioned during transport and retail display. They are well suited for bottles, jars, and products offered in many sizes, flavors, or variants.

### Tiered Product Displays

Tiered displays feature stepped rows that raise products placed at the back. This improves visibility of all products. This structure works well for cosmetics, skincare products, collectibles, electronic accessories, and product ranges where every variant should remain visible.

### Display Perforated Boxes

[Display perforated boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/perforated-boxes/) work as both a shipping carton and a retail display. Once the perforated panel is removed, the carton converts into a ready-to-use merchandising unit. This makes it ideal for supermarkets, convenience stores, club stores, and promotional retail displays.

### Front Cut-Out Display Boxes

These [front cut-out display boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/front-cut-out-display-boxes/) have a lowered front panel that provides a clear view of the products while allowing customers to remove them easily. They are commonly used for confectionery, personal care products, stationery, packaged snacks, and other retail items that need continuous visibility and convenient access.

SBS paperboard offers a smooth white surface that reproduces detailed graphics and vibrant brand colors with precision. It is an excellent choice for lightweight retail products and premium consumer packaging.

Corrugated board provides additional rigidity for heavier items, larger product quantities, and displays that must withstand transportation or extended retail use. E-flute construction provides strength while maintaining a refined printed appearance.

Kraft paperboard creates a natural, tactile look that complements organic, handmade, wellness, food, and environmentally conscious brands.

Pop-up displays place your branding where buying decisions are made. They give you valuable space to capture attention at the point of sale. Custom pop-up display boxes are designed to simplify retail merchandising from storage to restocking. Custom pop-up display boxes are retail packaging solutions designed to convert from a closed shipping box into an open product display. They help present products neatly on countertops, shelves, and checkout areas while keeping your branding visible.

### What products can be packed in pop-up display boxes?

These boxes are suitable for cosmetics, snacks, supplements, electronics accessories, stationery, small toys, promotional items, and many other lightweight retail products. Their size, shape, and internal structure can be customized to fit your product securely.

### Can I customize the size and design of the boxes?

Yes. Custom pop-up display boxes can be produced in different sizes, shapes, layouts, and display styles. You can add your logo, brand colors, product details, instructions, promotional messages, and other artwork to create packaging that matches your brand.

faqs.answer: Custom pop-up display boxes are retail packaging solutions designed to convert from a closed shipping box into an open product display. They help present products neatly on countertops, shelves, and checkout areas while keeping your branding visible.

faqs.question: What products can be packed in pop-up display boxes?
faqs.answer: These boxes are suitable for cosmetics, snacks, supplements, electronics accessories, stationery, small toys, promotional items, and many other lightweight retail products. Their size, shape, and internal structure can be customized to fit your product securely.

faqs.question: Can I customize the size and design of the boxes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Custom pop-up display boxes can be produced in different sizes, shapes, layouts, and display styles. You can add your logo, brand colors, product details, instructions, promotional messages, and other artwork to create packaging that matches your brand.

faqs.question: What materials are available for custom pop-up display boxes?
faqs.answer: Common material options include cardstock, kraft paper, corrugated board, and rigid paperboard. The best material depends on your product’s weight, required durability, shipping needs, and preferred appearance.

faqs.question: Which printing and finishing options can I choose?
faqs.answer: You can select full-color printing, spot-color printing, matte or gloss lamination, UV coating, foil stamping, embossing, debossing, and window cut-outs. These finishing options can improve durability and give your display packaging a more premium look.

faqs.question: Are pop-up display boxes easy to assemble?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most pop-up display boxes are supplied flat to save storage and shipping space. They are designed for quick assembly and can usually be opened, folded, and placed on a retail counter without special tools.

## Custom PR Boxes That Capture Media Attention

Making your brand name in the market is one of the most important things to do as a brand. To do so, many brands use custom PR boxes that help capture media attention. The PR boxes are designed to contain product samples, a company profile, product information, branded merchandise, and other free goodies for media members and social media influencers, helping brands get their foot in the door and start building a following in the ecommerce market.

So if you are looking for something that captivates media attention, use custom PR boxes to make a solid statement.

## Impress Influencers with Custom Kit PR Boxes

The purpose of every PR box is simple: to get your brand noticed. That is why your packaging should represent your business in the best possible way. Poor-quality packaging can create a negative first impression before anyone even sees your product. Custom PR boxes help you present your brand professionally and leave a lasting impression from the very first unboxing.

## Make Your PR Box Blog-Worthy With Our Customization Options

Looking for custom PR boxes that reflect your brand professionally? We create premium packaging designed to impress media professionals, influencers, and customers while helping your products stand out from the very first impression.

Here’s how you can design your PR box Packaging:

### Size That Fits Perfectly

Every product deserves packaging that fits perfectly. We manufacture custom PR boxes in any size to match your product dimensions, reducing movement during shipping and creating a clean presentation. Whether you are packing cosmetics, apparel, electronics, or promotional kits, every box is produced with precise measurements for a secure, professional fit.

### Durable & Sustainable Packaging Materials

Quality packaging starts with reliable materials. Our custom media boxes are made from durable, eco-friendly stock that protects your products while supporting sustainable packaging goals.

We offer the following packaging materials for PR Boxes

- Corrugated Cardboard
- Rigid Stock

Each material is selected for strength, print quality, and performance, ensuring your PR kits arrive safely while leaving a positive impression on media professionals and influencers.

High-quality printing transforms ordinary packaging into a memorable brand experience. We use advanced printing methods to produce vibrant colors, sharp graphics, and consistent branding on every custom PR box.

Every print is produced with precision to enhance your brand presentation.

### Premium Finishing Options

Premium finishes give your PR boxes a refined appearance while adding texture and visual appeal. These finishing techniques help your packaging stand out and create a lasting first impression.

We offer the following finishing options for your PR box packaging:

Every finish is applied with precision to give your custom media boxes a premium look and feel.

Custom box inserts add protection, organization, and a premium presentation to every PR box. They keep each product securely in place during shipping while creating a clean and professional unboxing experience. We offer a variety of packaging inserts, including:

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ordering custom pr boxes.

### What are PR Boxes?

PR boxes are custom packaging solutions for sending products to media professionals, influencers, and brand partners. They promote product launches, increase brand awareness, and encourage social media coverage through memorable unboxing experiences.

### Which products can I store in custom PR boxes?

Custom PR boxes can hold cosmetics, skincare, apparel, electronics, candles, food samples, beverages, promotional merchandise, and marketing materials. Each box is tailored to protect and professionally present your products.

### Can I print my artwork inside these boxes?

Yes. We offer inside and outside printing for custom PR boxes. You can add logos, artwork, brand messages, promotional graphics, and product information to create a memorable unboxing experience.

### Can I order a sample before ordering in bulk?

Yes. You can order a sample of your PR packaging boxes to evaluate the size, material, print quality, and overall appearance before placing a bulk order. This helps ensure complete satisfaction with your packaging.

### How soon can I receive my order?

Production usually takes 8–12 business days, depending on your order specifications and quantity. Rush production options may also be available for urgent projects, with fast, reliable shipping.

### Do you have any minimum order quantity for PR Boxes?

No, we do not have a minimum order quantity for your custom PR boxes. You can order as many boxes as you require, or as few as one.

sections.title: Custom PR Boxes That Capture Media Attention
sections.content:
Making your brand name in the market is one of the most important things to do as a brand. To do so, many brands use custom PR boxes that help capture media attention. The PR boxes are designed to contain product samples, a company profile, product information, branded merchandise, and other free goodies for media members and social media influencers, helping brands get their foot in the door and start building a following in the ecommerce market.

So if you are looking for something that captivates media attention, use custom PR boxes to make a solid statement.

Custom PR boxes help you present your brand professionally and leave a lasting impression from the very first unboxing.

sections.title: Premium Finishing Options

Custom box inserts add protection, organization, and a premium presentation to every PR box. They keep each product securely in place during shipping while creating a clean and professional unboxing experience. We offer a variety of packaging inserts, including:

- Luxury Coverings: Dress your boxes in premium textured papers or linen textures. We use specialized coatings to prevent fingerprint smudges and light scuffs.
- Custom Inserts: Hold your products firmly in place with tailored interior trays. Choose from EVA foam, eco-friendly cardboard partitions, or satin-lined plastic. Custom inserts prevent products from shifting while displaying them beautifully.

Your logo is the heart of your business identity. We print your branding with crisp, high-definition digital and offset techniques.

sections.title: What are Custom Presentation Boxes?
sections.content: Unlike standard cartons, these boxes use thick, heavy-duty paperboard. They do not collapse or bend easily. This structural integrity protects high-value items during transport. The exterior features luxury wraps, custom colors, and unique textures. Overall, these boxes serve as both protective [retail boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/) and branded [mailer boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/).

sections.title: Enhance Your Product Presentation with Stylish Presentation Boxes
sections.content:
The right box style changes how customers perceive your item. Different shapes create different emotional reactions during the unboxing process.

We offer stylish presentation box layouts to match your product’s specific identity.

- [Two-Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/)
- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/)
- [Drawer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/)

Each style can be customized to your needs. Specific sizes, printing, and brand-oriented artwork—get ideal [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) to present your promotional products excellently!

sections.title: Quality Materials & Features That Make Durable Presentation Boxes
sections.content:
Material matters when it comes to producing durable boxes. And speaking of presentation boxes, we use high-quality materials to ensure your boxes perform well.

Choose from:

- Corrugated Cardboard
- Rigid Stock

In addition to top-notch materials, every presentation box is designed with innovative features, including:

- Sturdy Construction: The materials and sturdy layout prevent crushing, warping, or denting. Your valuable products stay perfectly secure through complex supply chains.
- Luxury Coverings: Dress your boxes in premium textured papers or linen textures. We use specialized coatings to prevent fingerprint smudges and light scuffs.
- Custom Inserts: Hold your products firmly in place with tailored interior trays. Choose from EVA foam, eco-friendly cardboard partitions, or satin-lined plastic. Custom inserts prevent products from shifting while displaying them beautifully.

sections.title: Presentation Boxes with Logo That Elevate Your Brand Presence
sections.content:
Your logo is the heart of your business identity. We print your branding with crisp, high-definition digital and offset techniques.

To add a luxury touch, choose from our premium finishes below:

- Matte/Gloss Laminations
- Spot UV Coating
- Metallic foil stamping in gold, silver, or rose gold
- Embossing/Debossing

All these excellent finishes make your logo catch the light beautifully. Customers instantly recognize your commitment to superior quality by simply looking at your custom printed presentation boxes.

sections.title: Industries That Use Presentation Packaging Boxes
sections.content:
Luxury presentation packaging is flexible and preferred across many diverse industries. Any business selling premium items can benefit from these high-end boxes.

Which industries use our presentation boxes?

- Corporate & Promotional

These boxes are ideal for high-end onboarding kits, executive gifts, and yearly awards.

- Gift & Luxury

Turn ordinary boutique purchases into prized gifts. Presentation boxes are perfect for premium watches, designer leather goods, and expensive crystalware.

- Cosmetics

Customized presentation boxes are the go-to choice for skincare collections, luxury perfume bottles, and influencer PR packages.

- Food & Bakery

The luxury look of the boxes makes them perfect for premium chocolate assortments, high-end wines, and imported tea collections.

- Retail & E-commerce

Printed presentation boxes bridge the gap between online shopping and luxury retail. They help brands mail-order subscriptions with brand-printed subscription boxes.

- Special Events

The professional layout of these boxes is best suited to wedding invitation suites, charity galas, and exclusive milestone celebrations.

sections.title: Order Custom Presentation Boxes at Wholesale Prices from Us
sections.content:
High-end packaging does not have to break your business budget. We offer premium presentation packaging boxes at competitive wholesale pricing. You can even enjoy a lower per-unit price and bulk-order discounts or order them in a small batch—we have no minimum quantity requirement. Plus, we provide fast turnaround and hassle-free shipping you won’t want to skip.

Contact us today to start designing your custom presentation boxes!

## What are Reverse Tuck End Boxes?

Reverse tuck end boxes are one of the most popular [folding carton](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/folding-cartons/) options preferred by businesses across industries. They are similar to straight tuck ends but feature a reverse bottom end for a more secure closure.

## Why Choose Custom Reverse Tuck End Boxes?

Custom reverse tuck end boxes might look simple, but they come with innovative features that no business can afford to skip.

- Stress-Free Packing

Reverse tuck end closure makes the boxes easy to pack and to close – no knots to tie here. They are ideal for rapid packing of daily orders of all shapes and sizes. High volume, too, no problem.

- Keep Your Products Secure

The tuck end closure of the box is a handy feature. When a box is opened to place products inside, this closure keeps them in place while the box is stored, displayed, or delivered. Thus, every box prevents damage from the product moving around inside the box.

- Shelf Appeal That Turns Heads

Our reverse tuck end boxes are ideal packaging for creating a unique look for your products on the shelf. Their smooth panels, vibrant colors, and designs help create the perfect [custom packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) that make your products stand out.

## Industries That Use Reverse Tuck End Packaging

There are various industries that use reverse tuck-end packaging to pack and store their products. Some of the common and most popular industries are:

- Cosmetics
- Pharmaceuticals
- Electronics
- Food & Beverage
- Retail & Ecommerce

Whatever type of product you need to pack, reverse tuck end boxes ensure it looks stunning every time.

## Reliable Materials for Reliable Custom Boxes

Every durable box starts with the material. Therefore, we use selected, top-quality materials to guarantee each reverse tuck end box is durable and reliable.

You can choose from:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft

And the custom, precise sizing options we offer ensure that you’ll get the perfectly measured box every time. No more worries about your product getting damaged during display, shipping, and storage.

## Custom, Advanced Printing for Reverse Tuck End Boxes with Logo

Spread brand awareness with printed reverse tuck end boxes. Our custom, advanced printing options allow you to showcase your business professionally.

We use:

- Digital and Offset Printing
- CMYK and Pantone Matching Colors

Want to print your logo inside the boxes? Leave it to us; we provide outside, inside, and both-sided printing.

And to make sure your reverse tuck end boxes with logo pop up, don’t skip our excellent finishes, such as:

- Matte/Gloss Lamination
- Foil Stamping
- Spot UV
- Embossing.Debossing

Rest assured that your artwork, your logo, and all branding details will look sharp, clear, and professional.

## Order Reverse Tuck End Boxes with No Minimums from Us!

Getting the best-quality, customized reverse tuck end boxes is easy when you partner with us. Our pricing range is low, and our minimum quantity is zero. Whether you need 50 or 5000 boxes, each box is designed to meet the highest quality standard.

Reverse tuck end boxes are designed with tuck flaps on opposite ends, making them simple to open, close, and assemble.

### What materials do you use to produce reverse tuck end box packaging?

We use durable, reliable materials to produce reverse tuck end boxes, including paperboard, cardboard, and kraft paper.

### What sizes are available for custom reverse tuck end boxes?

We provide reverse tuck-end boxes in custom sizes; you can have them designed to your product's specifications.

### Can you print my logo inside of reverse tuck end boxes?

Yes, we offer outside, inside, and both-sided printing for reverse tuck end boxes.

### Will reverse tuck end boxes protect products during shipping?

Yes, the tuck end closure of reverse tuck end boxes keeps products in place while the box is being stored, displayed, or delivered.

sections.title: What are reverse tuck end boxes?
sections.content: Reverse tuck end boxes are designed with tuck flaps on opposite ends, making them simple to open, close, and assemble.

sections.title: What materials do you use to produce reverse tuck end box packaging?
sections.content: We use durable, reliable materials to produce reverse tuck end boxes, including paperboard, cardboard, and kraft paper.

sections.title: What sizes are available for custom reverse tuck end boxes?
sections.content: We provide reverse tuck-end boxes in custom sizes; you can have them designed to your product's specifications.

sections.title: Can you print my logo inside of reverse tuck end boxes?
sections.content: Yes, we offer outside, inside, and both-sided printing for reverse tuck end boxes.

sections.title: Will reverse tuck end boxes protect products during shipping?
sections.content: Yes, the tuck end closure of reverse tuck end boxes keeps products in place while the box is being stored, displayed, or delivered.

sections.title: What's the minimum order for printed reverse tuck end boxes?
sections.content:
We have no minimum order requirement; you can get printed reverse tuck end boxes in the exact quantity you need.

## Stylish & Unique Rigid Drawer Boxes For Maximum Impact

Rigid drawer boxes are the most popular type of [two piece boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/) that create a unique unboxing experience with a sleek pull-out drawer design. These boxes are designed to showcase your products in a sophisticated manner while leaving a lasting impression on customers.

Their unique appearance makes them perfect for every product that requires a memorable packaging experience. Their sliding mechanism offers full functionality to access the product while providing a clean, modern, and professional look.

Whether you want to store presents, jewelry, beauty products, apparel, or corporate gifts, they instantly elevate your product presentation and brand value.

## Custom Rigid Drawer Boxes: Built To Protect

Rigid drawer boxes are famous for their presentation and their sturdy construction. As their name suggests, they are made from the rigid stock, which consists of two different materials, such as the base and exterior material that provide both protection and a premium presentation of the box.

At Pack Legacy, we use the most durable and sustainable packaging material to manufacture your custom rigid drawer boxes.

For the base of rigid drawer box packaging, we offer the following material options:

- Grey Chipboard: Thick grey board from recycled pulp, known for its solid structure and sturdy base.
- Duplex Chipboard: Two-layer board featuring a smooth coated side and a sturdy uncoated back.
- Thick Cardboard: Heavy-duty board material for extra strength & protection for packaging products.

To make these boxes more presentable with custom artworks, we use the following exterior material options that provide a printable surface for drawer boxes:

- SBS C1S & C2S: High-quality paperboard with one or two coated sides for smooth printing.
- Natural Kraft: Durable Kraft paper, available in brown, black, and white with a natural texture.
- Holographic: Shiny holographic wrap that creates eye-catching, reflective effects.
- Textured: Paper with a raised or patterned surface for a unique tactile feel.
- Metallic: Shiny holographic wrap that creates eye-catching, reflective effects.

## Design Your Own Rigid Drawer Box

We understand how important it is for brands to appear unique and set themselves apart, which is why we offer a wide range of customization options for rigid drawer box packaging. We allow our clients to work closely with our experts to customize every aspect of their rigid drawer packaging to meet their unique brand needs.

We offer the following customization options:

### Custom & Standard Sizes

One box size cannot fit all products, which is why we offer both custom and standard sizes. Here are the standard sizes available for rigid drawer boxes:

- 5″ × 3″ × 1″ for small jewelry items
- 6″ × 6″ × 2″ is perfect for cosmetic and apparel items
- 12″ × 8″ × 3″ perfect luxury products and gourmet food items

If you do not find your box size listed, there’s no need to worry, as we also deal in custom sizes. All you have to do is let our experts know the required drawer box size, and they will manufacture it for you.

### Printing Options

Are you looking to make your rigid drawer boxes more compelling than others? Use our advanced printing techniques, such as digital and offset printing techniques. These printing techniques allow us to print your custom drawer boxes with logo, custom artworks, and other branding elements.

Our printing techniques use the CMYK and Pantone (PMS) color systems to ensure color accuracy and vibrant prints. Also, we use eco-friendly ink options, such as soy-based inks, to ensure that your packaging stays sustainable even after printing.

### Finishing & Add-on Options

Make your custom printed rigid drawer boxes more premium with the right finishing and add-on options. Our finishing and add-on options help in elevating the overall appearance of rigid drawer boxes.

Here are the finishing and add-on options we have to offer:

- Spot UV
- Embossing
- Foil Stamping
- Matte Lamination
- Aqueous Coating
- Gloss Lamination
- Soft Touch Lamination

To further enhance the appearance of your rigid drawer box, we also offer embellishments, including custom inserts, packaging card inserts, die-cut windows, custom labels, and more.

Are you looking for something besides drawer box packaging? Visit and explore our full range of [custom rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/), and select the one that best suits your needs.

## Benefits of Using Custom Rigid Drawer Boxes

Custom rigid drawer boxes offer a premium way to package products while keeping them safe and organized. Their sturdy structure and elegant sliding design create a memorable unboxing experience that adds value to your brand.

- Strong and durable construction for added product protection.
- Premium appearance that helps products look more luxurious.
- Fully customizable with logos, colors, inserts, and finishes.
- Smooth drawer-style opening that improves the customer experience.
- Suitable for cosmetics, jewelry, electronics, gifts, and more.

These boxes also support brand recognition and make products more appealing on retail shelves.

## Start Customizing Wholesale Rigid Boxes With Pack Legacy Today

Pack Legacy is a leading custom box manufacturer that deals in [custom packaging solutions](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/). We provide wholesale rigid drawer boxes for bulk orders. Also, our competitive pricing allows businesses of all sizes to get rigid drawer packaging at affordable rates without compromising box quality.

Ready to order wholesale rigid drawer boxes? Order now and get benefits like free shipping, design support, and no die plate charges.

Common questions about ordering custom rigid drawer boxes.

### What are the material options for rigid drawer packaging?

You can choose from the finest quality materials like chipboard, cardboard, or kraft.

### Can I get the box designed to my specific size?

Yes, your boxes will be accurately measured at the exact size, shape, and dimensions.

### How thick are rigid drawer boxes?

The thickness of the materials ranges from 800-2000gsm, depending on the box size you need.

### What printing techniques do you use?

We use high-resolution, unmatched printing quality, like digital and offset techniques, to present your company’s logo, images, text, and all branding elements.

### What products are best to be presented in a rigid drawer box?

You can present cosmetics, jewelry pieces, watches, or electronics excellently in a rigid drawer box.

sections.title: Stylish & Unique Rigid Drawer Boxes For Maximum Impact
sections.content:
Rigid drawer boxes are the most popular type of [two piece boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/) that create a unique unboxing experience with a sleek pull-out drawer design. These boxes are designed to showcase your products in a sophisticated manner while leaving a lasting impression on customers.

Their unique appearance makes them perfect for every product that requires a memorable packaging experience. Their sliding mechanism offers full functionality to access the product while providing a clean, modern, and professional look.

Whether you want to store presents, jewelry, beauty products, apparel, or corporate gifts, they instantly elevate your product presentation and brand value.

sections.title: Custom Rigid Drawer Boxes: Built To Protect
sections.content:
Rigid drawer boxes are famous for their presentation and their sturdy construction. As their name suggests, they are made from the rigid stock, which consists of two different materials, such as the base and exterior material that provide both protection and a premium presentation of the box.

At Pack Legacy, we use the most durable and sustainable packaging material to manufacture your custom rigid drawer boxes.

For the base of rigid drawer box packaging, we offer the following material options:

- Grey Chipboard: Thick grey board from recycled pulp, known for its solid structure and sturdy base.
- Duplex Chipboard: Two-layer board featuring a smooth coated side and a sturdy uncoated back.
- Thick Cardboard: Heavy-duty board material for extra strength & protection for packaging products.

To make these boxes more presentable with custom artworks, we use the following exterior material options that provide a printable surface for drawer boxes:

- SBS C1S & C2S: High-quality paperboard with one or two coated sides for smooth printing.
- Natural Kraft: Durable Kraft paper, available in brown, black, and white with a natural texture.
- Holographic: Shiny holographic wrap that creates eye-catching, reflective effects.
- Textured: Paper with a raised or patterned surface for a unique tactile feel.
- Metallic: Shiny holographic wrap that creates eye-catching, reflective effects.

sections.title: Design Your Own Rigid Drawer Box
sections.content:
We understand how important it is for brands to appear unique and set themselves apart, which is why we offer a wide range of customization options for rigid drawer box packaging. We allow our clients to work closely with our experts to customize every aspect of their rigid drawer packaging to meet their unique brand needs.

We offer the following customization options:

sections.title: Custom & Standard Sizes
sections.content:
One box size cannot fit all products, which is why we offer both custom and standard sizes. Here are the standard sizes available for rigid drawer boxes:

- 5″ × 3″ × 1″ for small jewelry items
- 6″ × 6″ × 2″ is perfect for cosmetic and apparel items
- 12″ × 8″ × 3″ perfect luxury products and gourmet food items

If you do not find your box size listed, there’s no need to worry, as we also deal in custom sizes. All you have to do is let our experts know the required drawer box size, and they will manufacture it for you.

sections.title: Printing Options
sections.content:
Are you looking to make your rigid drawer boxes more compelling than others? Use our advanced printing techniques, such as digital and offset printing techniques. These printing techniques allow us to print your custom drawer boxes with logo, custom artworks, and other branding elements.

Our printing techniques use the CMYK and Pantone (PMS) color systems to ensure color accuracy and vibrant prints. Also, we use eco-friendly ink options, such as soy-based inks, to ensure that your packaging stays sustainable even after printing.

sections.title: Finishing & Add-on Options
sections.content:
Make your custom printed rigid drawer boxes more premium with the right finishing and add-on options. Our finishing and add-on options help in elevating the overall appearance of rigid drawer boxes.

Here are the finishing and add-on options we have to offer:

- Spot UV
- Embossing
- Foil Stamping
- Matte Lamination
- Aqueous Coating
- Gloss Lamination
- Soft Touch Lamination

To further enhance the appearance of your rigid drawer box, we also offer embellishments, including custom inserts, packaging card inserts, die-cut windows, custom labels, and more.

Are you looking for something besides drawer box packaging? Visit and explore our full range of [custom rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/), and select the one that best suits your needs.

sections.title: Benefits of Using Custom Rigid Drawer Boxes
sections.content:
Custom rigid drawer boxes offer a premium way to package products while keeping them safe and organized. Their sturdy structure and elegant sliding design create a memorable unboxing experience that adds value to your brand.

- Strong and durable construction for added product protection.

These boxes also support brand recognition and make products more appealing on retail shelves.

## Roll End Tuck Top Boxes: The Perfect Retail & E-Commerce Packaging

Roll End Tuck Top (RETT) boxes are among the most popular [folding cartons](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/folding-cartons/), featuring a brilliant one-piece die-cut design. Their layout comes in rolled side panels and a top lid flap that tucks securely into the box.

We ship them completely flat to save you valuable storage space. When you are ready to pack, the box folds up seamlessly. The side panels roll over into the base, and the top lid tucks firmly into the frame. This smart design creates a sturdy, self-locking box that stays closed during transit.

What makes our Roll End Tuck Top Boxes perfect for e-commerce and [retail packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/)?

- Adhesive-Free Assembly

Forget about messy glue, staples, or packing tape. Our custom RETT boxes rely on precise engineering and secure friction locks. You can assemble each box in seconds, speeding up your packing fulfillment lines.

- Enhanced Protection

The roll-end design creates double-walled side panels upon assembly. This dual-layer construction offers incredible crush resistance, making them perfect for durable [mailer boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/) that ship your products safely.

- Better Perceived Value

The attached hinged lid opens smoothly to reveal your products all at once. This clean, organized presentation instantly boosts the perceived value of your products.

## Premium Materials for High-Quality RETT Boxes

We offer a premium selection of top-grade materials to produce high-quality Roll End Tuck Top boxes, including:

- SBS Paperboard
- Corrugated Cardboard
- Kraft Paper

Each material we use is highly durable and eco-friendly. Most importantly, you can choose the ideal material thickness, from 14pt to 24pt. For corrugated cardboard, we offer various fluting thicknesses (E-flute or B-flute) to maximize structural strength.

## Custom Roll End Tuck Top Boxes Available in Every Size

Standard sizes rarely fit unique products perfectly. That is why we manufacture custom-sized Roll End Tuck Top boxes tailored to your exact product dimensions. A snug fit reduces product movement, reduces the need for extra bubble wrap, and lowers your shipping costs. From small cosmetic items to large electronics, we can design the perfect fit for each.

We offer high-definition digital and offset printing to make your logo and artwork pop. To enhance product visibility, our PMS and CMYK color models ensure every box looks vibrant.

sections.title: Roll End Tuck Top Boxes: The Perfect Retail & E-Commerce Packaging
sections.content:
Roll End Tuck Top (RETT) boxes are among the most popular [folding cartons](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/folding-cartons/), featuring a brilliant one-piece die-cut design. Their layout comes in rolled side panels and a top lid flap that tucks securely into the box.

We ship them completely flat to save you valuable storage space. When you are ready to pack, the box folds up seamlessly. The side panels roll over into the base, and the top lid tucks firmly into the frame. This smart design creates a sturdy, self-locking box that stays closed during transit.

What makes our Roll End Tuck Top Boxes perfect for e-commerce and [retail packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/)?

- Adhesive-Free Assembly

Forget about messy glue, staples, or packing tape. Our custom RETT boxes rely on precise engineering and secure friction locks. You can assemble each box in seconds, speeding up your packing fulfillment lines.

- Enhanced Protection

The roll-end design creates double-walled side panels upon assembly. This dual-layer construction offers incredible crush resistance, making them perfect for durable [mailer boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/) that ship your products safely.

- Better Perceived Value

The attached hinged lid opens smoothly to reveal your products all at once. This clean, organized presentation instantly boosts the perceived value of your products.

sections.title: Premium Materials for High-Quality RETT Boxes
sections.content:
We offer a premium selection of top-grade materials to produce high-quality Roll End Tuck Top boxes, including:

- SBS Paperboard
- Corrugated Cardboard
- Kraft Paper

Each material we use is highly durable and eco-friendly. Most importantly, you can choose the ideal material thickness, from 14pt to 24pt. For corrugated cardboard, we offer various fluting thicknesses (E-flute or B-flute) to maximize structural strength.

sections.title: Custom Roll End Tuck Top Boxes Available in Every Size
sections.content: Standard sizes rarely fit unique products perfectly. That is why we manufacture custom-sized Roll End Tuck Top boxes tailored to your exact product dimensions. A snug fit reduces product movement, reduces the need for extra bubble wrap, and lowers your shipping costs. From small cosmetic items to large electronics, we can design the perfect fit for each.

sections.title: Printed Roll End Tuck Top Boxes That Enhance Product Visibility
sections.content:
We offer high-definition digital and offset printing to make your logo and artwork pop. To enhance product visibility, our PMS and CMYK color models ensure every box looks vibrant.

Even better, you can polish your custom Roll End Tuck Top box with excellent finishes, such as:

- Gloss Lamination
- Matte Lamination
- Spot UV
- Foil Stamping
- Embossing/Debossing

sections.content:

More reasons to choose us?

faqs.answer: Custom school boxes are specially designed packaging solutions for school supplies, uniforms, books, or promotional kits, tailored with school branding and eco-friendly materials.

faqs.question: Can the boxes be customized with my business logo and colors?
faqs.answer: Yes! We will print your school logo, mascot, colors, and even motivational designs to make your school boxes unique and engaging.

faqs.question: What materials are available for school packaging boxes?
faqs.answer: We provide high-quality materials to produce school packaging boxes, including cardboard, rigid stock, paperboard, kraft, and corrugated.

faqs.question: Are custom school boxes durable enough for heavy items like books?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our custom school boxes use strong materials and reinforced designs to hold textbooks, uniforms, and bulk supplies safely.

faqs.question: What's the minimum order for custom printed school boxes?
faqs.answer: We have no minimum requirement, you can order custom printed school boxes in the exact quantity you need.

faqs.question: What is the typical production time?
faqs.answer: Our production and shipping take 8–12 working days; rush-order options are also available.

## What are Shelf Ready Packaging Boxes?

While shelf ready boxes (SRP) and display boxes both showcase products in retail, they serve slightly different purposes in the logistics and retail journey.

Have a look at the core difference at a glance.

- Shelf Ready Boxes (SRP)

Designed to function as both shipping containers and retail displays. They travel through the supply chain as a sturdy, sealed shipping box. Once at the store, retail staff easily tear off a perforated section or lid and place the entire box directly onto the standard store shelf.

- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/)

Designed primarily for visual marketing and quick consumer access. They are often set up on [countertops display](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cardboard-counter-top-displays/), as [POP displays](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/pop-up-display-boxes/), or as endcaps. They are built to maximize impulse buys and visual impact, often requiring separate outer packaging during transit.

## Shelf Ready Boxes: Key Features & Benefits

Shelf ready packaging boxes are not generic packaging. We craft them with innovative features to make every box stand out.

- Fast & Easy Stocking: Unpack and display products in seconds. Save valuable team hours during busy peak stocking windows.
- High-Impact Branding: Stop shoppers in their tracks with bold, high-definition printing that makes your brand impossible to miss.
- Built for Ultimate Protection: Keep your products secure and perfect with heavy-duty corrugated board that withstands tough transit.
- Seamless Precision Fit: Eliminate messy displays and spills with custom dimensions tailored specifically to your product line.
- Eco-Friendly: Show customers you care with 100% recyclable, eco-conscious materials that support green initiatives.

## High-Quality Materials for Custom Shelf Ready Boxes That Perform

To ensure every shelf ready box excels, we use only selected, high-quality materials, including:

- Cardstock
- Kraft
- Corrugated Cardboard

You are free to choose a thickness from 12pt to 20pt, depending on your product’s needs. And to provide better protection, we create every box in the exact size and dimensions you need.

## Shelf Ready Boxes with Logo as Your Brand Ambassador

Promote your brand through every printed shelf ready box with our modern printing options, including:

- Offset & Digital Techniques
- PMS & CMYK Colors
- Outside, Inside, and Both-Sided Printing

Create a luxurious tactile feel with sleek matte, gloss, or spot UV finishes. Ultimately, you can draw immediate focus to your logo using metallic foil stamping or elegant debossing.

## Ideal Applications of Our Custom Shelf Ready Boxes

Our custom shelf ready boxes are designed to command attention across a wide variety of retail environments.

- Retail & Supermarkets: Perfect for food items, snacks, spices, and canned goods that need high visibility.
- Cosmetics & Beauty: Elevate beauty displays for lotions, soaps, and skincare products with a clean, organized presentation.
- E-Cigarettes & Small Goods: Keep compact, high-value items neatly arranged so customers can easily grab and buy.
- Countertop & Impulse Displays: Drive last-minute impulse sales right at checkout counters and promotional endcaps.

## Order Shelf Ready Boxes from Us—We Have No MOQs!

We are a reliable name when it comes to getting [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) at wholesale prices without compromising quality. Whether you need shelf ready packaging boxes in bulk or a small batch, every box is designed to meet the highest quality standard.

Request your shelf ready boxes from us today, and enjoy the benefits of:

- Free design support

## What are Shoulder Neck Rigid Boxes?

Shoulder neck rigid boxes, made of rigid material such as cardboard or chipboard, are stylish boxes with an extra neck portion when closed. The lid fits onto the base, forming a sturdy box-like structure that provides supreme product protection. The boxes’ multipurpose design makes them ideal for retail and e-commerce use.

## Deliver a Unique Unboxing Through Customized Shoulder Neck Boxes

We help you customize your boxes, from design to customized shapes, sizes, and printing options. Our die-cutting technique will precisely cut the boxes to the size and shape you need. You can opt for a friction-locked closure mechanism to further secure your products during shipping.

Moreover, our innovative digital and offset printing techniques provide one-sided and double-sided printing options. Also, you can make custom-printed shoulder neck rigid boxes feel more premium by using the right finishing options, such as spot UV, embossing, foil stamping, matte lamination, soft-touch lamination, and more.

To further enhance your unboxing experience, we also offer [custom box inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) that help hold your product in place while enhancing its appeal.

## The Perfect Combination of Practicality and Reusability

Our custom shoulder neck rigid boxes are not just aesthetically pleasing. We produce them by combining practicality and reusability.

The practical design of the boxes makes them perfect for packing various products, such as:

- Jewelry pieces
- Candles
- Electronics
- Perfumes
- Apparel products
- Gifts

Meanwhile, their premium look and feel are perfect for long-term use. Plus, their user-friendly design (easy to open and close) makes customers keep them for storage or reuse. This reusability ensures that your brand remains in the customers’ minds, even after the first purchase.

## Difference Between Shoulder Neck & Two Piece Rigid Boxes

Many mistake shoulder neck boxes with [two piece rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/) as they look similar in appearance. Some of the main differences are as follows:

Feature

Shoulder Neck Rigid Boxes

Two Piece Rigid Boxes

Structure

Consists of three components: a base, a shoulder (neck), and a lid.

Consists of only two components: a base and a separate lid.

Design Appearance

The shoulder section remains visible when the box is closed, creating a layered and premium look.

The lid fully covers the base, giving a simple and classic appearance.

Luxury Appeal

Considered more luxurious and sophisticated due to its distinctive construction.

Elegant and premium, but generally less decorative than shoulder neck boxes.

Product Presentation

Offers a dramatic unboxing experience with the visible neck section enhancing product display.

Provides a straightforward unboxing experience focused on simplicity.

Customization Options

Allows additional branding, color contrast, and design elements on the visible shoulder.

Customization is mainly limited to the lid and base surfaces.

Protection

Provides enhanced product stability and secure lid alignment.

Offers excellent protection but with a simpler closure mechanism.

Manufacturing Complexity

More complex to manufacture due to the additional shoulder component.

Easier and more cost-effective to produce.

Common Uses

Luxury cosmetics, jewelry, premium gifts, electronics, and high-end retail products.

Apparel, gift packaging, confectionery, cosmetics, and general retail products.

Cost

Typically, it is more expensive because of extra materials and assembly requirements.

More affordable compared to shoulder neck rigid boxes.

Shelf Impact

Creates a distinctive premium presence that stands out on retail shelves.

Offers a clean, timeless presentation suitable for a range of industries.

The best part about luxury shoulder boxes is that they can help your business reduce its environmental impact. The cardboard or chipboard material is recyclable and will not harm the environment. As more customers are driven to save the environment, having these eco-friendly boxes will surely strengthen your brand’s loyalty.

sections.title: What are Shoulder Neck Rigid Boxes?
sections.content: Shoulder neck rigid boxes, made of rigid material such as cardboard or chipboard, are stylish boxes with an extra neck portion when closed. The lid fits onto the base, forming a sturdy box-like structure that provides supreme product protection. The boxes’ multipurpose design makes them ideal for retail and e-commerce use.

sections.title: Deliver a Unique Unboxing Through Customized Shoulder Neck Boxes
sections.content:
We help you customize your boxes, from design to customized shapes, sizes, and printing options. Our die-cutting technique will precisely cut the boxes to the size and shape you need. You can opt for a friction-locked closure mechanism to further secure your products during shipping.

Moreover, our innovative digital and offset printing techniques provide one-sided and double-sided printing options. Also, you can make custom-printed shoulder neck rigid boxes feel more premium by using the right finishing options, such as spot UV, embossing, foil stamping, matte lamination, soft-touch lamination, and more.

To further enhance your unboxing experience, we also offer [custom box inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) that help hold your product in place while enhancing its appeal.

sections.title: The Perfect Combination of Practicality and Reusability
sections.content:
Our custom shoulder neck rigid boxes are not just aesthetically pleasing. We produce them by combining practicality and reusability.

The practical design of the boxes makes them perfect for packing various products, such as:

- Jewelry pieces
- Candles
- Electronics
- Perfumes
- Apparel products
- Gifts

Meanwhile, their premium look and feel are perfect for long-term use. Plus, their user-friendly design (easy to open and close) makes customers keep them for storage or reuse. This reusability ensures that your brand remains in the customers’ minds, even after the first purchase.

sections.title: Difference Between Shoulder Neck & Two Piece Rigid Boxes
sections.content:
Many mistake shoulder neck boxes with [two piece rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/) as they look similar in appearance. Some of the main differences are as follows:

Feature

Shoulder Neck Rigid Boxes

Two Piece Rigid Boxes

Structure

Consists of three components: a base, a shoulder (neck), and a lid.

Consists of only two components: a base and a separate lid.

Design Appearance

The shoulder section remains visible when the box is closed, creating a layered and premium look.

The lid fully covers the base, giving a simple and classic appearance.

Luxury Appeal

Considered more luxurious and sophisticated due to its distinctive construction.

Elegant and premium, but generally less decorative than shoulder neck boxes.

Product Presentation

Offers a dramatic unboxing experience with the visible neck section enhancing product display.

Provides a straightforward unboxing experience focused on simplicity.

Customization Options

Allows additional branding, color contrast, and design elements on the visible shoulder.

Customization is mainly limited to the lid and base surfaces.

Protection

Provides enhanced product stability and secure lid alignment.

Offers excellent protection but with a simpler closure mechanism.

Manufacturing Complexity

More complex to manufacture due to the additional shoulder component.

Easier and more cost-effective to produce.

Common Uses

Luxury cosmetics, jewelry, premium gifts, electronics, and high-end retail products.

Apparel, gift packaging, confectionery, cosmetics, and general retail products.

Cost

Typically, it is more expensive because of extra materials and assembly requirements.

More affordable compared to shoulder neck rigid boxes.

Shelf Impact

Creates a distinctive premium presence that stands out on retail shelves.

Offers a clean, timeless presentation suitable for a range of industries.

Need another type of [rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/) to deliver a unique unboxing experience? We can help with that, too!

sections.title: Strengthen Brand’s Loyalty by Being Eco-Friendly
sections.content: The best part about luxury shoulder boxes is that they can help your business reduce its environmental impact. The cardboard or chipboard material is recyclable and will not harm the environment. As more customers are driven to save the environment, having these eco-friendly boxes will surely strengthen your brand’s loyalty.

## What Makes Our Straight Tuck End Boxes Unique?

Straight tuck end boxes are one of the best-selling [folding cartons](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/folding-cartons/). When you order these excellent boxes from us, you can expect them to be of premium quality.

Here are the features that make our STE boxes unique and worth having.

- Same-Direction Folding: Both closure flaps fold toward the back panel to eliminate confusion during product assembly.
- Clean Face Presentation: The closure panels tuck cleanly into the rear. The front face remains completely unbroken, leaving a smooth, flawless canvas for your branding.
- Friction Lock Closures: Specially designed slit-locks secure the tabs tight—no tape, glue, or staples.
- Three-Fold Support: Each opening features dual side dust flaps. A large main tuck flap overlays them. This triple barrier keeps dirt out and increases strong crush resistance.

## Top-Quality Materials for Custom Straight Tuck End Boxes

Sturdy packaging starts with the material. We use only durable, eco-friendly materials to construct your straight tuck end packaging. Choose from:

- SBS Paperboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated

All materials we use offer ultimate protection to ensure your products stay safe and secure during shipping, display, and storage.

## Custom STE Boxes Tailored to Your Exact Size Requirements

No two products are exactly alike. That is why we do not believe in one-size-fits-all packaging.

Our custom size ensures your boxes are designed to your precise millimeter specifications. By having perfectly measured straight tuck end packaging, you won’t need excessive, wasteful void fill. This way, you can optimize your shipping dimensions to lower your postal costs. Simply provide your product length, width, and depth, and we will design a flawless fit.

## Add-Ons That Enhance Product Displays

Standard boxes protect your products, but our [customized boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) help them stand out and sell. With a range of premium add-ons, we enhance your product presentation and turn everyday packaging into a powerful marketing tool.

You can get:

- Window Cutouts: Add a crystal-clear plastic window cutout to your front panel so customers can view your product’s colors and textures without opening the box.
- [Custom Inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/): Molded pulp, foam, or paperboard trays that cradle your product securely in place.
- Hang Tab: An integrated, reinforced cardboard hanging tab at the top to hang your box beautifully on retail pegboard displays.

## Our Luxury Printing & Finishing Options

Make your brand unforgettable with custom printing. We use modern digital and offset printing techniques to achieve flawless color accuracy.

Pair your branded artwork with our premium finish options:

- Matte/Gloss Lamination
- Spot UV
- Foil Stamping
- Embossing/Debossing

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ordering straight tuck end boxes.

### How does a Straight Tuck End Box differ from a Reverse Tuck End Box?

In a Straight Tuck End Box, both the top and bottom flaps tuck in the same direction, whereas in a Reverse Tuck End Box, the flaps tuck in opposite directions. STE boxes offer a more seamless front appearance and are often preferred for high-end packaging.

### How long does it take to manufacture and ship custom STE boxes?

Production time varies depending on design complexity and order quantity. Typically, it takes 7-15 business days, plus shipping time.

### Are these boxes suitable for retail packaging?

Yes, Straight Tuck End Boxes are perfect for retail packaging because they offer a professional look, easy assembly, and secure product protection.

### Do you offer bulk discounts on large orders?

Yes, we provide competitive pricing and discounts on bulk purchases. Contact us for an instant quote.

### Can I get a custom design printed on my Straight Tuck End Box?

Yes, you can fully customize the box with your logo, branding, product information, and artwork using advanced printing techniques.

### Is there a minimum order quantity for custom STE boxes?

There is no minimum order quantity policy, we accommodate both small and large-scale orders.

## Subscription Boxes Designed for Memorable First Impressions

First impressions matter, and your packaging is the first touchpoint customers have with your brand. Our custom subscription boxes are designed to create unforgettable first impressions. Every detail, from the sturdy construction to the custom printing, is crafted to showcase your branding and deliver products in a way that feels premium, organized, and worth anticipating.

With your logo prominently printed on branded subscription boxes, every shipment doubles as a marketing channel. They reinforce brand identity, build customer loyalty, and turn the unboxing experience into something customers remember and share.

## Benefits of Custom Subscription Boxes

Every subscription box offers tremendous benefits, including:

- Fulfillment Efficiency: Standardized dimensions for faster packing.
- Unboxing Experience: Premium finishes and inside printing to delight customers.
- Brand Consistency: Accurate CMYK/Pantone colors across repeat orders.
- Product Protection: Inserts, dividers, and foam keep items secure.
- Marketing Impact: QR codes, campaign inserts, and promotional messages inside.

By combining protection, branding, and efficiency, our custom subscription boxes transform ordinary shipments into extraordinary experiences.

## Unique Subscription Box Styles for Every Brand

No two subscription services are alike, which is why we offer a wide range of box styles to fit your products and audience.

Choose from:

- [Custom Mailer Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/): Perfect for monthly subscriptions like beauty, apparel, books, and wellness.
- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Premium packaging for luxury goods, corporate kits, and collector items.
- [Tray & Sleeve Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/): Sliding reveal design for curated sets, cosmetics, and stationery.
- [Two‑Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): Elegant presentation for gifts, apparel, and premium collections.

From practical mailers to luxury magnetic closures, we help you choose the style and custom size that makes your subscription stand out. Need a custom style? Tell us your requirements, and we’ll create the ideal [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) you need!

## High-Quality Materials for Durable Subscription Packaging Boxes

The right material ensures your packaging looks impressive while keeping products safe in transit.

Therefore, we use only high-quality materials for durable subscription packaging boxes, such as:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Whether you need eco‑friendly kraft or premium rigid board, we match materials to your brand and shipping needs.

## Printing & Finishing Options You Can Get

Consistent branding across every delivery keeps your subscription memorable and professional. We offer advanced printing and finishing techniques to highlight your logo, graphics, and seasonal campaigns.

- Digital & Offset Printing Techniques.
- Color Accuracy: CMYK & Pantone matching for consistent brand colors.
- Exterior Branding: Your logo, product info, barcodes.
- Interior Panels: Seasonal graphics, welcome notes, QR codes.
- Finishes: Matte, gloss, soft‑touch, spot UV, foil stamping, embossing/debossing.

With us, your subscription packaging becomes a canvas for creativity and customer connection.

## Add‑Ons & Custom Features for Subscription Boxes

Beyond box styles and materials, the right add‑ons transform your subscription packaging into a complete brand experience.

Here are add-ons you can get for your subscription boxes:

- Window Cutouts: Showcase your products inside the box without opening.
- Ribbon Pulls & Belly Bands: Elegant finishing details for luxury or seasonal boxes.
- [Dividers](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/cardboard-box-dividers/): Organize multiple products neatly for curated sets.
- [Foam Inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/eva-foam-inserts/): Safeguard fragile or high‑value items.
- Branded Tissue Paper & Wraps: Add a polished, premium touch to apparel or gift subscriptions.

With customizable add‑ons, your subscription boxes go beyond packaging—they become a branded experience that protects products, delights customers, and strengthens loyalty.

## Industries That Choose Custom Subscription Boxes

Our custom subscription boxes fit any product category. Here are the industries that choose these exclusively designed boxes.

- Beauty & Wellness – Skincare kits, cosmetics, wellness products.
- Food & Snacks – Secure layouts for perishable goods.
- Apparel – Folded garments, tissue, branded inserts.
- Books & Stationery – Organized compartments for multiple items.
- Pet Supplies & Promotional Kits – Durable packaging with custom branding.

From beauty kits to pet supplies, we design packaging boxes that adapt to your industry and elevate your brand.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ordering custom subscription boxes.

### What is the best box style for a subscription business?

Corrugated mailer boxes are the most practical option for many ecommerce subscription programs because they combine shipping strength, easy assembly, and large printable surfaces.

### Can I order custom subscription boxes with no minimum quantity?

Yes. You can order a small run for testing or a larger wholesale quantity according to your business requirements.

### Can the boxes be printed on both the inside and outside?

Yes. Printing can be applied to outside, inside, or both sides of the box.

### Can you design inserts for several products?

Yes. Die-cut cardboard, corrugated partitions, foam inserts, velvet-lined compartments, and custom dividers are available.

### Can I request a sample before placing a larger order?

Yes. Plain samples, digitally printed samples, and production-grade samples can be discussed according to the level of testing required.

### What information should I provide?

Provide box dimensions, product weight, quantity, material preference, print coverage, finishes, insert requirements, delivery location, and your required completion date.

### Can I use different artwork for seasonal subscription boxes?

Yes. Seasonal or monthly artwork can be produced using the same approved structure and dieline, subject to the printing method and order quantities.

sections.title: What is the best box style for a subscription business?
sections.content: Corrugated mailer boxes are the most practical option for many ecommerce subscription programs because they combine shipping strength, easy assembly, and large printable surfaces.

sections.title: Can I order custom subscription boxes with no minimum quantity?
sections.content: Yes. You can order a small run for testing or a larger wholesale quantity according to your business requirements.

sections.title: Can the boxes be printed on both the inside and outside?
sections.content: Yes. Printing can be applied to outside, inside, or both sides of the box.

sections.title: Can you design inserts for several products?
sections.content: Yes. Die-cut cardboard, corrugated partitions, foam inserts, velvet-lined compartments, and custom dividers are available.

sections.title: Can I request a sample before placing a larger order?
sections.content: Yes. Plain samples, digitally printed samples, and production-grade samples can be discussed according to the level of testing required.

sections.title: What information should I provide?
sections.content: Provide box dimensions, product weight, quantity, material preference, print coverage, finishes, insert requirements, delivery location, and your required completion date.

sections.title: Can I use different artwork for seasonal subscription boxes?
sections.content:
Yes. Seasonal or monthly artwork can be produced using the same approved structure and dieline, subject to the printing method and order quantities.
