## Maintain Freshness of Every Leaf with Custom Tea Boxes

Premium tea brands need packaging that protects delicate leaves, preserves freshness, and maintains the quality of every blend. Our custom tea boxes are designed to help shield tea products from external exposure while creating a professional retail presentation.

We use durable packaging materials including:

- Paperboard: Lightweight, versatile, and ideal for vibrant retail printing.
- Cardboard: Provides reliable protection for everyday tea packaging.
- Kraft: Offers a natural, eco-friendly appearance for organic and specialty tea brands.
- Corrugated: Adds extra strength for shipping and bulk distribution.
- Rigid Stock: Creates a premium packaging experience for luxury tea collections.

Beyond material selection, our tea packaging can include specialized features that improve product protection:

- High-Barrier Inner Linings: Food-safe protective layers help reduce exposure to air and moisture, keeping loose leaves and tea bags fresher for longer.
- Light Protection: Durable box construction helps minimize light exposure that can affect the quality and appearance of delicate tea leaves.
- Moisture & Odor-Resistant Coatings: Protective coatings help prevent humidity and outside odors from affecting your custom tea blends.

## Beautiful Tea Packaging Styles That Boost Sales

Visual appeal drives first-time purchases. Therefore, we offer a wide range of structurally sound, eye-catching tea box styles tailored to your target audience.

Choose from the popular options below.

- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Classic retail choice with both top and bottom flaps folding into the same side for a seamless front presentation.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Highly efficient design with both flaps closing in opposite directions to optimize assembly speed and shelf durability.
- [Book-Style Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/book-boxes/): Open like a hardcover book, they are ideal for high-end luxury tea collections.
- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Designed with a hidden magnetic snap to enhance the gift appeal of your specialty blends.
- [Gable Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/): Feature a built-in handle, making them perfect for retail tea sets, seasonal promotions, and souvenir shops.
- [Sleeve Tray Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/): Offer an outer sleeve that slides off smoothly, revealing custom interior trays or tea assortments.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): An open-top box layout to showcase multiple tea bags on retail checkout counters.

Each box style can be tailored to your needs and product specifications. Get dividers to separate each tea bag, or get [custom inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) to enhance the visual appeal. You can also browse other styles of our [food boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/), or get your own custom style.

Plain packaging has no capacity to help your brand stand out. We use advanced printing techniques to design your custom tea boxes with logo. Your logo, artwork, product details, graphics, and all branding details will look professional in customers’ eyes.

To grab more attention, you can polish the boxes with excellent finishes, such as:

sections.title: Maintain Freshness of Every Leaf with Custom Tea Boxes
sections.content:
Premium tea brands need packaging that protects delicate leaves, preserves freshness, and maintains the quality of every blend. Our custom tea boxes are designed to help shield tea products from external exposure while creating a professional retail presentation.

We use durable packaging materials including:

- Paperboard: Lightweight, versatile, and ideal for vibrant retail printing.
- Cardboard: Provides reliable protection for everyday tea packaging.
- Kraft: Offers a natural, eco-friendly appearance for organic and specialty tea brands.
- Corrugated: Adds extra strength for shipping and bulk distribution.
- Rigid Stock: Creates a premium packaging experience for luxury tea collections.

Beyond material selection, our tea packaging can include specialized features that improve product protection:

- High-Barrier Inner Linings: Food-safe protective layers help reduce exposure to air and moisture, keeping loose leaves and tea bags fresher for longer.
- Light Protection: Durable box construction helps minimize light exposure that can affect the quality and appearance of delicate tea leaves.
- Moisture & Odor-Resistant Coatings: Protective coatings help prevent humidity and outside odors from affecting your custom tea blends.

sections.title: Beautiful Tea Packaging Styles That Boost Sales
sections.content:
Visual appeal drives first-time purchases. Therefore, we offer a wide range of structurally sound, eye-catching tea box styles tailored to your target audience.

Choose from the popular options below.

- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Classic retail choice with both top and bottom flaps folding into the same side for a seamless front presentation.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Highly efficient design with both flaps closing in opposite directions to optimize assembly speed and shelf durability.
- [Book-Style Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/book-boxes/): Open like a hardcover book, they are ideal for high-end luxury tea collections.
- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Designed with a hidden magnetic snap to enhance the gift appeal of your specialty blends.
- [Gable Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/gable-boxes/): Feature a built-in handle, making them perfect for retail tea sets, seasonal promotions, and souvenir shops.
- [Sleeve Tray Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/): Offer an outer sleeve that slides off smoothly, revealing custom interior trays or tea assortments.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): An open-top box layout to showcase multiple tea bags on retail checkout counters.

Each box style can be tailored to your needs and product specifications. Get dividers to separate each tea bag, or get [custom inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/) to enhance the visual appeal. You can also browse other styles of our [food boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/), or get your own custom style.

sections.title: Stand Out with Printed Tea Packaging Boxes
sections.content:
Plain packaging has no capacity to help your brand stand out. We use advanced printing techniques to design your custom tea boxes with logo. Your logo, artwork, product details, graphics, and all branding details will look professional in customers’ eyes.

To grab more attention, you can polish the boxes with excellent finishes, such as:

- Matte / Gloss Lamination
- Spot UV
- Foil Stamping
- Embossing / Debossing
- Stay Green with Eco-Friendly Tea Packaging

Attract eco-conscious tea lovers with sustainable materials. Our green tea packaging lineup features 100% recyclable paperboard and biodegradable unbleached kraft paper. We pair these earth-friendly substrates with non-toxic inks to lower your environmental footprint without sacrificing premium style.

sections.content:

Request a free quote today and enjoy fast, free shipping for custom tea boxes!

## What are Tray and Sleeve Boxes?

Tray and sleeve boxes are a two-piece packaging solution featuring an open-top inner container that holds the product and an outer wrapper that slides over it. They are widely used for luxury items, cosmetics, subscription kits, and gourmet foods. The box’s layout creates a premium, slide-to-reveal unboxing experience.

## Custom Tray and Sleeve Boxes: Modern Packaging That Pays Off

Investing in our [custom boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) directly grows your business sales. Sleeve and tray boxes offer high value at a low cost. They elevate simple products into premium gifts. The sleek design immediately captures buyers’ attention on crowded retail displays. Accordingly, this style improves customers’ perception of your brand’s quality. And better brand perception means you can command higher prices. It is a styling choice that pays off with loyal customers.

## Maximize Brand Visibility with Printed Tray and Sleeve Boxes

Your packaging tells your company story. The best thing about tray-and-sleeve boxes is that their layout gives you 360-degree space for logos, artwork, and copy. We can print your custom graphics across all four sides of the boxes.

With premium offset and digital printing techniques, your boxes will get crisp details. You can choose a clean matte lamination or a brilliant glossy finish.

Want to stand out more?

- Add shiny metallic foil stamping or raised embossing to add texture.
- Go with spot UV to highlight your design elements.

We can also add clear die-cut windows so buyers can preview your product without opening the box. A simple one-color or full-color printing—tell us how you want your sleeve packaging boxes to be.

## Premium Materials You Can Trust

Whether you use sleeve boxes for [retail packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/) or e-commerce shipments, they require durable raw materials.

Therefore, we use only high-quality material selections, including:

- Cardboard

- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Beyond premium materials, our custom sleeve boxes feature amazing features, including:

- The dense inner tray provides incredible structural protection against drops.

- They block out harmful dust, light, and impact.

With these modern boxes, you can rest assured that your products stay safe from production to customers’ hands.

faqs.answer: Sleeve boxes are a two-piece packaging solution featuring an open-top inner container that holds the product and an outer wrapper that slides over it. They are widely used for luxury items, cosmetics, subscription kits, and gourmet foods.

faqs.question: Do you provide samples for printed tray and sleeve boxes?

faqs.question: Which materials do you use to produce custom tray and sleeve boxes?

faqs.question: What’s the minimum order for customized tray and sleeve boxes?

faqs.answer: Yes, we cut every single tray and sleeve box to order. You can tailor the inner tray dimensions directly to your products.

## Preserve the Exclusive Sweetness with Custom Truffle Boxes

Truffles are, no doubt, everyone’s favorite treat. Yet, they are delicate and heat-sensitive. To ensure your truffles survive the rough shipping, handling, and display journeys, we use food-safe, high-quality materials, including:

- Cardboard
- Paperboard
- Corrugated
- Kraft
- Rigid Stock

But we don’t stop at materials. Our truffle boxes are engineered with protective features that guarantee your treats stay perfect and tasty every time.

- Food-Grade Linings: Interior food-grade linings to preserve the truffles’ flavors.
- Moisture & Odor Resistance: Keep the sweet flavor intact while protecting it from moisture and odor hazards.
- Thermal Insulation: Prevent every truffle from melting until reaching customers’ hands.
- [Custom Inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/packaging-inserts/): Cardboard inserts or dividers to separate each truffle and prevent them from crushing one another during transit.

## Present Better with Stylish Truffle Boxes

Give your premium truffles the best presentation they deserve with our exclusive truffle box styles.

- [Two-Piece Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): A lid-and-base layout that turns truffles into memorable gifts.
- [Straight Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Simple retail packaging with top and bottom flaps folding in the same direction.
- [Reverse Tuck End Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): Cost-effective, efficient box layout with two flaps that tuck in opposite directions.
- [Sleeve and Tray Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/tray-sleeve-boxes/): Feature an outer sleeve that slides elegantly out of the inner tray.
- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Feature hidden magnets for an unforgettable truffle reveal.
- [Drawer-Style Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): A modern drawer closure to deliver fun, interactive unboxing.
- [Display Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/display-boxes/): Showcase multiple truffles in a single, durable box at checkout counters.

Choose the box style you like and customize it to meet your expectations. If you have your own ideas, share them with us and let our packaging team design the most ideal [food boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/) for your high-end truffles.

## Truffle Boxes with Logo: Your Best Brand Advertiser

Want to make your confectionery brand prominent on shelves? All you need is our [custom boxes with logo](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/). With our innovative offset and digital printing techniques, you can print your business name, logo, images, and product details with color accuracy and sharp prints on every truffle box packaging.

For a polished look for custom printed truffle boxes, choose from our luxury finishes:

- Spot UV
- Matte / Gloss Laminations
- Foil Stamping
- Embossing / Debossing

Simply brief us on how you want your custom truffle boxes to look, and we guarantee to exceed your expectations.

## Buy Custom Truffle Boxes at Wholesale Prices from Us

We are dedicated to providing the finest-quality truffle packaging boxes at the lowest possible price. With our wholesale pricing and no minimum quantity requirement, you can save even more.

Request a free quote for custom truffle boxes today, and let us deliver them to your doorstep with fast, free shipping!

## What are Tuck Top Boxes?

Tuck top boxes feature a hinged lid that tucks neatly into the front panel. These boxes open from the top, making them ideal for products that need repeated access or premium presentation. They are easy to assemble, stack beautifully on shelves, and offer a large surface for branding.

## Choose the Right Tuck Top Style

Different products may require different tuck structures.

- [Straight Tuck](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Ideal for cosmetics, skincare, and premium retail products.
- [Reverse Tuck](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): A practical option for lightweight retail items.
- [Auto Bottom](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/auto-lock-bottom-boxes/): Better for faster assembly and products needing stronger bottom support.
- Snap-Lock Bottom: Suitable for candles, jars, and moderately heavier products.
- [Roll End Tuck Top](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/roll-end-tuck-top-boxes/): Provides additional structure for gift sets and product kits.

Our team can recommend the right structure based on your product size, weight, and packing requirements.

## Key Features That Make Custom Tuck Top Boxes Popular

We design every detail of a tuck top box to make your product safer, smarter, and more appealing.

- Dust Flaps: Extra protection against spills or dust.
- Customizable Sizes: Tailored to fit bakery goods, gifts, cosmetics, and more.
- Flat Shipping: Ship flat to save storage space.
- Reusable Appeal: Customers often reuse them, extending your brand visibility.

## High-Quality Materials That Elevate Quality

The material defines the feel and durability of our tuck top packaging boxes. We use only high-quality materials to turn a simple box into a premium brand experience.

Choose from:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each material keeps your custom tuck top boxes durable during shipping, display, and storage.

## Industries That Rely on Tuck Top Packaging Boxes

From bakeries to beauty counters, our tuck top packaging boxes are trusted across industries for their user-friendly layout and charm.

They are perfect for:

- [Bakery Packaging Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) & [Food Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/)
- [Custom Cosmetic Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/) & Beauty Packaging
- [Candle Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/candle-boxes/) & [Customized Gift Packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/gift-boxes/)
- [Retail Product Packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/)

Whatever industry you are in, we can create the ideal tuck top packaging your product deserves.

## Custom Printed Tuck Top Boxes That Promote & Sell

Our [custom printed boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) serve as a blank canvas—where a unique logo, colors, and textures tell your brand story.

To ensure your tuck top boxes with logo promote your brand and sell more products, we use advanced printing options, including:

- Offset & Digital Printing Techniques
- CMYK & PMS Colors
- Outside, Inside, and Both-Sided Printing
- Excellent Finishes: Matte/Glos Lamination, Spot UV, Foil Stamping, Embossing/Debossing

## Why Choose Our Tuck Top Boxes

Businesses choose our tuck top boxes because they deliver both function and flair.

- Premium Presentation: Hinged lid adds elegance.
- Customer Convenience: Easy to open and close.

Investing in custom tuck top boxes means investing in your brand’s future.

sections.title: What are Tuck Top Boxes?
sections.content: Tuck top boxes feature a hinged lid that tucks neatly into the front panel. These boxes open from the top, making them ideal for products that need repeated access or premium presentation. They are easy to assemble, stack beautifully on shelves, and offer a large surface for branding.

sections.title: Choose the Right Tuck Top Style
sections.content:
Different products may require different tuck structures.

- [Straight Tuck](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/straight-tuck-end-boxes/): Ideal for cosmetics, skincare, and premium retail products.
- [Reverse Tuck](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/reverse-tuck-end-boxes/): A practical option for lightweight retail items.
- [Auto Bottom](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/auto-lock-bottom-boxes/): Better for faster assembly and products needing stronger bottom support.
- Snap-Lock Bottom: Suitable for candles, jars, and moderately heavier products.
- [Roll End Tuck Top](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/roll-end-tuck-top-boxes/): Provides additional structure for gift sets and product kits.

Our team can recommend the right structure based on your product size, weight, and packing requirements.

sections.title: Key Features That Make Custom Tuck Top Boxes Popular
sections.content:
We design every detail of a tuck top box to make your product safer, smarter, and more appealing.

- Dust Flaps: Extra protection against spills or dust.
- Customizable Sizes: Tailored to fit bakery goods, gifts, cosmetics, and more.
- Flat Shipping: Ship flat to save storage space.
- Reusable Appeal: Customers often reuse them, extending your brand visibility.

sections.title: High-Quality Materials That Elevate Quality
sections.content:
The material defines the feel and durability of our tuck top packaging boxes. We use only high-quality materials to turn a simple box into a premium brand experience.

Choose from:

- Paperboard
- Cardboard
- Kraft
- Corrugated
- Rigid Stock

Each material keeps your custom tuck top boxes durable during shipping, display, and storage.

sections.title: Industries That Rely on Tuck Top Packaging Boxes
sections.content:
From bakeries to beauty counters, our tuck top packaging boxes are trusted across industries for their user-friendly layout and charm.

They are perfect for:

- [Custom Cosmetic Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/) & Beauty Packaging
- [Candle Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/candle-boxes/) & [Customized Gift Packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/gift-boxes/)
- [Retail Product Packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/)

Whatever industry you are in, we can create the ideal tuck top packaging your product deserves.

To ensure your tuck top boxes with logo promote your brand and sell more products, we use advanced printing options, including:

## What are Two Piece Rigid Boxes?

Two piece rigid boxes are specialized containers made from rigid stock that consist of two main parts, such as a lid and a base. These boxes are ideal for a wide range of products, including candles, electronics, jewelry, retail items, and more.

### What are The Key Features of Two Piece Boxes?

When it comes to showcasing your products in a sophisticated, luxurious manner, the only box style that comes to mind is the 2-piece rigid box. Some of the most popular key features of rigid boxes are as follows:

- Offer a seamless lid opening for a premium unboxing experience.
- High-end appearance that enhances brand value and product perception.
- Fully customizable in size, shape, color, and finishing options.
- Ideal for luxury items like cosmetics, gifts, electronics, and apparel.

Overall, these boxes not only protect the product but also create a strong first impression that enhances the customer experience.

## Combining High-Grade Materials and Intricate Layout

Two-piece rigid boxes contain a bottom tray and a separate top lid. The base is a bottom section that provides structure and support to your products. Meanwhile, the lid is a top section that fits over the base and provides a secure closure.

We create these boxes from high-grade materials like chipboard (a thicker material than cardboard). Their intricate layouts make them perfect for packing, presenting, and shipping valuable products such as electronics, cosmetics, gifts, jewelry, and luxury goods.

Whether you need two piece gift boxes for cosmetics or to store any product, we ensure our boxes serve their purpose.

## Why Choose Customized Rigid 2 Piece Boxes?

These customized boxes we provide come with tremendous benefits, such as:

- Sturdy materials offer optimal product protection
- The printable feature of the boxes helps in branding performance
- They are reusable and environmentally friendly

## Be Unique with Our Two Piece Boxes

No matter what products you sell, being unique is essential. This is why we create ideal boxes that add a unique touch to your products.

The best part is that we also provide complete customization options.

Here is what you can get!

- Impressive design collections to create your exclusive two piece rigid boxes
- Free design support from our experts to help you apply your own design ideas
- Vibrant color combinations with innovative PMS and CMYK color models
- Custom sizes and dimensions to perfectly fit your products inside with advanced die-cutting techniques

Tell us how you want to design your boxes and present your products. If you need another type of [rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/), our packaging team is ready to assist you anytime.

## Impress Customers Easily with Luxury Two Piece Boxes

To increase sales, you should impress market customers with your product display. Once you convince them that your products are excellent, they will not hesitate to pay more. Our custom two-piece boxes are the perfect solution for easily impressing your customers.

To further customize your boxes, we have the following customization options:

The finishes

- Matte and glossy coating
- UV spot
- Embossing and debossing techniques to pop up your brand’s logo or text on printed two piece boxes
- Silver or gold foiling

The add-ons

- Die-cut windows to make your products more visible to customers
- Custom box inserts
- Trendy ribbon pulls or hang tags
- Innovative closure options, including a magnetic closure

When customers see how well you take care of your product display, they will surely want to learn more about your brand.

## A Two Piece Set Up Box: Where Exclusivity Meets Reusability

All the materials we use to create custom two-piece boxes are recycled and sustainable, making them eco-friendly. Moreover, the rigid material’s non-bendable characteristic makes the boxes exclusive and reusable. The sleek, rigid texture will also drive customers to reuse the boxes to pack their valuable products. Thus, you can help protect the environment by reducing packaging waste.

sections.title: What are Two Piece Rigid Boxes?
sections.content: Two piece rigid boxes are specialized containers made from rigid stock that consist of two main parts, such as a lid and a base. These boxes are ideal for a wide range of products, including candles, electronics, jewelry, retail items, and more.

sections.title: What are The Key Features of Two Piece Boxes?
sections.content:
When it comes to showcasing your products in a sophisticated, luxurious manner, the only box style that comes to mind is the 2-piece rigid box. Some of the most popular key features of rigid boxes are as follows:

- Offer a seamless lid opening for a premium unboxing experience.
- High-end appearance that enhances brand value and product perception.
- Fully customizable in size, shape, color, and finishing options.
- Ideal for luxury items like cosmetics, gifts, electronics, and apparel.

Overall, these boxes not only protect the product but also create a strong first impression that enhances the customer experience.

sections.title: Combining High-Grade Materials and Intricate Layout
sections.content:
Two-piece rigid boxes contain a bottom tray and a separate top lid. The base is a bottom section that provides structure and support to your products. Meanwhile, the lid is a top section that fits over the base and provides a secure closure.

We create these boxes from high-grade materials like chipboard (a thicker material than cardboard). Their intricate layouts make them perfect for packing, presenting, and shipping valuable products such as electronics, cosmetics, gifts, jewelry, and luxury goods.

Whether you need two piece gift boxes for cosmetics or to store any product, we ensure our boxes serve their purpose.

sections.title: Why Choose Customized Rigid 2 Piece Boxes?
sections.content:
These customized boxes we provide come with tremendous benefits, such as:

- Sturdy materials offer optimal product protection
- The printable feature of the boxes helps in branding performance
- They are reusable and environmentally friendly

sections.title: Be Unique with Our Two Piece Boxes
sections.content:
No matter what products you sell, being unique is essential. This is why we create ideal boxes that add a unique touch to your products.

The best part is that we also provide complete customization options.

Here is what you can get!

- Impressive design collections to create your exclusive two piece rigid boxes
- Free design support from our experts to help you apply your own design ideas
- Vibrant color combinations with innovative PMS and CMYK color models
- Custom sizes and dimensions to perfectly fit your products inside with advanced die-cutting techniques

Tell us how you want to design your boxes and present your products. If you need another type of [rigid boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/), our packaging team is ready to assist you anytime.

sections.title: Impress Customers Easily with Luxury Two Piece Boxes
sections.content:
To increase sales, you should impress market customers with your product display. Once you convince them that your products are excellent, they will not hesitate to pay more. Our custom two-piece boxes are the perfect solution for easily impressing your customers.

To further customize your boxes, we have the following customization options:

The finishes

- Matte and glossy coating
- UV spot
- Embossing and debossing techniques to pop up your brand’s logo or text on printed two piece boxes
- Silver or gold foiling

The add-ons

- Die-cut windows to make your products more visible to customers
- Custom box inserts
- Trendy ribbon pulls or hang tags
- Innovative closure options, including a magnetic closure

When customers see how well you take care of your product display, they will surely want to learn more about your brand.

sections.title: A Two Piece Set Up Box: Where Exclusivity Meets Reusability
sections.content: All the materials we use to create custom two-piece boxes are recycled and sustainable, making them eco-friendly. Moreover, the rigid material’s non-bendable characteristic makes the boxes exclusive and reusable. The sleek, rigid texture will also drive customers to reuse the boxes to pack their valuable products. Thus, you can help protect the environment by reducing packaging waste.

## Protective Watch Boxes That Safeguard Your Masterpiece

Your watch is delicate. It needs packaging that shields it from scratches, dust, and moisture. Our custom watch boxes feature protective designs that cradle each piece securely.

- Precise, custom sizes that ensure a snug fit.
- Soft [foam inserts](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/eva-foam-inserts/) to prevent movement during transit.
- Reinforced walls that guard against external pressure.
- Moisture‑resistant coatings to keep the shine intact.

Whether shipping across continents or displaying in a boutique, our boxes ensure your watches arrive in flawless condition.

## Elevate Product Presentations with Luxury Watch Packaging

Luxury is in the details. Our watch boxes are crafted to impress at first glance. Glossy finishes, velvet linings, and magnetic closures create a premium unboxing experience. The moment a customer opens the box, they feel your brand’s exclusivity.

Moreover, we also offer embossed logos, metallic foiling, and textured laminations to add a touch of sophistication. Rest assured that every watch box becomes more than packaging—it becomes part of the watch’s story.

## High-Quality Material Options for Every Brand Vision

We understand that every brand has unique needs. That’s why our customized watch boxes come in a wide range of high-quality materials.

Choose from:

- Cardboard: Customizable and highly printable.
- Rigid Stock: Durable, crush‑resistant, perfect for premium branding.
- Paperboard: Lightweight, flexible, and ideal for vibrant printing.
- Corrugated: Strong, layered protection for shipping and e‑commerce.
- Kraft Paper: Rustic, recyclable, appeals to sustainability‑focused buyers.

Each material is carefully selected to balance durability with aesthetics. You can also choose from our thickness range of 0.3mm to 5mm.

## Premium Watch Box Styles That Speak Your Brand Language

We offer premium watch box styles to match your identity.

Explore our unique collections below.

- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Sleek, modern, and easy to open with hidden magnets.
- [Drawer‑Style Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/rigid-drawer-boxes/): Elegant pull‑out design for a luxurious reveal.
- [Two Piece Rigid Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/two-piece-rigid-boxes/): A minimalist lid-and-base design for an exclusive appeal.
- [Shoulder Neck Boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/product/shoulder-neck-rigid-boxes/): A premium three‑piece [rigid box](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/rigid-boxes/) with a lid, base, and inner “shoulder” or “neck.”

Each style is customizable in size, shape, and finish to fit your watches perfectly. Even if you have a specific style you need, we will create the ideal watch packaging boxes for you!

## Watch Boxes with Logo: Maximizing Your Brand Impact

[Custom printed boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/custom-boxes/) tell your brand’s story. Therefore, we provide advanced printing techniques to make your watch boxes with a logo unforgettable:

- Offset Printing: Sharp, high‑quality visuals for detailed designs.
- Digital Printing: Fast, cost‑effective, and vibrant.
- PMS & CMYK Colors.
- Outside, Inside, and Both-Sided Printing.
- Luxury Finishes: Foil Stamping, Spot UV Coating, Matte/Gloss Laminations, Embossing & Debossing.

With our limitless custom printing options, every watch box becomes a marketing tool that reinforces your brand’s prestige.

## Customized Watch Boxes: The Benefits That Go Beyond Packaging

We combine craftsmanship, innovation, and sustainability. Every box is designed with precision, ensuring it reflects the value of the watch inside.

Here are the benefits of choosing our customized watch boxes.

- Enhanced Brand Image: Luxury packaging builds trust and loyalty.
- Customer Satisfaction: Protective features ensure your watches arrive in perfect condition.
- Flexibility: Suitable for retail, gifting, and shipping.
- Memorable Unboxing: Create emotional connections with customers.

## Get Custom Watch Boxes at Wholesale Prices from Us!

Don’t settle for ordinary boxes to present your masterpiece. Our bulk-order and no-minimum options aim to make premium packaging accessible for businesses of all sizes. Choose wholesale watch boxes that protect, impress, and sell—all at affordable prices that fit your budget.

sections.title: Custom White Mailer Boxes: Protection You Can Count On
sections.content:
Crafted from eco‑friendly corrugated cardboard, our white mailer boxes are durable and sustainable. The smooth white surface provides a polished canvas for branding, while the sturdy structure ensures product protection through shipping and handling.

sections.content:
Time is money, and our white mailer packaging boxes save both. The tuck‑flap design allows you to assemble boxes in seconds without glue or tape. Each fold locks neatly into place, creating a secure, professional-looking enclosure.

- Fast setup: Assemble in seconds, no tools required.
- Secure closure: Tuck‑flaps lock tightly for safe shipping.
- Neat presentation: Crisp folds and clean edges enhance brand image.
- Efficient workflow: Ideal for bulk orders and busy fulfillment teams.

This easy assembly process keeps operations smooth, reduces labor time, and ensures every package looks impressive in customers’ eyes.

- Large: 12″ x 9″ x 4″; great for bulkier items, books, or multiple products
- Extra‑Large: 15″ x 12″ x 5″; designed for larger shipments and e‑commerce packaging

Need something unique? Let us know! Our custom sizing options let you design [mailer boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/mailer-boxes/) tailored to your exact product dimensions.

sections.title: Printed White Mailer Boxes That Increase Brand Awareness
sections.content:

## What are Window Boxes?

Custom window boxes are smart packaging solutions that blend visibility and protection. They feature a die‑cut opening, often covered with a transparent film, that lets customers preview the product inside without breaking the seal.

Unlike plain cartons, these boxes serve as both storage and display. They highlight the product’s quality while keeping it safe from dust, handling, and damage.

## Custom Window Boxes: Ideal Use Cases

Our window boxes are widely used in different industries for a wide variety of products, such as:

- [Bakery boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) featuring window cutouts are ideal for showcasing items like cupcakes, cookies, and bread.
- Adding window cutouts to [cosmetic boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/) makes them perfect for makeup, creams, and perfumes.
- [Retail packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/) designed with die-cut windows are best for presenting products like toys, electronics, and accessories
- [Food packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/) for snacks, chocolates, and gourmet treats.

Whatever industry you are in, we can create the ideal window packaging for your product. Inserts, dividers, ribbons, and handles—get the add-ons you need to highlight your product even more!

## High-Quality Materials That Matter

The strength and appeal of our window packaging boxes come from the materials. Crafted from durable cardboard, kraft, corrugated, or rigid stock, they balance strength with style.

To ensure every box meets your packaging needs, you can choose from material thickness ranges of 12-24pt (0.3 to 4 mm). Most importantly, our precise, custom sizing options let you get perfectly measured window boxes for your products.

sections.title: What are Window Boxes?
sections.content:
Custom window boxes are smart packaging solutions that blend visibility and protection. They feature a die‑cut opening, often covered with a transparent film, that lets customers preview the product inside without breaking the seal.

Unlike plain cartons, these boxes serve as both storage and display. They highlight the product’s quality while keeping it safe from dust, handling, and damage.

sections.title: Custom Window Boxes: Ideal Use Cases
sections.content:
Our window boxes are widely used in different industries for a wide variety of products, such as:

- [Bakery boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/bakery-boxes/) featuring window cutouts are ideal for showcasing items like cupcakes, cookies, and bread.
- Adding window cutouts to [cosmetic boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/cosmetic-boxes/) makes them perfect for makeup, creams, and perfumes.
- [Retail packaging boxes](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/retail-boxes/) designed with die-cut windows are best for presenting products like toys, electronics, and accessories
- [Food packaging](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/food-boxes/) for snacks, chocolates, and gourmet treats.

Whatever industry you are in, we can create the ideal window packaging for your product. Inserts, dividers, ribbons, and handles—get the add-ons you need to highlight your product even more!

sections.title: High-Quality Materials That Matter
sections.content:
The strength and appeal of our window packaging boxes come from the materials. Crafted from durable cardboard, kraft, corrugated, or rigid stock, they balance strength with style.

To ensure every box meets your packaging needs, you can choose from material thickness ranges of 12-24pt (0.3 to 4 mm). Most importantly, our precise, custom sizing options let you get perfectly measured window boxes for your products.

sections.title: Custom Printing for Window Boxes with Logo
sections.content:
Add your logo, patterns, or promotional messages with our high‑quality printing. Our custom printing options include offset and digital techniques with PMS & CMYK color models.

You can also polish your printed window boxes with excellent finishes, such as:

- Matte/Gloss Laminations
- Foil Stamping
- Spot UV
- Embossing/Debossing

sections.title: Benefits of Using Custom Window Boxes
sections.content:
Beyong product protection, our custom window boxes offer tremendous marketing benefits your business can get, including:

- Boost product visibility and customer trust
- Enhance product’s shelf appeal with stylish presentation
- Customizable with branding, colors, and finishes
- Cost‑effective yet premium in appearance

pages.content_markdown:
Policies

# Refund and return policy.

Custom packaging is made just for you. Here is how we handle defects, reprints, refunds and cancellations.

## Overview

Every Pack Legacy product is made to your exact specifications, so returns and refunds follow the terms below. Please inspect your shipment as soon as it arrives.

## Inspection window and faulty products

Report any defects, discrepancies or manufacturing variances within three business days of delivery.

Returns, reprints or refunds apply only to products that are faulty or that do not match your approved digital proof. Custom orders cannot be returned for reasons not related to a manufacturing defect.

## Manufacturer-side defects

If a defect is our fault, we will reprint or replace the affected part of your order, or the whole order, at no extra cost. We confirm whether a defect is valid after inspection.

- For a free reprint, ship the complete, unaltered order back to us within seven business days of filing your claim, at your cost.
- Photos or videos of the issue help us resolve your claim faster.

## Client-side errors and partial refunds

Errors that appear on the proof you approved, such as typos, approved dimensions or artwork placement, qualify for a partial refund only if the complete order is returned.

Partial refunds are reduced by the costs already incurred, including:

- Shipping
- Prepress setup and plate making
- Materials and printing time
- Card processing fees

## Order cancellation policy

Cancellation fees depend on how long ago you approved your proof:

Within 4 hours

of proof approval, if manufacturing has not physically started.

Full refund

4 to 12 hours

of proof approval, if prepress or material staging has begun.

After 24 hours

the order can no longer be cancelled or changed.

No cancellation

To cancel, email sales@packlegacy.com with your order reference as soon as possible.

## Contact us

If you have a question about this policy, our team is happy to help.

## Retail Packaging That Sells On The Shelf

The right retail box fits your product, survives handling and makes shoppers reach for it. Here is how to get it right.

### Compare Retail Box Materials

Choose a structure based on your product’s dimensions, weight and closure needs.

- Paperboard and cardboard: Light cartons for cosmetics, personal care and consumer goods, from 14pt to 24pt.
- Kraft: A natural brown paper finish. The right grade depends on construction, weight and printing.
- Corrugated: Fluted board for rigidity and cushioning. E-flute (1/16") gives a smooth retail surface; B-flute (1/8") suits heavier products.
- Rigid chipboard: Premium two-piece and presentation packaging, 30pt and above.

### Custom Printing, Finishes and Add-ons

Print your logo, product name, brand colors and required product information with digital or offset printing in CMYK and Pantone, on the outside, inside or both. Finish with matte or gloss lamination, soft-touch, Spot UV, foil stamping, or embossing and debossing. Die-cut windows and fitted inserts are available depending on the structure.

Need a UPC barcode? Reserve a clear panel and confirm the size and placement against your retailer’s specs. For hanging displays, share the tab design and product weight before approval.

### Retail Shelf and E-Commerce Packaging

Check shelf space, product orientation and barcode placement before approving your design, and add a hanging tab for pegboard displays. Shelf-ready and PDQ boxes move products from the shipping carton to the shelf with less handling. If you also sell online, tell us, as retail boxes may need an outer shipping carton or extra cushioning in transit.

### Order Custom Retail Boxes at Wholesale Prices

Pricing depends on dimensions, material, structure, printing, finishes, inserts and quantity. Standard production takes 8–12 business days after specs and artwork are approved. Include your product dimensions, box style, material, quantity and printing needs when you request a quote. Not sure which style you need? Describe your product and how it will be sold.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering retail boxes.

### How do I choose the correct retail box size?

Measure the length, width and height of your product, including any parts that stick out. The inside of the box must fit the product plus any inserts. Share your measurements and our team will confirm the size before production.

### What material suits heavier retail products?

Corrugated board gives extra structural support, and rigid boxes suit premium presentation. Material, thickness and base design should be chosen together.

### Can retail boxes include UPC barcodes and hanging tabs?

Yes, where the structure supports them. Send your barcode artwork, retailer specs and product weight.

### Can one box work for retail shelves and online orders?

Yes, if it meets both display and shipping needs. Extra cushioning or an outer shipping carton may be needed for transit.

### What is the difference between display boxes and shelf-ready boxes?

Display boxes present products on shelves or counters. Shelf-ready boxes move products from shipping cartons to shelves with less restocking work.

### What should I include in my quote request?

Your product dimensions, box style, material, quantity, printing and finishes, how the box will be used, and any artwork or barcode specs.

### Can I order different sizes for multiple products?

Yes. Share the dimensions and quantity for each product and we will quote them together.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.content: We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering retail boxes.

sections.title: How do I choose the correct retail box size?
sections.content: Measure the length, width and height of your product, including any parts that stick out. The inside of the box must fit the product plus any inserts. Share your measurements and our team will confirm the size before production.

sections.title: What material suits heavier retail products?
sections.content: Corrugated board gives extra structural support, and rigid boxes suit premium presentation. Material, thickness and base design should be chosen together.

sections.title: Can retail boxes include UPC barcodes and hanging tabs?
sections.content: Yes, where the structure supports them. Send your barcode artwork, retailer specs and product weight.

sections.title: Can one box work for retail shelves and online orders?
sections.content: Yes, if it meets both display and shipping needs. Extra cushioning or an outer shipping carton may be needed for transit.

sections.title: What is the difference between display boxes and shelf-ready boxes?
sections.content: Display boxes present products on shelves or counters. Shelf-ready boxes move products from shipping cartons to shelves with less restocking work.

sections.title: What should I include in my quote request?
sections.content: Your product dimensions, box style, material, quantity, printing and finishes, how the box will be used, and any artwork or barcode specs.

sections.title: Can I order different sizes for multiple products?
sections.content: Yes. Share the dimensions and quantity for each product and we will quote them together.

## What Are Rigid Boxes?

Rigid boxes, also called setup boxes, are made from thick cardboard or chipboard. They are a favorite of luxury brands, premium retail and high-end deliveries.

### Key Features of Rigid Boxes

- Pre-assembled: They arrive ready to use.
- Structural strength: They don't collapse under pressure.
- Premium feel: They raise the perceived value of what's inside.
- High-value products: A popular choice for electronics, jewelry and gifts.

### Enhance the Unboxing Experience

Packaging sets expectations. Custom rigid boxes make unboxing feel premium and encourage positive feedback. They also work as gift boxes without extra decoration, and inserts hold every item securely.

### Design Your Own Solid Rigid Boxes

A dedicated product expert works with you one-on-one. Shape and size are fully customizable, printed in CMYK and Pantone (PMS).

- Base board: Duplex chipboard, grey chipboard or thick cardboard.
- Printing surface: SBS C1S & C2S, natural kraft, holographic, metallic or textured paper.

### Premium Finishing & Add-on Options

Embossing, Spot UV, soft touch, gloss or matte lamination and foil stamping add polish and help protect against humidity. Ribbons, handles and magnetic closures are available too.

### Industries That Use Custom Rigid Boxes

Gifting, retail, electronics, cosmetics, jewelry and apparel brands all use rigid boxes to make their products look premium.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering rigid boxes.

### What sets rigid boxes apart from other packaging?

Compared with folding cartons, rigid boxes are sturdier, look more premium and protect better. They are durable, reusable and suit luxury and delicate products.

### What is the minimum order for rigid boxes?

There is no minimum. Order as few or as many boxes as you need.

### Are rigid boxes worth the cost?

Yes, when presentation, durability and perceived value matter. They cost more than standard folding cartons but strengthen your brand and protect your products.

### What products are best for rigid boxes?

Premium gifts, electronics, jewelry, candles and similar products.

### Can I customize the shape of my rigid boxes?

Yes, including round or hexagonal shapes.

### Do I need to assemble rigid boxes?

No. They arrive pre-assembled. Collapsible rigid boxes fold flat for shipping and storage.

sections.title: What Are Rigid Boxes?
sections.content: Rigid boxes, also called setup boxes, are made from thick cardboard or chipboard. They are a favorite of luxury brands, premium retail and high-end deliveries.

sections.title: Key Features of Rigid Boxes
sections.content:
- Pre-assembled: They arrive ready to use.
- Structural strength: They don't collapse under pressure.
- Premium feel: They raise the perceived value of what's inside.
- High-value products: A popular choice for electronics, jewelry and gifts.

sections.title: Enhance the Unboxing Experience
sections.content: Packaging sets expectations. Custom rigid boxes make unboxing feel premium and encourage positive feedback. They also work as gift boxes without extra decoration, and inserts hold every item securely.

sections.title: Design Your Own Solid Rigid Boxes
sections.content:
A dedicated product expert works with you one-on-one. Shape and size are fully customizable, printed in CMYK and Pantone (PMS).

- Base board: Duplex chipboard, grey chipboard or thick cardboard.
- Printing surface: SBS C1S & C2S, natural kraft, holographic, metallic or textured paper.

sections.title: Premium Finishing & Add-on Options
sections.content: Embossing, Spot UV, soft touch, gloss or matte lamination and foil stamping add polish and help protect against humidity. Ribbons, handles and magnetic closures are available too.

sections.title: Industries That Use Custom Rigid Boxes
sections.content: Gifting, retail, electronics, cosmetics, jewelry and apparel brands all use rigid boxes to make their products look premium.

faqs.question: What sets rigid boxes apart from other packaging?
faqs.answer: Compared with folding cartons, rigid boxes are sturdier, look more premium and protect better. They are durable, reusable and suit luxury and delicate products.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order for rigid boxes?
faqs.answer: There is no minimum. Order as few or as many boxes as you need.

faqs.question: Are rigid boxes worth the cost?
faqs.answer: Yes, when presentation, durability and perceived value matter. They cost more than standard folding cartons but strengthen your brand and protect your products.

faqs.question: What products are best for rigid boxes?
faqs.answer: Premium gifts, electronics, jewelry, candles and similar products.

faqs.question: Can I customize the shape of my rigid boxes?
faqs.answer: Yes, including round or hexagonal shapes.

faqs.question: Do I need to assemble rigid boxes?
faqs.answer: No. They arrive pre-assembled. Collapsible rigid boxes fold flat for shipping and storage.

pages.description: Production and shipping timelines, free shipping, rush orders and tracking for Pack Legacy custom packaging orders.
pages.content_markdown:
Policies

# Shipping policy.

When your boxes will be made, when they will ship, and how to follow them to your door.

## How delivery time works

Every order is made to order, so your delivery time has two parts: production time and shipping time.

8–10business days production

2–3business days shipping

10–12business days in total

## Standard production and shipping timelines

- Production takes 8 to 10 business days.
- Shipping takes 2 to 3 business days.
- The total is 10 to 12 business days from final artwork approval.
- Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding major manufacturing holidays.
- Production starts only after your artwork is approved and payment has cleared.

## Free shipping offer

Free standard shipping is applied automatically to qualifying orders that meet the minimum order value at checkout. We ship with trusted carriers including UPS, DHL and FedEx.

## Rush orders

- Rush production takes 6 to 8 business days.
- Expedited shipping is available at checkout.
- Rush fees are listed on your commercial invoice.
- Free shipping does not apply to rush or expedited shipping.

## Tracking information

Once your order passes final quality control and is labeled at our loading dock, we send an automated email with your tracking number and a link to the carrier’s tracking page (UPS, FedEx or DHL). You can also use our [order tracking page](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/track-your-order/).

## Shipping times, locations and restrictions

Transit times vary by location, carrier and order size.

- Please tell us if your delivery address needs a liftgate or has a dedicated loading dock.
- We are not liable for delays caused by severe weather, carrier capacity, or customs clearance on international shipments.

## Contact us

If you have a question about this policy, our team is happy to help.

- Email: sales@packlegacy.com
- Phone: +1 (424) 321-6460
- Address: 520 Vetterlein Ave, Hamilton Township, NJ 08619, USA

Give your bars packaging that sells before the scent. From handmade to luxury, our custom soap boxes look retail-ready and feel premium.

A good soap box shapes how your bar is seen, protects it from dust and moisture to preserve its texture and fragrance, and helps it get noticed faster on the shelf, in sustainable stocks that suit handmade, organic and luxury brands.

## Premium Packaging For Your Soap Bars

Window cutouts, premium textures, finishes and high-quality print give your soaps a professional, retail-ready presentation, whether they are handmade, organic, luxury or part of a subscription.

### Soap Boxes for Every Market

Brands of every size use our soap packaging, including handmade soap makers and artisans, organic and natural brands, luxury retail and spa collections, hotels and hospitality, wholesale and retail chains, and subscription services.

### Box Styles That Make Unboxing Special

- Straight and reverse tuck end boxes: Classic, cost-effective and easy to assemble.
- Sleeve packaging: A sleek sliding design for premium presentation.
- Drawer boxes: A luxury, rigid drawer-style opening.

### Customized to Your Bars and Your Brand

Custom colors, prints and your logo make every bar instantly recognizable on shelves and online. We tailor sizes, shapes, prints and finishes to your bars, with exact sizing for any bar shape, window cutouts for instant visibility and a choice of textures, patterns and finishes.

### Materials and Thickness

We help you choose the right thickness, from 300 to 600 GSM, to protect your bars and keep their shape. Choose from kraft, rigid, cardboard and corrugated stock.

### Printing and Finishes

Every box is precision-made for a consistent fit, and you can add specialty finishes, add-ons, inserts, sleeves and trays, and coatings.

- CMYK full-color printing: Vibrant, precise artwork.
- PMS spot colors: Exact brand color matching.
- Inside and outside printing: Branding visible everywhere.
- Luxury finishes: Matte, gloss, foil stamping, holographic, Spot UV, embossing and debossing.

### Order Your Custom Soap Boxes Today

Fill out the quote form or call us for wholesale soap boxes. Whether you need artisan batches or bulk retail orders, you get consistent quality and fast turnaround on every order.

| Add-ons | Die-cut windows, ribbons |

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered all the common questions you may have before ordering soap boxes.

### What are custom soap boxes, and why do I need them?

They are boxes made to the size of your soap. They protect the bar, improve shelf appeal and help your product stand out in a crowded market.

### Can I order soap packaging in custom sizes?

Yes. We make exact-fit boxes from your soap dimensions so each bar fits securely without extra space.

### Can I add my logo and brand colors?

Yes. You can print logos, patterns and color-matched branding on your boxes.

### Are eco-friendly options available?

Yes. Choose recyclable, biodegradable and compostable materials to highlight your sustainability.

### Do you offer full-color printing and special finishes?

Yes: CMYK full color, PMS spot colors, inside and outside printing, plus foil, Spot UV, embossing and debossing.

### How long does it take to get custom soap boxes?

Typically 8–12 business days, depending on printing, finishes and order size.

Every box is precision-made for a consistent fit, and you can add specialty finishes, add-ons, inserts, sleeves and trays, and coatings.

- Inside and outside printing: Branding visible everywhere.
- Luxury finishes: Matte, gloss, foil stamping, holographic, Spot UV, embossing and debossing.

# Terms and conditions.

Please read these terms before using our website or placing an order. They explain your responsibilities and ours.

## Using this website

By using the Pack Legacy website and services, you agree to these terms and conditions, along with any extra rules that apply to specific sections or services.

We may update this website and these terms at any time without notice. Please check this page from time to time so you know the current terms.

## Copyrights

Copyright © 2025 Pack Legacy. All rights reserved.

You may not copy, reproduce, republish or distribute any material, software, images, products or other content from this website without our written permission.

## Customer content

You are responsible for making sure you have the rights to every design, text, trademark and copyrighted work you send us. By placing an order, you confirm that your products do not infringe anyone’s rights and do not contain defamatory or unlawful material.

- We may refuse to print content we consider objectionable or that appears to belong to a third party.
- You are responsible for keeping your account password secure.
- We may ask for information to confirm your identity or your rights to the content you supply.
- We may disclose content or information where we are legally required to do so.

## Order placement

Once your order is confirmed, it is sent to our press office for production. After that point, no changes can be made to the order.

## Design files

Design files we share by default are 72 DPI (low resolution). If you need high-resolution files, ask for a quote at sales@packlegacy.com.

## Artwork provided by the customer

Please supply artwork in CMYK color at a minimum of 300 DPI.

We are not responsible for color shifts caused by converting RGB files to CMYK, or for blurry or pixelated prints caused by low-resolution artwork.

## Proof and color accuracy

Please review your final proof carefully before approving it. Electronic proofs cannot show transparency or the exact look of finishes.

Printed colors may vary slightly from your screen or artwork, especially on laminated items. We are not responsible for these small differences.

## Order cancellation and refunds

Once an order is approved, production begins. Approved orders are treated as final. For the cancellation windows that apply, please see our [refund and return policy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/refund-and-return-policy/).

## Returns and reprints

- Report any printing issue within 3 working days of receiving your order.
- Send digital photos of the defective product within 7 days.
- To receive a replacement, return at least 99% of the original order within 10 days, at your cost, after receiving written return authorization from us.
- Charges for expedited orders are non-refundable.
- If an error is ours, we will reprint the order. Refunds are not offered in place of a reprint.

## Shipment and delivery

Turnaround time starts once full payment and final artwork are received.

We are not responsible for delays caused by carriers, weather, customs or other events outside our control. If a delay is caused by us, for example an equipment failure, you are entitled to a refund.

See our [shipping policy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/shipping-policy/) for timelines.

## Contact us

sections.content: Design files we share by default are 72 DPI (low resolution). If you need high-resolution files, ask for a quote at sales@packlegacy.com.

sections.title: Artwork provided by the customer
sections.content:
Please supply artwork in CMYK color at a minimum of 300 DPI.

We are not responsible for color shifts caused by converting RGB files to CMYK, or for blurry or pixelated prints caused by low-resolution artwork.

sections.title: Proof and color accuracy
sections.content:
Please review your final proof carefully before approving it. Electronic proofs cannot show transparency or the exact look of finishes.

Printed colors may vary slightly from your screen or artwork, especially on laminated items. We are not responsible for these small differences.

sections.title: Order cancellation and refunds
sections.content: Once an order is approved, production begins. Approved orders are treated as final. For the cancellation windows that apply, please see our [refund and return policy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/refund-and-return-policy/).

sections.title: Returns and reprints
sections.content:

- Send digital photos of the defective product within 7 days.
- To receive a replacement, return at least 99% of the original order within 10 days, at your cost, after receiving written return authorization from us.
- Charges for expedited orders are non-refundable.
- If an error is ours, we will reprint the order. Refunds are not offered in place of a reprint.

sections.title: Shipment and delivery
sections.content:
Turnaround time starts once full payment and final artwork are received.

We are not responsible for delays caused by carriers, weather, customs or other events outside our control. If a delay is caused by us, for example an equipment failure, you are entitled to a refund.

pages.title: Where’s my box?
pages.description: Track your Pack Legacy custom packaging order with DHL, FedEx or UPS. Paste your tracking number to see live delivery updates.
pages.content_markdown:
Order tracking

# Where’s my box?

Paste the tracking number from your shipping email. We’ll spot the carrier and open live updates from UPS, FedEx or DHL.

Tracking number

Track

Carrier:UPSFedExDHL

Your tracking number is in the shipping email we send when your order leaves our facility.

![](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/frame-4-1.png)

Out for delivery Shipped with tracking

Your order’s journey

## From proof to your doorstep.

Tracking starts when your boxes leave our facility. Here is where your order is before that.

1. 01

### Proof approved

Your design is final and payment has cleared.
2. 02

### In production

8–10 business days to print and build your boxes.
3. 03

### Quality check

Every order is inspected before it is packed.
4. 04

### Shipped

We email your tracking number and carrier link.

Tracking email sent
5. 05

### In transit

Usually 2–3 business days with free shipping.
6. 06

### Delivered

Your boxes arrive, ready to fill.

Our carriers

## Track directly with your carrier.

Not sure which one? Match your number to the format below.

![UPS tracking](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/image-1.jpg)

### UPS tracking

Number looks like

1Z + 16 letters and numbers

Example

1Z999AA10123456784

[Open UPS tracking](https://www.ups.com/track?loc=en_US&requester=ST/)

![FedEx tracking](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/image.jpg)

### FedEx tracking

Number looks like

12 or 15 digits

Example

123456789012

[Open FedEx tracking](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking.html)

![DHL tracking](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/image-1-1.png)

### DHL tracking

Number looks like

10 digits (DHL Express)

Example

1234567890

[Open DHL tracking](https://www.dhl.com/us-en/home/tracking.html)

Tracking not working?

## Try these first.

- 1Give it a few hoursCarriers can take up to 24 hours to show the first scan after pickup.
- 2Check the carrierA UPS number won't work on the FedEx site. Your shipping email names the carrier.
- 3Look in spamSearch your inbox and spam folder for “Pack Legacy” or “tracking”.
- 4Copy it exactlyPaste the number without spaces or dashes. Our tracker removes spaces for you.

### Still can’t find your order?

Send us your name and order reference and we’ll check its status for you.

sales@packlegacy.com+1 (424) 321-6460[Contact our team](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/contact-us/)

Shipping questions

## Good to know.

01

### When will I get my tracking number?

Once your order passes final quality control and is labeled for pickup, we email your tracking number with a link to the carrier’s tracking page.

02

### Which carriers do you use?

We ship with UPS, FedEx and DHL. The carrier depends on your location and order size.

03

### My delivery needs a liftgate or loading dock. What should I do?

Please tell us before your order ships, by email at sales@packlegacy.com, so we can arrange the right delivery.

04

### Why is my international order delayed?

International shipments can be held for customs clearance, which is outside our control. See our [shipping policy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/shipping-policy/) for details.

[Read our full shipping policy](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/shipping-policy/)

## Need more boxes?

Reorders are quick. Send us your previous order details and we will get them moving.

[Get a free quote](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/get-a-quote/)[Talk to our team](https://packlegacy-website.vercel.app/contact-us/)
